```ts
export type AutoDecision={kind:'auto';approval_id:string};
export interface CandidatesFilter{source?:ListedSource;issuer_id?:string;document_id?:string}

export type DocumentsDbErrorCode='lease_lost'|'not_eligible'|'revision_exists'|'evidence_incomplete'|'approval_revoked'|'not_publishable'|'invalid_citation'|'decided'|'already_staged'|'binding_conflict'|'invalid_expected_rev'|'stale_plan'|'not_hk_item'|'run_pending'|'invalid_chosen'|'item_not_open'|'too_many_approvals'|'not_found'|'invalid_input'|'cursor_regression'|'unknown';
export class DocumentsDbError extends Error{constructor(public code:DocumentsDbErrorCode,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='DocumentsDbError';}}

export interface DocumentsDb{
 // writes (rpc, one per §4.8 function of migration one)
 reconcileScope(source:ListedSource,rows:DocScopeInput[]):Promise<number>;
 claimSyncLease(issuer:string,source:ListedSource,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;
 insertDocumentVersion(issuer:string,source:ListedSource,batch:string,doc:DocumentInsert,assets:AssetInsert[]):Promise<InsertVersionResult>;
 insertUploadDocument(owner:string,doc:DocumentInsert):Promise<InsertVersionResult>;
 advanceCursor(issuer:string,source:ListedSource,batch:string,mode:'backfill'|'poll',cursor:DocScopeCursor|null,done:boolean,reset?:boolean):Promise<void>;   // never backwards unless reset (P2-4): cursor_regression
 releaseSyncLease(issuer:string,source:ListedSource,batch:string,outcome:'success'|'failed',nextDue:string):Promise<void>;
 reclassifyDocument(document:string,patch:Partial<Pick<DocumentRow,'doc_class'|'classifier_gen'|'fiscal_year'|'fiscal_period'|'period_end'|'filing_source_ref'>>,actor:string):Promise<void>;
 claimExtractLease(document:string,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;
 renewExtractLease(document:string,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;      // holder only, no attempt counted; false = taken over / moved on (P2-7)
 finishExtract(document:string,batch:string,extraction:ExtractionInsert,pages:PageInsert[]):Promise<string>;
 failExtract(document:string,batch:string,code:string):Promise<void>;
 requestExtract(document:string,actor:string):Promise<void>;
 claimCandidatesLease(extraction:string,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;
 renewCandidatesLease(extraction:string,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;  // holder only, no attempt counted (P2-7)
 finishCandidates(extraction:string,batch:string,status:'done'|'failed'):Promise<void>;
 requestCandidatesRegen(filter:CandidatesFilter,actor:string):Promise<number>;
 writeCandidateChecks(extraction:string,batch:string,rows:{candidate_id:string;checks:CheckResult[];checks_passed:boolean}[]):Promise<{written:number;inherited:number}>;
 insertCitation(row:CitationInsert):Promise<string>;
 publishCitations(ids:string[]):Promise<number>;
 insertCandidates(extraction:string,batch:string,rows:CandidateInsert[]):Promise<{inserted:number}>;
 decideCandidate(candidate:string,decision:HumanDecision|AutoDecision):Promise<{status:CandidateStatus}>;
 stageCandidatePublication(candidate:string,pubGen:number,run:string,factId:string):Promise<void>;
 insertApproval(row:Omit<ApprovalRow,'approval_id'|'approved_at'|'revoked_at'>):Promise<string>;
 revokeApproval(approvalId:string):Promise<void>;
 // reads: paged, or bounded with an explicit limit
 documentVersions(source:DocSource,sourceRef:string,page:PageOpts):Promise<Page<DocumentRow>>;
 knownSourceRefs(issuer:string,source:ListedSource,refs:string[]):Promise<Set<string>>;            // refs chunked ≤ 500
 readDocuments(issuer:string,opts:{asOf:string;source?:DocSource;docClass?:DocClass;from?:string;to?:string;allVersions?:boolean}&PageOpts):Promise<Page<DocumentRow>>;
 documentById(id:string):Promise<DocumentRow|null>;
 assetsOf(documentId:string):Promise<AssetRow[]>;                                                  // ≤ 100 (unique per role/filename)
 extractionsOf(documentId:string,page:PageOpts):Promise<Page<ExtractionRow>>;
 extractionById(id:string):Promise<ExtractionRow|null>;
 pagesOf(extractionId:string,pageNos:number[]):Promise<PageRow[]>;                                 // ≤ 100 page numbers
 citationById(id:string):Promise<CitationRow|null>;
 citationsByIds(ids:string[]):Promise<CitationRow[]>;                                              // ≤ 100
 candidatesOf(where:{extractionId:string}|{status:CandidateStatus}|{issuerId:string;status?:CandidateStatus},page:PageOpts):Promise<Page<CandidateRow>>;
 candidateById(id:string):Promise<CandidateRow|null>;
 publicationsOf(where:{candidateIds:string[]}|{runId:string}|{issuerId:string;pubGen:number;state?:PublicationState},page:PageOpts):Promise<Page<PublicationRow>>;
 approvalsFor(extractorRef:string,opts:{limit:number}):Promise<ApprovalRow[]>;                    // > limit rows → DocumentsDbError('too_many_approvals')
 storedDue(limit:number):Promise<DocumentRow[]>;
 candidatesDue(limit:number):Promise<ExtractionRow[]>;
 scopeDue(source:ListedSource,now:string,limit:number):Promise<DocScopeRow[]>;
 scopeRows(source:ListedSource,issuerIds:string[]):Promise<DocScopeRow[]>;
 scopeAll(source:ListedSource):Promise<DocScopeRow[]>;                                            // every row incl. priority 0, issuer_id asc (spec §6.4 retire)
}
export interface ObjectStore{
 put(path:string,bytes:Uint8Array,mime:string):Promise<'created'|'exists'>;
 get(path:string):Promise<Uint8Array>;
 head(path:string):Promise<{bytes:number}|null>;
 signedUrl(path:string,expiresSeconds:number):Promise<string>;
}

// pages.json (spec §7.2); offsets are code points relative to the page text
export interface LayoutItem{text:string;x0:number;x1:number;y:number;h:number;char_start:number;char_end:number}   // one text run; offsets are page code points (C-1)
export interface LayoutLine{index:number;y:number;x0:number;x1:number;text:string;char_start:number;char_end:number;items:LayoutItem[]}   // HTML lines carry one item spanning the line at x=0
export interface LayoutCell{row:number;col:number;text:string;bbox:{x0:number;y0:number;x1:number;y1:number}|null;line_index:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;numeric:boolean}
export interface LayoutTable{header_lines:LayoutLine[];cells:LayoutCell[];row_count:number;col_count:number;col_x0:number[]}
export interface PageLayout{page_no:number;width:number|null;height:number|null;text:string;lines:LayoutLine[];tables:LayoutTable[]}
export interface PagesJson{extractor_version:string;table_algo_version:string;code_version:string;content_sha256:string;has_text_layer:boolean;pages:PageLayout[]}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/db-contract.ts
// Shared DocumentsDb contract (spec §4.8, §4.11): the same scenarios run against memoryDocumentsDb
// (db.test.ts) and pgDocumentsDb (documents.integration.test.ts), so the in-memory rules the unit
// tests rely on are exactly the migration-one SQL functions' rules. Not a test file: it registers
// describe/it only when called. Every scenario creates its own issuer, so it also runs on a shared
// database; global reads (storedDue, candidatesDue, scopeDue) are asserted with `some`/`find`.
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from './types';
import type {AssetInsert,CandidateInsert,CitationInsert,DocScopeCursor,DocumentInsert,DocumentsDb,ExtractionInsert,ListedSource,Page,PageInsert,PageOpts} from './types';

export interface DocsContractHarness{
 db:DocumentsDb;
 /** A pre-created issuer (FK target) for callers that need just one. */
 issuerId:string;
 /** A fresh issuer (pg: an issuers row). */
 issuer():Promise<string>;
 /** A fresh ingest_batches row id. */
 batchId():Promise<string>;
 /** A fresh auth.users id (owners, deciders, approvers). */
 user():Promise<string>;
 /** Moves a lease into the past: sync (issuer + source), extract (document), candidates (extraction). */
 expire(kind:'sync'|'extract'|'candidates',key:string,source?:ListedSource):Promise<void>;
 /** Marks a publication abandoned — a state only migration two's functions produce. */
 abandonPublication(candidateId:string,pubGen:number):Promise<void>;
 close?():Promise<void>;
}

export const sha=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');
/** Code-point length / slice, like PostgreSQL length()/substr() on UTF8. */
export const cpLen=(s:string)=>Array.from(s).length;
export const cpSlice=(s:string,start:number,end:number)=>Array.from(s).slice(start,end).join('');

export function docInsert(o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={}):DocumentInsert{
 const content=sha(randomUUID());
 const ref=o.source_ref??`${Date.now()}${Math.floor(Math.random()*1e6)}_c`;
 return {issuer_id:null,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_ref:ref,form_type:'Annual Report',doc_class:'annual_report',classifier_gen:1,title:'二零二五年年報',language:'zh',
  source_url:`https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0320/${ref}.pdf`,content_sha256:content,bytes:1024,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:`blobs/${content}.pdf`,
  acquisition:{fetched_at:'2026-03-20T10:00:00.000Z',http_status:200,content_type:'application/pdf',content_length:1024,etag:null,last_modified:null,user_agent:'test'},
  published_at:'2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z',published_at_precision:'instant',available_at:'2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-03-20',
  fiscal_year:2025,fiscal_period:'FY',period_end:'2025-12-31',filing_source_ref:null,permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,
  batch_id:randomUUID(),code_version:'test-code',...o};
}
export function assetInsert(o:Partial<AssetInsert>={}):AssetInsert{
 const content=sha(randomUUID());
 return {role:'filing_index',filename:'index.json',source_url:'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1/000000000126000001/index.json',content_sha256:content,bytes:10,
  mime:'application/json',storage_path:`blobs/${content}.json`,acquisition:{fetched_at:'2026-03-20T10:00:00.000Z',http_status:200},...o};
}
export function pageInsert(page_no:number,text:string,o:Partial<PageInsert>={}):PageInsert{
 return {page_no,text,text_hash:sha(text),char_count:cpLen(text),width:595,height:842,line_count:text===''?0:text.split('\n').length,has_tables:false,...o};
}
export function extractionInsert(pageCount:number,o:Partial<ExtractionInsert>={}):ExtractionInsert{
 return {extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:'test-code',has_text_layer:true,page_count:pageCount,
  pages_json_path:`extractions/${sha('c')}/${sha(String(pageCount))}.pages.json`,pages_json_sha256:sha(randomUUID()),...o};
}
/** 'code' of a DocumentsDbError rejection, 'resolved' when it did not reject. */
export const code=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>'resolved',e=>e instanceof DocumentsDbError?e.code:`not_documents_db_error:${String(e)}`);
export async function drain<T>(read:(p:PageOpts)=>Promise<Page<T>>,limit:number):Promise<{rows:T[];pages:number}>{
 const rows:T[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;let pages=0;
 do{const p:Page<T>=await read({cursor,limit});rows.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;pages++;}while(cursor);
 return {rows,pages};
}
export const PAGE_TEXT='損益表 a\u{2000B}b\u{1F600}c 收益 1,234\n毛利 (56)';

export function documentsDbContract(label:string,setup:()=>Promise<DocsContractHarness>):void{
 describe(label,()=>{
  let h:DocsContractHarness;let db:DocumentsDb;
  beforeAll(async()=>{h=await setup();db=h.db;},60000);
  afterAll(async()=>{await h?.close?.();},30000);
  const ready=async(source:ListedSource='hkexnews')=>{
   const iss=await h.issuer();const b=await h.batchId();
   expect(await db.reconcileScope(source,[{issuer_id:iss,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:'00268'}])).toBe(1);
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(iss,source,b,600)).toBe(true);
   return {iss,b};
  };
  const stored=async(o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={},assets:AssetInsert[]=[])=>{
   const source=(o.source??'hkexnews') as ListedSource;const {iss,b}=await ready(source);
   const r=await db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,source,b,docInsert(o),assets);
   expect(r.outcome).toBe('inserted');
   return {iss,b,doc:r.document_id};
  };
  const extracted=async(o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={},texts:string[]=[PAGE_TEXT,'第二頁'],x:Partial<ExtractionInsert>={})=>{
   const s=await stored(o);
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(s.doc,s.b,600)).toBe(true);
   const ext=await db.finishExtract(s.doc,s.b,extractionInsert(texts.length,x),texts.map((t,i)=>pageInsert(i+1,t)));
   return {...s,ext};
  };
  const cite=(doc:string,ext:string,text:string,needle:string,by:CitationInsert['created_by']='extractor',page_no=1)=>{
   const cp=Array.from(text);const start=cp.findIndex((_,i)=>cp.slice(i,i+cpLen(needle)).join('')===needle);
   const end=start+cpLen(needle);
   return db.insertCitation({document_id:doc,extraction_id:ext,page_no,char_start:start,char_end:end,bbox:null,snippet:cpSlice(text,start,end),text_hash:sha(text),created_by:by,created_ref:'test'});
  };
  const factCandidate=async(doc:string,ext:string,o:Partial<CandidateInsert>={}):Promise<CandidateInsert>=>{
   const v=await cite(doc,ext,PAGE_TEXT,'1,234');const l=await cite(doc,ext,PAGE_TEXT,'收益');const t=await cite(doc,ext,PAGE_TEXT,'損益表');
   return {kind:'financial_fact',extractor_kind:'rule',extractor_ref:'hk-facts/1/hk-facts/1.0',natural_key:'revenue::2025-12-31:12M:HKD',
    citations:{value:v,label:l,unit:t,period:[{role:'statement_title',citation_id:t},{role:'column_header',citation_id:t}]},
    payload:{concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'12M',value:'1234000',presented:'1,234',unit:'HKD',scale:'1000',sign_flip:false,
     period_derivation:{rule:'title_duration',title_date:'2025-12-31',column_text:'2025'},consolidation:'consolidated'},
    fingerprint:sha('revenue-1234'),input_snapshot:{content_sha256:sha('x'),pages_json_sha256:sha('y'),page_nos:[1],extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:'test-code'},...o};
  };

  it('sync scope: reconcile counts real changes; the lease is exclusive, renewable and expires; cursor and release need the holder',async()=>{
   const iss=await h.issuer();const b=await h.batchId();const b2=await h.batchId();
   const row={issuer_id:iss,reasons:['in_scope'],priority:10,fetch_key:'00268'};
   expect(await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[row])).toBe(1);
   expect(await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[row])).toBe(0);
   expect(await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{...row,priority:20}])).toBe(1);
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(randomUUID(),'hkexnews',b,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b2,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b2,'backfill',{segment:'2024',last_ref:'r1',settled:[],attempts:{},seq:1},false))).toBe('lease_lost');
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',{segment:'2024',last_ref:'r3',settled:['r2'],attempts:{r4:1},seq:3},false);
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'poll',{segment:'p',last_ref:null,settled:[],attempts:{},seq:1},false);
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'poll',null,false);
   expect((await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0]).toMatchObject({issuer_id:iss,source:'hkexnews',priority:20,reasons:['in_scope'],backfill_cursor:{segment:'2024',last_ref:'r3',settled:['r2'],attempts:{r4:1},seq:3},backfill_done:false,poll_cursor:{},lease_batch_id:b});
   await h.expire('sync',iss,'hkexnews');
   expect(await db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b2,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',null,true))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await code(db.releaseSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,'failed','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'))).toBe('lease_lost');
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b2,'backfill',null,true);
   await db.releaseSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b2,'success','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
   const s=(await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0];
   expect(s).toMatchObject({backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:true,lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_status:'success',next_due_at:'2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
   expect(s.last_success_at).not.toBeNull();
   expect((await db.scopeDue('hkexnews','2029-12-31T23:59:59.000Z',1000)).some(r=>r.issuer_id===iss)).toBe(false);
   expect((await db.scopeDue('hkexnews','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',1000)).some(r=>r.issuer_id===iss)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.scopeRows('cninfo',[iss])).toEqual([]);
   expect(await code(db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,0))).toBe('invalid_input');
   // scopeAll (B-1): every row of the source, priority 0 included, issuer_id ascending
   const iss0=await h.issuer();
   await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:iss0,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:'00002'}]);
   const all=await db.scopeAll('hkexnews');
   expect(all.map(r=>r.issuer_id)).toEqual([...all.map(r=>r.issuer_id)].sort());
   expect(all.find(r=>r.issuer_id===iss0)?.priority).toBe(0);
   expect(all.some(r=>r.issuer_id===iss)).toBe(true);
   expect((await db.scopeAll('cninfo')).some(r=>r.issuer_id===iss)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('advanceCursor never moves backwards without reset (P2-4): stale or missing seq, reopening a finished backfill',async()=>{
   const {iss,b}=await ready();
   const cur=(seq:number,last_ref:string|null='r'):DocScopeCursor=>({segment:'y2026',last_ref,settled:[],attempts:{},seq});
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',cur(5),false);
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',cur(5,'older'),false))).toBe('cursor_regression');
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',cur(4),false))).toBe('cursor_regression');
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',{segment:'y2026'} as unknown as DocScopeCursor,false))).toBe('cursor_regression');
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',{...cur(9),seq:'9'} as unknown as DocScopeCursor,false))).toBe('invalid_input');
   expect((await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0].backfill_cursor).toEqual(cur(5));               // nothing changed
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',cur(6),false);
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',null,true);                                    // completion
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',null,true);                                    // a repeated completion is fine
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',null,false))).toBe('cursor_regression');   // done → not done
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',cur(1),false))).toBe('cursor_regression'); // a backfill cursor after completion
   expect((await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0]).toMatchObject({backfill_done:true,backfill_cursor:{}});
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'backfill',null,false,true);                              // explicit operator reset
   expect((await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0]).toMatchObject({backfill_done:false,backfill_cursor:{}});
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'poll',cur(2),false);
   expect(await code(db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'poll',cur(2),false))).toBe('cursor_regression');
   await db.advanceCursor(iss,'hkexnews',b,'poll',cur(1),false,true);                                // reset may move it back
   expect((await db.scopeRows('hkexnews',[iss]))[0].poll_cursor).toEqual(cur(1));
   await db.releaseSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,'success','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('renewExtractLease / renewCandidatesLease (P2-7): the holder extends without counting an attempt; after a takeover they are false',async()=>{
   const {doc,b}=await stored();const b2=await h.batchId();
   expect(await db.renewExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(false);                                        // not leased
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.renewExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.renewExtractLease(doc,b2,600)).toBe(false);
   expect((await db.documentById(doc))!.extract_attempts).toBe(1);
   await h.expire('extract',doc);
   expect(await db.renewExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);                                         // expired but nobody took over: still ours
   await h.expire('extract',doc);
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b2,600)).toBe(true);                                        // takeover
   expect(await db.renewExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await code(db.finishExtract(doc,b,extractionInsert(1),[pageInsert(1,'x')]))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await code(db.renewExtractLease(doc,b2,0))).toBe('invalid_input');
   const x=await extracted();
   expect(await db.renewCandidatesLease(x.ext,x.b,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(x.ext,x.b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.renewCandidatesLease(x.ext,x.b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect((await db.extractionById(x.ext))!.candidates_attempts).toBe(1);
   await h.expire('candidates',x.ext);
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(x.ext,b2,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.renewCandidatesLease(x.ext,x.b,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await code(db.finishCandidates(x.ext,x.b,'done'))).toBe('lease_lost');
   await db.finishCandidates(x.ext,b2,'done');
   expect(await db.renewCandidatesLease(x.ext,b2,600)).toBe(false);                                  // moved on
  });

   const again=await db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'edgar',b,docInsert({...pick(first),source:'edgar'}),[assetInsert()]);

   expect((await db.assetsOf(doc)).map(a=>[a.role,a.filename,a.document_id])).toEqual([['filing_index','index.json',doc]]);
   expect(await db.assetsOf(v2.document_id)).toEqual([]);
   expect([...await db.knownSourceRefs(iss,'edgar',[first.source_ref,'nope'])]).toEqual([first.source_ref]);
   expect([...await db.knownSourceRefs(await h.issuer(),'edgar',[first.source_ref])]).toEqual([]);
   const p1=await db.documentVersions('edgar',first.source_ref,{limit:1});
   expect(p1.rows.map(r=>r.source_version)).toEqual([1]);expect(p1.nextCursor).not.toBeNull();
   const p2=await db.documentVersions('edgar',first.source_ref,{limit:1,cursor:p1.nextCursor});

   expect(await code(db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'edgar',b,docInsert({source:'edgar',market:'US',language:'en'}),[assetInsert(),assetInsert()]))).toBe('invalid_input');   // same role + filename
   const other=await ready('edgar');
   expect(await code(db.insertDocumentVersion(other.iss,'edgar',other.b,docInsert({...pick(first),content_sha256:sha('v3')}),[]))).toBe('invalid_input');
   await h.expire('sync',iss,'edgar');
   expect(await code(db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'edgar',b,docInsert({source:'edgar',market:'US',language:'en'}),[]))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await code(db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'cninfo',b,docInsert({source:'cninfo'}),[]))).toBe('lease_lost');   // no cninfo scope row
   expect(await db.documentById(randomUUID())).toBeNull();
  });

  it('extract lease: attempts are counted at claim and the claim after a third crash closes the document as extract_failed',async()=>{
   const {doc,b}=await stored();const b2=await h.batchId();const actor=await h.user();
   expect((await db.storedDue(1000)).some(d=>d.document_id===doc)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect((await db.storedDue(1000)).some(d=>d.document_id===doc)).toBe(false);          // leased
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b2,600)).toBe(false);
   await h.expire('extract',doc);expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b2,600)).toBe(true);
   await h.expire('extract',doc);expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect((await db.documentById(doc))!.extract_attempts).toBe(3);
   await h.expire('extract',doc);
   expect((await db.storedDue(1000)).some(d=>d.document_id===doc)).toBe(true);           // not filtered by attempts
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b2,600)).toBe(false);
   expect(await db.documentById(doc)).toMatchObject({status:'extract_failed',extract_lease_until:null,extract_lease_batch_id:null,extract_attempts:3});
   expect(await code(db.failExtract(doc,b,'extract_error'))).toBe('lease_lost');
   await db.requestExtract(doc,actor);
   expect(await db.documentById(doc)).toMatchObject({status:'stored',extract_attempts:0});
   expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,b,600)).toBe(true);
   await db.failExtract(doc,b,'extract_error');                                            // attempt 1 < 3: stays stored
   expect(await db.documentById(doc)).toMatchObject({status:'stored',extract_lease_batch_id:null,extract_attempts:1});
   expect(await code(db.requestExtract(randomUUID(),actor))).toBe('not_found');
  });

  it('citations: code-point offsets, snippet and hash checks; publish only human/module citations of public documents',async()=>{

   expect(await code(db.insertCitation({...base,char_start:utf16,char_end:utf16+2,snippet:PAGE_TEXT.slice(utf16,utf16+2)}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCitation({...base,char_start:0,char_end:cpLen(PAGE_TEXT)+1,snippet:PAGE_TEXT}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCitation({...base,char_start:3,char_end:3,snippet:''}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCitation({...base,char_start:0,char_end:3,snippet:cpSlice(PAGE_TEXT,0,3),text_hash:sha('other')}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCitation({...base,page_no:9,char_start:0,char_end:1,snippet:'損'}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   const other=await extracted();

   const emoji=await db.insertCitation({...base,char_start:Array.from(PAGE_TEXT).indexOf('\u{1F600}'),char_end:Array.from(PAGE_TEXT).indexOf('\u{1F600}')+1,snippet:'\u{1F600}'});
   expect((await db.citationById(emoji))!.snippet).toBe('\u{1F600}');
   expect(await code(db.publishCitations([id]))).toBe('not_publishable');
   const human=await cite(doc,ext,PAGE_TEXT,'毛利','human');
   expect(await db.publishCitations([human,human])).toBe(1);
   expect(await db.publishCitations([human])).toBe(0);
   expect((await db.citationById(human))!.visibility).toBe('public');
   expect(await code(db.publishCitations([human,randomUUID()]))).toBe('not_publishable');
   expect((await db.citationsByIds([emoji,id,randomUUID()])).map(c=>c.citation_id).sort()).toEqual([emoji,id].sort());
   // a private upload's citation can never be published
   const owner=await h.user();const b=await h.batchId();const content=sha(randomUUID());
   const up=await db.insertUploadDocument(owner,docInsert({source:'upload',market:'other',source_url:null,language:null,permission:'private',owner_user_id:owner,batch_id:b,content_sha256:content,storage_path:`blobs/${content}.pdf`}));

   const upExt=await db.finishExtract(up.document_id,b,extractionInsert(1),[pageInsert(1,'研報 目標價 12')]);
   expect(await db.extractionById(upExt)).toMatchObject({candidates_role:'none'});
   const priv=await cite(up.document_id,upExt,'研報 目標價 12','目標價','human');
   expect(await code(db.publishCitations([priv]))).toBe('not_publishable');
  });

  it('candidates: lease, citation references, idempotent insert, checks with human-decision inheritance by fingerprint, human decisions',async()=>{
   const {iss,doc,ext,b}=await extracted();const b2=await h.batchId();const user=await h.user();
   const c1=await factCandidate(doc,ext);
   expect(await code(db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[c1]))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(ext,b,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(ext,b2,600)).toBe(false);
   const c2=await factCandidate(doc,ext,{natural_key:'cost_of_revenue::2025-12-31:12M:HKD',fingerprint:sha('cost')});
   expect(await db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[c1,c2])).toEqual({inserted:2});
   expect(await db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[c1])).toEqual({inserted:0});
   const foreign=await extracted();const fv=await cite(foreign.doc,foreign.ext,PAGE_TEXT,'收益');
   expect(await code(db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[{...c1,natural_key:'x',citations:{...(c1.citations as object),value:fv}}]))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[{...c1,natural_key:'y',citations:{...(c1.citations as object),label:'not-a-uuid'}}]))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[{...c1,natural_key:'z',citations:{value:(c1.citations as {value:string}).value}}]))).toBe('invalid_citation');   // financial_fact needs label/unit/period

   expect(listed.rows).toHaveLength(2);expect(listed.pages).toBe(2);
   const r1=listed.rows.find(r=>r.natural_key===c1.natural_key)!;const r2=listed.rows.find(r=>r.natural_key===c2.natural_key)!;expect(r1).toMatchObject({status:'candidate',checks:[],checks_passed:false,decision_kind:null,batch_id:b,document_id:doc});
   const passed=[{check:'citation_verified',blocking:true,passed:true}];
   expect(await db.writeCandidateChecks(ext,b,[{candidate_id:r1.candidate_id,checks:passed,checks_passed:true},{candidate_id:r2.candidate_id,checks:[{check:'unit_known',blocking:true,passed:false}],checks_passed:false}])).toEqual({written:2,inherited:0});
   expect(await code(db.writeCandidateChecks(ext,b2,[]))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await code(db.decideCandidate(r2.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'}))).toBe('not_eligible');
   expect(await db.decideCandidate(r1.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'})).toEqual({status:'confirmed'});
   expect(await db.decideCandidate(r1.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'})).toEqual({status:'confirmed'});
   expect(await code(db.decideCandidate(r1.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'rejected'}))).toBe('decided');
   expect(await db.decideCandidate(r1.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'candidate'})).toEqual({status:'candidate'});
   expect(await db.candidateById(r1.candidate_id)).toMatchObject({status:'candidate',decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,decided_at:null});
   expect(await db.decideCandidate(r1.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'})).toEqual({status:'confirmed'});
   expect(await db.decideCandidate(r2.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'rejected'})).toEqual({status:'rejected'});
   expect(await code(db.writeCandidateChecks(ext,b,[{candidate_id:r1.candidate_id,checks:passed,checks_passed:true}]))).toBe('decided');
   expect(await code(db.decideCandidate(randomUUID(),{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'}))).toBe('not_found');
   // regeneration under a new extractor_ref: same fingerprint → the human decision is inherited once checks pass
   await db.finishCandidates(ext,b,'done');
   expect(await db.requestCandidatesRegen({document_id:doc},user)).toBe(1);
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(ext,b2,600)).toBe(true);
   expect(await db.insertCandidates(ext,b2,[{...c1,extractor_ref:'hk-facts/2/hk-facts/1.0'},{...c2,extractor_ref:'hk-facts/2/hk-facts/1.0'}])).toEqual({inserted:2});
   const regen=(await drain(p=>db.candidatesOf({extractionId:ext},p),10)).rows.filter(r=>r.extractor_ref==='hk-facts/2/hk-facts/1.0');
   const r3=regen.find(r=>r.fingerprint===c1.fingerprint)!;const r4=regen.find(r=>r.fingerprint===c2.fingerprint)!;
   expect(await db.writeCandidateChecks(ext,b2,[{candidate_id:r3.candidate_id,checks:passed,checks_passed:true},{candidate_id:r4.candidate_id,checks:passed,checks_passed:true}])).toEqual({written:2,inherited:1});
   expect(await db.candidateById(r3.candidate_id)).toMatchObject({status:'confirmed',decision_kind:'human',decided_by:user,inherited_from:r1.candidate_id});
   expect(await db.candidateById(r4.candidate_id)).toMatchObject({status:'candidate',inherited_from:null});   // rejections are not inherited
   expect((await drain(p=>db.candidatesOf({issuerId:iss,status:'confirmed'},p),1)).rows.map(r=>r.candidate_id).sort()).toEqual([r1.candidate_id,r3.candidate_id].sort());
   expect((await drain(p=>db.candidatesOf({status:'rejected'},p),1000)).rows.some(r=>r.candidate_id===r2.candidate_id)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('auto decisions and publications: version-matched unrevoked approvals only; the publication state machine; revocation reverts at staging',async()=>{
   const {iss,doc,ext,b}=await extracted();const user=await h.user();
   expect(await db.claimCandidatesLease(ext,b,600)).toBe(true);
   const base=await factCandidate(doc,ext);
   const mk=(key:string,concept='revenue')=>({...base,natural_key:`${key}::2025-12-31:12M:HKD`,fingerprint:sha(key),payload:{...(base.payload as object),concept}});
   await db.insertCandidates(ext,b,[mk('a'),mk('b'),mk('c','gross_profit'),mk('d'),mk('e')]);
   const rows=(await drain(p=>db.candidatesOf({extractionId:ext},p),10)).rows;
   const byKey=(k:string)=>rows.find(r=>r.natural_key.startsWith(`${k}:`))!.candidate_id;
   const passed=[{check:'citation_verified',blocking:true,passed:true}];

   expect((await drain(p=>db.publicationsOf({issuerId:iss,pubGen:1,state:'staged'},p),1)).rows.map(p=>p.candidate_id)).toEqual([byKey('a')]);

/** The writer-side fields of a stored row, to re-submit the same document. */
function pick(d:Awaited<ReturnType<DocumentsDb['documentById']>>&object):Partial<DocumentInsert>{
 const {document_id:_a,source_version:_b,supersedes_document_id:_c,observed_replacement:_d,status:_e,current_extraction_id:_f,extract_lease_until:_g,extract_lease_batch_id:_h,extract_attempts:_i,created_at:_j,...rest}=d;
 return rest;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/db.test.ts
// memoryDocumentsDb against the shared contract, memory-only rules (injectable clock, validation
// before any write), and the supabaseDocumentsDb wiring (rpc names and arguments, chunking, cursor
// codec, envelope and row normalisation, error mapping, approval_revoked outcome) over a stub client.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

documentsDbContract('memoryDocumentsDb contract',async()=>{
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();
 return {db,issuerId:randomUUID(),issuer:async()=>randomUUID(),batchId:async()=>randomUUID(),user:async()=>randomUUID(),
  expire:async(kind,key,source)=>{if(kind==='sync')db.expireSyncLease(key,source!);else if(kind==='extract')db.expireExtractLease(key);else db.expireCandidatesLease(key);},
  abandonPublication:async(candidate,gen)=>{const p=db._raw.publications.get(`${candidate}|${gen}`);if(p)p.state='abandoned';}};
});

describe('cursor codec and chunking',()=>{
 it('round-trips the sort key and refuses anything else as invalid_input',()=>{
  const c=encodeCursor(['2026-01-01T00:00:00.123456+00:00','b3c1e9d0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001']);
  expect(c).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/);
  expect(decodeCursor(c)).toEqual(['2026-01-01T00:00:00.123456+00:00','b3c1e9d0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001']);
  expect(decodeCursor(encodeCursor([3]))).toEqual([3]);
  for(const bad of ['%%%',encodeCursor([]),Buffer.from('{"a":1}').toString('base64url'),Buffer.from('[null]').toString('base64url')])expect(()=>decodeCursor(bad)).toThrow(DocumentsDbError);
 });
 it('chunks without an empty tail',()=>{

 });
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- supabaseDocumentsDb over a stub client
type Call={fn:string;args:Record<string,unknown>};
function stub(answers:Record<string,(args:Record<string,unknown>)=>unknown>,tables:Record<string,unknown[]>={}){
 const calls:Call[]=[];const queries:{table:string;ops:[string,unknown[]][]}[]=[];
 const client={
  rpc:async(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>{calls.push({fn,args});const a=answers[fn];if(!a)return {data:null,error:{message:`no stub for ${fn}`}};const r=a(args);return r instanceof Error?{data:null,error:{message:r.message,code:'P0001'}}:{data:r,error:null};},
  from:(table:string)=>{
   const q={table,ops:[] as [string,unknown[]][]};queries.push(q);
   const builder:Record<string,unknown>={};
   for(const op of ['select','eq','gt','lte','in','is','or','order','limit','insert','update'])builder[op]=(...a:unknown[])=>{q.ops.push([op,a]);return builder;};
   builder.maybeSingle=()=>Promise.resolve({data:(tables[table]??[])[0]??null,error:null});
   builder.single=()=>Promise.resolve({data:(tables[table]??[])[0]??null,error:null});
   builder.then=(res:(v:unknown)=>unknown,rej:(e:unknown)=>unknown)=>Promise.resolve({data:tables[table]??[],error:null}).then(res,rej);
   return builder;
  },
 };
 return {db:supabaseDocumentsDb(client as unknown as SupabaseClient),calls,queries};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/db.ts
// DocumentsDb over Supabase (spec §4.8, §4.11): every write is one SQL function of migration one
// (rpc) because no role writes the document tables directly (§4.12) — the one exception is
// extraction_approvals (service_role insert + update(revoked_at)). Reads that need a join, the
// server clock or a POST body are service-only SQL functions (read_documents, documents_stored_due,
// extractions_candidates_due, known_source_refs, list_candidates, list_candidate_publications);
// single-table reads use .from() with an explicit limit. Errors: the functions raise with the code
// as the first word of the message (lease_lost 55P03; not_eligible, revision_exists, decided, … P0001;
// not_found P0002; invalid_citation / invalid_input 22023); toDocumentsDbError maps that, check /
// not-null / foreign-key / bad-text violations → invalid_input, the rest → unknown. Cursors are
// opaque base64url JSON arrays of the sort key in the database's own text form (PostgREST keeps
// microseconds), so a keyset never skips or repeats a row. New RPCs are not registered in
// database.types.ts (repo convention): the client is narrowed locally.
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from './types';
import type {
 Acquisition,ApprovalRow,AssetInsert,AssetRow,CandidateRow,CandidatesFilter,CandidateStatus,CitationRow,DocScopeRow,DocumentInsert,DocumentRow,
 DocumentsDb,DocumentsDbErrorCode,ExtractionInsert,ExtractionRow,InsertVersionResult,ListedSource,Page,PageInsert,PageOpts,PageRow,PublicationRow,
} from './types';
export {DocumentsDbError} from './types';
export type {DocumentsDb} from './types';

/** refs per known_source_refs call (spec §4.11). */
export const REFS_CHUNK=500;
/** ids per bounded read (pagesOf, citationsByIds, publicationsOf candidateIds). */
export const IDS_MAX=100;
/** ids per `.in()` filter (URL length). */
export const IN_CHUNK=100;
/** rows per insert_candidates / write_candidate_checks call. */
export const WRITE_CHUNK=500;
const MESSAGE_CODES:readonly DocumentsDbErrorCode[]=['lease_lost','not_eligible','revision_exists','evidence_incomplete','approval_revoked','not_publishable','invalid_citation','decided','already_staged','binding_conflict','invalid_expected_rev','stale_plan','not_hk_item','run_pending','invalid_chosen','item_not_open','too_many_approvals','not_found','invalid_input','cursor_regression'];
const INPUT_STATES=new Set(['23514','23502','23503','22023','22P02','22007','22008','22003']);

export interface PgErrorLike{message?:string;code?:string|null;details?:string|null;hint?:string|null}
/** PostgreSQL / PostgREST error → DocumentsDbError (shared by the Supabase and pg adapters). */
export function toDocumentsDbError(e:PgErrorLike|DocumentsDbError):DocumentsDbError{
 if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError)return e;
 const message=e.message??'';
 const head=message.split(/[\s:]/,1)[0];
 if(e.code==='55P03'||head==='lease_lost')return new DocumentsDbError('lease_lost',message||'lease_lost');
 if((MESSAGE_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(head))return new DocumentsDbError(head as DocumentsDbErrorCode,message);
 if(e.code&&INPUT_STATES.has(e.code))return new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input',message);
 return new DocumentsDbError('unknown',message||'unknown');
}

/** Opaque cursor: base64url(JSON array of the sort key). */
export function encodeCursor(parts:(string|number)[]):string{return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(parts),'utf8').toString('base64url');}
export function decodeCursor(c:string):(string|number)[]{
 let v:unknown;
 try{v=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(c,'base64url').toString('utf8'));}catch{throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input','invalid_cursor');}
 if(!Array.isArray(v)||v.length===0||!v.every(x=>typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='number'))throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input','invalid_cursor');
 return v as (string|number)[];
}
/** Plain chunking (an empty input yields no chunk). */
export function chunk<T>(xs:T[],size:number):T[][]{const out:T[][]=[];for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i+=size)out.push(xs.slice(i,i+size));return out;}
export function checkLimit(limit:number):number{
 if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>PAGE_LIMIT_MAX)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input',`invalid_limit:${limit}`);
 return limit;
}
/** PostgREST answers at most 1,000 rows (max_rows), so a limit + 1 look-ahead read must ask for ≤ 1,000 (codex plan round 1 P2-1). */
export const LOOKAHEAD_MAX=999;
/** Page size of a limit + 1 look-ahead read (documentVersions, extractionsOf), the same in all three implementations: a valid limit capped at LOOKAHEAD_MAX (a short page with a next cursor is an ordinary page). */
export const lookaheadLimit=(limit:number)=>Math.min(checkLimit(limit),LOOKAHEAD_MAX);
/** approvalsFor detects overflow by look-ahead, so its limit itself must be ≤ LOOKAHEAD_MAX (all three implementations). */
export function checkApprovalsLimit(limit:number):number{
 const l=checkLimit(limit);
 if(l>LOOKAHEAD_MAX)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input',`invalid_limit:${limit}`);
 return l;
}
export function checkIds<T>(ids:T[],max=IDS_MAX):T[]{if(ids.length>max)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input',`too_many_ids:${ids.length}`);return ids;}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- row normalisation (PostgREST json, to_jsonb, or pg text)
const ts=(v:unknown):string=>new Date(String(v)).toISOString();
const tsOrNull=(v:unknown):string|null=>v===null||v===undefined?null:ts(v);
const strOrNull=(v:unknown):string|null=>v===null||v===undefined?null:String(v);
const numOrNull=(v:unknown):number|null=>v===null||v===undefined?null:Number(v);
const obj=<T>(v:unknown):T=>(v&&typeof v==='object'?v:{}) as T;

export function documentFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):DocumentRow{
 return {
  document_id:String(r.document_id),issuer_id:strOrNull(r.issuer_id),source:r.source as DocumentRow['source'],market:r.market as DocumentRow['market'],
  source_ref:String(r.source_ref),source_version:Number(r.source_version),supersedes_document_id:strOrNull(r.supersedes_document_id),observed_replacement:r.observed_replacement===true,
  form_type:strOrNull(r.form_type),doc_class:r.doc_class as DocumentRow['doc_class'],classifier_gen:Number(r.classifier_gen),title:String(r.title),
  language:(r.language??null) as DocumentRow['language'],source_url:strOrNull(r.source_url),content_sha256:String(r.content_sha256),bytes:Number(r.bytes),
  mime:r.mime as DocumentRow['mime'],storage_path:String(r.storage_path),acquisition:obj<Acquisition>(r.acquisition),published_at:ts(r.published_at),
  published_at_precision:r.published_at_precision as DocumentRow['published_at_precision'],available_at:ts(r.available_at),available_date:String(r.available_date),
  fiscal_year:numOrNull(r.fiscal_year),fiscal_period:(r.fiscal_period??null) as DocumentRow['fiscal_period'],period_end:strOrNull(r.period_end),
  filing_source_ref:strOrNull(r.filing_source_ref),permission:r.permission as DocumentRow['permission'],owner_user_id:strOrNull(r.owner_user_id),
  license_ref:strOrNull(r.license_ref),status:r.status as DocumentRow['status'],current_extraction_id:strOrNull(r.current_extraction_id),
  extract_lease_until:tsOrNull(r.extract_lease_until),extract_lease_batch_id:strOrNull(r.extract_lease_batch_id),extract_attempts:Number(r.extract_attempts),
  batch_id:String(r.batch_id),code_version:String(r.code_version),created_at:ts(r.created_at),
 };
}
export function assetFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):AssetRow{
 return {asset_id:String(r.asset_id),document_id:String(r.document_id),role:r.role as AssetRow['role'],filename:String(r.filename),source_url:String(r.source_url),
  content_sha256:String(r.content_sha256),bytes:Number(r.bytes),mime:String(r.mime),storage_path:String(r.storage_path),acquisition:obj<Acquisition>(r.acquisition),created_at:ts(r.created_at)};
}
export function extractionFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):ExtractionRow{
 return {extraction_id:String(r.extraction_id),document_id:String(r.document_id),extractor_version:String(r.extractor_version),table_algo_version:String(r.table_algo_version),
  code_version:String(r.code_version),has_text_layer:r.has_text_layer===true,page_count:Number(r.page_count),pages_json_path:String(r.pages_json_path),
  pages_json_sha256:String(r.pages_json_sha256),candidates_role:r.candidates_role as ExtractionRow['candidates_role'],candidates_status:r.candidates_status as ExtractionRow['candidates_status'],
  candidates_attempts:Number(r.candidates_attempts),candidates_lease_until:tsOrNull(r.candidates_lease_until),candidates_lease_batch_id:strOrNull(r.candidates_lease_batch_id),
  batch_id:String(r.batch_id),created_at:ts(r.created_at)};
}
export function pageFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):PageRow{
 return {extraction_id:String(r.extraction_id),page_no:Number(r.page_no),text:String(r.text),text_hash:String(r.text_hash),char_count:Number(r.char_count),
  width:numOrNull(r.width),height:numOrNull(r.height),line_count:Number(r.line_count),has_tables:r.has_tables===true};
}
export function citationFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):CitationRow{
 return {citation_id:String(r.citation_id),document_id:String(r.document_id),extraction_id:String(r.extraction_id),page_no:Number(r.page_no),
  char_start:Number(r.char_start),char_end:Number(r.char_end),bbox:(r.bbox??null) as CitationRow['bbox'],snippet:String(r.snippet),text_hash:String(r.text_hash),
  visibility:r.visibility as CitationRow['visibility'],created_by:r.created_by as CitationRow['created_by'],created_ref:String(r.created_ref),created_at:ts(r.created_at)};
}
export function candidateFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):CandidateRow{
 return {candidate_id:String(r.candidate_id),document_id:String(r.document_id),extraction_id:String(r.extraction_id),kind:r.kind as CandidateRow['kind'],
  extractor_kind:r.extractor_kind as CandidateRow['extractor_kind'],extractor_ref:String(r.extractor_ref),natural_key:String(r.natural_key),
  citations:obj<CandidateRow['citations']>(r.citations),payload:obj<CandidateRow['payload']>(r.payload),fingerprint:String(r.fingerprint),
  checks:(Array.isArray(r.checks)?r.checks:[]) as CandidateRow['checks'],checks_passed:r.checks_passed===true,status:r.status as CandidateStatus,
  decision_kind:(r.decision_kind??null) as CandidateRow['decision_kind'],decided_by:strOrNull(r.decided_by),approval_id:strOrNull(r.approval_id),
  decided_at:tsOrNull(r.decided_at),inherited_from:strOrNull(r.inherited_from),input_snapshot:obj<CandidateRow['input_snapshot']>(r.input_snapshot),
  batch_id:String(r.batch_id),created_at:ts(r.created_at)};
}
export function publicationFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):PublicationRow{
 return {candidate_id:String(r.candidate_id),pub_gen:Number(r.pub_gen),run_id:String(r.run_id),fact_id:String(r.fact_id),state:r.state as PublicationRow['state'],created_at:ts(r.created_at),updated_at:ts(r.updated_at)};
}
export function approvalFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):ApprovalRow{
 return {approval_id:String(r.approval_id),extractor_ref:String(r.extractor_ref),extractor_version:String(r.extractor_version),table_algo_version:String(r.table_algo_version),
  code_version:String(r.code_version),concepts:(Array.isArray(r.concepts)?r.concepts:[]).map(String),gold_sha256:String(r.gold_sha256),
  precision:canonicalDecimal(String(r.precision)),recall:canonicalDecimal(String(r.recall)),report_path:String(r.report_path),approved_by:String(r.approved_by),
  approved_at:ts(r.approved_at),revoked_at:tsOrNull(r.revoked_at)};
}
export function scopeFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):DocScopeRow{
 return {issuer_id:String(r.issuer_id),source:r.source as ListedSource,reasons:(Array.isArray(r.reasons)?r.reasons:[]).map(String),priority:Number(r.priority),
  fetch_key:String(r.fetch_key),backfill_cursor:obj<DocScopeRow['backfill_cursor']>(r.backfill_cursor),backfill_done:r.backfill_done===true,
  poll_cursor:obj<DocScopeRow['poll_cursor']>(r.poll_cursor),next_due_at:ts(r.next_due_at),lease_until:tsOrNull(r.lease_until),lease_batch_id:strOrNull(r.lease_batch_id),
  last_attempt_at:tsOrNull(r.last_attempt_at),last_success_at:tsOrNull(r.last_success_at),last_status:(r.last_status??null) as DocScopeRow['last_status'],updated_at:ts(r.updated_at)};
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- argument builders (shared by the Supabase and pg adapters)
/** DocumentInsert → p_doc (the function supplies id, version, supersedes, status, timestamps). */
export const docArg=(d:DocumentInsert)=>({...d});
export const assetsArg=(a:AssetInsert[])=>a.map(x=>({...x}));
export const extractionArg=(e:ExtractionInsert)=>({...e});
export const pagesArg=(p:PageInsert[])=>p.map(x=>({...x}));
export const approvalArg=(a:Omit<ApprovalRow,'approval_id'|'approved_at'|'revoked_at'>)=>({...a});
export function candidatesWhere(where:{extractionId:string}|{status:CandidateStatus}|{issuerId:string;status?:CandidateStatus}){
 if('extractionId' in where)return {p_extraction:where.extractionId,p_status:null,p_issuer:null};
 if('issuerId' in where)return {p_extraction:null,p_status:where.status??null,p_issuer:where.issuerId};
 return {p_extraction:null,p_status:where.status,p_issuer:null};
}
export function publicationsWhere(where:{candidateIds:string[]}|{runId:string}|{issuerId:string;pubGen:number;state?:PublicationRow['state']}){
 if('candidateIds' in where)return {p_candidate_ids:checkIds(where.candidateIds),p_run:null,p_issuer:null,p_pub_gen:null,p_state:null};
 if('runId' in where)return {p_candidate_ids:null,p_run:where.runId,p_issuer:null,p_pub_gen:null,p_state:null};
 return {p_candidate_ids:null,p_run:null,p_issuer:where.issuerId,p_pub_gen:where.pubGen,p_state:where.state??null};
}
export const regenFilter=(f:CandidatesFilter)=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(f).filter(([,v])=>v!==undefined));
/** Envelope of read_documents / list_* → Page (the SQL cursor object becomes an opaque string). */
export interface Envelope{rows:Record<string,unknown>[];next_cursor:Record<string,unknown>|null}
export function pageOf<T>(env:Envelope,map:(r:Record<string,unknown>)=>T,keys:string[]):Page<T>{
 const nc=env.next_cursor;
 return {rows:(env.rows??[]).map(map),nextCursor:nc?encodeCursor(keys.map(k=>nc[k] as string|number)):null};
}
/** Opaque cursor → the SQL cursor object of read_documents / list_* (keys in order). */
export function sqlCursor(cursor:string|null|undefined,keys:string[]):Record<string,string|number>|null{
 if(!cursor)return null;
 const parts=decodeCursor(cursor);
 if(parts.length!==keys.length)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input','invalid_cursor');
 return Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k,i)=>[k,parts[i]]));
}
export const READ_DOC_KEYS=['available_at','document_id'];
export const CANDIDATE_KEYS=['created_at','candidate_id'];
export const PUBLICATION_KEYS=['candidate_id','pub_gen'];
export function readDocumentsArgs(issuer:string,o:Parameters<DocumentsDb['readDocuments']>[1]){
 return {p_issuer:issuer,p_as_of:o.asOf,p_source:o.source??null,p_doc_class:o.docClass??null,p_from:o.from??null,p_to:o.to??null,
  p_cursor:sqlCursor(o.cursor,READ_DOC_KEYS),p_limit:checkLimit(o.limit),p_all_versions:o.allVersions===true};
}
/** Keyset slice of an ordered page read with limit + 1 rows: the extra row only signals "more". */
export function sliceRows<R,T>(raw:R[],limit:number,map:(r:R)=>T,key:(r:R)=>(string|number)[]):Page<T>{
 const more=raw.length>limit;const kept=more?raw.slice(0,limit):raw;
 return {rows:kept.map(map),nextCursor:more?encodeCursor(key(kept[kept.length-1])):null};
}

interface RpcResult{data:unknown;error:PgErrorLike|null}
// The query builder is left untyped on purpose (same as src/lib/facts/db.ts).
interface NarrowClient{rpc:(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>PromiseLike<RpcResult>;from:(table:string)=>any}

export function supabaseDocumentsDb(client:SupabaseClient):DocumentsDb{
 const c=client as unknown as NarrowClient;
 const call=async<T>(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<T>=>{const {data,error}=await c.rpc(fn,args);if(error)throw toDocumentsDbError(error);return data as T;};
 const rows=async(q:PromiseLike<RpcResult>):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>=>{const {data,error}=await q;if(error)throw toDocumentsDbError(error);return (data??[]) as Record<string,unknown>[];};
 const maybe=async(q:PromiseLike<RpcResult>):Promise<Record<string,unknown>|null>=>{const {data,error}=await q;if(error)throw toDocumentsDbError(error);return (data??null) as Record<string,unknown>|null;};
 return {
  async reconcileScope(source,input){return Number(await call('reconcile_document_sync_scope',{p_source:source,p_rows:input}));},
  async claimSyncLease(issuer,source,batch,ttl){return (await call('claim_document_sync_lease',{p_issuer:issuer,p_source:source,p_batch:batch,p_ttl:ttl}))===true;},
  insertDocumentVersion:(issuer,source,batch,doc,assets)=>call<InsertVersionResult>('insert_document_version',{p_issuer:issuer,p_source:source,p_batch:batch,p_doc:docArg(doc),p_assets:assetsArg(assets)}),
  insertUploadDocument:(owner,doc)=>call<InsertVersionResult>('insert_upload_document',{p_owner:owner,p_doc:docArg(doc)}),
  async advanceCursor(issuer,source,batch,mode,cursor,done,reset=false){await call('advance_document_cursor',{p_issuer:issuer,p_source:source,p_batch:batch,p_mode:mode,p_cursor:cursor,p_done:done,p_reset:reset});},
  async releaseSyncLease(issuer,source,batch,outcome,nextDue){await call('release_document_sync_lease',{p_issuer:issuer,p_source:source,p_batch:batch,p_outcome:outcome,p_next_due:nextDue});},
  async reclassifyDocument(document,patch,actor){await call('reclassify_document',{p_document:document,p_patch:patch,p_actor:actor});},
  async claimExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){return (await call('claim_document_extract_lease',{p_document:document,p_batch:batch,p_ttl:ttl}))===true;},
  async renewExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){return (await call('renew_document_extract_lease',{p_document:document,p_batch:batch,p_ttl:ttl}))===true;},
  async finishExtract(document,batch,extraction,pages){return String(await call('finish_document_extract',{p_document:document,p_batch:batch,p_extraction:extractionArg(extraction),p_pages:pagesArg(pages)}));},
  async failExtract(document,batch,code){await call('fail_document_extract',{p_document:document,p_batch:batch,p_code:code});},
  async requestExtract(document,actor){await call('request_document_extract',{p_document:document,p_actor:actor,p_extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,p_table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION});},
  async claimCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){return (await call('claim_candidates_lease',{p_extraction:extraction,p_batch:batch,p_ttl:ttl}))===true;},
  async renewCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){return (await call('renew_candidates_lease',{p_extraction:extraction,p_batch:batch,p_ttl:ttl}))===true;},
  async finishCandidates(extraction,batch,status){await call('finish_candidates',{p_extraction:extraction,p_batch:batch,p_status:status});},
  async requestCandidatesRegen(filter,actor){return Number(await call('request_candidates_regen',{p_filter:regenFilter(filter),p_actor:actor}));},
  async writeCandidateChecks(extraction,batch,input){
   let written=0,inherited=0;
   for(const part of input.length?chunk(input,WRITE_CHUNK):[[]]){const r=await call<{written:number;inherited:number}>('write_candidate_checks',{p_extraction:extraction,p_batch:batch,p_rows:part});written+=Number(r.written);inherited+=Number(r.inherited);}
   return {written,inherited};
  },
  async insertCitation(row){return String(await call('insert_citation',{p_row:row}));},
  async publishCitations(ids){return Number(await call('publish_citations',{p_ids:ids}));},
  async insertCandidates(extraction,batch,input){
   let inserted=0;

  },
  async candidatesOf(where,page){
   return pageOf(await call<Envelope>('list_candidates',{...candidatesWhere(where),p_cursor:sqlCursor(page.cursor,CANDIDATE_KEYS),p_limit:checkLimit(page.limit)}),candidateFromRow,CANDIDATE_KEYS);

  async publicationsOf(where,page){
   return pageOf(await call<Envelope>('list_candidate_publications',{...publicationsWhere(where),p_cursor:sqlCursor(page.cursor,PUBLICATION_KEYS),p_limit:checkLimit(page.limit)}),publicationFromRow,PUBLICATION_KEYS);
  },

   const limit=checkApprovalsLimit(opts.limit);
   const r=await rows(c.from('extraction_approvals').select('*').eq('extractor_ref',extractorRef).is('revoked_at',null).order('approved_at',{ascending:false}).order('approval_id').limit(limit+1));
   if(r.length>limit)throw new DocumentsDbError('too_many_approvals',`more than ${limit} approvals for ${extractorRef}`);
   return r.map(approvalFromRow);
  },
  async storedDue(limit){return ((await call<Record<string,unknown>[]|null>('documents_stored_due',{p_limit:checkLimit(limit)}))??[]).map(documentFromRow);},
  async candidatesDue(limit){return ((await call<Record<string,unknown>[]|null>('extractions_candidates_due',{p_limit:checkLimit(limit)}))??[]).map(extractionFromRow);},
  async scopeDue(source,now,limit){
   return (await rows(c.from('document_sync_scope').select('*').eq('source',source).gt('priority',0).lte('next_due_at',now)
    .order('next_due_at').order('priority',{ascending:false}).order('issuer_id').limit(checkLimit(limit)))).map(scopeFromRow);
  },
  async scopeRows(source,issuerIds){
   const out:DocScopeRow[]=[];
   for(const part of chunk([...new Set(issuerIds)],IN_CHUNK))out.push(...(await rows(c.from('document_sync_scope').select('*').eq('source',source).in('issuer_id',part).order('issuer_id'))).map(scopeFromRow));
   return out;
  },
  async scopeAll(source){
   const out:DocScopeRow[]=[];
   for(let from=0;;from+=PAGE_LIMIT_MAX){
    const r=await rows(c.from('document_sync_scope').select('*').eq('source',source).order('issuer_id').range(from,from+PAGE_LIMIT_MAX-1));
    out.push(...r.map(scopeFromRow));
    if(r.length<PAGE_LIMIT_MAX)return out;
   }
  },
 };
}
/** Exhaustive pager for callers that need every row of a paged read (tests, scripts). */
export async function allPages<T>(read:(page:PageOpts)=>Promise<Page<T>>,limit=PAGE_LIMIT_MAX):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
 do{const p:Page<T>=await read({cursor,limit});out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor);
 return out;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 `memory-documents-db.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/memory-documents-db.ts
// In-memory DocumentsDb for unit tests (spec §4.8, §4.11, §11.1). It reproduces the rules of the
// migration-one SQL functions so sync/extract/candidates unit tests see the database's behaviour:
// sync scope leases (claim / renew / expiry against an injectable clock), version allocation per
// (source, source_ref) with duplicate / versioned / supersedes / observed_replacement, extract and
// candidates leases with attempts counted only at claim and the third crash closed by the next claim
// (extract_failed / exhausted), the candidates role decided at finishExtract, revision_exists,
// code-point citation validation, publish_citations limits, candidate insertion (always
// 'candidate'), write_candidate_checks with human-decision inheritance by fingerprint,
// decide_candidate (human and auto rules), the publication state machine of
// stage_candidate_publication (incl. approval_revoked with the reversion kept), approvals with the
// threshold and too_many_approvals, read_documents as-of version selection, and keyset cursors.
// Every method validates fully before it writes (one SQL statement / transaction) and contains no
// await between its reads and writes, so calls are atomic with respect to each other.
// _raw exposes the maps for memoryHkFactsPort (Task 13) and for tests that need a state no
// migration-one function produces (e.g. a publication marked abandoned by migration two).
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';
import {checkApprovalsLimit,checkIds,checkLimit,decodeCursor,encodeCursor,lookaheadLimit,regenFilter} from './db';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from './types';
import type {
 ApprovalRow,AssetRow,CandidateRow,CitationRow,DocScopeRow,DocumentInsert,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ExtractionRow,ListedSource,Page,PageRow,PublicationRow,
} from './types';

export interface MemoryDocumentsDb extends DocumentsDb{
 /** Fixes "now" for leases and timestamps; null returns to the wall clock. */
 setNow(iso:string|null):void;
 expireSyncLease(issuer:string,source:ListedSource):void;
 expireExtractLease(document:string):void;
 expireCandidatesLease(extraction:string):void;
 documents():DocumentRow[];extractions():ExtractionRow[];pages():PageRow[];citations():CitationRow[];candidates():CandidateRow[];
 publications():PublicationRow[];approvals():ApprovalRow[];scope():DocScopeRow[];assets():AssetRow[];
 _raw:{documents:Map<string,DocumentRow>;assets:Map<string,AssetRow>;extractions:Map<string,ExtractionRow>;pages:Map<string,PageRow>;citations:Map<string,CitationRow>;
  candidates:Map<string,CandidateRow>;publications:Map<string,PublicationRow>;approvals:Map<string,ApprovalRow>;scope:Map<string,DocScopeRow>};
}

const LISTED:readonly string[]=['edgar','cninfo','hkexnews'];
const MARKETS:readonly string[]=['US','CN','HK','other'];
const CLASSES:readonly string[]=['annual_report','interim_report','quarterly_report','results_announcement','current_report','registration','proxy','ownership','other'];
const MIMES:readonly string[]=['application/pdf','text/html','application/xhtml+xml','application/xml','text/xml','application/json'];
const SHA=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const invalid=(m:string)=>new DocumentsDbError('invalid_input',m);
const leaseLost=()=>new DocumentsDbError('lease_lost');
const notFound=()=>new DocumentsDbError('not_found');
const clone=<T>(v:T):T=>structuredClone(v);
const cmp=(a:string|number,b:string|number)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const sk=(issuer:string,source:string)=>`${issuer}|${source}`;
const pk=(extraction:string,page:number)=>`${extraction}|${page}`;
const ck=(candidate:string,gen:number)=>`${candidate}|${gen}`;
const sha256=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');
/** Code points, like PostgreSQL length()/substr() on a UTF8 database. */
const cps=(s:string)=>Array.from(s);
const isObj=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>!!v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);

/** The column checks of disclosure_documents (§4.1) that a writer could violate. */
function checkDocument(d:DocumentRow):void{
 if(!MARKETS.includes(d.market))throw invalid('market');
 if(!CLASSES.includes(d.doc_class))throw invalid('doc_class');
 if(!Number.isInteger(d.classifier_gen)||d.classifier_gen<0)throw invalid('classifier_gen');
 if(typeof d.title!=='string')throw invalid('title');
 if(d.language!==null&&d.language!=='zh'&&d.language!=='en')throw invalid('language');
 if(!SHA.test(d.content_sha256))throw invalid('content_sha256');
 if(!Number.isInteger(d.bytes)||d.bytes<=0)throw invalid('bytes');
 if(!MIMES.includes(d.mime))throw invalid('mime');
 if(typeof d.storage_path!=='string'||!d.storage_path)throw invalid('storage_path');
 if(!isObj(d.acquisition))throw invalid('acquisition');
 if(d.published_at_precision!=='instant'&&d.published_at_precision!=='date')throw invalid('published_at_precision');
 if(Number.isNaN(Date.parse(d.published_at))||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(d.available_at))||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d.available_date))throw invalid('dates');
 if(d.fiscal_period!==null&&!['FY','H1','Q1','Q3'].includes(d.fiscal_period))throw invalid('fiscal_period');
 if(!['public','licensed','private'].includes(d.permission))throw invalid('permission');
 if((d.permission==='public')!==(d.owner_user_id===null))throw invalid('dd_owner_iff_private');
 if(d.permission==='public'&&d.issuer_id===null)throw invalid('dd_issuer_required');
 if((d.source==='upload')!==(d.source_url===null))throw invalid('dd_upload_shape');
 if(typeof d.code_version!=='string'||!d.batch_id)throw invalid('code_version/batch_id');
}

export function memoryDocumentsDb(opts:{now?:()=>Date}={}):MemoryDocumentsDb{
 const documents=new Map<string,DocumentRow>();const assets=new Map<string,AssetRow>();const extractions=new Map<string,ExtractionRow>();
 const pages=new Map<string,PageRow>();const citations=new Map<string,CitationRow>();const candidates=new Map<string,CandidateRow>();
 const publications=new Map<string,PublicationRow>();const approvals=new Map<string,ApprovalRow>();const scope=new Map<string,DocScopeRow>();
 let fixedNow:string|null=null;let lastStamp='';
 const now=()=>fixedNow??(opts.now?opts.now():new Date()).toISOString();
 const later=(secs:number)=>new Date(Date.parse(now())+secs*1000).toISOString();
 /** created_at: strictly increasing, so (created_at, id) orders like insertion. */
 const stamp=()=>{const t=now();lastStamp=t>lastStamp?t:new Date(Date.parse(lastStamp)+1).toISOString();return lastStamp;};
 const live=(until:string|null)=>until!==null&&until>now();

  const s=scope.get(sk(issuer,source));

 };

 const extractLock=(document:string,batch:string)=>{const d=docOf(document);if(d.extract_lease_batch_id!==batch||!live(d.extract_lease_until))throw leaseLost();return d;};
 const candidatesLock=(extraction:string,batch:string)=>{

  if(e.candidates_lease_batch_id!==batch||!live(e.candidates_lease_until))throw leaseLost();
  return e;
 };
 const versionsOf=(source:string,ref:string)=>[...documents.values()].filter(d=>d.source===source&&d.source_ref===ref).sort((a,b)=>a.source_version-b.source_version);
 const candidateCitationIds=(c:Record<string,unknown>)=>{
  const out:unknown[]=[];
  for(const v of Object.values(c)){
   if(typeof v==='string')out.push(v);
   else if(Array.isArray(v))for(const a of v)if(isObj(a))out.push(a.citation_id);
  }

 };
 const page=<T>(sorted:T[],limit:number,key:(r:T)=>(string|number)[]):Page<T>=>{
  const more=sorted.length>limit;const kept=sorted.slice(0,limit);
  return {rows:kept.map(clone),nextCursor:more?encodeCursor(key(kept[kept.length-1])):null};
 };
 const after=(cursor:string|null|undefined,n:number)=>{if(!cursor)return null;const p=decodeCursor(cursor);if(p.length!==n)throw invalid('invalid_cursor');return p;};
 /** (a1,a2) > (b1,b2) lexicographic. */
 const gt2=(a:(string|number)[],b:(string|number)[])=>cmp(a[0],b[0])>0||(cmp(a[0],b[0])===0&&cmp(a[1],b[1])>0);

 const db:MemoryDocumentsDb={
  setNow(iso){fixedNow=iso;},
  expireSyncLease(issuer,source){const s=scope.get(sk(issuer,source));if(s&&s.lease_until)s.lease_until=new Date(Date.parse(now())-1000).toISOString();},
  expireExtractLease(document){const d=documents.get(document);if(d&&d.extract_lease_until)d.extract_lease_until=new Date(Date.parse(now())-1000).toISOString();},
  expireCandidatesLease(extraction){const e=extractions.get(extraction);if(e&&e.candidates_lease_until)e.candidates_lease_until=new Date(Date.parse(now())-1000).toISOString();},
  documents:()=>[...documents.values()].map(clone),extractions:()=>[...extractions.values()].map(clone),pages:()=>[...pages.values()].map(clone),
  citations:()=>[...citations.values()].map(clone),candidates:()=>[...candidates.values()].map(clone),publications:()=>[...publications.values()].map(clone),
  approvals:()=>[...approvals.values()].map(clone),scope:()=>[...scope.values()].map(clone),assets:()=>[...assets.values()].map(clone),
  _raw:{documents,assets,extractions,pages,citations,candidates,publications,approvals,scope},

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- scope
  async reconcileScope(source,input){
   listed(source);
   const seen=new Set<string>();let n=0;
   for(const r of input){
    if(seen.has(r.issuer_id))continue;seen.add(r.issuer_id);

     scope.set(sk(r.issuer_id,source),{issuer_id:r.issuer_id,source,reasons:[...r.reasons],priority:r.priority,fetch_key:r.fetch_key,backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:false,poll_cursor:{},

   return false;
  },
  async advanceCursor(issuer,source,batch,mode,cursor,done,reset=false){
   if(mode!=='backfill'&&mode!=='poll')throw invalid('mode');
   if(cursor!==null&&(typeof cursor!=='object'||Array.isArray(cursor)))throw invalid('cursor');
   const seqOf=(c:unknown)=>isObj(c)&&'seq' in c?c.seq:undefined;
   if(cursor!==null&&seqOf(cursor)!==undefined&&typeof seqOf(cursor)!=='number')throw invalid('cursor');
   const s=scopeLock(issuer,source,batch);

    if(mode==='backfill'&&s.backfill_done&&!(cursor===null&&done===true))throw new DocumentsDbError('cursor_regression','cursor_regression: backfill_done');
    const old=seqOf(mode==='backfill'?s.backfill_cursor:s.poll_cursor);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- documents
  async insertDocumentVersion(issuer,source,batch,doc,input){

   const prev=versions[versions.length-1];
   const row:DocumentRow={...nullDoc(doc),document_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,source,batch_id:batch,permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,

    extract_lease_until:null,extract_lease_batch_id:null,extract_attempts:0,created_at:stamp()};
   checkDocument(row);
   const rows:AssetRow[]=input.map(a=>({...clone(a),asset_id:randomUUID(),document_id:row.document_id,created_at:row.created_at}));
   const keys=new Set<string>();
   for(const a of rows){
    const k=`${a.role}|${a.filename}`;if(keys.has(k))throw invalid('document_assets_role_file_uniq');keys.add(k);
    if(!['filing_index','xbrl_instance','exhibit'].includes(a.role)||!SHA.test(a.content_sha256)||!(a.bytes>0)||!isObj(a.acquisition))throw invalid('asset');

  },
  async insertUploadDocument(owner,doc){

   const ref=`${owner}/${doc.content_sha256}`;
   const dup=versionsOf('upload',ref)[0];
   if(dup)return {outcome:'duplicate',document_id:dup.document_id};
   const row:DocumentRow={...nullDoc(doc),document_id:randomUUID(),source:'upload',source_ref:ref,owner_user_id:owner,source_url:null,source_version:1,supersedes_document_id:null,
    observed_replacement:false,status:'stored',current_extraction_id:null,extract_lease_until:null,extract_lease_batch_id:null,extract_attempts:0,created_at:stamp()};
   checkDocument(row);
   documents.set(row.document_id,row);
   return {outcome:'inserted',document_id:row.document_id};
  },
  async reclassifyDocument(document,patch,actor){
   if(!actor)throw invalid('actor');
   const allowed=['doc_class','classifier_gen','fiscal_year','fiscal_period','period_end','filing_source_ref'];
   if(Object.keys(patch).some(k=>!allowed.includes(k)))throw invalid('patch');
   const d=docOf(document);
   const next={...d,...patch};checkDocument(next);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- extraction
  async claimExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){

   if(!d||d.status!=='stored')return false;
   if(!(d.extract_lease_batch_id===null||!live(d.extract_lease_until)||d.extract_lease_batch_id===batch))return false;
   if(d.extract_attempts>=3){d.status='extract_failed';d.extract_lease_until=null;d.extract_lease_batch_id=null;return false;}
   d.extract_lease_batch_id=batch;d.extract_lease_until=later(ttl);d.extract_attempts+=1;

  async renewExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){

  async finishExtract(document,batch,extraction,input){
```
