```ts
   if(!extraction.extractor_version||!extraction.table_algo_version||typeof extraction.has_text_layer!=='boolean'||!Number.isInteger(extraction.page_count)||extraction.page_count<0)throw invalid('extraction fields');
   if(!SHA.test(extraction.pages_json_sha256))throw invalid('pages_json_sha256');
   if([...extractions.values()].some(x=>x.document_id===document&&x.extractor_version===extraction.extractor_version&&x.table_algo_version===extraction.table_algo_version))throw new DocumentsDbError('revision_exists');
   const nos=input.map(p=>p.page_no);
   const ok=input.length===extraction.page_count&&new Set(nos).size===nos.length&&(nos.length===0||(Math.min(...nos)===1&&Math.max(...nos)===nos.length))
    &&input.every(p=>typeof p.text==='string'&&p.char_count===cps(p.text).length&&p.text_hash===sha256(p.text)&&Number.isInteger(p.line_count)&&p.line_count>=0);
   if(!ok)throw invalid('pages do not match page_count, char_count or text_hash');
   const role=d.source==='hkexnews'&&d.market==='HK'&&(d.doc_class==='annual_report'||d.doc_class==='interim_report')&&extraction.has_text_layer?(d.language==='zh'?'primary':'comparison'):'none';
   const row:ExtractionRow={...clone(extraction),extraction_id:randomUUID(),document_id:document,candidates_role:role,candidates_status:role==='none'?'n/a':'pending',candidates_attempts:0,
    candidates_lease_until:null,candidates_lease_batch_id:null,batch_id:batch,created_at:stamp()};
   extractions.set(row.extraction_id,row);
   for(const p of input)pages.set(pk(row.extraction_id,p.page_no),{...clone(p),extraction_id:row.extraction_id,has_tables:p.has_tables===true});
   d.status=extraction.has_text_layer?'extracted':'no_text_layer';d.current_extraction_id=row.extraction_id;d.extract_lease_until=null;d.extract_lease_batch_id=null;
   return row.extraction_id;
  },
  async failExtract(document,batch,code){
   if(!code)throw invalid('code');
   const d=extractLock(document,batch);
   if(d.extract_attempts>=3)d.status='extract_failed';
   d.extract_lease_until=null;d.extract_lease_batch_id=null;
  },
  async requestExtract(document,actor){
   if(!actor)throw invalid('actor');
   const d=docOf(document);
   if([...extractions.values()].some(x=>x.document_id===document&&x.extractor_version===EXTRACTOR_VERSION&&x.table_algo_version===TABLE_ALGO_VERSION))throw new DocumentsDbError('revision_exists');
   if(d.status!=='stored'){d.status='stored';d.extract_attempts=0;d.extract_lease_until=null;d.extract_lease_batch_id=null;}
  },

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- candidates scheduling
  async claimCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){
   ttlCheck(ttl);
   const e=extractions.get(extraction);
   if(!e||(e.candidates_status!=='pending'&&e.candidates_status!=='failed'))return false;
   if(!(e.candidates_lease_batch_id===null||!live(e.candidates_lease_until)||e.candidates_lease_batch_id===batch))return false;
   if(e.candidates_attempts>=3){e.candidates_status='exhausted';e.candidates_lease_until=null;e.candidates_lease_batch_id=null;return false;}
   e.candidates_lease_batch_id=batch;e.candidates_lease_until=later(ttl);e.candidates_attempts+=1;
   return true;
  },
  async renewCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){
   ttlCheck(ttl);
   const e=extractions.get(extraction);
   if(!e||(e.candidates_status!=='pending'&&e.candidates_status!=='failed')||e.candidates_lease_batch_id!==batch)return false;
   e.candidates_lease_until=later(ttl);
   return true;
  },
  async finishCandidates(extraction,batch,status){
   if(status!=='done'&&status!=='failed')throw invalid('status');
   const e=candidatesLock(extraction,batch);
   e.candidates_status=status;e.candidates_lease_until=null;e.candidates_lease_batch_id=null;
  },
  async requestCandidatesRegen(filter,actor){
   if(!actor)throw invalid('actor');
   const f=regenFilter(filter) as {source?:string;issuer_id?:string;document_id?:string};
   if(Object.keys(f).some(k=>!['source','issuer_id','document_id'].includes(k)))throw invalid('filter');
   let n=0;
   for(const e of extractions.values()){
    const d=documents.get(e.document_id)!;
    if(d.current_extraction_id!==e.extraction_id||e.candidates_role==='none'||!['done','failed','exhausted'].includes(e.candidates_status))continue;
    if((f.source&&d.source!==f.source)||(f.issuer_id&&d.issuer_id!==f.issuer_id)||(f.document_id&&d.document_id!==f.document_id))continue;
    e.candidates_status='pending';e.candidates_attempts=0;e.candidates_lease_until=null;e.candidates_lease_batch_id=null;n++;
   }
   return n;
  },

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- citations
  async insertCitation(row){
   const e=extractions.get(row.extraction_id);
   const p=pages.get(pk(row.extraction_id,row.page_no));
   if(!e||!p||e.document_id!==row.document_id)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: page');
   if(!Number.isInteger(row.char_start)||!Number.isInteger(row.char_end)||row.char_start<0||row.char_end<=row.char_start||row.char_end>p.char_count)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: range');
   if(row.snippet!==cps(p.text).slice(row.char_start,row.char_end).join(''))throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: snippet');
   if(row.text_hash!==p.text_hash)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: text_hash');
   if(!['extractor','human','llm','module'].includes(row.created_by)||!row.created_ref)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: creator');
   if(row.bbox!==null&&row.bbox!==undefined&&!isObj(row.bbox))throw invalid('bbox');
   const id=randomUUID();
   citations.set(id,{...clone(row),bbox:row.bbox??null,citation_id:id,visibility:'internal',created_at:stamp()});
   return id;
  },
  async publishCitations(ids){
   for(const id of ids){
    const c=citations.get(id);const d=c&&documents.get(c.document_id);
    if(!c||!d||!(c.created_by==='human'||c.created_by==='module')||d.permission!=='public')throw new DocumentsDbError('not_publishable');
   }
   let n=0;
   for(const id of new Set(ids)){const c=citations.get(id)!;if(c.visibility==='internal'){c.visibility='public';n++;}}
   return n;
  },

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- candidates
  async insertCandidates(extraction,batch,input){
   const e=candidatesLock(extraction,batch);
   for(const x of input){
    const cit=x.citations as Record<string,unknown>;
    if(!isObj(cit)||typeof cit.value!=='string')throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: shape');
    if(x.kind==='financial_fact'&&(typeof cit.label!=='string'||typeof cit.unit!=='string'||!Array.isArray(cit.period)||cit.period.length===0))throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: shape');
    for(const id of candidateCitationIds(cit)){
     const c=typeof id==='string'&&UUID.test(id)?citations.get(id.toLowerCase()):undefined;
     if(!c||c.extraction_id!==extraction||c.document_id!==e.document_id)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation','invalid_citation: reference');
    }
    if(!['financial_fact','table_cell','field'].includes(x.kind)||!['rule','llm'].includes(x.extractor_kind)||!x.extractor_ref||!x.natural_key||!SHA.test(x.fingerprint)||!isObj(x.payload)||!isObj(x.input_snapshot))throw invalid('candidate');
   }
   const key=(c:{kind:string;extractor_ref:string;natural_key:string})=>`${c.kind}|${c.extractor_ref}|${c.natural_key}`;
   const existing=new Set([...candidates.values()].filter(c=>c.extraction_id===extraction).map(key));
   let inserted=0;
   for(const x of input){
    if(existing.has(key(x)))continue;existing.add(key(x));
    const id=randomUUID();
    candidates.set(id,{...clone(x),candidate_id:id,document_id:e.document_id,extraction_id:extraction,checks:[],checks_passed:false,status:'candidate',decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,
     approval_id:null,decided_at:null,inherited_from:null,batch_id:batch,created_at:stamp()});
    inserted++;
   }
   return {inserted};
  },
  async writeCandidateChecks(extraction,batch,input){
   candidatesLock(extraction,batch);
   const sorted=[...input].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.candidate_id,b.candidate_id));
   for(const x of sorted){
    if(!Array.isArray(x.checks)||typeof x.checks_passed!=='boolean')throw invalid('checks');
    const c=candidates.get(x.candidate_id);
    if(!c||c.extraction_id!==extraction)throw notFound();
    if(c.status!=='candidate')throw new DocumentsDbError('decided');
   }
   let written=0,inherited=0;
   for(const x of sorted){
    const c=candidates.get(x.candidate_id)!;
    c.checks=clone(x.checks);c.checks_passed=x.checks_passed;written++;
    if(!x.checks_passed)continue;
    const src=[...candidates.values()]
     .filter(s=>s.document_id===c.document_id&&s.fingerprint===c.fingerprint&&s.candidate_id!==c.candidate_id&&s.decision_kind==='human'&&(s.status==='confirmed'||s.status==='promoted'))
     .sort((a,b)=>cmp(b.decided_at??'',a.decided_at??'')||cmp(a.candidate_id,b.candidate_id))[0];
    if(src){Object.assign(c,{status:'confirmed',decision_kind:'human',decided_by:src.decided_by,approval_id:null,decided_at:now(),inherited_from:src.candidate_id});inherited++;}
   }
   return {written,inherited};
  },
  async decideCandidate(candidate,decision){
   const c=candidates.get(candidate);if(!c)throw notFound();
   if(decision.kind==='human'){
    if(!decision.decided_by||!['confirmed','rejected','candidate'].includes(decision.status))throw invalid('human decision');
    if(c.status===decision.status)return {status:c.status};
    if(c.status==='candidate'&&decision.status==='confirmed'){
     if(!c.checks_passed)throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
     Object.assign(c,{status:'confirmed',decision_kind:'human',decided_by:decision.decided_by,approval_id:null,decided_at:now(),inherited_from:null});
    }else if(c.status==='candidate'&&decision.status==='rejected'){
     Object.assign(c,{status:'rejected',decision_kind:'human',decided_by:decision.decided_by,approval_id:null,decided_at:now(),inherited_from:null});
    }else if(c.status==='confirmed'&&decision.status==='candidate'){
     if([...publications.values()].some(p=>p.candidate_id===candidate))throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
     Object.assign(c,{status:'candidate',decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,approval_id:null,decided_at:null,inherited_from:null});
    }else throw new DocumentsDbError('decided');
    return {status:decision.status};
   }
   if(decision.kind!=='auto'||!decision.approval_id)throw invalid('decision');
   if(c.status==='confirmed'&&c.decision_kind==='auto'&&c.approval_id===decision.approval_id)return {status:c.status};
   if(c.status!=='candidate'||c.extractor_kind!=='rule'||!c.checks_passed)throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
   const a=approvals.get(decision.approval_id);
   if(!a)throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
   if(a.revoked_at!==null)throw new DocumentsDbError('approval_revoked');
   const e=extractions.get(c.extraction_id)!;
   const concept=(c.payload as {concept?:unknown}).concept;
   if(a.extractor_ref!==c.extractor_ref||a.extractor_version!==e.extractor_version||a.table_algo_version!==e.table_algo_version||a.code_version!==e.code_version||typeof concept!=='string'||!a.concepts.includes(concept))throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
   Object.assign(c,{status:'confirmed',decision_kind:'auto',decided_by:null,approval_id:a.approval_id,decided_at:now(),inherited_from:null});
   return {status:'confirmed'};
  },
  async stageCandidatePublication(candidate,pubGen,run,factId){
   if(!Number.isInteger(pubGen)||pubGen<1||!run||!factId)throw invalid('publication');
   const c=candidates.get(candidate);if(!c)throw notFound();
   if(c.status!=='confirmed'&&c.status!=='promoted')throw new DocumentsDbError('not_eligible');
   if(c.decision_kind==='auto'&&c.approval_id&&approvals.get(c.approval_id)?.revoked_at){
    if(c.status==='confirmed')Object.assign(c,{status:'candidate',decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,approval_id:null,decided_at:null,inherited_from:null});
    throw new DocumentsDbError('approval_revoked');   // the reversion stays (the SQL function commits it and answers the outcome)
   }
   const p=publications.get(ck(candidate,pubGen));const t=now();
   if(!p)publications.set(ck(candidate,pubGen),{candidate_id:candidate,pub_gen:pubGen,run_id:run,fact_id:factId,state:'staged',created_at:t,updated_at:t});
   else if(p.state==='abandoned')Object.assign(p,{state:'staged',run_id:run,fact_id:factId,updated_at:t});
   else throw new DocumentsDbError('already_staged');
  },
  async insertApproval(row){
   // precision/recall are ratios, not financial values: Number is fine for the threshold check
   if(!(Number(row.precision)>=0.95&&Number(row.recall)>=0.95&&Number(row.precision)<=1&&Number(row.recall)<=1))throw invalid('ea_threshold');
   if(!row.extractor_ref||!row.approved_by||!SHA.test(row.gold_sha256)||!Array.isArray(row.concepts))throw invalid('approval');
   const id=randomUUID();
   approvals.set(id,{...clone(row),precision:canonicalDecimal(row.precision),recall:canonicalDecimal(row.recall),approval_id:id,approved_at:stamp(),revoked_at:null});
   return id;
  },
  async revokeApproval(approvalId){
   const a=approvals.get(approvalId);if(!a)throw notFound();
   if(a.revoked_at===null)a.revoked_at=now();
  },

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- reads
  async documentVersions(source,sourceRef,p){
   const limit=lookaheadLimit(p.limit);const a=after(p.cursor,1);
   return page(versionsOf(source,sourceRef).filter(d=>!a||d.source_version>Number(a[0])),limit,d=>[d.source_version]);
  },
  async knownSourceRefs(issuer,source,refs){
   const want=new Set(refs);
   return new Set([...documents.values()].filter(d=>d.issuer_id===issuer&&d.source===source&&want.has(d.source_ref)).map(d=>d.source_ref));
  },
  async readDocuments(issuer,o){
   const limit=checkLimit(o.limit);const a=after(o.cursor,2);
   const visible=[...documents.values()].filter(d=>d.issuer_id===issuer&&d.available_date<=o.asOf);
   const top=new Map<string,number>();
   for(const d of visible){const k=`${d.source}|${d.source_ref}`;top.set(k,Math.max(top.get(k)??0,d.source_version));}
   const picked=visible
    .filter(d=>(o.allVersions===true||top.get(`${d.source}|${d.source_ref}`)===d.source_version)
     &&(!o.source||d.source===o.source)&&(!o.docClass||d.doc_class===o.docClass)&&(!o.from||d.available_date>=o.from)&&(!o.to||d.available_date<=o.to)
     &&(!a||gt2([String(a[0]),String(a[1])],[d.available_at,d.document_id])))
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(y.available_at,x.available_at)||cmp(y.document_id,x.document_id));
   return page(picked,limit,d=>[d.available_at,d.document_id]);
  },
  async documentById(id){const d=documents.get(id);return d?clone(d):null;},
  async assetsOf(documentId){return [...assets.values()].filter(a=>a.document_id===documentId).sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.role,y.role)||cmp(x.filename,y.filename)).slice(0,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX).map(clone);},
  async extractionsOf(documentId,p){
   const limit=lookaheadLimit(p.limit);const a=after(p.cursor,2);
   const rows=[...extractions.values()].filter(e=>e.document_id===documentId&&(!a||gt2([String(a[0]),String(a[1])],[e.created_at,e.extraction_id])))
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(y.created_at,x.created_at)||cmp(y.extraction_id,x.extraction_id));
   return page(rows,limit,e=>[e.created_at,e.extraction_id]);
  },
  async extractionById(id){const e=extractions.get(id);return e?clone(e):null;},
  async pagesOf(extractionId,pageNos){
   checkIds(pageNos);
   return [...new Set(pageNos)].sort((x,y)=>x-y).map(n=>pages.get(pk(extractionId,n))).filter((p):p is PageRow=>!!p).map(clone);
  },
  async citationById(id){const c=citations.get(id);return c?clone(c):null;},
  async citationsByIds(ids){checkIds(ids);return [...new Set(ids)].sort(cmp).map(id=>citations.get(id)).filter((c):c is CitationRow=>!!c).map(clone);},
  async candidatesOf(where,p){
   const limit=checkLimit(p.limit);const a=after(p.cursor,2);
   const match=(c:CandidateRow)=>{
    if('extractionId' in where)return c.extraction_id===where.extractionId;
    if('issuerId' in where)return documents.get(c.document_id)?.issuer_id===where.issuerId&&(!where.status||c.status===where.status);
    return c.status===where.status;
   };
   const rows=[...candidates.values()].filter(c=>match(c)&&(!a||gt2([c.created_at,c.candidate_id],[String(a[0]),String(a[1])])))
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.created_at,y.created_at)||cmp(x.candidate_id,y.candidate_id));
   return page(rows,limit,c=>[c.created_at,c.candidate_id]);
  },
  async candidateById(id){const c=candidates.get(id);return c?clone(c):null;},
  async publicationsOf(where,p){
   const limit=checkLimit(p.limit);const a=after(p.cursor,2);
   if('candidateIds' in where)checkIds(where.candidateIds);
   const match=(x:PublicationRow)=>{
    if('candidateIds' in where)return where.candidateIds.includes(x.candidate_id);
    if('runId' in where)return x.run_id===where.runId;
    const c=candidates.get(x.candidate_id);
    return !!c&&documents.get(c.document_id)?.issuer_id===where.issuerId&&x.pub_gen===where.pubGen&&(!where.state||x.state===where.state);
   };
   const rows=[...publications.values()].filter(x=>match(x)&&(!a||gt2([x.candidate_id,x.pub_gen],[String(a[0]),Number(a[1])])))
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.candidate_id,y.candidate_id)||x.pub_gen-y.pub_gen);
   return page(rows,limit,x=>[x.candidate_id,x.pub_gen]);
  },
  async approvalsFor(extractorRef,o){
   const limit=checkApprovalsLimit(o.limit);
   const rows=[...approvals.values()].filter(a=>a.extractor_ref===extractorRef&&a.revoked_at===null).sort((x,y)=>cmp(y.approved_at,x.approved_at)||cmp(x.approval_id,y.approval_id));
   if(rows.length>limit)throw new DocumentsDbError('too_many_approvals',`more than ${limit} approvals for ${extractorRef}`);
   return rows.map(clone);
  },
  async storedDue(limit){
   checkLimit(limit);
   return [...documents.values()].filter(d=>d.status==='stored'&&!live(d.extract_lease_until)).sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.created_at,y.created_at)||cmp(x.document_id,y.document_id)).slice(0,limit).map(clone);
  },
  async candidatesDue(limit){
   checkLimit(limit);
   return [...extractions.values()].filter(e=>(e.candidates_status==='pending'||e.candidates_status==='failed')&&!live(e.candidates_lease_until)&&documents.get(e.document_id)?.current_extraction_id===e.extraction_id)
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.created_at,y.created_at)||cmp(x.extraction_id,y.extraction_id)).slice(0,limit).map(clone);
  },
  async scopeDue(source,at,limit){
   checkLimit(limit);
   const t=new Date(at).toISOString();
   return [...scope.values()].filter(s=>s.source===source&&s.priority>0&&s.next_due_at<=t)
    .sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.next_due_at,y.next_due_at)||y.priority-x.priority||cmp(x.issuer_id,y.issuer_id)).slice(0,limit).map(clone);
  },
  async scopeRows(source,issuerIds){
   const want=new Set(issuerIds);
   return [...scope.values()].filter(s=>s.source===source&&want.has(s.issuer_id)).sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.issuer_id,y.issuer_id)).map(clone);
  },
  async scopeAll(source){
   return [...scope.values()].filter(s=>s.source===source).sort((x,y)=>cmp(x.issuer_id,y.issuer_id)).map(clone);
  },
 };
 return db;
}

/** A DocumentInsert with every optional column as null (jsonb_populate_record semantics). */
function nullDoc(d:DocumentInsert):Omit<DocumentRow,'document_id'|'source_version'|'supersedes_document_id'|'observed_replacement'|'status'|'current_extraction_id'|'extract_lease_until'|'extract_lease_batch_id'|'extract_attempts'|'created_at'>{
 const x=clone(d);
 return {...x,issuer_id:x.issuer_id??null,form_type:x.form_type??null,language:x.language??null,source_url:x.source_url??null,fiscal_year:x.fiscal_year??null,
  fiscal_period:x.fiscal_period??null,period_end:x.period_end??null,filing_source_ref:x.filing_source_ref??null,owner_user_id:x.owner_user_id??null,license_ref:x.license_ref??null};
}
```

```ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Task 3: pgDocumentsDb
interface PgDocsHarness extends DocsContractHarness{pool:Pool;close():Promise<void>}
async function pgDocsHarness():Promise<PgDocsHarness>{
 const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
 const pool=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,statement_timeout:8000});   // a regression that blocks fails cleanly instead of hanging afterAll
 const issuer=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await pool.query(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) values($1,'ZZ Docs Contract')`,[id]);return id;};
 return {
  pool,db:pgDocumentsDb(pool),issuerId:await issuer(),issuer,
  batchId:async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await pool.query(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,'documents-sync','documents.hkexnews')`,[id]);return id;},
  user:async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await pool.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email) values($1,$2)`,[id,`${id}@example.test`]);return id;},
  expire:async(kind,key,source)=>{
   if(kind==='sync')await pool.query(`update public.document_sync_scope set lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' where issuer_id=$1 and source=$2`,[key,source]);
   else if(kind==='extract')await pool.query(`update public.disclosure_documents set extract_lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' where document_id=$1`,[key]);
   else await pool.query(`update public.document_extractions set candidates_lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' where extraction_id=$1`,[key]);
  },
  abandonPublication:async(candidate,gen)=>{await pool.query(`update public.candidate_publications set state='abandoned' where candidate_id=$1 and pub_gen=$2`,[candidate,gen]);},
  close:async()=>{await pool.end();},
 };
}

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('pgDocumentsDb on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 // The same scenarios memoryDocumentsDb passes in db.test.ts, now against the SQL functions.
 documentsDbContract('pgDocumentsDb contract',pgDocsHarness);

 describe('keyset paging over more than 1,000 rows (PostgREST max_rows is 1,000)',()=>{
  let h:PgDocsHarness;
  beforeAll(async()=>{h=await pgDocsHarness();},60000);
  afterAll(async()=>{await h?.close();});
  const N=1203;

  it('readDocuments returns 1,203 documents exactly once, in (available_at desc, document_id desc) order, with ties on available_at',async()=>{
   const iss=await h.issuer();const b=await h.batchId();const tag=randomUUID().slice(0,8);
   // three documents per minute share an available_at: the document_id tiebreak is exercised.
   // extract_failed keeps them out of storedDue for the rest of the suite.
   await h.pool.query(`insert into public.disclosure_documents(document_id,issuer_id,source,market,source_ref,source_version,doc_class,classifier_gen,title,source_url,content_sha256,bytes,mime,storage_path,acquisition,
     published_at,published_at_precision,available_at,available_date,permission,status,batch_id,code_version)
    select gen_random_uuid(),$1,'hkexnews','HK','bulk-'||$3||'-'||g,1,'other',1,'t','https://x',encode(sha256(convert_to($3||g::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,'application/pdf','blobs/x.pdf','{}'::jsonb,
     t.ts,'instant',t.ts,(t.ts at time zone 'UTC')::date,'public','extract_failed',$2,'c'
    from generate_series(1,$4::int) g cross join lateral (select timestamptz '2020-01-01 00:00:00.000001+00' + make_interval(secs => (g/3)*60) as ts) t`,[iss,b,tag,N]);
   const expected=(await h.pool.query(`select document_id from public.disclosure_documents where issuer_id=$1 order by available_at desc, document_id desc`,[iss])).rows.map(r=>r.document_id as string);
   expect(expected).toHaveLength(N);
   const first=await h.db.readDocuments(iss,{asOf:'2030-01-01',limit:1000});
   expect(first.rows).toHaveLength(1000);expect(first.nextCursor).not.toBeNull();
   const second=await h.db.readDocuments(iss,{asOf:'2030-01-01',limit:1000,cursor:first.nextCursor});
   expect(second.rows).toHaveLength(N-1000);expect(second.nextCursor).toBeNull();
   expect([...first.rows,...second.rows].map(r=>r.document_id)).toEqual(expected);
   const small=await drain(p=>h.db.readDocuments(iss,{asOf:'2030-01-01',...p}),7);
   expect(small.rows.map(r=>r.document_id)).toEqual(expected);expect(small.pages).toBe(Math.ceil(N/7));
  },120000);

  it('documentVersions and candidatesOf page past 1,000 rows without gaps or repeats',async()=>{
   const iss=await h.issuer();const b=await h.batchId();const ref=`many-${randomUUID()}`;
   await h.pool.query(`insert into public.disclosure_documents(document_id,issuer_id,source,market,source_ref,source_version,doc_class,classifier_gen,title,source_url,content_sha256,bytes,mime,storage_path,acquisition,
     published_at,published_at_precision,available_at,available_date,permission,status,batch_id,code_version)
    select gen_random_uuid(),$1,'cninfo','CN',$3,g,'other',1,'t','https://x',encode(sha256(convert_to($3||g::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),1,'application/pdf','blobs/x.pdf','{}'::jsonb,
     now(),'date',now(),current_date,'public','extract_failed',$2,'c'
    from generate_series(1,1001) g`,[iss,b,ref]);
   const versions=await drain(p=>h.db.documentVersions('cninfo',ref,p),1000);
   expect(versions.rows.map(r=>r.source_version)).toEqual(Array.from({length:1001},(_,i)=>i+1));expect(versions.pages).toBe(2);
   expect((await h.db.documentVersions('cninfo',ref,{limit:1000})).rows).toHaveLength(999);   // P2-1: look-ahead pages hold ≤ LOOKAHEAD_MAX rows in every implementation
   // 1,001 candidates on one extraction, inserted in one statement (equal created_at: the candidate_id tiebreak decides)
   await h.db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:iss,reasons:['t'],priority:1,fetch_key:'00001'}]);
   expect(await h.db.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',b,600)).toBe(true);
   const {document_id}=await h.db.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'hkexnews',b,docInsert(),[]);
   expect(await h.db.claimExtractLease(document_id,b,600)).toBe(true);
   const ext=await h.db.finishExtract(document_id,b,extractionInsert(1),[pageInsert(1,PAGE_TEXT)]);
   const value=await h.db.insertCitation({document_id,extraction_id:ext,page_no:1,char_start:0,char_end:1,bbox:null,snippet:Array.from(PAGE_TEXT)[0],text_hash:createHash('sha256').update(PAGE_TEXT,'utf8').digest('hex'),created_by:'extractor',created_ref:'t'});
   expect(await h.db.claimCandidatesLease(ext,b,600)).toBe(true);
   const rows=Array.from({length:1001},(_,i)=>({kind:'field' as const,extractor_kind:'rule' as const,extractor_ref:'bulk',natural_key:`k${i}`,citations:{value},payload:{i},fingerprint:createHash('sha256').update(String(i)).digest('hex'),input_snapshot:{} as never}));
   expect(await h.db.insertCandidates(ext,b,rows)).toEqual({inserted:1001});   // three insert_candidates calls (WRITE_CHUNK = 500: 500 + 500 + 1)
   const expected=(await h.pool.query(`select candidate_id from public.extraction_candidates where extraction_id=$1 order by created_at, candidate_id`,[ext])).rows.map(r=>r.candidate_id as string);
   const cands=await drain(p=>h.db.candidatesOf({extractionId:ext},p),1000);
   expect(cands.rows.map(r=>r.candidate_id)).toEqual(expected);expect(cands.pages).toBe(2);
   const byIssuer=await drain(p=>h.db.candidatesOf({issuerId:iss,status:'candidate'},p),333);
   expect(byIssuer.rows).toHaveLength(1001);expect(new Set(byIssuer.rows.map(r=>r.candidate_id)).size).toBe(1001);
  },120000);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/pg-documents-db.ts
// TEST-ONLY DocumentsDb over node-postgres (spec §4.11): it calls the same migration-one SQL
// functions supabaseDocumentsDb calls through rpc, and runs the single-table reads as plain SQL
// with the same filters, order and limits, so the shared contract and the offline integration
// tests exercise the real schema (locks, leases, triggers, RLS-free service reads). Nothing in
// src/app imports this. typeParsers keep date/timestamptz as the server's text: cursors carry the
// exact microsecond value and the db.ts normalisers turn timestamps into toISOString() form; int8
// and numeric arrive as strings and are Number()ed / canonicalised there. extraction_approvals is
// written directly (the one table service_role may write, §4.12). Errors are mapped with
// toDocumentsDbError exactly like PostgREST errors.
import type {Pool} from 'pg';
import {typeParsers} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {
 CANDIDATE_KEYS,IN_CHUNK,PUBLICATION_KEYS,READ_DOC_KEYS,REFS_CHUNK,WRITE_CHUNK,approvalFromRow,assetFromRow,candidateFromRow,candidatesWhere,checkApprovalsLimit,checkIds,checkLimit,chunk,citationFromRow,
 decodeCursor,documentFromRow,extractionFromRow,lookaheadLimit,pageFromRow,pageOf,publicationFromRow,publicationsWhere,readDocumentsArgs,regenFilter,scopeFromRow,sliceRows,sqlCursor,toDocumentsDbError,
} from './db';
import type {Envelope,PgErrorLike} from './db';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from './types';
import type {CandidateStatus,DocScopeRow,DocumentsDb,InsertVersionResult} from './types';

export function pgDocumentsDb(pool:Pool):DocumentsDb{
 const run=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>{
  try{return await pool.query({text,values,types:typeParsers});}
  catch(e){throw toDocumentsDbError(e as PgErrorLike);}
 };
 const fn=async<T>(call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>(await run(`select ${call} as v`,values)).rows[0].v as T;
 const json=(v:unknown)=>v===null||v===undefined?null:JSON.stringify(v);
 const one=async(text:string,values:unknown[])=>(await run(text,values)).rows[0] as Record<string,unknown>|undefined;
 return {
  async reconcileScope(source,input){return Number(await fn('public.reconcile_document_sync_scope($1,$2::jsonb)',[source,json(input)]));},
  async claimSyncLease(issuer,source,batch,ttl){return (await fn<boolean>('public.claim_document_sync_lease($1,$2,$3,$4)',[issuer,source,batch,ttl]))===true;},
  insertDocumentVersion:(issuer,source,batch,doc,assets)=>fn<InsertVersionResult>('public.insert_document_version($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,$5::jsonb)',[issuer,source,batch,json(doc),json(assets)]),
  insertUploadDocument:(owner,doc)=>fn<InsertVersionResult>('public.insert_upload_document($1,$2::jsonb)',[owner,json(doc)]),
  async advanceCursor(issuer,source,batch,mode,cursor,done,reset=false){await fn('public.advance_document_cursor($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::jsonb,$6,$7)',[issuer,source,batch,mode,json(cursor),done,reset]);},
  async releaseSyncLease(issuer,source,batch,outcome,nextDue){await fn('public.release_document_sync_lease($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::timestamptz)',[issuer,source,batch,outcome,nextDue]);},
  async reclassifyDocument(document,patch,actor){await fn('public.reclassify_document($1,$2::jsonb,$3)',[document,json(patch),actor]);},
  async claimExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){return (await fn<boolean>('public.claim_document_extract_lease($1,$2,$3)',[document,batch,ttl]))===true;},
  async renewExtractLease(document,batch,ttl){return (await fn<boolean>('public.renew_document_extract_lease($1,$2,$3)',[document,batch,ttl]))===true;},
  async finishExtract(document,batch,extraction,pages){return String(await fn('public.finish_document_extract($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4::jsonb)',[document,batch,json(extraction),json(pages)]));},
  async failExtract(document,batch,code){await fn('public.fail_document_extract($1,$2,$3)',[document,batch,code]);},
  async requestExtract(document,actor){await fn('public.request_document_extract($1,$2,$3,$4)',[document,actor,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION]);},
  async claimCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){return (await fn<boolean>('public.claim_candidates_lease($1,$2,$3)',[extraction,batch,ttl]))===true;},
  async renewCandidatesLease(extraction,batch,ttl){return (await fn<boolean>('public.renew_candidates_lease($1,$2,$3)',[extraction,batch,ttl]))===true;},
  async finishCandidates(extraction,batch,status){await fn('public.finish_candidates($1,$2,$3)',[extraction,batch,status]);},
  async requestCandidatesRegen(filter,actor){return Number(await fn('public.request_candidates_regen($1::jsonb,$2)',[json(regenFilter(filter)),actor]));},
  async writeCandidateChecks(extraction,batch,input){
   let written=0,inherited=0;
   for(const part of input.length?chunk(input,WRITE_CHUNK):[[]]){const r=await fn<{written:number;inherited:number}>('public.write_candidate_checks($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[extraction,batch,json(part)]);written+=Number(r.written);inherited+=Number(r.inherited);}
   return {written,inherited};
  },
  async insertCitation(row){return String(await fn('public.insert_citation($1::jsonb)',[json(row)]));},
  async publishCitations(ids){return Number(await fn('public.publish_citations($1::uuid[])',[ids]));},
  async insertCandidates(extraction,batch,input){
   let inserted=0;
   for(const part of input.length?chunk(input,WRITE_CHUNK):[[]])inserted+=Number((await fn<{inserted:number}>('public.insert_candidates($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[extraction,batch,json(part)])).inserted);
   return {inserted};
  },
  async decideCandidate(candidate,decision){const r=await fn<{status:CandidateStatus}>('public.decide_candidate($1,$2::jsonb)',[candidate,json(decision)]);return {status:r.status};},
  async stageCandidatePublication(candidate,pubGen,run_,factId){
   const r=await fn<{outcome:string}>('public.stage_candidate_publication($1,$2,$3,$4)',[candidate,pubGen,run_,factId]);
   if(r.outcome==='approval_revoked')throw new DocumentsDbError('approval_revoked');
  },
  async insertApproval(row){
   const r=await one(`insert into public.extraction_approvals (extractor_ref, extractor_version, table_algo_version, code_version, concepts, gold_sha256, precision, recall, report_path, approved_by)
    values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5::text[],$6,$7::numeric,$8::numeric,$9,$10) returning approval_id`,
    [row.extractor_ref,row.extractor_version,row.table_algo_version,row.code_version,row.concepts,row.gold_sha256,row.precision,row.recall,row.report_path,row.approved_by]);
   return String(r!.approval_id);
  },
  async revokeApproval(approvalId){
   const changed=await run(`update public.extraction_approvals set revoked_at = now() where approval_id = $1 and revoked_at is null`,[approvalId]);
   if(changed.rowCount===0&&!(await one(`select 1 from public.extraction_approvals where approval_id = $1`,[approvalId])))throw new DocumentsDbError('not_found');
  },
  async documentVersions(source,sourceRef,page){
   const limit=lookaheadLimit(page.limit);const after=page.cursor?Number(decodeCursor(page.cursor)[0]):null;
   const r=await run(`select * from public.disclosure_documents where source = $1 and source_ref = $2 and ($3::int is null or source_version > $3) order by source_version limit $4`,[source,sourceRef,after,limit+1]);
   return sliceRows(r.rows,limit,documentFromRow,x=>[Number(x.source_version)]);
  },
  async knownSourceRefs(issuer,source,refs){
   const out=new Set<string>();
   for(const part of chunk([...new Set(refs)],REFS_CHUNK))for(const x of (await fn<string[]|null>('public.known_source_refs($1,$2,$3::text[])',[issuer,source,part]))??[])out.add(x);
   return out;
  },
  async readDocuments(issuer,opts){
   const a=readDocumentsArgs(issuer,opts);
   return pageOf(await fn<Envelope>('public.read_documents($1,$2::date,$3,$4,$5::date,$6::date,$7::jsonb,$8,$9)',[a.p_issuer,a.p_as_of,a.p_source,a.p_doc_class,a.p_from,a.p_to,json(a.p_cursor),a.p_limit,a.p_all_versions]),documentFromRow,READ_DOC_KEYS);
  },
  async documentById(id){const r=await one(`select * from public.disclosure_documents where document_id = $1`,[id]);return r?documentFromRow(r):null;},
  async assetsOf(documentId){return (await run(`select * from public.document_assets where document_id = $1 order by role, filename limit $2`,[documentId,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX])).rows.map(assetFromRow);},
  async extractionsOf(documentId,page){
   const limit=lookaheadLimit(page.limit);const [at,id]=page.cursor?decodeCursor(page.cursor):[null,null];
   const r=await run(`select * from public.document_extractions where document_id = $1 and ($2::timestamptz is null or (created_at, extraction_id) < ($2::timestamptz, $3::uuid))
    order by created_at desc, extraction_id desc limit $4`,[documentId,at,id,limit+1]);
   return sliceRows(r.rows,limit,extractionFromRow,x=>[String(x.created_at),String(x.extraction_id)]);
  },
  async extractionById(id){const r=await one(`select * from public.document_extractions where extraction_id = $1`,[id]);return r?extractionFromRow(r):null;},
  async pagesOf(extractionId,pageNos){
   if(checkIds(pageNos).length===0)return [];
   return (await run(`select * from public.document_pages where extraction_id = $1 and page_no = any($2::int[]) order by page_no`,[extractionId,[...new Set(pageNos)]])).rows.map(pageFromRow);
  },
  async citationById(id){const r=await one(`select * from public.document_citations where citation_id = $1`,[id]);return r?citationFromRow(r):null;},
  async citationsByIds(ids){
   if(checkIds(ids).length===0)return [];
   return (await run(`select * from public.document_citations where citation_id = any($1::uuid[]) order by citation_id`,[[...new Set(ids)]])).rows.map(citationFromRow);
  },
  async candidatesOf(where,page){
   const w=candidatesWhere(where);
   return pageOf(await fn<Envelope>('public.list_candidates($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb,$5)',[w.p_extraction,w.p_status,w.p_issuer,json(sqlCursor(page.cursor,CANDIDATE_KEYS)),checkLimit(page.limit)]),candidateFromRow,CANDIDATE_KEYS);
  },
  async candidateById(id){const r=await one(`select * from public.extraction_candidates where candidate_id = $1`,[id]);return r?candidateFromRow(r):null;},
  async publicationsOf(where,page){
   const w=publicationsWhere(where);
   return pageOf(await fn<Envelope>('public.list_candidate_publications($1::uuid[],$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb,$7)',[w.p_candidate_ids,w.p_run,w.p_issuer,w.p_pub_gen,w.p_state,json(sqlCursor(page.cursor,PUBLICATION_KEYS)),checkLimit(page.limit)]),publicationFromRow,PUBLICATION_KEYS);
  },
  async approvalsFor(extractorRef,opts){
   const limit=checkApprovalsLimit(opts.limit);
   const r=(await run(`select * from public.extraction_approvals where extractor_ref = $1 and revoked_at is null order by approved_at desc, approval_id limit $2`,[extractorRef,limit+1])).rows;
   if(r.length>limit)throw new DocumentsDbError('too_many_approvals',`more than ${limit} approvals for ${extractorRef}`);
   return r.map(approvalFromRow);
  },
  async storedDue(limit){return ((await fn<Record<string,unknown>[]|null>('public.documents_stored_due($1)',[checkLimit(limit)]))??[]).map(documentFromRow);},
  async candidatesDue(limit){return ((await fn<Record<string,unknown>[]|null>('public.extractions_candidates_due($1)',[checkLimit(limit)]))??[]).map(extractionFromRow);},
  async scopeDue(source,now,limit){
   return (await run(`select * from public.document_sync_scope where source = $1 and priority > 0 and next_due_at <= $2::timestamptz order by next_due_at, priority desc, issuer_id limit $3`,[source,now,checkLimit(limit)])).rows.map(scopeFromRow);
  },
  async scopeRows(source,issuerIds){
   const out:DocScopeRow[]=[];
   for(const part of chunk([...new Set(issuerIds)],IN_CHUNK))out.push(...(await run(`select * from public.document_sync_scope where source = $1 and issuer_id = any($2::uuid[]) order by issuer_id`,[source,part])).rows.map(scopeFromRow));
   return out;
  },
  async scopeAll(source){
   return (await run(`select * from public.document_sync_scope where source = $1 order by issuer_id`,[source])).rows.map(scopeFromRow);
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/object-store.test.ts

import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {ObjectStoreError,blobPath,extOfMime,isDuplicateError,isNotFoundError,isStorePath,memoryObjectStore,pagesJsonPath,supabaseObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {DOCS_BUCKET} from './types';

const H=createHash('sha256').update('pdf').digest('hex');const P=createHash('sha256').update('pages').digest('hex');
const bytes=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);

describe('paths',()=>{
 it('are content addressed and validated',()=>{
  expect(blobPath(H,'application/pdf')).toBe(`blobs/${H}.pdf`);
  expect(blobPath(H,'text/html')).toBe(`blobs/${H}.htm`);
  expect(blobPath(H,'application/xhtml+xml')).toBe(`blobs/${H}.htm`);
  expect(blobPath(H,'text/xml')).toBe(`blobs/${H}.xml`);
  expect(blobPath(H,'application/json')).toBe(`blobs/${H}.json`);
  expect(pagesJsonPath(H,P)).toBe(`extractions/${H}/${P}.pages.json`);
  expect(()=>extOfMime('image/png')).toThrow(ObjectStoreError);
  expect(()=>blobPath('ABC','application/pdf')).toThrow(/invalid_path/);
  expect(()=>pagesJsonPath(H,'x')).toThrow(/invalid_path/);
  expect(isStorePath(`blobs/${H}.pdf`)).toBe(true);
  for(const bad of [`blobs/${H}.exe`,`../blobs/${H}.pdf`,`blobs/${H}.pdf/x`,`extractions/${H}/${P}.json`,''])expect(isStorePath(bad)).toBe(false);

});

describe('error shape normalisation (Supabase duplicate shape unverified: spec §15 Q6)',()=>{
 it('treats statusCode 409, HTTP 409 and "already exists"/"Duplicate" as a duplicate; 404 shapes as not found',()=>{
  expect(isDuplicateError({message:'The resource already exists',status:400,statusCode:'409'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isDuplicateError({message:'x',status:409})).toBe(true);
  expect(isDuplicateError({message:'x',error:'Duplicate'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isDuplicateError({message:'The resource already exists'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isDuplicateError({message:'Payload too large',status:413,statusCode:'413'})).toBe(false);
  expect(isNotFoundError({message:'Object not found',status:400,statusCode:'404'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isNotFoundError({message:'x',status:404})).toBe(true);
  expect(isNotFoundError({message:'Internal error',status:500})).toBe(false);
 });
});

describe('memoryObjectStore',()=>{
 it('creates once, answers exists, copies bytes in and out, heads, signs, and fails on demand',async()=>{
  const store=memoryObjectStore({failPut:p=>p.endsWith('.json')});const path=blobPath(H,'application/pdf');
  const b=bytes('%PDF-1.4');
  expect(await store.put(path,b,'application/pdf')).toBe('created');
  b[0]=0;                                                                     // the caller's buffer changes afterwards
  expect(await store.put(path,bytes('other'),'application/pdf')).toBe('exists');
  const got=await store.get(path);expect(new TextDecoder().decode(got)).toBe('%PDF-1.4');
  got[0]=0;expect(new TextDecoder().decode(await store.get(path))).toBe('%PDF-1.4');
  expect(await store.head(path)).toEqual({bytes:8});
  expect(await store.head(blobPath(P,'application/pdf'))).toBeNull();
  expect(await store.signedUrl(path,300)).toBe(`memory://${DOCS_BUCKET}/${path}?expires=300`);
  await expect(store.signedUrl(path,0)).rejects.toThrow(/signed_url_failed/);
  await expect(store.get(blobPath(P,'application/pdf'))).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'object_not_found'});
  await expect(store.put(pagesJsonPath(H,P),bytes('{}'),'application/json')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'object_put_failed'});
  await expect(store.put('blobs/x.pdf',bytes('x'),'application/pdf')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'invalid_path'});
  expect([...store.objects().keys()]).toEqual([path]);
 });
});
```

```ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {addDecimal,isDecimal,negate,parsePresented,scaleDecimal,subDecimal} from './decimal';

describe('scaleDecimal',()=>{

  expect(scaleDecimal('12.5','1000000')).toBe('12500000');

  expect(scaleDecimal('123','0.01')).toBe('1.23');

  expect(scaleDecimal('98765432109876543210','0.01')).toBe('987654321098765432.1');
 });

  expect(addDecimal('0.000001','0.000009')).toBe('0.00001');
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `object-store.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/object-store.ts
// ObjectStore over the private bucket disclosure-docs (spec §4.10, §4.11). Content-addressed paths:
// originals at blobs/{sha256}.{pdf|htm|xml|json}, extraction output at
// extractions/{content_sha256}/{pages_json_sha256}.pages.json — the bytes alone decide the object,
// so an existing object is never rewritten: put() uploads with upsert:false and answers 'exists'
// for a duplicate. Objects are never deleted (replay obligation). Every path is validated before
// any request. Acquisition metadata is not stored here (it lives on the document/asset rows).
// Duplicate-upload error shape (spec §15 question 6) is UNVERIFIED against hosted Supabase in this
// repo; the installed storage-js (2.105) raises StorageApiError{message, status, statusCode} where
// statusCode is the body's statusCode (Supabase answers HTTP 400 with statusCode '409', error
// 'Duplicate', message 'The resource already exists'). isDuplicateError therefore accepts
// statusCode '409', HTTP status 409, or a message/error matching /already exists|duplicate/i; the
// F3-0 Vercel/Supabase smoke records the real shape in the runbook (Task 19). Not-found reads
// (download / info) are normalised the same way (statusCode '404', status 404, /not.?found/i).
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {DOCS_BUCKET} from './types';
import type {DocMime,ObjectStore} from './types';

export type ObjectStoreErrorCode='object_put_failed'|'object_get_failed'|'object_not_found'|'invalid_path'|'signed_url_failed';
export class ObjectStoreError extends Error{
 constructor(public code:ObjectStoreErrorCode,message?:string){super(message===undefined?code:`${code}: ${message}`);this.name='ObjectStoreError';}
}

const EXT:Record<DocMime,string>={'application/pdf':'pdf','text/html':'htm','application/xhtml+xml':'htm','application/xml':'xml','text/xml':'xml','application/json':'json'};
const SHA=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const PATH=/^(?:blobs\/[0-9a-f]{64}\.(?:pdf|htm|xml|json)|extractions\/[0-9a-f]{64}\/[0-9a-f]{64}\.pages\.json)$/;
/** Longest signed URL lifetime accepted (7 days, the Storage maximum). */
export const MAX_SIGNED_SECONDS=604800;

export function extOfMime(mime:string):string{
 const ext=(EXT as Record<string,string>)[mime];
 if(!ext)throw new ObjectStoreError('invalid_path',`unsupported mime ${mime}`);
 return ext;
}
export function blobPath(sha256:string,mime:string):string{
 if(!SHA.test(sha256))throw new ObjectStoreError('invalid_path',`not a sha256: ${sha256.slice(0,80)}`);
 return `blobs/${sha256}.${extOfMime(mime)}`;
}
export function pagesJsonPath(contentSha:string,pagesSha:string):string{
 if(!SHA.test(contentSha)||!SHA.test(pagesSha))throw new ObjectStoreError('invalid_path','not a sha256');
 return `extractions/${contentSha}/${pagesSha}.pages.json`;
}
export const isStorePath=(path:string):boolean=>PATH.test(path);
const checkPath=(path:string)=>{if(!isStorePath(path))throw new ObjectStoreError('invalid_path',path.slice(0,120));};
const checkExpiry=(s:number)=>{if(!Number.isInteger(s)||s<1||s>MAX_SIGNED_SECONDS)throw new ObjectStoreError('signed_url_failed',`invalid expiry ${s}`);};

export interface StorageErrorLike{message?:string;statusCode?:string|number;status?:number;error?:string}
export function isDuplicateError(e:StorageErrorLike):boolean{
 return String(e.statusCode??'')==='409'||e.status===409||/already exists|duplicate/i.test(`${e.message??''} ${e.error??''}`);
}
export function isNotFoundError(e:StorageErrorLike):boolean{
 return String(e.statusCode??'')==='404'||e.status===404||/not.?found/i.test(`${e.message??''} ${e.error??''}`);
}

export function supabaseObjectStore(client:SupabaseClient,bucket:string=DOCS_BUCKET):ObjectStore{
 const b=()=>client.storage.from(bucket);
 return {
  async put(path,bytes,mime){
   checkPath(path);
   const {error}=await b().upload(path,bytes,{contentType:mime,upsert:false});
   if(!error)return 'created';
   if(isDuplicateError(error as StorageErrorLike))return 'exists';
   throw new ObjectStoreError('object_put_failed',(error as StorageErrorLike).message);
  },
  async get(path){
   checkPath(path);
   const {data,error}=await b().download(path);
   if(error){
    if(isNotFoundError(error as StorageErrorLike))throw new ObjectStoreError('object_not_found',path);
    throw new ObjectStoreError('object_get_failed',(error as StorageErrorLike).message);
   }
   return new Uint8Array(await data.arrayBuffer());
  },
  async head(path){
   checkPath(path);
   const {data,error}=await b().info(path);
   if(error){
    if(isNotFoundError(error as StorageErrorLike))return null;
    throw new ObjectStoreError('object_get_failed',(error as StorageErrorLike).message);
   }
   return {bytes:Number(data.size)};
  },
  async signedUrl(path,expiresSeconds){
   checkPath(path);checkExpiry(expiresSeconds);
   const {data,error}=await b().createSignedUrl(path,expiresSeconds);
   if(error||!data?.signedUrl)throw new ObjectStoreError('signed_url_failed',(error as StorageErrorLike|null)?.message??'no url');
   return data.signedUrl;
  },
 };
}

export interface MemoryObject{bytes:Uint8Array;mime:string}
/** In-memory store for unit tests. failPut lets a test make chosen uploads fail (object_put_failed). */
export function memoryObjectStore(opts:{failPut?:(path:string)=>boolean}={}):ObjectStore&{objects():Map<string,MemoryObject>}{
 const objects=new Map<string,MemoryObject>();
 return {
  objects:()=>objects,
  async put(path,bytes,mime){
   checkPath(path);
   if(opts.failPut?.(path))throw new ObjectStoreError('object_put_failed',`injected failure for ${path}`);
   if(objects.has(path))return 'exists';
   objects.set(path,{bytes:new Uint8Array(bytes),mime});   // a copy: later mutation of the caller's buffer cannot rewrite evidence
   return 'created';
  },
  async get(path){
   checkPath(path);
   const o=objects.get(path);if(!o)throw new ObjectStoreError('object_not_found',path);
   return new Uint8Array(o.bytes);
  },
  async head(path){checkPath(path);const o=objects.get(path);return o?{bytes:o.bytes.byteLength}:null;},
  async signedUrl(path,expiresSeconds){
   checkPath(path);checkExpiry(expiresSeconds);
   if(!objects.has(path))throw new ObjectStoreError('object_not_found',path);
   return `memory://${DOCS_BUCKET}/${path}?expires=${expiresSeconds}`;
  },
 };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `decimal.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/decimal.ts
// Exact decimal-string arithmetic for HK financial values (spec §7.5 item 5, §7.6 R5-8): a value
// is presented × scale with the sign rule applied, and never passes through Number. Scaling is a
// decimal-point shift (canonicalDecimal accepts an exponent); addition and subtraction use BigInt on
// a common number of fraction digits. Every result is in the canonical form of
// src/lib/facts/json-numbers.ts::canonicalDecimal (no exponent, no leading/trailing zeros, '-0' →
// '0'). Invalid input throws invalid_decimal (a programming error, not a data outcome).
// parsePresented reads one table cell (NFKC first: full-width digits, commas and parentheses
// become ASCII): '(1,234)' and '-1,234' are negative, a lone dash (- – —) is 'dash' (no value for
// the period), anything else that is not a well-grouped number is null.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../facts/json-numbers';

export type Scale='1'|'0.01'|'1000'|'1000000';
const SHIFT:Record<Scale,number>={'1':0,'0.01':-2,'1000':3,'1000000':6};
const DECIMAL=/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/;
const invalid=(s:unknown)=>new Error(`invalid_decimal:${String(s).slice(0,40)}`);

/** A plain signed decimal literal (no exponent, no grouping, no '+'). */
export function isDecimal(s:string):boolean{return typeof s==='string'&&DECIMAL.test(s);}
const check=(s:string)=>{if(!isDecimal(s))throw invalid(s);return s;};

/** digits × scale, exactly (digits may carry a sign and a fraction). */
export function scaleDecimal(digits:string,scale:Scale):string{
 const k=SHIFT[scale];
 if(k===undefined)throw invalid(scale);
 return canonicalDecimal(`${check(digits)}e${k}`);
}
export function negate(d:string):string{
 const c=canonicalDecimal(check(d));
 return c==='0'?'0':c.startsWith('-')?c.slice(1):`-${c}`;
}
/** Both operands as BigInt on the same number of fraction digits. */
function aligned(a:string,b:string):{x:bigint;y:bigint;frac:number}{
 const ca=canonicalDecimal(check(a)),cb=canonicalDecimal(check(b));
 const fa=ca.split('.')[1]?.length??0,fb=cb.split('.')[1]?.length??0;const frac=Math.max(fa,fb);
 const big=(c:string,f:number)=>BigInt(c.replace('.','')+'0'.repeat(frac-f));
 return {x:big(ca,fa),y:big(cb,fb),frac};
}
function fromScaled(n:bigint,frac:number):string{
 const neg=n<0n;let s=(neg?-n:n).toString();
 if(frac>0){s=s.padStart(frac+1,'0');s=`${s.slice(0,s.length-frac)}.${s.slice(s.length-frac)}`;}
 return canonicalDecimal(`${neg?'-':''}${s}`);
}
export function addDecimal(a:string,b:string):string{const {x,y,frac}=aligned(a,b);return fromScaled(x+y,frac);}
export function subDecimal(a:string,b:string):string{const {x,y,frac}=aligned(a,b);return fromScaled(x-y,frac);}

const GROUPED=/^(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?$/;
/** One presented table cell → unsigned digits (commas removed) and its sign; 'dash' for a lone dash; null otherwise. */
export function parsePresented(cell:string):{digits:string;negative:boolean}|'dash'|null{
 const s=cell.normalize('NFKC').trim();
 if(/^[-–—]$/.test(s))return 'dash';
 const m=/^(\()?([-–—])?([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)(\))?$/.exec(s);
 if(!m)return null;
 const [,open,minus,body,close]=m;
 if(!!open!==!!close||(open&&minus))return null;
 if(!GROUPED.test(body))return null;
 return {digits:body.replace(/,/g,''),negative:!!open||!!minus};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 写冒烟脚本 `scripts/documents/smoke-pdf.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Local pdfjs-dist smoke (document pipeline spec §7.1, §15 question 3; plan F3 Task 4).
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/documents/smoke-pdf.ts <file.pdf> [--max-pages <n>]
 *
 * Loads the Node build `pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs` (no canvas, no worker file: pdf.js runs
 * its fake worker in-process under Node), opens the PDF, calls getTextContent() on every page (or
 * the first n) and prints ONE JSON line:
 *   {file, bytes, sha256, pdfjsVersion, node, pages, pagesRead, textItems, pagesWithText, loadMs, totalMs, rssMb, peakRssMb, heapUsedMb}
 * `pages` is the number the Vercel preview smoke must reproduce (spec §7.1 pass criterion);
 * peakRssMb is sampled after every page. No network, no database, no writes. Exit 1 on a load or
 * parse failure (the error message is printed as {error}), 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {basename} from 'node:path';

const USAGE='usage: smoke-pdf.ts <file.pdf> [--max-pages <n>]';
const mb=(n:number)=>Math.round(n/1048576*10)/10;

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let file:string|undefined;let maxPages=Infinity;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--max-pages'){const n=Number(argv[++i]);if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}maxPages=n;}
  else if(!x.startsWith('--')&&file===undefined)file=x;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!file){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 const raw=readFileSync(file);
 const t0=performance.now();
 const pdfjs=await import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
 // getDocument takes ownership of (and may transfer) the buffer it is given: pass a copy.
 const doc=await pdfjs.getDocument({data:new Uint8Array(raw),isEvalSupported:false,disableFontFace:true,useSystemFonts:false,verbosity:0}).promise;
 const loadMs=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);
 const pages=doc.numPages;
 let textItems=0,pagesWithText=0,pagesRead=0,peak=process.memoryUsage().rss;
 try{
  for(let p=1;p<=pages&&p<=maxPages;p++){
   const page=await doc.getPage(p);
   const content=await page.getTextContent();
   const items=content.items.filter(it=>'str' in it&&it.str.trim()!=='').length;
   textItems+=items;if(items>0)pagesWithText++;pagesRead++;
   page.cleanup();
   peak=Math.max(peak,process.memoryUsage().rss);
  }
 }finally{await doc.destroy();}
 const m=process.memoryUsage();
 console.log(JSON.stringify({file:basename(file),bytes:raw.byteLength,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex'),pdfjsVersion:pdfjs.version,node:process.version,
  pages,pagesRead,textItems,pagesWithText,loadMs,totalMs:Math.round(performance.now()-t0),rssMb:mb(m.rss),peakRssMb:mb(peak),heapUsedMb:mb(m.heapUsed)}));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.log(JSON.stringify({error:(e as Error).message}));process.exitCode=1;});
```

生成一个两页、带 Helvetica 文本层的最小 PDF（xref 偏移按字节算；文件不提交）：

```bash
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const o=['<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>','<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R 4 0 R] /Count 2 >>'];for(const c of [6,7])o.push('<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 595 842] /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> /Contents '+c+' 0 R >>');o.push('<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>');for(const t of ['Revenue 1,234','Page two']){const s='BT /F1 12 Tf 72 720 Td ('+t+') Tj ET';o.push('<< /Length '+s.length+' >>\nstream\n'+s+'\nendstream');}let out='%PDF-1.4\n';const off=[];o.forEach((b,i)=>{off.push(Buffer.byteLength(out));out+=(i+1)+' 0 obj\n'+b+'\nendobj\n';});const x=Buffer.byteLength(out);out+='xref\n0 '+(o.length+1)+'\n0000000000 65535 f \n'+off.map(n=>String(n).padStart(10,'0')+' 00000 n \n').join('')+'trailer\n<< /Size '+(o.length+1)+' /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n'+x+'\n%%EOF\n';fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[1],out);" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/f3-smoke-two.pdf"
```

## Part B — 采集（Tasks 5–8）

本 Part 落地规格 §5.4（分类）、§6.4（范围）、§6.2（来源适配器）、§6.1/§10（同步核心与采集错误）、§6.3（`documents-sync` cron、脚本、`vercel.json`）。四个任务的代码都只依赖注入的 `DocumentsDb` / `TableClient` / `ObjectStore` / 抓取函数；单测全部在 `memoryDocumentsDb`（Task 2）+ `memoryObjectStore`（Task 4）+ `memoryTableClient` 上跑，不联网。

### Part B 契约变更请求（已整合）

> 整合状态：本节保留各 Part 的原始提案以便追溯；每条的裁决见文末「整合记录」，定稿签名以本计划头部「共享契约」与「契约补充」为准。

| B-2 | `SourceAdapter` 增加必填 `coverageGap:string\|null` 与可选 `assetsFromIndex?(listed:Listed,indexBytes:Uint8Array):ListedAsset[]`；`Listed.assets` 的元素类型命名为 `ListedAsset={role:AssetRole;filename:string;url:string;required:boolean}` | EDGAR 在 `files[]` 核对前不得置 `backfill_done`（§6.2），核心需要知道"段走完≠历史完整"；XBRL 实例的文件名只有抓到 `index.json` 后才知道（§6.1 第 6 步） | 仅 `sources/shared.ts`（本 Part 自有文件） |

### 跨 Part 假设（实现 Task 2/4 时请保证；本 Part 的测试依赖这些行为）

- `memoryDocumentsDb()` 返回的对象可被展开（`{...db}`）且方法不依赖 `this`；`setNow(iso)` 同时驱动租约到期判断与 `reconcileScope` 新行的 `next_due_at`。
- `reconcileScope` 新建行：`backfill_cursor={}`、`poll_cursor={}`、`backfill_done=false`、`next_due_at=now`、租约空、`last_*` 为 null；已有行只改 `reasons/priority/fetch_key`。
- `claimSyncLease`：行不存在 → false；他批次未过期 → false；同批次 → 续租 true。`releaseSyncLease`：仅持有者（否则 `DocumentsDbError('lease_lost')`）；写 `last_attempt_at=now`、`last_status`、成功时 `last_success_at=now`、`next_due_at=p_next_due`（原样），清租约。
- `insertDocumentVersion` / `advanceCursor`：租约不是本批次或已过期 → `DocumentsDbError('lease_lost')`；`advanceCursor(…,cursor=null,…)` 存 `{}`；`'backfill'` 模式写 `backfill_cursor` 与 `backfill_done`，`'poll'` 模式只写 `poll_cursor`；不带 `reset` 时只进不退（已完成回填只接受重复完成；新游标 `seq` 必须大于已存的），否则 `cursor_regression`（P2-4）。
- `insertDocumentVersion` 的版本语义按 §4.8：同 `(source,source_ref)` 已有同哈希 → `duplicate`；否则 `source_version=max+1`、`supersedes_document_id`=上一最高版本、`observed_replacement=(max>0)`；资产随文档写入（`assets()` 可读）。函数**不改** `p_doc.available_at`（替换版本的 `available_at=fetched_at` 由本 Part 在调用前决定，见 Task 7）。
- `knownSourceRefs(issuer,source,refs)` 只返回该发行人该来源已入库的引用；`documentVersions(source,ref,{limit})` 返回该引用全部版本（顺序不限）。
- `scopeDue(source,now,limit)`：`priority>0 and next_due_at<=now`（是否同时排除未过期租约都可以，本 Part 不依赖）。
- `memoryDocumentsDb` 暴露 `expireSyncLease(issuer,source)`、`documents()`、`assets()`、`scope()`（契约补充表已列）。
- `object-store.ts`：`blobPath(sha256,mime)` 对 `application/json` → `.json`、`application/xml`/`text/xml` → `.xml`、`text/html`/`application/xhtml+xml` → `.htm`、`application/pdf` → `.pdf`；`memoryObjectStore()` 是普通对象（可 `{...store,put}` 覆盖），`objects()` 返回 `Map<path,…>`。
- Part D1（Task 13/14）：港股文档的 `fiscal_year/fiscal_period/period_end` 只在标题含"截至…止"/"for the … ended …"时由 `classify` 填写（如 `0268` 夹具标题 `二零二六年中期報告` → 三者为 null）；`filing_source_ref` 对 hkexnews 恒为 null（HK filing 的 `source_ref` 含版本号，由晋升步骤生成）。候选与 filing 的期间不得依赖这三列非空。

### 规格中的问题与本 Part 的处理

1. **§6.1 `SyncDeps` 形状**：规格写 `list/segments` 两个函数，骨架契约写 `adapter:SourceAdapter`。按骨架。
2. **§6.1 第 5 步"先 HEAD/Content-Length"**：实现为**一次 GET**：响应头 `Content-Length` 超限即取消读取返回 `too_large`，否则流式读到上限即 `cancel()`。效果相同（正文从不读过上限），请求数减半（HKEX 1 req/s）。
3. **替换版本的 `available_at`**（§5.2）：SQL 函数接收的 `p_doc` 已带 `available_at`，函数内才知道是否"替换"。本 Part 在插入前读 `documentVersions`：已有版本且无同哈希 → `available_at=fetched_at`。同步租约串行化同发行人同来源；同一 `source_ref` 被两个发行人列出（联合公告）时理论上可竞争，此时版本号仍由函数正确分配，只有 `available_at` 可能取发布时间——记入 §17 偏差候选。
4. **`document_fetch_exhausted` 的 payload"含三次错误"**：游标契约只有 `{segment,last_ref,settled,attempts,seq}`（按 source_ref 记次数，P2-5），不存历史错误；payload 记 `attempts` 与最后一次 `{code,message}`，前两次错误在各自批次的 `errors` 中。
5. **`maxPerIssuer` 与 hkexnews 默认 `refetch=true`**：规格"新项计数"——已知项（即使重新下载）不计数。代价：hkex 每次运行重新下载窗口内已知 PDF（轮询窗口 1–2 天，量小）。
6. **轮询窗口未走完**（上限或截止）：规格未定。段 id 为 `poll:<from>`，游标保存该 id，下次从同一 `from` 继续同一列表（新项只会追加在末尾）；走完才清游标。
7. **EDGAR 覆盖缺口**：`files[]` 未核对时，`recent` 走完后 `backfill_done` 保持 false、回填游标重置为 `{}`（下次从头，已知项是不下载的重复）、回执 `coverage_summary`、`next_due=now+1d`（不是"回填未完 → now"，否则每次 cron 都重列）。
8. **EDGAR 历史段**：`segments()` 是同步的，无法预知 `files[]` 的文件名；核对后只有一个 `history` 段，`list()` 内逐个取 `filingTo >= from` 的文件。形态未核对（§15 问题 1），默认关闭（`EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED=false`）。
9. **HKEX 英文版**：§5.1 要求 `_c/_e` 两行，但现有采集器只搜 `lang=zh`（夹具只有 `_c`）。本 Part 每段各搜一次中文与英文（`lang=en`），假定英文页与已录制的中文页同布局——**未核对**；适配器选项 `languages` 可退回 `['zh']`。英文标题行的 headline（`[Interim/Half-Year Report]`、`[Final Results]`、`[Interim Results]`）已加入分类规则。
10. **巨潮排除词**：规格只对年报/半年报写排除词；本 Part 对季报同样适用（`摘要|英文|更正|已取消|补充` → other），并接受 `一季度报告/三季度报告`（无"第"）。
11. **EDGAR 持股表单**：EDGAR 现名 `SCHEDULE 13D/13G`（夹具出现 `SCHEDULE 13G`），与 `SC 13D/13G` 及 `/A` 一并归 `ownership`。
12. **HK 期间字段**：只对定期报告类（年报、中报、季报、业绩公告）解析；`fiscal_year` = 期末日的年份（3 月年结的公司 FY2026 = 截至 2026-03-31）；"截至…止"后的 `年度`→FY、`六個月`→H1，否则按类别。
13. **回执 `fetched` 口径**：有计数结局的项（inserted/versioned/duplicates/quarantined/failed）才计 `fetched`；404 只进 `skipped_summary(document_missing)`，避免"全是 404"被 `unaccounted` 误判为失败。
14. **dry-run**：规格只说"不上传、不建批次"。本 Part 的 dry-run 会下载待处理项正文（冒烟需要验证大小/MIME/哈希）并按 `documentVersions` 预判 `inserted/versioned/duplicates`；不抓资产；不写任何行、对象、隔离、游标、租约、批次、新鲜度。
15. **§6.3 `vercel.json` 五条**：本 Part 只加三条 `documents-sync`；`documents-extract`/`documents-candidates` 两条按骨架由 Task 19 在冒烟通过后加。
16. **脚本无截止**：租约 600 s 可能在长回填中过期，核心在每次写之前若租约 120 s 内到期即同批次续租（规格二同法），续租失败按 `lease_lost`。
17. **cron 的 `sinceYear`**：取 `当前年 − 10`（§1.1 成功标准）。

### 指挥步骤（真实网络，本 Part 代码不做）

F3-1 核对（§13、§15 问题 1/2），结果写 runbook 与实施日志：(a) 用一家公司录 EDGAR `filings.files[]` 分页文件与一份 `index.json` 为夹具，确认与 `edgar.ts` 的假设一致后，新开提交把 `EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED` 改 `true` 并补 `edgar.test.ts` 的真实夹具用例；(b) 录 HKEX 英文标题搜索页（`lang=en`）夹具，若布局不同则把 `deps.ts` 的 hkexnews 适配器设为 `languages:['zh']` 并记偏差；(c) 核对 HKEX 标题搜索按年范围是否截断条数，若截断把 `yearSegments` 改为更短区间；(d) `scripts/documents/sync.ts --source <s> --issuer <3 家> --since-year 2016`（dry-run）三来源各跑一次，回执落审计目录。

```ts
  expect(c('恒生电子2026年第一季度报告')).toMatchObject({doc_class:'quarterly_report',fiscal_period:'Q1',period_end:'2026-03-31'});

 });
 it('exclusion words make the document other',()=>{
  for(const t of ['2025年年度报告摘要','2025年年度报告（英文版）','关于2025年年度报告的更正公告','2025年年度报告（已取消）','2025年年度报告补充公告','2026年半年度报告摘要'])expect(c(t).doc_class,t).toBe('other');

  expect(c('关于股票期权激励计划自主行权的公告')).toEqual({doc_class:'other',fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:null,filing_source_ref:null,language:'zh'});
 });
});

  expect(h('[Interim Report]','Interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026','r_e')).toMatchObject({fiscal_period:'H1',period_end:'2026-06-30'});
```

```ts
  await reconcileDocumentScope({tables,db},'hkexnews',{today:TODAY});
  await reconcileDocumentScope({tables,db},'hkexnews',{today:TODAY});
  expect(calls[1].rows).toEqual(calls[0].rows);
  await tables.update('research_entity_keys',{user_id:'u',entity_id:'e-h'},{in_scope:false});
  const r=await reconcileDocumentScope({tables,db},'hkexnews',{today:TODAY});
  expect(r).toMatchObject({desired:0,retired:1});
  expect(calls[2].rows).toEqual([{issuer_id:H,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:'00268'}]);
  expect(await db.scopeDue('hkexnews',NOW_ISO,10)).toEqual([]);
  // a retired row is not retired again (priority already 0): nothing to write
  const again=await reconcileDocumentScope({tables,db},'hkexnews',{today:TODAY});
  expect(again).toMatchObject({desired:0,retired:0});
  expect(calls).toHaveLength(3);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/classify.ts
// Document classification (spec §5.4). classify(source, input) maps one listed item to doc_class,
// fiscal_year / fiscal_period / period_end, filing_source_ref and language. Pure: no I/O. A rule
// change bumps CLASSIFIER_GEN (types.ts) and old rows are reclassified through reclassify_document.
//  edgar:    form → class; fiscal fields null; filing_source_ref = accession (source_ref before '/'); 'en'.
//  cninfo:   title keywords with exclusions (摘要|英文|更正|已取消|补充); fiscal_year = the single
//            four-digit year before 年 in the title; period_end by class; 'zh'.
//  hkexnews: headline keywords (title when the headline is empty); period from a 截至…止 /
//            "for the … ended …" phrase in the title (cnDate), else null; language from the _c/_e
//            suffix of source_ref. filing_source_ref stays null (the HK filing ref carries the
//            document version, spec §4.9; it is bound by the promotion step, not here).
// cnDate(s) finds the FIRST date in s written as 二零二五年十二月三十一日 / 二〇二五年… /
// 2025年12月31日 / 31 December 2025 / December 31, 2025 (NFKC first, so full-width digits work)
// and returns it as an ISO date, null when none or the calendar date is invalid.
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN} from './types';
import type {DocClass,FiscalPeriod,ListedSource} from './types';

export {CLASSIFIER_GEN};
export interface ClassifyInput{form_type?:string|null;title:string;headline?:string|null;source_ref:string}
export interface Classified{doc_class:DocClass;fiscal_year:number|null;fiscal_period:FiscalPeriod|null;period_end:string|null;filing_source_ref:string|null;language:'zh'|'en'|null}

const CN_DIGIT:Record<string,number>={'零':0,'〇':0,'○':0,'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4,'五':5,'六':6,'七':7,'八':8,'九':9};
const MONTHS=['january','february','march','april','may','june','july','august','september','october','november','december'];
/** 一..九, 十, 十二, 二十, 三十一 → 1..31; null for anything else. */
function cnSmall(s:string):number|null{
 if(/^[一二三四五六七八九]$/.test(s))return CN_DIGIT[s];
 const m=/^([一二三])?十([一二三四五六七八九])?$/.exec(s);
 if(!m)return null;
 return (m[1]?CN_DIGIT[m[1]]:1)*10+(m[2]?CN_DIGIT[m[2]]:0);
}
const pad=(n:number)=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
function isoOf(y:number,m:number,d:number):string|null{
 if(!Number.isInteger(y)||y<1900||y>2999||m<1||m>12||d<1||d>31)return null;
 const t=new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d));
 if(t.getUTCFullYear()!==y||t.getUTCMonth()!==m-1||t.getUTCDate()!==d)return null;
 return `${y}-${pad(m)}-${pad(d)}`;
}
const DATE_PATTERNS:{re:RegExp;parse:(m:RegExpExecArray)=>string|null}[]=[
 {re:/([零〇○一二三四五六七八九]{4})\s*年\s*([一二三四五六七八九十]{1,3})\s*月\s*([一二三四五六七八九十]{1,3})\s*日/,
  parse:m=>{const y=Number([...m[1]].map(c=>CN_DIGIT[c]).join(''));const mo=cnSmall(m[2]),d=cnSmall(m[3]);return mo===null||d===null?null:isoOf(y,mo,d);}},
 {re:/(\d{4})\s*年\s*(\d{1,2})\s*月\s*(\d{1,2})\s*日/,parse:m=>isoOf(Number(m[1]),Number(m[2]),Number(m[3]))},
 {re:/\b(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December),?\s+(\d{4})\b/i,
  parse:m=>isoOf(Number(m[3]),MONTHS.indexOf(m[2].toLowerCase())+1,Number(m[1]))},
 {re:/\b(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+(\d{1,2}),?\s+(\d{4})\b/i,
  parse:m=>isoOf(Number(m[3]),MONTHS.indexOf(m[1].toLowerCase())+1,Number(m[2]))},
];
/** First date in `s` (earliest position across all patterns) as YYYY-MM-DD; null when none parses. */
export function cnDate(s:string):string|null{
 const text=s.normalize('NFKC');
 let best:{at:number;iso:string|null}|null=null;
 for(const p of DATE_PATTERNS){
  const m=p.re.exec(text);
  if(m&&(best===null||m.index<best.at))best={at:m.index,iso:p.parse(m)};
 }
 return best?.iso??null;
}

const EDGAR_CLASS:[RegExp,DocClass][]=[
 [/^(10-K|20-F|40-F|10-K\/A|20-F\/A)$/,'annual_report'],
 [/^(10-Q|10-Q\/A)$/,'quarterly_report'],
 [/^(8-K|8-K\/A|6-K)$/,'current_report'],
 [/^(S-1|424B.*)$/,'registration'],
 [/^DEF 14A$/,'proxy'],
 // SCHEDULE 13D/13G is EDGAR's current name for the SC 13D/13G forms (and their amendments).
 [/^(SC|SCHEDULE) 13[DG](\/A)?$/,'ownership'],
];
const NONE={fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:null} as const;

function classifyEdgar(i:ClassifyInput):Classified{
 const form=(i.form_type??'').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
 const hit=EDGAR_CLASS.find(([re])=>re.test(form));
 const accn=i.source_ref.split('/')[0];
 return {doc_class:hit?hit[1]:'other',...NONE,filing_source_ref:accn||null,language:'en'};
}

const CN_EXCLUDE=/摘要|英文|更正|已取消|补充/;
function classifyCninfo(i:ClassifyInput):Classified{
 const t=i.title.normalize('NFKC');
 const years=[...new Set([...t.matchAll(/((?:19|20)\d{2})\s*年/g)].map(m=>Number(m[1])))];
 const year=years.length===1?years[0]:null;
 const periodic=(doc_class:DocClass,fiscal_period:FiscalPeriod,mmdd:string):Classified=>({doc_class,fiscal_year:year,fiscal_period:year===null?null:fiscal_period,period_end:year===null?null:`${year}-${mmdd}`,filing_source_ref:null,language:'zh'});
 const excluded=CN_EXCLUDE.test(t);
 if(!excluded&&t.includes('半年度报告'))return periodic('interim_report','H1','06-30');
 if(!excluded&&t.includes('年度报告')&&!t.includes('半年'))return periodic('annual_report','FY','12-31');
 if(!excluded&&/第?一季度报告/.test(t))return periodic('quarterly_report','Q1','03-31');
 if(!excluded&&/第?三季度报告/.test(t))return periodic('quarterly_report','Q3','09-30');
 if(/业绩快报|业绩预告/.test(t))return {doc_class:'results_announcement',fiscal_year:year,fiscal_period:null,period_end:null,filing_source_ref:null,language:'zh'};
 return {doc_class:'other',...NONE,filing_source_ref:null,language:'zh'};
}

function hkClass(text:string):DocClass{
 if(/年報|年报|Annual Report/i.test(text))return 'annual_report';
 if(/中期\/半年度報告|中期報告|半年度報告|中期报告|半年度报告|Interim Report|Interim\/Half-Year Report|Half-Year Report/i.test(text))return 'interim_report';
 if(/季度報告|季度报告|Quarterly Report/i.test(text))return 'quarterly_report';
 if(/業績公告|全年業績|中期業績|业绩公告|全年业绩|中期业绩|Results Announcement|Final Results|Interim Results/i.test(text))return 'results_announcement';
 return 'other';
}
/** The reporting period phrase of an HKEX title: 截至<date>止(年度|六個月) or "for the (year|six months) ended <date>". */
function hkPeriod(title:string):{end:string;duration:'FY'|'H1'|null}|null{
 const t=title.normalize('NFKC');
 const zh=/截至\s*(.+?)\s*止\s*(年度|六個月|六个月)?/.exec(t);
 if(zh){const end=cnDate(zh[1]);if(end)return {end,duration:zh[2]==='年度'?'FY':zh[2]?'H1':null};}
 const en=/for the\s+(year|six months|six-month period|period)\s+ended\s+(.+)$/i.exec(t);
 if(en){const end=cnDate(en[2]);if(end)return {end,duration:/^year$/i.test(en[1])?'FY':/six/i.test(en[1])?'H1':null};}
 return null;
}
const HK_PERIODIC=new Set<DocClass>(['annual_report','interim_report','quarterly_report','results_announcement']);
function classifyHkex(i:ClassifyInput):Classified{
 const head=(i.headline??'').trim();
 const doc_class=hkClass(head.length>0?head:i.title);
 const language=/_c$/i.test(i.source_ref)?'zh':/_e$/i.test(i.source_ref)?'en':null;
 const p=HK_PERIODIC.has(doc_class)?hkPeriod(i.title):null;
 if(!p)return {doc_class,...NONE,filing_source_ref:null,language};
 const fiscal_period:FiscalPeriod|null=p.duration??(doc_class==='annual_report'?'FY':doc_class==='interim_report'?'H1':null);
 return {doc_class,fiscal_year:Number(p.end.slice(0,4)),fiscal_period,period_end:p.end,filing_source_ref:null,language};
}

export function classify(source:ListedSource,input:ClassifyInput):Classified{
 if(source==='edgar')return classifyEdgar(input);
 if(source==='cninfo')return classifyCninfo(input);
 return classifyHkex(input);
}
```
