```ts
// src/lib/documents/scope.ts
// Document sync scope (spec §6.4). reconcileDocumentScope(source) is idempotent: it computes the
// desired rows of one source, retires rows that left the sources (reasons [], priority 0, fetch_key
// kept; never deleted) and hands everything to DocumentsDb.reconcileScope (SQL
// reconcile_document_sync_scope), which only writes reasons/priority/fetch_key.
//  edgar:    the facts US scope source (active tickers of US_UNIVERSES → current owner → active issuer
//            with a CIK); fetch_key = 10-digit CIK; reasons universe:<u>.
//  cninfo:   research_entity_keys.in_scope with issuer_id → the issuer's current A-share by the facts
//            rule (chooseCnTicker); only .SH/.SZ (.BJ is not on cninfo's sse/szse columns: skipped
//            bj_excluded); fetch_key '<code>,<cninfo_org_id>' ('<code>,' when the org id is unknown).
//  hkexnews: research_entity_keys.in_scope with issuer_id whose issuers.hkex_stock_code_primary is
//            set; fetch_key = that 5-digit code.
// Merged issuers never enter. Shared helpers come from src/lib/facts/scope.ts by import (that file is
// not edited); its keysetAll is not exported, so the same keyset reader is repeated here.
// documentScopeRowFor builds ONE issuer's row the same way for explicit runs (reasons ['explicit']).
import {MAX_PAGE,selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import type {RangeOptions,Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '../entities/resolve';
import {US_UNIVERSES,chooseCnTicker,currentSecurities,fetchKey} from '../facts/scope';
import type {DocScopeInput,DocumentsDb,ListedSource} from './types';

export const DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY=10;
export interface DocScopeDeps{tables:TableClient;db:Pick<DocumentsDb,'reconcileScope'|'scopeRows'|'scopeAll'>}
export interface DocScopeResult{desired:number;retired:number;skipped:Record<string,number>}

const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim().length>0?v.trim():null;
const normTicker=(t:string)=>t.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
const bump=(m:Record<string,number>,k:string)=>{m[k]=(m[k]??0)+1;};
const isoToday=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

/** 5-digit HKEX stock code of an issuer row (issuers.hkex_stock_code_primary). */
export function hkFetchKey(issuer:{hkex_stock_code_primary?:unknown}):string{
 const code=str(issuer.hkex_stock_code_primary);
 if(!code||!/^\d{5}$/.test(code))throw new Error('missing_hkex_code');
 return code;
}
/** '<6-digit code>,<orgId>'; orgId null/empty → '<code>,' (the adapter resolves it through topSearch). */
export function cninfoFetchKey(code:string,orgId:string|null):string{
 if(!/^\d{6}$/.test(code))throw new Error('not_cn_code');
 const org=orgId?.trim()??'';
 if(org.includes(','))throw new Error('invalid_org_id');
 return `${code},${org}`;
}

/** Keyset paging on a non-unique column (same algorithm as facts/scope.ts::keysetAll, which is not exported). */
async function keysetAll(tables:TableClient,table:string,match:Row,range:RangeOptions,orderBy:string,keyCols:string[]):Promise<Row[]>{
 const seen=new Set<string>(),out:Row[]=[];
 let cursor:string|null=null;
 for(;;){
  const gte={...range.gte,...(cursor===null?{}:{[orderBy]:cursor})};
  const page=await tables.select(table,match,{...range,gte,orderBy,limit:MAX_PAGE});
  for(const r of page){const k=keyCols.map(c=>String(r[c])).join('\u0000');if(!seen.has(k)){seen.add(k);out.push(r);}}
  if(page.length<MAX_PAGE)return out;
  const last=String(page[page.length-1][orderBy]);
  if(last===cursor)throw new Error('scope_tie_group_overflow');
  cursor=last;
 }
}
const SEC_KEY=['issuer_id','ticker','valid_from'];

async function issuerMap(tables:TableClient):Promise<Map<string,Row>>{
 return new Map((await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{},'issuer_id')).map(i=>[String(i.issuer_id),i]));
}
async function inScopeIssuers(tables:TableClient,skipped:Record<string,number>):Promise<string[]>{
 const keys=await keysetAll(tables,'research_entity_keys',{in_scope:true},{},'entity_id',['user_id','entity_id']);
 const ids=new Set<string>();
 for(const k of keys){const id=str(k.issuer_id);if(id)ids.add(id);else bump(skipped,'no_issuer');}
 return [...ids].sort();
}
/** Issuer usable for documents: exists and is not merged (merged issuers' filings belong to the survivor). */
function usable(issuers:Map<string,Row>,id:string,skipped:Record<string,number>):Row|null{
 const i=issuers.get(id);
 if(!i){bump(skipped,'unknown_issuer');return null;}
 if(i.status==='merged'){bump(skipped,'issuer_merged');return null;}
 return i;
}

async function desiredEdgar(tables:TableClient,today:string,skipped:Record<string,number>):Promise<DocScopeInput[]>{
 const reasonsByTicker=new Map<string,Set<string>>();
 for(const u of US_UNIVERSES){
  for(const m of await selectAll(tables,'security_universe_memberships',{universe:u,is_active:true},'ticker')){
   const t=normTicker(String(m.ticker));
   (reasonsByTicker.get(t)??reasonsByTicker.set(t,new Set()).get(t)!).add(`universe:${u}`);
  }
 }
 const ownerByTicker=new Map<string,string>();
 for(const s of await currentSecurities(tables,today)){const id=str(s.issuer_id);if(id)ownerByTicker.set(normTicker(String(s.ticker)),id);}
 const issuers=await issuerMap(tables);
 const out=new Map<string,DocScopeInput>();
 for(const [ticker,reasons] of reasonsByTicker){
  const id=ownerByTicker.get(ticker);
  if(!id){bump(skipped,'unknown_ticker');continue;}
  const issuer=issuers.get(id);
  if(!issuer||issuer.status!=='active'){bump(skipped,'issuer_not_active');continue;}
  let key:string;
  try{key=fetchKey('US',{cik:str(issuer.cik)});}catch{bump(skipped,'no_cik');continue;}
  const row=out.get(id)??out.set(id,{issuer_id:id,reasons:[],priority:DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:key}).get(id)!;
  row.reasons=[...new Set([...row.reasons,...reasons])].sort();
 }
 return [...out.values()];
}

/** cninfo row of one issuer from its current securities, or the skip reason. */
function cninfoRow(issuer:Row,secs:Row[],reasons:string[]):DocScopeInput|{reason:string}{
 const c=chooseCnTicker(secs);
 if('reason' in c)return {reason:c.reason};
 const m=/^(\d{6})\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/.exec(c.ticker);
 if(!m)return {reason:'no_cn_ticker'};
 if(m[2]==='BJ')return {reason:'bj_excluded'};
 try{return {issuer_id:String(issuer.issuer_id),reasons,priority:DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:cninfoFetchKey(m[1],str(issuer.cninfo_org_id))};}
 catch{return {reason:'invalid_org_id'};}
}

async function desiredCninfo(tables:TableClient,today:string,skipped:Record<string,number>):Promise<DocScopeInput[]>{
 const ids=await inScopeIssuers(tables,skipped);
 const issuers=await issuerMap(tables);
 const byIssuer=new Map<string,Row[]>();
 for(const s of await currentSecurities(tables,today)){const id=str(s.issuer_id);if(id)(byIssuer.get(id)??byIssuer.set(id,[]).get(id)!).push(s);}
 const out:DocScopeInput[]=[];
 for(const id of ids){
  const issuer=usable(issuers,id,skipped);if(!issuer)continue;
  const r=cninfoRow(issuer,byIssuer.get(id)??[],['cohort']);
  if('reason' in r){bump(skipped,r.reason);continue;}
  out.push(r);
 }
 return out;
}

async function desiredHk(tables:TableClient,skipped:Record<string,number>):Promise<DocScopeInput[]>{
 const ids=await inScopeIssuers(tables,skipped);
 const issuers=await issuerMap(tables);
 const out:DocScopeInput[]=[];
 for(const id of ids){
  const issuer=usable(issuers,id,skipped);if(!issuer)continue;
  let key:string;
  try{key=hkFetchKey(issuer);}catch{bump(skipped,'no_hkex_code');continue;}
  out.push({issuer_id:id,reasons:['cohort'],priority:DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:key});
 }
 return out;
}

export async function reconcileDocumentScope(deps:DocScopeDeps,source:ListedSource,opts:{today?:string}={}):Promise<DocScopeResult>{
 const today=opts.today??isoToday();
 const skipped:Record<string,number>={};
 const desired=source==='edgar'?await desiredEdgar(deps.tables,today,skipped):source==='cninfo'?await desiredCninfo(deps.tables,today,skipped):await desiredHk(deps.tables,skipped);
 const wanted=new Set(desired.map(d=>d.issuer_id));
 const retired:DocScopeInput[]=(await deps.db.scopeAll(source))
  .filter(r=>r.priority>0&&!wanted.has(r.issuer_id))
  .map(r=>({issuer_id:r.issuer_id,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:r.fetch_key}));
 const rows=[...desired,...retired].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:0);
 if(rows.length>0)await deps.db.reconcileScope(source,rows);
 return {desired:desired.length,retired:retired.length,skipped};
}

/**
 * One issuer's scope input for explicit runs (scripts --issuer, replay tests), reasons ['explicit'].
 * Null when the issuer is unknown or merged or has no fetch key for this source; the sync core then
 * reports scope_unresolved. Database errors propagate.
 */
export async function documentScopeRowFor(tables:TableClient,source:ListedSource,issuerId:string,opts:{today?:string}={}):Promise<DocScopeInput|null>{
 const today=opts.today??isoToday();
 const [issuer]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuerId},{limit:1});
 if(!issuer||issuer.status==='merged')return null;
 const reasons=['explicit'];
 if(source==='edgar'){
  try{return {issuer_id:issuerId,reasons,priority:DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:fetchKey('US',{cik:str(issuer.cik)})};}catch{return null;}
 }
 if(source==='hkexnews'){
  try{return {issuer_id:issuerId,reasons,priority:DOC_SCOPE_PRIORITY,fetch_key:hkFetchKey(issuer)};}catch{return null;}
 }
 const secs=(await keysetAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{issuer_id:issuerId},{},'ticker',SEC_KEY)).filter(r=>isCurrentSecurity(r,today));
 const r=cninfoRow(issuer,secs,reasons);
 return 'reason' in r?null:r;
}
```

### Task 6: 来源适配器 `sources/{shared,edgar,cninfo,hkexnews}.ts`

**Files:** Create: `src/lib/documents/sources/shared.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/edgar.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/cninfo.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/hkexnews.ts` / Test: `src/lib/documents/sources/shared.test.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/edgar.test.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/cninfo.test.ts`、`src/lib/documents/sources/hkexnews.test.ts`
**Spec:** §6.2、§6.1 第 5 步（抓取、退避、上限）、§5.1（`source_ref`）、§15 问题 1/2/4
**Depends on:** Task 5（`classify`）；Task 2（`types.ts`）；现有采集器只 import 不改：`collectors/shared.ts::{DEFAULT_USER_AGENT,localDate}`、`collectors/edgar.ts::primaryDocumentUrl`、`collectors/cninfo.ts::{CNINFO_HISTORY,CNINFO_TOPSEARCH}`、`collectors/hkexnews.ts::{HKEX_PREFIX,HKEX_TITLESEARCH,parseTitleSearch}`。未导出的部分（cninfo 的 `STATIC`/`PAGE_SIZE`、topSearch、HKEX `prefix.do` 解析）在新文件里最小重写。夹具复用 `src/lib/research/ingest/__fixtures__/collectors/*`。

要点：
- 一个来源一次运行一个 `PoliteHttp`（适配器列表与正文下载共用节奏）：UA = `EDGAR_USER_AGENT ?? DEFAULT_USER_AGENT`；最小间隔 edgar 120 ms / cninfo 500 ms / hkexnews 1000 ms；单请求超时 `min(60 s, 剩余 − 20 s)`（剩余 ≤ 20 s 抛 `budget_exhausted`）；429/503 退避 1→2→4→8 s，预算不够等待即抛 `budget_exhausted`；其余非 2xx 抛 `HttpError`；`fetchBytes` 的 404 → `'not_found'`。
- 段：回填 = 自然年 `y<year>`（id 稳定）；轮询 = 一个窗口 `poll:<from>`。EDGAR 回填只有 `recent`（`coverageGap='edgar_files_unverified'`），`EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED=true` 后才有 `history`。
- 列表默认只留定期报告类（`PERIODIC_CLASSES`，owner 决策 B），`allAnnouncements` 关闭过滤；返回按 `(published_at, source_ref)` 稳定排序、按 `source_ref` 去重的**完整**段列表。

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/shared.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {HttpError,assetMime,fetchBytes,makeDocBudget,orderListed,pollSegment,politeHttp,requestTimeoutMs,sniffMime,yearSegments} from './shared';
import type {Listed} from './shared';
import type {DocScopeRow} from '../types';

const unlimited=makeDocBudget(null);
const left=(ms:number)=>({deadline:new Date(0),remainingMs:()=>ms});
const pdf=(n:number)=>{const b=new Uint8Array(n);b.set([0x25,0x50,0x44,0x46,0x2d]);return b;};   // '%PDF-' + zeros
const scope=(o:Partial<DocScopeRow>={}):DocScopeRow=>({issuer_id:'i',source:'hkexnews',reasons:[],priority:10,fetch_key:'00268',backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:true,poll_cursor:{},next_due_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z',lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z',...o});

describe('budget and timeouts',()=>{
 it('remainingMs follows the injected clock; no deadline is unlimited',()=>{
  let t=Date.parse('2026-11-06T00:00:00Z');
  const b=makeDocBudget(new Date(t+240_000),()=>new Date(t));
  expect(b.remainingMs()).toBe(240_000);t+=250_000;expect(b.remainingMs()).toBe(0);
  expect(unlimited.remainingMs()).toBe(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
 });
 it('request timeout is min(60 s, remaining − 20 s) and refuses when nothing is left',()=>{
  expect(requestTimeoutMs(unlimited)).toBe(60_000);
  expect(requestTimeoutMs(left(50_000))).toBe(30_000);
  expect(()=>requestTimeoutMs(left(20_000))).toThrow('budget_exhausted');
 });
});

describe('politeHttp',()=>{
 it('declares the User-Agent (default from the collectors) and paces requests',async()=>{
  const seen:string[]=[];const sleeps:number[]=[];let now=0;
  const http=politeHttp({minIntervalMs:500,clock:()=>now,sleep:async ms=>{sleeps.push(ms);now+=ms;},fetch:async(_u,init)=>{seen.push(String((init?.headers as Record<string,string>)['User-Agent']));return new Response('ok');}});
  await http.getText('https://x/a',unlimited);now+=100;await http.getText('https://x/b',unlimited);
  expect(seen[0]).toBe(process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT);
  expect(sleeps).toEqual([400]);
 });
 it('backs off 1→2→4→8 s on 429/503, then throws HttpError; stops early when the budget cannot cover the wait',async()=>{
  const sleeps:number[]=[];
  const f=vi.fn(async()=>new Response('busy',{status:503}));
  const http=politeHttp({fetch:f,sleep:async ms=>{sleeps.push(ms);}});
  await expect(http.getText('https://x/a',unlimited)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(HttpError);
  expect(sleeps).toEqual([1000,2000,4000,8000]);expect(f).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5);
  const ok=vi.fn().mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response('',{status:429})).mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response('fine'));
  expect(await politeHttp({fetch:ok,sleep:async()=>{}}).getText('https://x/b',unlimited)).toBe('fine');
  const tight=politeHttp({fetch:async()=>new Response('',{status:429}),sleep:async()=>{}});
  await expect(tight.getText('https://x/c',left(21_500))).rejects.toThrow('budget_exhausted');
 });
});

describe('fetchBytes',()=>{
 it('returns bytes, mime, status, lower-cased headers and fetch time',async()=>{
  const r=await fetchBytes('https://x/a.pdf',unlimited,1000,{fetch:async()=>new Response(pdf(10),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/pdf; charset=binary',ETag:'"e1"'}}),clock:()=>Date.parse('2026-11-06T01:02:03Z')});
  if(typeof r==='string')throw new Error(r);
  expect(r.bytes.length).toBe(10);expect(r.mime).toBe('application/pdf');expect(r.status).toBe(200);
  expect(r.headers.etag).toBe('"e1"');expect(r.fetchedAt).toBe('2026-11-06T01:02:03.000Z');
 });
 it('404 → not_found; other errors throw',async()=>{
  expect(await fetchBytes('https://x/a',unlimited,10,{fetch:async()=>new Response('',{status:404})})).toBe('not_found');
  await expect(fetchBytes('https://x/a',unlimited,10,{fetch:async()=>new Response('',{status:500})})).rejects.toThrow('http_500');
 });
 it('too_large from Content-Length without reading, and from the streamed body at the cap',async()=>{
  expect(await fetchBytes('https://x/a',unlimited,10,{fetch:async()=>new Response(pdf(5),{headers:{'Content-Length':'11'}})})).toBe('too_large');
  const stream=new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({start(c){c.enqueue(pdf(6));c.enqueue(new Uint8Array(6));c.close();}});
  expect(await fetchBytes('https://x/a',unlimited,10,{fetch:async()=>new Response(stream)})).toBe('too_large');
  const exact=await fetchBytes('https://x/a',unlimited,10,{fetch:async()=>new Response(pdf(10))});
  expect(typeof exact==='string'?exact:exact.bytes.length).toBe(10);
 });
});

describe('mime',()=>{
 it('PDF magic wins; a declared PDF without it is unexpected; html/json pass through',()=>{
  expect(sniffMime('application/octet-stream',pdf(8))).toBe('application/pdf');

  expect(assetMime('','pltr-20260630_htm.xml')).toBe('application/xml');

 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/edgar.test.ts
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED,edgarAdapter} from './edgar';
import {makeDocBudget,politeHttp} from './shared';
import type {DocScopeRow} from '../types';

const fx=(n:string)=>readFileSync(new URL(`../../research/ingest/__fixtures__/collectors/${n}`,import.meta.url),'utf8');
const budget=makeDocBudget(null);
const NOW=new Date('2026-11-06T00:00:00Z');
const scope=(o:Partial<DocScopeRow>={}):DocScopeRow=>({issuer_id:'i',source:'edgar',reasons:[],priority:10,fetch_key:'0001321655',backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:false,poll_cursor:{},next_due_at:NOW.toISOString(),lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:NOW.toISOString(),...o});
function http(routes:Record<string,string>){
 const urls:string[]=[];
 return {urls,http:politeHttp({fetch:async u=>{urls.push(String(u));const body=routes[String(u)];return body===undefined?new Response('',{status:404}):new Response(body);},sleep:async()=>{}})};
}
const SUB='https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001321655.json';

describe('edgarAdapter',()=>{
 it('is recent-only with a coverage gap until files[] is verified (spec §15 q1)',()=>{
  expect(EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED).toBe(false);
  const a=edgarAdapter({http:politeHttp()});
  expect(a.coverageGap).toBe('edgar_files_unverified');
  expect(a.segments(scope(),'backfill',2016,NOW)).toEqual([{id:'recent',from:'2016-01-01',to:'2026-11-06'}]);
  expect(edgarAdapter({http:politeHttp(),filesVerified:true}).segments(scope(),'backfill',2016,NOW).map(s=>s.id)).toEqual(['history','recent']);
  expect(edgarAdapter({http:politeHttp(),filesVerified:true}).coverageGap).toBeNull();
  expect(a.segments(scope({backfill_done:true,last_success_at:'2026-11-05T03:30:00.000Z'}),'poll',2016,NOW)[0].id).toBe('poll:2026-11-04');
 });
 it('lists the recorded submissions: default forms only, sorted, with source_ref, URL and the required index asset',async()=>{
  const {http:h,urls}=http({[SUB]:fx('edgar-submissions-1321655.json')});
  const rows=await edgarAdapter({http:h}).list(scope(),{id:'recent',from:'2016-01-01',to:'2026-11-06'},budget);
  expect(urls).toEqual([SUB]);
  expect(rows.map(r=>[r.form_type,r.source_ref])).toEqual([
   ['8-K','0001321655-26-000033/pltr-20260603.htm'],
```

```ts
const scope=(key:string):DocScopeRow=>({issuer_id:'i',source:'cninfo',reasons:[],priority:10,fetch_key:key,backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:false,poll_cursor:{},next_due_at:NOW.toISOString(),lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:NOW.toISOString()});
const ann=(id:number,title:string,day:number)=>({announcementId:String(id),announcementTitle:title,announcementTime:Date.UTC(2025,2,day)-8*3600_000,adjunctUrl:`finalpage/2025-03-${String(day).padStart(2,'0')}/${id}.PDF`,adjunctType:'PDF'});
function server(pages:unknown[]){
 const bodies:string[]=[];
 const http=politeHttp({sleep:async()=>{},fetch:async(u,init)=>{
  const url=String(u);const body=String(init?.body??'');
  if(url.includes('topSearch'))return new Response(fx('cninfo-topsearch-600570.json'));
  bodies.push(body);
  const n=Number(new URLSearchParams(body).get('pageNum'));
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(pages[n-1]??{announcements:[],hasMore:false}));
 }});
 return {http,bodies};
}

 });

  expect(a.segments(scope('600570,x'),'poll',2025,NOW)).toHaveLength(1);

 });

  const {http,bodies}=server([page]);

  expect(all).toHaveLength(5);
  expect(all[0]).toMatchObject({source_ref:'1225553659',source_url:'http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-09-09/1225553659.PDF',form_type:'PDF',published_at:'2026-09-08T16:00:00.000Z',precision:'date'});
  const q=new URLSearchParams(bodies[0]);
  expect(q.get('stock')).toBe('600570,gssh0600570');expect(q.get('column')).toBe('sse');expect(q.get('seDate')).toBe('2026-01-01~2026-11-06');expect(q.get('category')).toBe('');
  expect(bodies).toHaveLength(1);   // hasMore=true but a short page is the last page
 });
 it('walks every page, keeps periodic reports, resolves an unknown orgId by topSearch',async()=>{
```

```ts
 }});
 return {http,calls};
}

  expect(calls[0].url).toContain('name=0268');

  expect(q.get('lang')).toBe('ZH');expect(q.get('stockId')).toBe('9332');expect(q.get('from')).toBe('20260101');expect(q.get('to')).toBe('20261106');
  expect(calls[2].url).toContain('lang=en');expect(new URLSearchParams(calls[2].body).get('lang')).toBe('EN');
 });
 it('allAnnouncements keeps every row; the stockId is looked up once per run',async()=>{

 });
 it('an empty result page is an empty list; layout drift and an unknown code throw',async()=>{

 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/shared.ts
// Source adapter plumbing (spec §6.2, §6.1 step 5). One PoliteHttp per source run: declared
// User-Agent (EDGAR_USER_AGENT ?? DEFAULT_USER_AGENT of the research collectors), a minimum gap
// between requests (edgar 120 ms, cninfo 500 ms, hkexnews 1000 ms), a per-request timeout of
// min(60 s, remaining budget − 20 s) instead of the collectors' fixed 30 s, and 429/503 back-off
// 1→2→4→8 s that stops when the budget cannot cover the wait. fetchBytes reads at most maxBytes:
// a Content-Length above the cap is answered 'too_large' without reading the body, otherwise the
// body is streamed and the read cancelled at the cap (one GET; no separate HEAD request). 404 →
// 'not_found'; any other non-2xx throws HttpError. Segments: backfill = calendar years from
// sinceYear (ids y<year>, stable across runs); poll = one window [last_success_at − 1 day, today]
// whose id `poll:<from>` keeps an unfinished window's start, so a resumed poll continues the same list.
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT,localDate} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import type {AssetRole,DocClass,DocMime,DocScopeCursor,DocScopeRow,ListedSource} from '../types';

export interface Segment{id:string;from:string;to:string}
export interface ListedAsset{role:AssetRole;filename:string;url:string;required:boolean}
export interface Listed{source_ref:string;source_url:string;title:string;form_type:string|null;headline?:string;published_at:string;precision:'instant'|'date';assets?:ListedAsset[]}
export interface Budget{deadline:Date|null;remainingMs():number}
export interface FetchedBytes{bytes:Uint8Array;mime:string;status:number;headers:Record<string,string>;fetchedAt:string}
export type FetchBytes=(url:string,budget:Budget,maxBytes:number)=>Promise<FetchedBytes|'too_large'|'not_found'>;
export interface SourceAdapter{
 source:ListedSource;
 segments(scope:DocScopeRow,mode:'backfill'|'poll',sinceYear:number,now:Date):Segment[];
 list(scope:DocScopeRow,segment:Segment,budget:Budget):Promise<Listed[]>;
 /** Assets named by a fetched filing index (EDGAR: XBRL instance); optional assets, fetched after the index. */
 assetsFromIndex?(listed:Listed,indexBytes:Uint8Array):ListedAsset[];
 /** Non-null while the backfill segments cannot reach the full history (EDGAR before files[] is verified): backfill_done is never set and coverage_summary reports it. */
 coverageGap:string|null;
}

export const DAY_MS=86_400_000;
export const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS=60_000;
export const BUDGET_RESERVE_MS=20_000;
export const RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[1000,2000,4000,8000] as const;
/** Periodic report classes stored by default for cninfo and hkexnews (owner decision B). */
export const PERIODIC_CLASSES:ReadonlySet<DocClass>=new Set<DocClass>(['annual_report','interim_report','quarterly_report','results_announcement']);
export const DOC_MIMES:readonly DocMime[]=['application/pdf','text/html','application/xhtml+xml','application/xml','text/xml','application/json'];

/** Remaining time until the deadline on the injected clock; no deadline = unlimited. */
export function makeDocBudget(deadline:Date|null,now:()=>Date=()=>new Date()):Budget{
 return {deadline,remainingMs:()=>deadline===null?Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY:Math.max(0,deadline.getTime()-now().getTime())};
}

export class HttpError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly status:number,readonly url:string){super(`http_${status}`);this.name='HttpError';}
}
export interface HttpOptions{fetch?:typeof fetch;userAgent?:string;minIntervalMs?:number;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;clock?:()=>number}
export interface PoliteHttp{
 readonly userAgent:string;
 /** One request with pacing, budget timeout and 429/503 back-off; 2xx returns the Response, anything else throws HttpError. */
 request(method:'GET'|'POST',url:string,budget:Budget,init?:{body?:string;headers?:Record<string,string>}):Promise<Response>;
 getText(url:string,budget:Budget,headers?:Record<string,string>):Promise<string>;
 postForm(url:string,body:string,budget:Budget):Promise<string>;
 fetchBytes:FetchBytes;
}

const realSleep=(ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
/** Per-request timeout: min(60 s, remaining − 20 s); throws budget_exhausted when nothing is left. */
export function requestTimeoutMs(budget:Budget):number{
 const left=budget.remainingMs()-BUDGET_RESERVE_MS;
 if(left<=0)throw new Error('budget_exhausted');
 return Math.min(FETCH_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS,left);
}

export function politeHttp(opts:HttpOptions={}):PoliteHttp{
 const doFetch=opts.fetch??fetch;
 const userAgent=opts.userAgent??process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
 const gap=opts.minIntervalMs??0;const sleep=opts.sleep??realSleep;const clock=opts.clock??Date.now;
 let last=Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 const pace=async()=>{const wait=last+gap-clock();if(wait>0)await sleep(wait);last=clock();};
 const request:PoliteHttp['request']=async(method,url,budget,init={})=>{
  for(let attempt=0;;attempt++){
   const timeout=requestTimeoutMs(budget);
   await pace();
   const headers:Record<string,string>={'User-Agent':userAgent,...(method==='POST'?{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}:{}),...init.headers};
   const res=await doFetch(url,{method,headers,body:init.body,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(timeout)});
   if(res.ok)return res;
   if((res.status===429||res.status===503)&&attempt<RETRY_DELAYS_MS.length){
    const wait=RETRY_DELAYS_MS[attempt];
    await res.body?.cancel().catch(()=>undefined);
    if(budget.remainingMs()-BUDGET_RESERVE_MS<wait+1000)throw new Error('budget_exhausted');
    await sleep(wait);continue;
   }
   await res.body?.cancel().catch(()=>undefined);
   throw new HttpError(res.status,url);
  }
 };
 const fetchBytes:FetchBytes=async(url,budget,maxBytes)=>{
  let res:Response;
  try{res=await request('GET',url,budget,{headers:{Accept:'*/*'}});}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof HttpError&&e.status===404)return 'not_found';throw e;}
  const headers:Record<string,string>={};
  res.headers.forEach((v,k)=>{headers[k.toLowerCase()]=v;});
  const declared=Number(headers['content-length']);
  if(headers['content-length']!==undefined&&Number.isFinite(declared)&&declared>maxBytes){await res.body?.cancel().catch(()=>undefined);return 'too_large';}
  const chunks:Uint8Array[]=[];let total=0;
  if(res.body){
   const reader=res.body.getReader();
   for(;;){
    const {done,value}=await reader.read();
    if(done)break;
    total+=value.byteLength;
    if(total>maxBytes){await reader.cancel().catch(()=>undefined);return 'too_large';}
    chunks.push(value);
   }
  }
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(total);let at=0;
  for(const c of chunks){bytes.set(c,at);at+=c.byteLength;}
  const mime=(headers['content-type']??'').split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  return {bytes,mime,status:res.status,headers,fetchedAt:new Date(clock()).toISOString()};
 };
 return {
  userAgent,request,fetchBytes,
  getText:async(url,budget,headers)=>(await request('GET',url,budget,{headers})).text(),
  postForm:async(url,body,budget)=>(await request('POST',url,budget,{body})).text(),
 };
}

/** Contract entry point (plan §契约补充): a one-off polite fetch; adapters and the sync core share one PoliteHttp instead. */
export function fetchBytes(url:string,budget:Budget,maxBytes:number,opts:HttpOptions={}):Promise<FetchedBytes|'too_large'|'not_found'>{
 return politeHttp(opts).fetchBytes(url,budget,maxBytes);
}

/** The stored MIME of a downloaded document: '%PDF-' magic wins; a declared PDF without it, or an undeclared type, is null (unexpected_mime). */
export function sniffMime(declared:string,bytes:Uint8Array):DocMime|null{
 if(bytes.length>=5&&String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(0,5))==='%PDF-')return 'application/pdf';
 if(declared!=='application/pdf'&&(DOC_MIMES as readonly string[]).includes(declared))return declared as DocMime;
 return null;
}
/** MIME of an asset: by extension for .json/.xml (servers often say text/plain), else a declared document type; null = unusable. */
export function assetMime(declared:string,filename:string):DocMime|null{
 if(/\.json$/i.test(filename))return 'application/json';
 if(/\.xml$/i.test(filename))return 'application/xml';
 return declared!=='application/pdf'&&(DOC_MIMES as readonly string[]).includes(declared)?declared as DocMime:null;
}

/** Backfill segments: one per calendar year sinceYear..this year (UTC+8 date; covers the US/CN/HK calendars), the current year ending today. */
export function yearSegments(sinceYear:number,now:Date):Segment[]{
 const today=localDate(now.toISOString(),8);const thisYear=Number(today.slice(0,4));
 const out:Segment[]=[];
 for(let y=sinceYear;y<=thisYear;y++)out.push({id:`y${y}`,from:`${y}-01-01`,to:y===thisYear?today:`${y}-12-31`});
 return out;
}
/** Poll window: resumes an unfinished window (cursor segment poll:<from>), else last_success_at − 1 day (7 days back when never successful), to today (UTC+8). */
export function pollSegment(scope:DocScopeRow,now:Date):Segment{
 const cur=scope.poll_cursor as Partial<DocScopeCursor>;
 const resume=typeof cur.segment==='string'&&/^poll:\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cur.segment)?cur.segment.slice(5):null;
 const base=scope.last_success_at!==null&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(scope.last_success_at))?Date.parse(scope.last_success_at)-DAY_MS:now.getTime()-7*DAY_MS;
 const from=resume??new Date(base).toISOString().slice(0,10);
 return {id:`poll:${from}`,from,to:localDate(now.toISOString(),8)};
}
/** Stable order (published_at, source_ref) with the first occurrence of each source_ref kept. */
export function orderListed(items:Listed[]):Listed[]{
 const seen=new Set<string>();const out:Listed[]=[];
 for(const i of items){if(!seen.has(i.source_ref)){seen.add(i.source_ref);out.push(i);}}
 return out.sort((a,b)=>a.published_at<b.published_at?-1:a.published_at>b.published_at?1:a.source_ref<b.source_ref?-1:a.source_ref>b.source_ref?1:0);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/edgar.ts
// EDGAR list adapter (spec §6.2, §5.1). Lists data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK{10}.json: the `recent`
// columnar arrays, and — only once `filesVerified` — the historical files named in filings.files[]
// ({name, filingFrom, filingTo}, each fetched from data.sec.gov/submissions/{name} and assumed to be
// the same columnar shape as `recent`). That shape and the filing index JSON (directory.item[], XBRL
// instance = *_htm.xml) are NOT verified in this repo (spec §15 q1): until the commander records a
// real files[] page and index.json as fixtures and flips EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED, backfill has the
// `recent` segment only and the adapter reports coverageGap, so the sync core never sets
// backfill_done and emits coverage_summary. source_ref = '<accession>/<primaryDocument>'; asset =
// the filing index (required); the XBRL instance is added from the index (optional).
import {primaryDocumentUrl} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/edgar';
import {DAY_MS,orderListed,pollSegment} from './shared';
import type {Budget,Listed,ListedAsset,PoliteHttp,Segment,SourceAdapter} from './shared';
import type {DocScopeRow} from '../types';

export const EDGAR_INTERVAL_MS=120;
/** Spec §6.2 default form set; --forms adds to it. */
export const EDGAR_DOC_FORMS=['10-K','10-Q','20-F','40-F','10-K/A','10-Q/A','20-F/A','8-K','8-K/A','6-K'] as const;
/** Flipped by the commander after recording real files[] / index.json fixtures (spec §15 q1). */
export const EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED=false;
const SUBMISSIONS='https://data.sec.gov/submissions/';

interface Columnar{accessionNumber:string[];acceptanceDateTime:string[];form:string[];primaryDocument:string[];primaryDocDescription?:string[];filingDate?:string[]}
interface FileEntry{name?:unknown;filingFrom?:unknown;filingTo?:unknown}
interface Submissions{filings?:{recent?:unknown;files?:unknown}}
export interface EdgarAdapterOptions{http:PoliteHttp;forms?:readonly string[];filesVerified?:boolean}

function asColumnar(v:unknown,where:string):Columnar{
 const c=v as Partial<Columnar>|null;
 if(!c||!Array.isArray(c.accessionNumber)||!Array.isArray(c.acceptanceDateTime)||!Array.isArray(c.form)||!Array.isArray(c.primaryDocument))throw new Error(`layout_changed: ${where}`);
 return c as Columnar;
}
const archiveDir=(cik:string,accn:string)=>`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/${Number(cik)}/${accn.replace(/-/g,'')}/`;

export function edgarAdapter(opts:EdgarAdapterOptions):SourceAdapter{
 const forms=new Set(opts.forms??EDGAR_DOC_FORMS);
 const verified=opts.filesVerified??EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED;
 const submissions=async(cik:string,budget:Budget):Promise<Submissions>=>{
  if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(cik))throw new Error('invalid_fetch_key');
  return JSON.parse(await opts.http.getText(`${SUBMISSIONS}CIK${cik}.json`,budget,{Accept:'application/json'})) as Submissions;
 };
 const toListed=(cik:string,c:Columnar,seg:Segment):Listed[]=>{
  const lo=Date.parse(`${seg.from}T00:00:00Z`),hi=Date.parse(`${seg.to}T00:00:00Z`)+DAY_MS;
  const out:Listed[]=[];
  for(let i=0;i<c.accessionNumber.length;i++){
   const form=String(c.form[i]??'');const accn=String(c.accessionNumber[i]??'');const doc=String(c.primaryDocument[i]??'');
   const t=Date.parse(String(c.acceptanceDateTime[i]??''));
   if(!forms.has(form)||!accn||!doc||!Number.isFinite(t)||t<lo||t>=hi)continue;
   const desc=String(c.primaryDocDescription?.[i]??'')||form;const filed=String(c.filingDate?.[i]??'');
   out.push({source_ref:`${accn}/${doc}`,source_url:primaryDocumentUrl(cik,accn,doc),title:filed?`${form} ${desc} (${filed})`:`${form} ${desc}`,form_type:form,
    published_at:new Date(t).toISOString(),precision:'instant',assets:[{role:'filing_index',filename:'index.json',url:`${archiveDir(cik,accn)}index.json`,required:true}]});
  }
  return out;
 };
 return {
  source:'edgar',
  coverageGap:verified?null:'edgar_files_unverified',
  segments(scope:DocScopeRow,mode,sinceYear,now){
   if(mode==='poll')return [pollSegment(scope,now)];
   const to=now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
   const recent={id:'recent',from:`${sinceYear}-01-01`,to};
   return verified?[{id:'history',from:recent.from,to},recent]:[recent];
  },
  async list(scope,seg,budget){
   const cik=scope.fetch_key;
   const sub=await submissions(cik,budget);
   const cols:Columnar[]=[];
   if(seg.id==='history'){
    const files=sub.filings?.files;
    if(!Array.isArray(files))throw new Error('layout_changed: filings.files');
    for(const f of files as FileEntry[]){
     if(typeof f.name!=='string'||!/^CIK\d{10}-submissions-\d{3}\.json$/.test(f.name))throw new Error('layout_changed: filings.files[].name');
     if(typeof f.filingTo==='string'&&f.filingTo<seg.from)continue;
     cols.push(asColumnar(JSON.parse(await opts.http.getText(`${SUBMISSIONS}${f.name}`,budget,{Accept:'application/json'})),f.name));
    }
   }else cols.push(asColumnar(sub.filings?.recent,'filings.recent'));
   return orderListed(cols.flatMap(c=>toListed(cik,c,seg)));
  },
  assetsFromIndex(listed,indexBytes){
   const idx=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(indexBytes)) as {directory?:{item?:{name?:unknown}[]}};
   const items=idx.directory?.item;
   if(!Array.isArray(items))return [];
   const base=listed.assets?.find(a=>a.role==='filing_index')?.url.replace(/index\.json$/,'');
   if(!base)return [];
   return items.map(i=>i.name).filter((n):n is string=>typeof n==='string'&&/^[\w.-]+_htm\.xml$/.test(n))
    .map((filename):ListedAsset=>({role:'xbrl_instance',filename,url:`${base}${filename}`,required:false}));
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/cninfo.ts
// 巨潮 list adapter (spec §6.2). fetch_key '<code>,<orgId>' (orgId empty → resolved once per run by
// topSearch, exact code match, same protocol as collectors/cninfo.ts). A segment is a date range
// (backfill: one calendar year; poll: the poll window); list() walks every hisAnnouncement/query page
// (PAGE_SIZE 30; a short page is the last page even when hasMore says otherwise — observed live) and
// returns the segment's complete list in stable order. category stays '' (its periodic-report value is
// unverified, spec §15 q4) and classify() filters to PERIODIC_CLASSES unless allAnnouncements.
// SH/SZ only: column sse for 6xxxxx, szse otherwise. published_at = announcementTime (Beijing
// midnight), precision 'date'. PDF url = static.cninfo.com.cn/<adjunctUrl>.
import {CNINFO_HISTORY,CNINFO_TOPSEARCH} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/cninfo';
import {classify} from '../classify';
import {PERIODIC_CLASSES,orderListed,pollSegment,yearSegments} from './shared';
import type {Budget,Listed,PoliteHttp,SourceAdapter} from './shared';

export const CNINFO_INTERVAL_MS=500;
const STATIC='http://static.cninfo.com.cn/';
const PAGE_SIZE=30,MAX_PAGES=200;
interface Announcement{announcementId?:unknown;announcementTitle?:unknown;announcementTime?:unknown;adjunctUrl?:unknown;adjunctType?:unknown}
export interface CninfoAdapterOptions{http:PoliteHttp;allAnnouncements?:boolean}

export function parseCninfoKey(key:string):{code:string;orgId:string|null}{
 const m=/^(\d{6}),([^,]*)$/.exec(key);
 if(!m)throw new Error('invalid_fetch_key');
 return {code:m[1],orgId:m[2].length>0?m[2]:null};
}

export function cninfoAdapter(opts:CninfoAdapterOptions):SourceAdapter{
 const orgCache=new Map<string,string>();
 const orgIdOf=async(code:string,known:string|null,budget:Budget):Promise<string>=>{
  if(known)return known;
  const hit=orgCache.get(code);if(hit)return hit;
  const rows=JSON.parse(await opts.http.postForm(CNINFO_TOPSEARCH,`keyWord=${encodeURIComponent(code)}&maxNum=10`,budget)) as {code?:unknown;orgId?:unknown}[];
  const row=Array.isArray(rows)?rows.find(r=>r.code===code&&typeof r.orgId==='string'&&r.orgId.length>0):undefined;
  if(!row)throw new Error('cninfo_org_unresolved');
  orgCache.set(code,row.orgId as string);
  return row.orgId as string;
 };
 return {
  source:'cninfo',coverageGap:null,
  segments:(scope,mode,sinceYear,now)=>mode==='poll'?[pollSegment(scope,now)]:yearSegments(sinceYear,now),
  async list(scope,seg,budget){
   const {code,orgId:known}=parseCninfoKey(scope.fetch_key);
   const orgId=await orgIdOf(code,known,budget);
   const column=code.startsWith('6')?'sse':'szse';
   const out:Listed[]=[];
   for(let pageNum=1;;pageNum++){
    if(pageNum>MAX_PAGES)throw new Error('cninfo_too_many_pages');
    const body=new URLSearchParams({pageNum:String(pageNum),pageSize:String(PAGE_SIZE),column,tabName:'fulltext',plate:'',stock:`${code},${orgId}`,searchkey:'',secid:'',category:'',trade:'',
     seDate:`${seg.from}~${seg.to}`,sortName:'',sortType:'',isHLtitle:'true'}).toString();
    const page=JSON.parse(await opts.http.postForm(CNINFO_HISTORY,body,budget)) as {announcements?:unknown;hasMore?:unknown};
    if(page.announcements!==null&&page.announcements!==undefined&&!Array.isArray(page.announcements))throw new Error('layout_changed: announcements');
    const rows=(page.announcements??[]) as Announcement[];
    for(const a of rows){
     if(typeof a.announcementId!=='string'||typeof a.announcementTime!=='number'||typeof a.adjunctUrl!=='string'||typeof a.announcementTitle!=='string')throw new Error('layout_changed: announcement');
     const title=a.announcementTitle.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').trim();
     const formType=typeof a.adjunctType==='string'?a.adjunctType:null;
     if(!opts.allAnnouncements&&!PERIODIC_CLASSES.has(classify('cninfo',{form_type:formType,title,source_ref:a.announcementId}).doc_class))continue;
     out.push({source_ref:a.announcementId,source_url:STATIC+a.adjunctUrl.replace(/^\/+/,''),title,form_type:formType,published_at:new Date(a.announcementTime).toISOString(),precision:'date'});
    }
    if(page.hasMore!==true||rows.length<PAGE_SIZE)break;
   }
   return orderListed(out);
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sources/hkexnews.ts
// HKEXnews list adapter (spec §6.2). fetch_key = 5-digit stock code; prefix.do resolves the stockId
// once per run (the collectors pass the 4-digit form, e.g. 0268, which is what we send); the title
// search returns the whole result table for a date range (parseTitleSearch from collectors/hkexnews.ts,
// which throws layout_changed on drift). A segment is a date range (backfill: calendar year; poll: the
// poll window). Whether the title search caps rows per range is unverified (spec §15 q2): the
// commander records it; if it caps, segments become shorter ranges (a later change). source_ref = the
// PDF file id (…/2026090300863_c.pdf → 2026090300863_c). Both language versions are listed (spec §5.1):
// one Chinese search (lang=zh, _c files) and one English search (lang=en, _e files) per segment, merged.
// The English page is assumed to share the recorded Chinese layout (unverified: the F3-1 verification
// records an English fixture; `languages:['zh']` turns the English search off if it differs).
// form_type and headline = the HKEX headline; published_at = release time (HKT → UTC), 'instant'.
import {HKEX_PREFIX,HKEX_TITLESEARCH,parseTitleSearch} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/hkexnews';
import {classify} from '../classify';
import {PERIODIC_CLASSES,orderListed,pollSegment,yearSegments} from './shared';
import type {Budget,Listed,PoliteHttp,SourceAdapter} from './shared';

export const HKEX_INTERVAL_MS=1000;
export interface HkexnewsAdapterOptions{http:PoliteHttp;allAnnouncements?:boolean;languages?:readonly ('zh'|'en')[]}

/** File id of an HKEX document link: last path segment without its .pdf/.htm/.html extension; null otherwise. */
export function hkexSourceRef(url:string):string|null{
 let path:string;
 try{path=new URL(url).pathname;}catch{return null;}
 return /\/([^/]+)\.(pdf|htm|html)$/i.exec(path)?.[1]??null;
}

export function hkexnewsAdapter(opts:HkexnewsAdapterOptions):SourceAdapter{
 const ids=new Map<string,number>();
 const stockIdOf=async(code:string,budget:Budget):Promise<number>=>{
  if(!/^\d{5}$/.test(code))throw new Error('invalid_fetch_key');
  const hit=ids.get(code);if(hit!==undefined)return hit;
  const name=String(Number(code)).padStart(4,'0');
  const text=await opts.http.getText(`${HKEX_PREFIX}?callback=callback&lang=ZH&type=A&name=${name}&market=SEHK`,budget);
  const json=JSON.parse(text.replace(/^[^(]*\(/,'').replace(/\);?\s*$/,'')) as {stockInfo?:{stockId?:unknown;code?:unknown}[]};
  const row=json.stockInfo?.find(s=>Number(s.code)===Number(code)&&typeof s.stockId==='number');
  if(!row)throw new Error('hkex_stock_unresolved');
  ids.set(code,row.stockId as number);
  return row.stockId as number;
 };
 return {
  source:'hkexnews',coverageGap:null,
  segments:(scope,mode,sinceYear,now)=>mode==='poll'?[pollSegment(scope,now)]:yearSegments(sinceYear,now),
  async list(scope,seg,budget){
   const stockId=await stockIdOf(scope.fetch_key,budget);
   const out:Listed[]=[];
   for(const lang of opts.languages??['zh','en']){
    const body=new URLSearchParams({lang:lang==='zh'?'ZH':'EN',category:'0',market:'SEHK',searchType:'1',documentType:'-1',t1code:'-2',t2Gcode:'-2',t2code:'-2',stockId:String(stockId),
     from:seg.from.replace(/-/g,''),to:seg.to.replace(/-/g,''),'MB-Daterange':'0',title:''}).toString();
    const rows=parseTitleSearch(await opts.http.postForm(lang==='zh'?HKEX_TITLESEARCH:HKEX_TITLESEARCH.replace('lang=zh','lang=en'),body,budget));
    for(const r of rows){
     const ref=hkexSourceRef(r.document_url);
     if(!ref)continue;
     if(!opts.allAnnouncements&&!PERIODIC_CLASSES.has(classify('hkexnews',{form_type:r.headline,headline:r.headline,title:r.title,source_ref:ref}).doc_class))continue;
     out.push({source_ref:ref,source_url:r.document_url,title:r.title,form_type:r.headline||null,headline:r.headline,published_at:r.released_at,precision:'instant'});
    }
   }
   return orderListed(out);
  },
 };
}
```

### Task 7: 同步核心 `sync.ts`

**Files:** Create: `src/lib/documents/sync.ts` / Test: `src/lib/documents/sync.test.ts`
**Spec:** §6.1、§10（采集各行）、§5.2（可得时间）、§4.10（对象先于行、内容寻址）、§1.1 成功标准第 4、6 条
**Depends on:** Task 2（`types.ts`、`memoryDocumentsDb`）、Task 4（`object-store.ts::{blobPath,memoryObjectStore}`）、Task 5（`classify`、`reconcileDocumentScope`、`documentScopeRowFor`）、Task 6（`sources/shared.ts`）；计划一 `dq/batches.ts::{startBatch,finishBatch,emptyCounts}`、`dq/freshness.ts::recordAttempt`、`dq/quarantine.ts::quarantine`

行为清单（测试逐条覆盖）：
- 批次 `producer='documents-sync'`、`dataset='documents.<source>'`、`tool_versions={classifier_gen,source}`；`codeVersion` 缺失且非 dry-run → 在建批次前抛 `DocumentsSyncError('code_version_unavailable')`；适配器来源与 `opts.source` 不符 → `adapter_mismatch`。
- 定时路径先 `reconcileDocumentScope`，再 `scopeDue(source, now, limit)`；显式 `issuerIds` 不调和、不看到期，缺行由 `documentScopeRowFor` 建（apply 写入、dry-run 只在内存构造），建不出 → `scope_unresolved`（failed）。
- 剩余预算 < 90 s 不开始新发行人（`deadline_hit` 信息码，`{not_started}`）；剩余 < 25 s 不开始新项（发行人 `deadline_hit`、游标落盘、`next_due=now`）。
- 认领租约后**重读**本行（`scopeRows`），模式与游标取重读值，不用选择时的快照（计划审计 P2-4：别的批次可能在选择与认领之间推进并释放）。
- 游标是 source_ref 检查点 `{segment,last_ref,settled,attempts,seq}`（计划审计 P2-5，不再用下标）：续跑时重新列表，`settled`（本轮处理过但没入库：404/隔离/耗尽）跳过；已入库且位置不晚于 `last_ref` 在新列表中位置的跳过；未入库的项一律处理（插入不会被跳过，删除不会让后续项被跳过）；重试次数按 source_ref 记。每次落盘 `seq+1`，SQL 拒绝不递增的 `seq` 与把已完成回填改回未完成（`cursor_regression`，`reset` 例外）。每项开始网络/写入**之前**落盘（`advanceCursor`），所以崩溃从该项重来；连续的已知重复只在下一次落盘时合并写一次。存储的段 id 不在本次段列表 → 从第一段重来。
- 已知项（`knownSourceRefs`）且 `refetch=false` → `duplicates`，不下载、不计入 `maxPerIssuer`（默认 50）；hkexnews 默认 `refetch=true`。新项达到上限 → 停在该项（`code='item_limit'`、`next_due=now`）。
- 404 → `skipped_summary(document_missing)` 前进；`too_large` → 隔离 `document_too_large` 前进；MIME 嗅探不在本来源允许集 → 隔离 `unexpected_mime` 前进；抓取/上传/必抓资产失败 → 不前进、`attempts[source_ref]+1`、发行人 failed（`next_due=now+6h`），第三次 → 隔离 `document_fetch_exhausted` 并前进、继续后续项。隔离键：`dataset=documents.<source>`、`table='disclosure_documents'`、`natural_key='<source>:<source_ref>'`。
- 写入顺序：原件 `store.put(blobPath)` → 资产（EDGAR `index.json` 必抓；`assetsFromIndex` 给出的 XBRL 实例可选，失败/超限 → `skipped_summary(xbrl_skipped)`）→ `insertDocumentVersion`（文档 + 资产一次事务）。替换版本 `available_at = fetched_at`，首版 `= published_at`；`available_date` 按来源时区（US 纽约，CN/HK UTC+8）。
- 段全部走完：回填 → `advanceCursor(null, done = coverageGap===null)`；有缺口时回执 `coverage_summary`；轮询 → 清游标；`next_due=now+1d`。
- `lease_lost`（插入/游标/续租）→ 发行人 failed，之后对该发行人不再调用任何写函数（不释放）。
- `finishBatch` 状态由 `batchStatusFromCounts` 得出；`recordAttempt('documents.<source>', {ok: idle || 至少一个发行人 success, cadence:'daily'})`。基础设施异常：尽力收尾批次与新鲜度后重抛。

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sync.test.ts
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from './memory-documents-db';
import {blobPath,memoryObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {DocumentsSyncError,availableDateOf,runDocumentsSync} from './sync';
import type {SyncDeps,SyncOptions} from './sync';
import type {FetchBytes,FetchedBytes,Listed,ListedAsset,Segment,SourceAdapter} from './sources/shared';
import type {ListedSource} from './types';

const NOW_ISO='2026-11-06T02:00:00.000Z';const NOW=new Date(NOW_ISO);
const H='44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444';const M='55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555';
const OPS='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa';   // a batch id used to edit the scope row the way an earlier run left it
const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const pdfBytes=(tag:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(`%PDF-1.7 ${tag}`);
const item=(ref:string,day:string,o:Partial<Listed>={}):Listed=>({source_ref:ref,source_url:`https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/${ref}.pdf`,title:'二零二六年中期報告',form_type:'[中期/半年度報告]',headline:'財務報表 - [中期/半年度報告]',published_at:`${day}T08:38:00.000Z`,precision:'instant',...o});

interface FakeAdapter extends SourceAdapter{lists:Record<string,Listed[]|Error>;segs:{backfill:Segment[];poll:Segment[]};listed:string[]}
function adapter(source:ListedSource='hkexnews',o:{gap?:string|null;fromIndex?:(l:Listed,b:Uint8Array)=>ListedAsset[]}={}):FakeAdapter{
 const a:FakeAdapter={
  source,coverageGap:o.gap??null,listed:[],
  lists:{},segs:{backfill:[{id:'y2025',from:'2025-01-01',to:'2025-12-31'},{id:'y2026',from:'2026-01-01',to:'2026-11-06'}],poll:[{id:'poll:2026-11-05',from:'2026-11-05',to:'2026-11-06'}]},
  segments:(_s,mode)=>a.segs[mode],
  async list(_s,seg){a.listed.push(seg.id);const l=a.lists[seg.id]??[];if(l instanceof Error)throw l;return l;},
 };
 if(o.fromIndex)a.assetsFromIndex=o.fromIndex;
 return a;
}
type Answer=FetchedBytes|'too_large'|'not_found'|Error;
function fetcher(){
 const answers=new Map<string,Answer[]>();const calls:string[]=[];
 const ok=(bytes:Uint8Array,mime='application/pdf',fetchedAt=NOW_ISO):FetchedBytes=>({bytes,mime,status:200,headers:{'content-type':mime,'content-length':String(bytes.length)},fetchedAt});
 const fetch:FetchBytes=async url=>{calls.push(url);const q=answers.get(url);if(!q||q.length===0)throw new Error(`no answer for ${url}`);const a=q.length>1?q.shift()!:q[0];if(a instanceof Error)throw a;return a;};
 return {fetch,calls,ok,set:(url:string,...a:Answer[])=>{answers.set(url,a);}};
}
async function setup(o:{source?:ListedSource;gap?:string|null;fromIndex?:(l:Listed,b:Uint8Array)=>ListedAsset[];deadline?:Date|null;codeVersion?:string|null}={}){
 const source=o.source??'hkexnews';
 const tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_freshness:['dataset'],issuers:['issuer_id']});
 await tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id:H,cik:'1321655',hkex_stock_code_primary:'00268',cninfo_org_id:null,status:'active'});
 await tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id:M,cik:null,hkex_stock_code_primary:'09999',cninfo_org_id:null,status:'merged',merged_into:H});
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();db.setNow(NOW_ISO);
 await db.reconcileScope(source,[{issuer_id:H,reasons:['cohort'],priority:10,fetch_key:source==='edgar'?'0001321655':'00268'}]);
 const store=memoryObjectStore();const a=adapter(source,o);const f=fetcher();
 const deps:SyncDeps={db,tables,store,adapter:a,fetchBytes:f.fetch,now:()=>NOW,deadline:o.deadline===undefined?null:o.deadline,codeVersion:o.codeVersion===undefined?'a'.repeat(40):o.codeVersion,userAgent:'OsbornAlpha test ua'};
 const run=(x:Partial<SyncOptions>={})=>runDocumentsSync(deps,{source,limit:25,issuerIds:[H],sinceYear:2025,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script',...x});
 const scopeRow=()=>db.scope().find(s=>s.issuer_id===H&&s.source===source)!;
 const quarantined=()=>tables.rows('dq_quarantine');
 return {tables,db,store,a,f,deps,run,scopeRow,quarantined,source};
}
const backfillLists=(s:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof setup>>)=>{
 s.a.lists={y2025:[item('2025082500100_c','2025-08-25')],y2026:[item('2026031900200_c','2026-03-19'),item('2026090300863_c','2026-09-03')],'poll:2026-11-05':[item('2026090300863_c','2026-09-03')]};
 for(const l of [...(s.a.lists.y2025 as Listed[]),...(s.a.lists.y2026 as Listed[])])s.f.set(l.source_url,s.f.ok(pdfBytes(l.source_ref)));
};

describe('runDocumentsSync — backfill, idempotence, versions',()=>{
 it('first run inserts every listed PDF, stores it content-addressed, completes backfill and schedules a day later',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:3,inserted:3,duplicates:0,versioned:0,failed:0});
  expect(r.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({issuerId:H,fetchKey:'00268',outcome:'success'});
  const docs=s.db.documents();
  expect(docs).toHaveLength(3);
  const d=docs.find(x=>x.source_ref==='2026090300863_c')!;
  const bytes=pdfBytes('2026090300863_c');
  expect(d).toMatchObject({issuer_id:H,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_version:1,observed_replacement:false,doc_class:'interim_report',classifier_gen:1,language:'zh',
   content_sha256:sha(bytes),bytes:bytes.length,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:blobPath(sha(bytes),'application/pdf'),published_at:'2026-09-03T08:38:00.000Z',published_at_precision:'instant',
   available_at:'2026-09-03T08:38:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-09-03',permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,batch_id:r.batchId,code_version:'a'.repeat(40),
   acquisition:{fetched_at:NOW_ISO,http_status:200,content_type:'application/pdf',content_length:bytes.length,etag:null,last_modified:null,user_agent:'OsbornAlpha test ua'}});
  expect(s.store.objects().has(d.storage_path)).toBe(true);
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:true,backfill_cursor:{},last_status:'success',lease_until:null,next_due_at:'2026-11-07T02:00:00.000Z'});
  const [batch]=s.tables.rows('ingest_batches');
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({producer:'documents-sync',dataset:'documents.hkexnews',status:'success',triggered_by:'script',tool_versions:{classifier_gen:'1',source:'hkexnews'}});
  expect(s.tables.rows('dq_freshness')[0]).toMatchObject({dataset:'documents.hkexnews',consecutive_errors:0});
 });
 it('second run (poll, refetch off): every listed item is a known duplicate, no download, no new row, cursor cleared',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const first=await s.run();
  const calls=s.f.calls.length;
  const second=await s.run({refetch:false});
  expect(s.a.listed.at(-1)).toBe('poll:2026-11-05');
  expect(second.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,inserted:0,duplicates:1});
  expect(s.f.calls.length).toBe(calls);
  expect(s.db.documents()).toHaveLength(first.counts.inserted);
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:true,poll_cursor:{}});
 });
 it('re-running the same backfill reports duplicates equal to the first run inserts, the cursor never moving back',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const first=await s.run();
  await s.db.claimSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,600);
  await s.db.advanceCursor(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'backfill',null,false,true);   // operator reset: replay the whole backfill
  await s.db.releaseSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'success',NOW_ISO);
  const calls=s.f.calls.length;
  const again=await s.run({refetch:false});
  expect(again.counts).toMatchObject({inserted:0,versioned:0,duplicates:first.counts.inserted});
  expect(s.f.calls.length).toBe(calls);
  expect(s.db.documents()).toHaveLength(first.counts.inserted);
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_done).toBe(true);
 });
 it('hkexnews refetches known items by default: same bytes → duplicate; new bytes → a new version visible from the fetch instant',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  await s.run();
  const url=item('2026090300863_c','2026-09-03').source_url;
  s.f.set(url,s.f.ok(pdfBytes('2026090300863_c')));
  const same=await s.run();
  expect(same.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,duplicates:1,inserted:0,versioned:0});
  s.f.set(url,s.f.ok(pdfBytes('2026090300863_c replaced'),'application/pdf','2026-11-06T02:00:05.000Z'));
  const changed=await s.run();
  expect(changed.counts).toMatchObject({versioned:1});
  const versions=s.db.documents().filter(d=>d.source_ref==='2026090300863_c').sort((a,b)=>a.source_version-b.source_version);
  expect(versions.map(v=>v.source_version)).toEqual([1,2]);
  expect(versions[1]).toMatchObject({supersedes_document_id:versions[0].document_id,observed_replacement:true,published_at:'2026-09-03T08:38:00.000Z',available_at:'2026-11-06T02:00:05.000Z',available_date:'2026-11-06'});
  expect(s.store.objects().has(versions[0].storage_path)).toBe(true);
 });
});

describe('runDocumentsSync — cursor, item cap, deadline',()=>{
 it('known items do not count against maxPerIssuer; the cursor stops at the first new item over the cap and the issuer is due now',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();
  const all=['a1','a2','a3','b1','b2','b3'].map((r,i)=>item(r,`2026-0${i+1}-01`));
  s.a.lists={y2025:[],y2026:all.slice(0,3)};
  for(const l of all)s.f.set(l.source_url,s.f.ok(pdfBytes(l.source_ref)));
  await s.run({maxPerIssuer:50});
  // reset to backfill over a longer list: three known + three new
  s.a.lists.y2026=all;
  await s.db.claimSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,600);
  await s.db.advanceCursor(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'backfill',null,false,true);   // operator reset
  await s.db.releaseSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'success',NOW_ISO);
  const r=await s.run({maxPerIssuer:2,refetch:false});
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({duplicates:3,inserted:2});
  expect(r.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'success',code:'item_limit'});
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:false,backfill_cursor:{segment:'y2026',last_ref:'b2',settled:[],attempts:{}},next_due_at:NOW_ISO});
  const rest=await s.run({maxPerIssuer:2,refetch:false});
  expect(rest.counts).toMatchObject({inserted:1,duplicates:0});
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_done).toBe(true);
 });
 it('resumes inside a segment from the stored checkpoint (a settled ref is not fetched again); an unknown segment id restarts from the first segment',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  await s.db.claimSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,600);
  await s.db.advanceCursor(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'backfill',{segment:'y2026',last_ref:'2026031900200_c',settled:['2026031900200_c'],attempts:{},seq:1},false);
  await s.db.releaseSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'success',NOW_ISO);
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(s.a.listed).toEqual(['y2026']);
  expect(r.counts.inserted).toBe(1);
  expect(s.db.documents().map(d=>d.source_ref)).toEqual(['2026090300863_c']);
  const t=await setup();backfillLists(t);
  await t.db.claimSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,600);
  await t.db.advanceCursor(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'backfill',{segment:'y2019',last_ref:'x',settled:[],attempts:{x:2},seq:7},false);
  await t.db.releaseSyncLease(H,'hkexnews',OPS,'success',NOW_ISO);
  await t.run();
  expect(t.a.listed).toEqual(['y2025','y2026']);
  expect(t.db.documents()).toHaveLength(3);
 });
 it('stops starting items under the item budget (deadline_hit, cursor kept, due now) and starts no issuer under 90 s',async()=>{
  const s=await setup({deadline:new Date(NOW.getTime()+20_000)});backfillLists(s);
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.errors).toEqual([{code:'deadline_hit',message:JSON.stringify({not_started:1})}]);
  expect(r.issuers).toEqual([]);
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
  const t=await setup({deadline:new Date(NOW.getTime()+100_000)});backfillLists(t);
  let clock=NOW.getTime();t.deps.now=()=>new Date(clock);
  const list=t.a.list.bind(t.a);t.a.list=async(sc,seg,b)=>{clock+=80_000;return list(sc,seg,b);};   // listing takes 80 s: 20 s left
  const r2=await t.run();
  expect(r2.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'success',code:'deadline_hit'});
  expect(r2.errors.map(e=>e.code)).toContain('deadline_hit');
  expect(t.db.documents()).toHaveLength(0);
  expect(t.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:false,last_status:'success',next_due_at:'2026-11-06T02:01:20.000Z'});   // nothing started: due again at once
 });
 it('P2-5: resumes by source_ref — a removal before the checkpoint skips nothing, an insertion before it is still fetched, retries stay with their source_ref',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();
  const [A,B,C,X,Y]=['r-a','r-b','r-c','r-x','r-y'].map((r,i)=>item(r,`2026-0${i+1}-01`));
  for(const l of [A,B,C,X,Y])s.f.set(l.source_url,s.f.ok(pdfBytes(l.source_ref)));
  const refs=()=>s.db.documents().map(d=>d.source_ref).sort();
  s.a.lists={y2025:[],y2026:[A,B,C]};
  expect((await s.run({maxPerIssuer:1,refetch:false})).issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'success',code:'item_limit'});
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toMatchObject({segment:'y2026',last_ref:'r-a'});
  s.a.lists.y2026=[B,C];                                                      // A left the listing: an ordinal 1 would now skip B
  await s.run({maxPerIssuer:1,refetch:false});
  expect(refs()).toEqual(['r-a','r-b']);
  s.a.lists.y2026=[X,B,C];                                                    // X inserted before the checkpoint
  s.f.set(C.source_url,new Error('ECONNRESET'));
  const r3=await s.run({maxPerIssuer:5,refetch:false});
  expect(refs()).toEqual(['r-a','r-b','r-x']);
  expect(r3.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'fetch_failed'});
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toMatchObject({segment:'y2026',attempts:{'r-c':1}});
  s.a.lists.y2026=[X,B,Y,C];                                                  // another insertion ahead of the failing item: its retry count stays with r-c
  await s.run({maxPerIssuer:5,refetch:false});
  expect(refs()).toEqual(['r-a','r-b','r-x','r-y']);
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toMatchObject({last_ref:'r-y',attempts:{'r-c':2}});
  await s.run({maxPerIssuer:5,refetch:false});
  expect(s.quarantined()).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({natural_key:'hkexnews:r-c',reason_code:'document_fetch_exhausted'})]);
  expect(s.quarantined()[0].payload).toMatchObject({attempts:3});
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:true,backfill_cursor:{}});
 });
 it('P2-4: a batch that finished the backfill between our selection and our claim is not regressed — the row is reread under our lease',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const OTHER='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb';
  const claim=s.db.claimSyncLease;let raced=false;
  s.deps.db={...s.db,claimSyncLease:async(i,src,b,ttl)=>{
   if(!raced&&b!==OTHER){
    raced=true;                                                               // selection already read backfill_done=false
    expect(await claim(i,src,OTHER,600)).toBe(true);
    await s.db.advanceCursor(i,src,OTHER,'backfill',null,true);
    await s.db.releaseSyncLease(i,src,OTHER,'success',NOW_ISO);
   }
   return claim(i,src,b,ttl);
  }};
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'success'});
  expect(s.a.listed).toEqual(['poll:2026-11-05']);                             // poll mode from the reread row, not a stale backfill
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:true,backfill_cursor:{},poll_cursor:{}});
 });
});

describe('runDocumentsSync — item failures',()=>{
 it('fetch failures do not advance; the third quarantines document_fetch_exhausted and advances',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const bad=item('2025082500100_c','2025-08-25').source_url;
  s.f.set(bad,new Error('ECONNRESET'));
  const r1=await s.run();
  expect(r1.status).toBe('failed');
  expect(r1.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'fetch_failed'});
  expect(r1.errors[0]).toMatchObject({code:'fetch_failed',key:`${H}:2025082500100_c`});
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_cursor:{segment:'y2025',last_ref:null,settled:[],attempts:{'2025082500100_c':1},seq:1},last_status:'failed',next_due_at:'2026-11-06T08:00:00.000Z'});
  await s.run();
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toEqual({segment:'y2025',last_ref:null,settled:[],attempts:{'2025082500100_c':2},seq:2});
  const r3=await s.run();
  expect(r3.counts).toMatchObject({quarantined:1,inserted:2,failed:0});
  expect(r3.status).toBe('success');
  expect(s.quarantined()).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({dataset:'documents.hkexnews',table_name:'disclosure_documents',natural_key:'hkexnews:2025082500100_c',reason_code:'document_fetch_exhausted',status:'open'})]);
  expect(s.quarantined()[0].payload).toMatchObject({url:bad,attempts:3,last_error:{code:'fetch_failed',message:'ECONNRESET'}});
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_done).toBe(true);
 });
 it('too_large and unexpected_mime quarantine and advance; 404 is a skipped_summary and advances',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const [a,b,c]=[item('2025082500100_c','2025-08-25'),item('2026031900200_c','2026-03-19'),item('2026090300863_c','2026-09-03')].map(x=>x.source_url);
  s.f.set(a,'too_large');s.f.set(b,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('<html>blocked</html>'),'application/pdf'));s.f.set(c,'not_found');
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:2,quarantined:2,inserted:0,failed:0});
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
  expect(s.quarantined().map(q=>q.reason_code).sort()).toEqual(['document_too_large','unexpected_mime']);
  expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'skipped_summary',key:`${H}:document_missing`,message:'{"document_missing":1}'});
  expect(s.db.documents()).toEqual([]);expect(s.store.objects().size).toBe(0);
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_done).toBe(true);
 });
 it('an HTML error page served as HTTP 200 for a .pdf URL (HKEX answers a missing _e file this way) is quarantined unexpected_mime, never stored',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  const url=item('2026090300863_c','2026-09-03').source_url.replace(/_c\.pdf$/,'_e.pdf');
  const e=item('2026090300863_e','2026-09-03');expect(e.source_url).toBe(url);
  s.a.lists={...s.a.lists,y2026:[...(s.a.lists.y2026 as Listed[]),e]};
  s.f.set(url,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>HKEXnews error</body></html>'),'text/html'));
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(s.quarantined().map(q=>q.reason_code)).toEqual(['unexpected_mime']);
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({quarantined:1,inserted:3,failed:0});
  expect(s.db.documents().some(d=>d.source_ref==='2026090300863_e')).toBe(false);
  expect([...s.store.objects().values()].every(o=>o.mime==='application/pdf')).toBe(true);
 });
 it('an object put failure writes no row and does not advance',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  s.deps.store={...s.store,put:async()=>{throw new Error('storage 500');}};
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'object_put_failed'});
  expect(s.db.documents()).toEqual([]);
  expect(s.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toEqual({segment:'y2025',last_ref:null,settled:[],attempts:{'2025082500100_c':1},seq:1});
 });
 it('a list failure stops the issuer without moving the cursor (list_failed)',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  s.a.lists.y2025=new Error('layout_changed: result table not found');
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.status).toBe('failed');
  expect(r.errors[0]).toMatchObject({code:'list_failed',key:`${H}:y2025`});
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_cursor:{},last_status:'failed'});
 });
});

describe('runDocumentsSync — EDGAR assets and coverage',()=>{
 const edgarItem=(o:Partial<Listed>={}):Listed=>({source_ref:'0001321655-26-000041/pltr-20260630.htm',source_url:'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1321655/000132165526000041/pltr-20260630.htm',title:'10-Q',form_type:'10-Q',published_at:'2026-08-03T22:06:38.000Z',precision:'instant',
  assets:[{role:'filing_index',filename:'index.json',url:'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1321655/000132165526000041/index.json',required:true}],...o});
 const XBRL='https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1321655/000132165526000041/pltr-20260630_htm.xml';
 const fromIndex=():ListedAsset[]=>[{role:'xbrl_instance',filename:'pltr-20260630_htm.xml',url:XBRL,required:false}];
 async function edgarSetup(){
  const s=await setup({source:'edgar',gap:'edgar_files_unverified',fromIndex});
  s.a.segs.backfill=[{id:'recent',from:'2025-01-01',to:'2026-11-06'}];
  s.a.lists={recent:[edgarItem()]};
  s.f.set(edgarItem().source_url,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('<html>10-Q</html>'),'text/html'));
  s.f.set(edgarItem().assets![0].url,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('{"directory":{"item":[]}}'),'application/json'));
  return s;
 }
 it('stores the main document with its index and XBRL instance in one insert; New York calendar date',async()=>{
  const s=await edgarSetup();
  s.f.set(XBRL,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('<xbrl/>'),'text/xml'));
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.counts.inserted).toBe(1);
  const [d]=s.db.documents();
  expect(d).toMatchObject({market:'US',doc_class:'quarterly_report',filing_source_ref:'0001321655-26-000041',language:'en',mime:'text/html',available_date:'2026-08-03'});
  expect(s.db.assets().map(a=>[a.role,a.filename,a.mime])).toEqual([['filing_index','index.json','application/json'],['xbrl_instance','pltr-20260630_htm.xml','application/xml']]);
  expect(s.store.objects().size).toBe(3);
 });
 it('an oversized or missing XBRL instance is skipped (xbrl_skipped); a failing index blocks the item',async()=>{
  const s=await edgarSetup();
  s.f.set(XBRL,'too_large');
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.counts.inserted).toBe(1);
  expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'skipped_summary',key:`${H}:xbrl_skipped`,message:'{"xbrl_skipped":1}'});
  expect(s.db.assets().map(a=>a.role)).toEqual(['filing_index']);
  const t=await edgarSetup();
  t.f.set(edgarItem().assets![0].url,'not_found');
  const r2=await t.run();
  expect(r2.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'asset_fetch_failed'});
  expect(t.db.documents()).toEqual([]);
  expect(t.scopeRow().backfill_cursor).toEqual({segment:'recent',last_ref:null,settled:[],attempts:{'0001321655-26-000041/pltr-20260630.htm':1},seq:1});
 });
 it('with a coverage gap the finished backfill is not marked done: cursor reset, coverage_summary, due in a day',async()=>{
  const s=await edgarSetup();s.f.set(XBRL,'not_found');
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'coverage_summary',key:H,message:JSON.stringify({gap:'edgar_files_unverified',segments:['recent']})});
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
  expect(s.scopeRow()).toMatchObject({backfill_done:false,backfill_cursor:{},next_due_at:'2026-11-07T02:00:00.000Z'});
  const again=await s.run({refetch:false});
  expect(again.counts).toMatchObject({duplicates:1,inserted:0});
 });
 it('rejects a document MIME the source does not allow',async()=>{
  const s=await edgarSetup();
  s.f.set(edgarItem().source_url,s.f.ok(new TextEncoder().encode('plain'),'text/plain'));
  await s.run();
  expect(s.quarantined().map(q=>q.reason_code)).toEqual(['unexpected_mime']);
 });
});

describe('runDocumentsSync — leases, batches, dry run',()=>{
 it('a lease held by another batch is skipped_summary(leased); a merged issuer is skipped',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();backfillLists(s);
  await s.db.claimSyncLease(H,'hkexnews','00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ff',600);
  const r=await s.run();
  expect(r.issuers[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'skipped',code:'leased'});
  expect(r.errors).toEqual([{code:'skipped_summary',key:`${H}:leased`,message:'{"leased":1}'}]);
  expect(s.db.documents()).toEqual([]);
  const t=await setup();
  await t.db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:M,reasons:['cohort'],priority:10,fetch_key:'09999'}]);
  const r2=await t.run({issuerIds:[M]});
```
