```ts
// src/lib/documents/sync.ts
// Document sync core (spec §6.1, §10). One ingest_batches row per call (producer documents-sync,
// dataset documents.<source>); the scheduled path reconciles the scope first (§6.4), then walks the
// due issuers until the budget has less than 90 s left (deadline_hit). Per issuer: lease → mode
// (backfill until backfill_done, then poll) → segments from the adapter → for each segment the
// complete ordered list → its items, resumed from the source_ref checkpoint (codex plan round 1
// P2-5; never an ordinal into the freshly fetched, mutable list): the cursor {segment, last_ref,
// settled, attempts, seq} names the furthest item processed in this segment pass, the refs processed
// without a stored row (404 / quarantined / exhausted) and the failed attempts per source_ref. On
// resume a settled ref, or a known (stored) ref at or before last_ref's position in the new list, is
// skipped; an unknown ref is always processed (an insertion is never skipped, a removal skips
// nothing); retries stay with their own source_ref. seq increases at every checkpoint and the SQL
// refuses a stale one (P2-4); the scope row is reread after the lease is claimed, so a batch that
// advanced and released between selection and claim is never regressed. The checkpoint is persisted
// before any network or write work on an item, so a crash resumes at that item. Per item: a known
// source_ref with refetch=false is a duplicate (no download, does
// not count against maxPerIssuer); otherwise fetch (≤ MAX_DOC_BYTES) → MIME → sha256 → object
// put (content-addressed, before the row) → assets (EDGAR index required, XBRL optional) →
// insert_document_version (document + assets in one transaction). too_large / unexpected_mime →
// quarantine and advance; 404 → skipped_summary(document_missing) and advance; fetch / put /
// required-asset failures do NOT advance: attempts[source_ref]+1, the issuer stops as failed, and the
// third failure quarantines document_fetch_exhausted and advances. A replacement version (an earlier
// version of the same source_ref exists) is available from the fetch instant, never back-dated
// (§5.2). Lease release: done → now+1 d; success but unfinished (item cap, deadline) → now;
// failed → now+6 h; lease_lost → no further database call for that issuer. Batch status always
// comes from batchStatusFromCounts; freshness ok = idle or at least one issuer success. Dry run:
// no batch, lease, cursor, object, quarantine or document write; fetches the bytes of the items it
// would process and plans their outcome against documentVersions.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {localDate} from '../research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {classify} from './classify';
import {blobPath} from './object-store';
import {documentScopeRowFor,reconcileDocumentScope} from './scope';
import {DAY_MS,assetMime,makeDocBudget,sniffMime} from './sources/shared';
import type {Budget,FetchBytes,FetchedBytes,Listed,ListedAsset,SourceAdapter} from './sources/shared';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,DocumentsDbError,MAX_DOC_BYTES} from './types';
import type {Acquisition,AssetInsert,DocMarket,DocMime,DocScopeCursor,DocScopeInput,DocScopeRow,DocumentInsert,DocumentsDb,ListedSource,ObjectStore} from './types';

export interface SyncDeps{db:DocumentsDb;tables:TableClient;store:ObjectStore;adapter:SourceAdapter;fetchBytes:FetchBytes;now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;userAgent:string}
export interface SyncOptions{source:ListedSource;limit:number;issuerIds?:string[];sinceYear:number;refetch?:boolean;dryRun:boolean;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;maxPerIssuer?:number}
export type IssuerOutcomeKind='success'|'failed'|'skipped'|'planned';
export interface DocIssuerOutcome{issuerId:string;fetchKey:string;outcome:IssuerOutcomeKind;code?:string;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[]}
export interface DocSyncReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];issuers:DocIssuerOutcome[];idle:boolean}
export class DocumentsSyncError extends Error{constructor(readonly code:string){super(code);this.name='DocumentsSyncError';}}

export const DEADLINE_MS=240_000;
export const LEASE_TTL_S=600;
export const LEASE_RENEW_MS=120_000;
export const MIN_ISSUER_MS=90_000;
/** Budget below which no new item starts: one fetch needs the 20 s reserve plus room to write. */
export const MIN_ITEM_MS=25_000;
export const DEFAULT_MAX_PER_ISSUER=50;
export const MAX_ITEM_ATTEMPTS=3;
export const NEXT_DUE_DONE_MS=DAY_MS;
export const NEXT_DUE_FAIL_MS=6*3600_000;
const COUNTERS=['fetched','inserted','duplicates','versioned','quarantined','failed'] as const;
const MARKET:Record<ListedSource,DocMarket>={edgar:'US',cninfo:'CN',hkexnews:'HK'};
/** Document MIME types accepted per source (anything else is quarantined unexpected_mime). */
export const ALLOWED_MIMES:Record<ListedSource,readonly DocMime[]>={edgar:['text/html','application/xhtml+xml','application/xml','text/xml','application/pdf'],cninfo:['application/pdf'],hkexnews:['application/pdf']};
const NY_DATE=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'America/New_York',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'});
/** available_date = calendar day of available_at in the source's zone: US America/New_York, CN/HK UTC+8 (spec §5.2). */
export function availableDateOf(source:ListedSource,iso:string):string{return source==='edgar'?NY_DATE.format(new Date(iso)):localDate(iso,8);}
const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,200);
const sha256Hex=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const isLeaseLost=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='lease_lost';

interface RunCtx{deps:SyncDeps;source:ListedSource;batchId:string|null;sinceYear:number;refetch:boolean;maxPerIssuer:number;budget:Budget}
type ItemResult={advance:true;stored:boolean}|{advance:false;code:string;message:string};
const isRecord=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>typeof v==='object'&&v!==null&&!Array.isArray(v);
class RetryItem extends Error{constructor(readonly code:string,message:string){super(message);}}

function acquisitionOf(got:FetchedBytes,userAgent:string):Acquisition{
 const len=Number(got.headers['content-length']);
 return {fetched_at:got.fetchedAt,http_status:got.status,content_type:got.headers['content-type']??null,content_length:got.headers['content-length']!==undefined&&Number.isFinite(len)?len:null,
  etag:got.headers.etag??null,last_modified:got.headers['last-modified']??null,user_agent:userAgent};
}

async function syncIssuer(ctx:RunCtx,selected:DocScopeRow):Promise<DocIssuerOutcome>{
 const {deps,source,batchId,budget}=ctx;const {db}=deps;const dry=batchId===null;
 const issuer=selected.issuer_id;
 const out:DocIssuerOutcome={issuerId:issuer,fetchKey:selected.fetch_key,outcome:'skipped',counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[]};
 const skips=new Map<string,number>();
 const skip=(reason:string)=>skips.set(reason,(skips.get(reason)??0)+1);
 const finish=(outcome:IssuerOutcomeKind,code?:string)=>{
  out.outcome=outcome;if(code!==undefined)out.code=code;
  for(const [reason,n] of skips)out.errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:`${issuer}:${reason}`,message:JSON.stringify({[reason]:n})});
  return out;
 };
 const [issuerRow]=await deps.tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer},{limit:1});
 if(issuerRow?.status==='merged'){skip('issuer_merged');return finish('skipped','issuer_merged');}
 if(!dry&&!await db.claimSyncLease(issuer,source,batchId,LEASE_TTL_S)){skip('leased');return finish('skipped','leased');}
 // P2-4: the selection's snapshot may be stale (another batch may have advanced and released in
 // between); mode and cursors come from the row reread under our lease
 const scope=dry?selected:(await db.scopeRows(source,[issuer]))[0]??selected;
 let leaseUntil=deps.now().getTime()+LEASE_TTL_S*1000;let released=false;
 const renew=async()=>{
  if(dry||leaseUntil-deps.now().getTime()>=LEASE_RENEW_MS)return;
  if(!await db.claimSyncLease(issuer,source,batchId!,LEASE_TTL_S))throw new DocumentsDbError('lease_lost');
  leaseUntil=deps.now().getTime()+LEASE_TTL_S*1000;
 };
 const release=async(outcome:'success'|'failed',delayMs:number)=>{
  if(dry||released)return;released=true;
  try{await db.releaseSyncLease(issuer,source,batchId!,outcome,new Date(deps.now().getTime()+delayMs).toISOString());}
  catch(e){out.errors.push({code:isLeaseLost(e)?'lease_lost':'cleanup_failed',key:issuer,message:`release: ${errMsg(e)}`});}
 };
 const mode:'backfill'|'poll'=scope.backfill_done?'poll':'backfill';
 const segments=deps.adapter.segments(scope,mode,ctx.sinceYear,deps.now());
 const stored=(mode==='backfill'?scope.backfill_cursor:scope.poll_cursor) as Partial<DocScopeCursor>;
 let seq=typeof stored.seq==='number'&&Number.isSafeInteger(stored.seq)&&stored.seq>=0?stored.seq:0;
 let seg=segments.findIndex(s=>s.id===stored.segment);
 let lastRef:string|null=null;let settled=new Set<string>();let attempts=new Map<string,number>();
 if(seg<0)seg=0;
 else{
  lastRef=typeof stored.last_ref==='string'?stored.last_ref:null;
  settled=new Set(Array.isArray(stored.settled)?stored.settled.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'):[]);
  if(isRecord(stored.attempts))for(const [ref,n] of Object.entries(stored.attempts))if(typeof n==='number'&&Number.isInteger(n)&&n>0)attempts.set(ref,n);
 }
 let dirty=false;
 const persist=async()=>{
  if(dry||!dirty||seg>=segments.length)return;
  await renew();
  seq++;
  await db.advanceCursor(issuer,source,batchId!,mode,{segment:segments[seg].id,last_ref:lastRef,settled:[...settled],attempts:Object.fromEntries(attempts),seq},false);
  dirty=false;
 };
 const park=async(reason:string,item:Listed,payload:Record<string,unknown>)=>{
  if(!dry)await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:`documents.${source}`,table:'disclosure_documents',naturalKey:`${source}:${item.source_ref}`,reasonCode:reason,batchId:batchId!,payload:{issuer_id:issuer,source_ref:item.source_ref,url:item.source_url,...payload}});
  out.counts.fetched++;out.counts.quarantined++;
 };
 /** One item; a RetryItem means "do not advance". */
 const processItem=async(item:Listed):Promise<ItemResult>=>{
  let got:FetchedBytes|'too_large'|'not_found';
  try{got=await deps.fetchBytes(item.source_url,budget,MAX_DOC_BYTES);}
  catch(e){return {advance:false,code:'fetch_failed',message:errMsg(e)};}
  if(got==='not_found'){skip('document_missing');return {advance:true,stored:false};}
  if(got==='too_large'){await park('document_too_large',item,{max_bytes:MAX_DOC_BYTES});return {advance:true,stored:false};}
  const mime=sniffMime(got.mime,got.bytes);
  if(mime===null||!ALLOWED_MIMES[source].includes(mime)){await park('unexpected_mime',item,{declared:got.mime,sniffed:mime});return {advance:true,stored:false};}
  const sha=sha256Hex(got.bytes);
  const prior=await db.documentVersions(source,item.source_ref,{limit:1000});
  if(dry){
   out.counts.fetched++;
   if(prior.rows.some(r=>r.content_sha256===sha))out.counts.duplicates++;else if(prior.rows.length>0)out.counts.versioned++;else out.counts.inserted++;
   return {advance:true,stored:true};
  }
  try{
   await deps.store.put(blobPath(sha,mime),got.bytes,mime);
  }catch(e){return {advance:false,code:'object_put_failed',message:errMsg(e)};}
  let assets:AssetInsert[];
  try{assets=await fetchAssets(item);}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof RetryItem)return {advance:false,code:e.code,message:e.message};throw e;}
  const cls=classify(source,{form_type:item.form_type,title:item.title,headline:item.headline,source_ref:item.source_ref});
  // A replacement is visible from the moment we saw it, not from the original release (spec §5.2).
  // The sync lease serialises this issuer/source; a source_ref listed under two issuers can race and
  // is then still versioned correctly by the SQL function (only available_at could be the release time).
  const replacement=prior.rows.length>0&&!prior.rows.some(r=>r.content_sha256===sha);
  const availableAt=replacement?got.fetchedAt:new Date(item.published_at).toISOString();
  const doc:DocumentInsert={
   issuer_id:issuer,source,market:MARKET[source],source_ref:item.source_ref,form_type:item.form_type,doc_class:cls.doc_class,classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,
   title:item.title,language:cls.language,source_url:item.source_url,content_sha256:sha,bytes:got.bytes.length,mime,storage_path:blobPath(sha,mime),
   acquisition:acquisitionOf(got,deps.userAgent),published_at:new Date(item.published_at).toISOString(),published_at_precision:item.precision,
   available_at:availableAt,available_date:availableDateOf(source,availableAt),fiscal_year:cls.fiscal_year,fiscal_period:cls.fiscal_period,period_end:cls.period_end,
   filing_source_ref:cls.filing_source_ref,permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,batch_id:batchId!,code_version:deps.codeVersion!,
  };
  await renew();
  const r=await db.insertDocumentVersion(issuer,source,batchId!,doc,assets);
  out.counts.fetched++;
  if(r.outcome==='inserted')out.counts.inserted++;else if(r.outcome==='versioned')out.counts.versioned++;else out.counts.duplicates++;
  return {advance:true,stored:true};
 };
 /** Required assets failing → RetryItem; optional ones → skipped_summary(xbrl_skipped). The index may name more assets. */
 const fetchAssets=async(item:Listed):Promise<AssetInsert[]>=>{
  const specs:ListedAsset[]=[...(item.assets??[])];const rows:AssetInsert[]=[];
  const optionalMiss=(a:ListedAsset,code:string,message:string)=>{if(a.required)throw new RetryItem(code,`${a.filename}: ${message}`);skip('xbrl_skipped');};
  for(let i=0;i<specs.length;i++){
   const a=specs[i];
   let r:FetchedBytes|'too_large'|'not_found';
   try{r=await deps.fetchBytes(a.url,budget,MAX_DOC_BYTES);}catch(e){optionalMiss(a,'asset_fetch_failed',errMsg(e));continue;}
   if(typeof r==='string'){optionalMiss(a,'asset_fetch_failed',r);continue;}
   const m=assetMime(r.mime,a.filename);
   if(m===null){optionalMiss(a,'asset_fetch_failed','asset_mime');continue;}
   const sha=sha256Hex(r.bytes);
   try{await deps.store.put(blobPath(sha,m),r.bytes,m);}catch(e){optionalMiss(a,'object_put_failed',errMsg(e));continue;}
   rows.push({role:a.role,filename:a.filename,source_url:a.url,content_sha256:sha,bytes:r.bytes.length,mime:m,storage_path:blobPath(sha,m),acquisition:acquisitionOf(r,deps.userAgent)});
   if(a.role==='filing_index'&&deps.adapter.assetsFromIndex){
    let more:ListedAsset[]=[];
    try{more=deps.adapter.assetsFromIndex(item,r.bytes);}catch{skip('xbrl_skipped');}
    for(const x of more)if(!specs.some(s=>s.role===x.role&&s.filename===x.filename))specs.push(x);
   }
  }
  return rows;
 };
 try{
  let newItems=0;let stop:null|'limit'|'deadline'=null;
  segLoop:
  for(;seg<segments.length;seg++,lastRef=null,settled=new Set(),attempts=new Map(),dirty=true){
   const segment=segments[seg];
   let items:Listed[];
   try{items=await deps.adapter.list(scope,segment,budget);}
   catch(e){
    await persist();
    out.counts.failed++;out.errors.push({code:'list_failed',key:`${issuer}:${segment.id}`,message:errMsg(e)});
    await release('failed',NEXT_DUE_FAIL_MS);return finish('failed','list_failed');
   }
   const known=await db.knownSourceRefs(issuer,source,items.map(i=>i.source_ref));
   // furthest position of this pass in the NEW list (-1: fresh pass, or the checkpoint item is gone)
   let reached=lastRef===null?-1:items.findIndex(i=>i.source_ref===lastRef);
   for(let i=0;i<items.length;i++){
    const item=items[i];const ref=item.source_ref;const isKnown=known.has(ref);
    const passed=()=>{if(i>reached){reached=i;lastRef=ref;}attempts.delete(ref);dirty=true;};
    if(settled.has(ref))continue;                                   // processed in this pass without a stored row
    if(isKnown&&i<=reached)continue;                                // stored and already passed in this pass
    if(isKnown&&!ctx.refetch){out.counts.fetched++;out.counts.duplicates++;passed();continue;}
    if(!isKnown&&newItems>=ctx.maxPerIssuer){stop='limit';break segLoop;}
    if(budget.remainingMs()<MIN_ITEM_MS){stop='deadline';break segLoop;}
    await persist();
    const r=await processItem(item);
    if(!isKnown)newItems++;
    if(r.advance){if(!r.stored)settled.add(ref);passed();continue;}
    const n=(attempts.get(ref)??0)+1;
    if(n>=MAX_ITEM_ATTEMPTS){
     await park('document_fetch_exhausted',item,{attempts:n,last_error:{code:r.code,message:r.message}});
     settled.add(ref);passed();continue;
    }
    attempts.set(ref,n);dirty=true;await persist();
    out.counts.fetched++;out.counts.failed++;out.errors.push({code:r.code,key:`${issuer}:${item.source_ref}`,message:r.message});
    await release('failed',NEXT_DUE_FAIL_MS);return finish('failed',r.code);
   }
  }
  if(stop!==null){
   await persist();
   if(stop==='deadline')out.errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',key:issuer,message:JSON.stringify({segment:segments[seg]?.id??null,last_ref:lastRef})});
   await release('success',0);return finish(dry?'planned':'success',stop==='limit'?'item_limit':'deadline_hit');
  }
  // Every segment done.
  const gap=mode==='backfill'?deps.adapter.coverageGap:null;
  if(gap!==null)out.errors.push({code:'coverage_summary',key:issuer,message:JSON.stringify({gap,segments:segments.map(s=>s.id)})});
  if(!dry){
   await renew();
   // backfill with a coverage gap restarts its (cheap: known items are duplicates) segments next time and never claims completeness
   await db.advanceCursor(issuer,source,batchId!,mode,null,mode==='backfill'&&gap===null);
  }
  await release('success',NEXT_DUE_DONE_MS);
  return finish(dry?'planned':'success');
 }catch(e){
  if(isLeaseLost(e)){out.counts.fetched++;out.counts.failed++;out.errors.push({code:'lease_lost',key:issuer});return finish('failed','lease_lost');}
  const code=e instanceof DocumentsDbError?e.code:'unknown';
  out.counts.fetched++;out.counts.failed++;out.errors.push({code,key:issuer,message:errMsg(e)});
  await release('failed',NEXT_DUE_FAIL_MS);return finish('failed',code);
 }
}

type Selected={scope:DocScopeRow}|{unresolved:string};
/**
 * Scheduled path: due rows. Explicit issuers: their rows by id in the given order; a missing row is
 * built by documentScopeRowFor — seeded through reconcileScope when applying (reasons ['explicit']),
 * constructed in memory for a dry run — and an issuer without a fetch key is reported scope_unresolved.
 */
async function selectScopes(deps:SyncDeps,opts:SyncOptions):Promise<Selected[]>{
 if(opts.issuerIds===undefined)return (await deps.db.scopeDue(opts.source,deps.now().toISOString(),opts.limit)).map(scope=>({scope}));
 const ids=[...new Set(opts.issuerIds)];
 const have=new Map((await deps.db.scopeRows(opts.source,ids)).map(s=>[s.issuer_id,s]));
 const today=deps.now().toISOString().slice(0,10);const seed:DocScopeInput[]=[];
 for(const id of ids){
  if(have.has(id))continue;
  const row=await documentScopeRowFor(deps.tables,opts.source,id,{today});
  if(row===null)continue;
  const at=deps.now().toISOString();
  if(opts.dryRun)have.set(id,{...row,source:opts.source,backfill_cursor:{},backfill_done:false,poll_cursor:{},next_due_at:at,lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_status:null,updated_at:at});
  else seed.push(row);
 }
 if(seed.length>0){
  await deps.db.reconcileScope(opts.source,seed);
  for(const s of await deps.db.scopeRows(opts.source,seed.map(r=>r.issuer_id)))have.set(s.issuer_id,s);
 }
 return ids.map(id=>{const scope=have.get(id);return scope?{scope}:{unresolved:id};});
}
const unresolvedOutcome=(issuerId:string):DocIssuerOutcome=>({issuerId,fetchKey:'',outcome:'failed',code:'scope_unresolved',counts:{...emptyCounts(),fetched:1,failed:1},errors:[{code:'scope_unresolved',key:issuerId}]});

export async function runDocumentsSync(deps:SyncDeps,opts:SyncOptions):Promise<DocSyncReceipt>{
 const {source}=opts;const dataset=`documents.${source}`;
 if(deps.adapter.source!==source)throw new DocumentsSyncError('adapter_mismatch');
 if(!opts.dryRun&&(deps.codeVersion===null||deps.codeVersion===''))throw new DocumentsSyncError('code_version_unavailable');
 const budget=makeDocBudget(deps.deadline,deps.now);
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const issuers:DocIssuerOutcome[]=[];
 let idle=false,succeeded=0;
 const loop=async(batchId:string|null)=>{
  const ctx:RunCtx={deps,source,batchId,sinceYear:opts.sinceYear,refetch:opts.refetch??source==='hkexnews',maxPerIssuer:opts.maxPerIssuer??DEFAULT_MAX_PER_ISSUER,budget};
  const selected=await selectScopes(deps,opts);
  idle=selected.length===0;
  for(let i=0;i<selected.length;i++){
   const sel=selected[i];
   if(budget.remainingMs()<MIN_ISSUER_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:JSON.stringify({not_started:selected.length-i})});break;}
   const r='unresolved' in sel?unresolvedOutcome(sel.unresolved):await syncIssuer(ctx,sel.scope);
   issuers.push(r);for(const k of COUNTERS)counts[k]+=r.counts[k];errors.push(...r.errors);
   if(r.outcome==='success')succeeded++;
  }
 };
 if(opts.dryRun){
  await loop(null);
  return {batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts,errors,issuers,idle};
 }
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'documents-sync',dataset,toolVersions:{classifier_gen:String(CLASSIFIER_GEN),source},codeVersion:deps.codeVersion!,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy});
 try{
  // Scheduled path reconciles the scope first; explicit issuers (scripts, tests) skip it.
  if(opts.issuerIds===undefined)await reconcileDocumentScope({tables:deps.tables,db:deps.db},source,{today:deps.now().toISOString().slice(0,10)});
  await loop(batchId);
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,dataset,{ok:idle||succeeded>0,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{attempted:issuers.length,succeeded,idle}});
  return {batchId,status,counts,errors,issuers,idle};
 }catch(e){
  errors.push({code:'unknown',message:errMsg(e)});
  try{await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());}catch{/* left running; runbook SQL closes it */}
  try{await recordAttempt(deps.tables,dataset,{ok:false,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{error:errMsg(e)}});}catch{/* same */}
  throw e;
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/deps.ts
// Production wiring of the document pipeline (spec §6.1, §6.3). productionDocumentsDeps builds one
// PoliteHttp per run with the source's request gap (edgar 120 ms, cninfo 500 ms, hkexnews 1000 ms)
// shared by the list adapter and the document downloads, plus the Supabase DocumentsDb / TableClient /
// ObjectStore. documentsCodeVersion delegates to the facts rule (src/lib/facts/sync.ts::resolveCodeVersion):
// cron routes accept only a full VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA (allowGit false); scripts may fall back to
// `git rev-parse HEAD` (+ -dirty). null = refuse to apply. Sync wiring only: extraction wiring is
// extract/deps.ts (Task 10), candidates wiring is candidates/run.ts::supabaseCandidatesDeps (Task 15).
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../facts/sync';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from './db';
import {supabaseObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {CNINFO_INTERVAL_MS,cninfoAdapter} from './sources/cninfo';
import {EDGAR_DOC_FORMS,EDGAR_INTERVAL_MS,edgarAdapter} from './sources/edgar';
import {HKEX_INTERVAL_MS,hkexnewsAdapter} from './sources/hkexnews';
import {politeHttp} from './sources/shared';
import type {SourceAdapter} from './sources/shared';
import type {SyncDeps} from './sync';
import type {ListedSource} from './types';

export function documentsCodeVersion(opts:{allowGit:boolean}={allowGit:false}):string|null{
 return opts.allowGit?resolveCodeVersion(process.env):resolveCodeVersion(process.env,()=>{throw new Error('git_not_allowed');});
}

export const SOURCE_INTERVAL_MS:Record<ListedSource,number>={edgar:EDGAR_INTERVAL_MS,cninfo:CNINFO_INTERVAL_MS,hkexnews:HKEX_INTERVAL_MS};
export interface DocumentsDepsOptions{
 deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;now?:()=>Date;
 /** Reuse an existing admin client (scripts hold one). */
 admin?:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>;
 /** edgar: forms added to EDGAR_DOC_FORMS (script --forms). */
 extraForms?:string[];
 /** cninfo/hkexnews: store every announcement, not only periodic reports (script --all-announcements, owner decision B). */
 allAnnouncements?:boolean;
 fetch?:typeof fetch;userAgent?:string;
}
export function productionDocumentsDeps(source:ListedSource,opts:DocumentsDepsOptions):SyncDeps{
 const sb=opts.admin??getAdminSupabase();
 const http=politeHttp({minIntervalMs:SOURCE_INTERVAL_MS[source],fetch:opts.fetch,userAgent:opts.userAgent});
 const adapter:SourceAdapter=source==='edgar'?edgarAdapter({http,forms:[...new Set([...EDGAR_DOC_FORMS,...(opts.extraForms??[])])]})
  :source==='cninfo'?cninfoAdapter({http,allAnnouncements:opts.allAnnouncements}):hkexnewsAdapter({http,allAnnouncements:opts.allAnnouncements});
 return {db:supabaseDocumentsDb(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),store:supabaseObjectStore(sb),adapter,fetchBytes:http.fetchBytes,
  now:opts.now??(()=>new Date()),deadline:opts.deadline,codeVersion:opts.codeVersion,userAgent:http.userAgent};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the cron route**

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/documents-sync/route.ts
// Document sync trigger (spec §6.3): CRON_SECRET bearer (authorized() copied from facts-sync),
// source=edgar|cninfo|hkexnews required exactly once, limit 1..200 (default 25), every query parameter
// at most once (a repeated one is invalid_parameter:<name>), maxDuration 300 with a 240 s deadline
// handed to the core (no new issuer under 90 s: deadline_hit). Without VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA the run is
// refused (503 code_version_unavailable, spec §6.1). sinceYear = this year − 10 (spec §1.1). The HTTP
// receipt carries codes, keys and counts only, never messages. A duplicate cron delivery is harmless:
// issuers leased by the first run are skipped as 'leased'.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {DEADLINE_MS,DocumentsSyncError,runDocumentsSync} from '@/lib/documents/sync';
import type {DocSyncReceipt} from '@/lib/documents/sync';
import {documentsCodeVersion,productionDocumentsDeps} from '@/lib/documents/deps';
import type {ListedSource} from '@/lib/documents/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT=25,MAX_LIMIT=200;
const SOURCES:readonly ListedSource[]=['edgar','cninfo','hkexnews'];
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function publicReceipt(r:DocSyncReceipt){
 const errs=(list:{code:string;key?:string}[])=>list.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key});
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,errors:errs(r.errors),idle:r.idle,
  issuers:r.issuers.map(i=>({issuerId:i.issuerId,fetchKey:i.fetchKey,outcome:i.outcome,code:i.code,counts:i.counts,errors:errs(i.errors)}))};
}

function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 for(const name of new Set(url.searchParams.keys()))if(url.searchParams.getAll(name).length>1)return err(`invalid_parameter:${name}`,`${name} may be given once`,400);
 const source=url.searchParams.get('source');
 if(source===null||!(SOURCES as readonly string[]).includes(source))return err('invalid_parameter:source','source must be edgar, cninfo or hkexnews',400);
 const limitRaw=url.searchParams.get('limit');
 let limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT;
 if(limitRaw!==null){if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(limitRaw)||Number(limitRaw)<1||Number(limitRaw)>MAX_LIMIT)return err('invalid_parameter:limit',`limit must be 1..${MAX_LIMIT}`,400);limit=Number(limitRaw);}
 const codeVersion=documentsCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const deps=productionDocumentsDeps(source as ListedSource,{deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion});
  const receipt=await runDocumentsSync(deps,{source:source as ListedSource,limit,sinceYear:started.getUTCFullYear()-10,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',source,limit,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof DocumentsSyncError?e.code:'sync_failed','Documents sync failed',500);   // code only: no message leaves the server
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the script**

```ts
/**
 * Document sync from the command line (spec §6.3). No deadline; dry run by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/sync.ts --source edgar|cninfo|hkexnews
 *        [--issuer <issuer_id|ticker>]... [--limit n] [--since-year y] [--forms F1,F2]
 *        [--all-announcements] [--refetch] [--apply]
 *
 * Dry run: lists, downloads the items it would process and plans duplicate / versioned / inserted
 * against the database (read-only: no batch, lease, cursor, object, quarantine or document write).
 * --apply records an ingest_batches receipt (dataset documents.<source>, triggered_by script) and needs
 * a code version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git checkout). --issuer takes an issuer uuid or a ticker
 * resolved by today's ownership (unknown → exit 2); an issuer without a document_sync_scope row is
 * seeded by the core on --apply (reasons ['explicit']; the next cron reconcile retires it unless a
 * source lists it). --forms adds EDGAR forms to the default set (edgar only). --all-announcements
 * stores every cninfo/HKEX announcement instead of periodic reports only (owner decision B; not edgar).
 * --refetch downloads known source_refs again (hkexnews always does by default; spec §15 q2).
 * Do not run --apply while the cron for the same source is running (leases make it safe, not useful).
 * Exit 0 on success, 1 when the batch (or any issuer of a dry run) failed, 2 on bad arguments.
 * tsx does NOT load .env.local: use node --env-file as above (never commit that file).
 */
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../src/lib/entities/resolve';
import {documentsCodeVersion,productionDocumentsDeps} from '../../src/lib/documents/deps';
import {runDocumentsSync} from '../../src/lib/documents/sync';
import type {ListedSource} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: sync.ts --source edgar|cninfo|hkexnews [--issuer <issuer_id|ticker>]... [--limit n] [--since-year y] [--forms F1,F2] [--all-announcements] [--refetch] [--apply]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
interface Args{source:ListedSource;issuers:string[];limit:number;sinceYear:number;forms:string[];allAnnouncements:boolean;refetch:boolean;apply:boolean}

function usage(msg?:string):never{console.error(msg??USAGE);process.exit(2);}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const thisYear=new Date().getUTCFullYear();
 const a:Args={source:'hkexnews',issuers:[],limit:25,sinceYear:thisYear-10,forms:[],allAnnouncements:false,refetch:false,apply:false};let source:string|undefined;
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--'))usage();return v;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--source'){if(source!==undefined)usage('--source may be given once');source=next(i++);}
  else if(x==='--issuer')a.issuers.push(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--since-year')a.sinceYear=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--forms')a.forms.push(...next(i++).split(',').map(f=>f.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(f=>f.length>0));
  else if(x==='--all-announcements')a.allAnnouncements=true;
  else if(x==='--refetch')a.refetch=true;
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else usage();
 }
 if(source!=='edgar'&&source!=='cninfo'&&source!=='hkexnews')usage();
 a.source=source;
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>1000)usage('--limit must be 1..1000');
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.sinceYear)||a.sinceYear<1990||a.sinceYear>thisYear)usage('--since-year out of range');
 if(a.forms.length>0&&a.source!=='edgar')usage('--forms is for --source edgar only');
 if(a.allAnnouncements&&a.source==='edgar')usage('--all-announcements is for cninfo/hkexnews only');
 return a;
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const codeVersion=documentsCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??(args.apply?null:'dry-run');
 if(!codeVersion)usage('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const deps=productionDocumentsDeps(args.source,{deadline:null,codeVersion,admin,extraForms:args.forms,allAnnouncements:args.allAnnouncements});
 let issuerIds:string[]|undefined;
 if(args.issuers.length>0){
  const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  issuerIds=[];
  for(const t of args.issuers){
   if(UUID.test(t)){issuerIds.push(t.toLowerCase());continue;}
   const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:t},{today});
   if(!r)usage(`unknown ticker: ${t}`);
   issuerIds.push(r.issuer_id);
  }
 }
 const receipt=await runDocumentsSync(deps,{source:args.source,limit:args.limit,issuerIds,sinceYear:args.sinceYear,refetch:args.refetch||undefined,dryRun:!args.apply,triggeredBy:'script'});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:args.apply?'apply':'dry-run (no batch written; pass --apply to write)',source:args.source,codeVersion,...receipt},null,1));
 const failed=args.apply?receipt.status!=='success':receipt.issuers.some(i=>i.outcome==='failed');
 process.exit(failed?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

### 跨 Part 假设（Part A 实现必须满足，否则本 Part 测试会红）

- `memoryDocumentsDb()`（Task 2）：`reconcileScope` 建 scope 行；`claimSyncLease` 对新行返回 true；`insertDocumentVersion` 在同步租约下按 `(source, source_ref)` 分配版本、同哈希 → `duplicate`、新哈希 → `versioned`（`supersedes_document_id` 指向上一版、`observed_replacement=true`）；`insertUploadDocument` 同 owner 同哈希 → `duplicate`、不同 owner → 新行；不校验 `batch_id` 是否存在于 `ingest_batches`。`claimExtractLease` 只对 `status='stored'` 且租约空/过期/同批次返回 true，`extract_attempts>=3` 时置 `extract_failed` 并返回 false，否则 attempts+1；`failExtract` 在 attempts>=3 时置 `extract_failed` 并清租约；`finishExtract` 校验抽取租约、按 §7.3 判定 `candidates_role/status`、置 `extracted|no_text_layer` 与 `current_extraction_id`、清租约；`requestExtract` 对已存在 `(EXTRACTOR_VERSION, TABLE_ALGO_VERSION)` 版本抛 `DocumentsDbError('revision_exists')`，否则回 `stored`、attempts=0；`storedDue` 只按 `status='stored'` 与租约选取；`insertCitation` 校验 `char_end<=char_count`、片段与 `text_hash = document_pages.text_hash`；`publishCitations` 对非 human/module 或非公共文档抛 `not_publishable`；`readDocuments` 支持 `allVersions`、按 `(available_at desc, document_id desc)` 游标分页；`documentVersions` 返回该 `(source, source_ref)` 的全部版本；`expireExtractLease(doc)` 存在。
- **引用的 `text_hash` = 所在页 `document_pages.text_hash`**（`insert_citation` 的"text_hash 一致"按此理解；§4.5 的 integrity 也按此重算）。
- `db.ts`：`decodeCursor` 对非本层编码的字符串（`'%%%'`、`'bm90LWpzb24'`）抛错；`encodeCursor` 的结果可被 `decodeCursor` 解码。`supabaseDocumentsDb(client)` 的参数接受 `getAnonSupabase()` / `getAdminSupabase()` 的返回值。
- `object-store.ts`：`memoryObjectStore()` 的 `put` 对已存在路径返回 `'exists'`、`get` 对不存在路径抛错、带 `objects():Map<string,MemoryObject>`（`MemoryObject={bytes:Uint8Array;mime:string}`，整合时按 Part A 对齐）；`pagesJsonPath(c,p)='extractions/'+c+'/'+p+'.pages.json'`、`blobPath(sha,'application/pdf')='blobs/'+sha+'.pdf'`。

- `classify.ts`（Task 5）的 `classify(source,{form_type?,title,headline?,source_ref})` 返回 `{doc_class,fiscal_year,fiscal_period,period_end,filing_source_ref,language}`（reprocess 路由用；测试里 mock 掉）。

### Task 9: 页面抽取（PDF 文本层、表格、HTML、pages.json）

**Files:** Create: `src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/tables.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/pdf.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/html.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/pdfjs-worker.d.ts`、`src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/build.ts`、`scripts/documents/make-fixture-pdf.ts`、`src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/minimal-two-pages.pdf`、`src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/no-text.pdf`（由脚本生成）、`src/lib/documents/fixtures/tables/hk-is-page.items.json` / Test: `src/lib/documents/extract/{pdf,tables,html,pages-json}.test.ts`
**Spec:** §4.4（码点）、§7.1、§7.2、§11.1
**Depends on:** Task 4（`pdfjs-dist` 依赖）、Task 2（`types.ts`，含契约变更 C-1）

**夹具方案（为什么这样做）。** 规格要求"手写最小 PDF、≤ 2 KB、被引用文本之前含增补平面汉字与 emoji"。写含 CJK 的 PDF 通常要嵌字体；这里用一个**不嵌字体程序**的 Type0 字体（`Identity-H` 编码 + `ToUnicode` CMap）：pdf.js 的文本层只读 ToUnicode，所以码 `0001→U+2000B 𠀋`、`0002→U+1F600 😀`、`0003→U+FF11 １`（NFKC 后为 `1`）都能被抽出，拉丁文本用 Helvetica。PDF 字节由 `fixtures/pdf/build.ts` 确定性生成（1827 字节），`scripts/documents/make-fixture-pdf.ts` 写成提交的 `.pdf`，测试断言提交的字节等于生成器输出——既满足"提交的夹具文件"，又让夹具可审阅、可重建。码点不变量在三层都测：`pdf.test.ts`（真 pdf.js 输出，`Revenue` 在码点 3..10、UTF-16 下标为 5）、`pages-json.test.ts`（`cpLength/cpSlice/assemblePage`）、`html.test.ts`（25 万字符页里越过增补平面字符的偏移）。表格检测用合成的港股损益表页**文本项** JSON（`RawItem[]`，可手写），经 `layoutFromItems` 得到带偏移的 `lines` 再 `detectTables`——偏移由代码算出，夹具里不用手算码点。

**实测结论（写进代码头注）。** 在真实 `2026090300863_c.pdf` 上，只用规格的数值正则会把标签里的破折号（`Other income and gains – net`、`– Basic`）和日期数字（`Balance at 1 January 2026`）当成数值列；因此加入"数值尾"规则：只有行末、与前一项间隔 ≥ 1 em 的连续数值项才是单元格。修正后该文件损益表得到 4 列（标签/附注/本期/上期）、21 行，财务状况表、权益变动表列数与人工一致。`pages.json` 坐标取 0.01 pt，86 页文件约 4.9 MB（缩进 1 的夹具文件）。

// src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json.test.ts
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {assemblePage,buildPagesJson,cpLength,cpSlice,normalizeText,pageInsertsOf,parseRecordedFixture,serializePagesJson,sha256Hex} from './pages-json';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {PageLayout} from '../types';

const SHA='a'.repeat(64);
const piece=(text:string,x0:number,spaceBefore=false)=>({text,x0,x1:x0+10,y:100,h:10,spaceBefore});
const page=(no:number,t:string):PageLayout=>{const {text,lines}=assemblePage(t?[{y:1,pieces:[piece(t,0)]}]:[]);return {page_no:no,width:612,height:792,text,lines,tables:[]};};

describe('code points',()=>{
 it('cpLength / cpSlice count 𠀋 and 😀 as one each, unlike UTF-16 length/slice',()=>{
  const s='𠀋😀 Revenue';
  expect(cpLength(s)).toBe(10);
  expect(s.length).toBe(12);
  expect(cpSlice(s,3,10)).toBe('Revenue');
  expect(cpSlice(s,0,1)).toBe('𠀋');
  expect(cpSlice(s,1,2)).toBe('😀');
 });
 it('normalizeText: NFKC, whitespace folded (U+3000, NBSP, tabs), trimmed',()=>{
  expect(normalizeText('　ＡＢＣ\t  １２３ ﬁ ')).toBe('ABC 123 fi');
  expect(normalizeText(' \n ')).toBe('');
 });
});

describe('assemblePage',()=>{
 it('records page offsets while concatenating; rows joined by \\n, spaceBefore only between pieces',()=>{
  const {text,lines}=assemblePage([{y:200,pieces:[piece('𠀋😀',0,true),piece('Revenue',30,true)]},{y:180,pieces:[]},{y:150,pieces:[piece('Total',0),piece('1,234',50)]}]);
  expect(text).toBe('𠀋😀 Revenue\nTotal1,234');
  expect(lines.map(l=>[l.index,l.char_start,l.char_end,l.x0,l.x1])).toEqual([[0,0,10,0,40],[1,11,21,0,60]]);
  expect(lines[0].items.map(i=>[i.char_start,i.char_end])).toEqual([[0,2],[3,10]]);
 });
});

describe('buildPagesJson / pageInsertsOf',()=>{
 it('stamps the versions, hashes the exact serialised bytes, and is deterministic',()=>{
  const a=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:SHA,code_version:'c'.repeat(40),has_text_layer:true,pages:[page(1,'𠀋😀 Revenue'),page(2,'')]});
  const b=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:SHA,code_version:'c'.repeat(40),has_text_layer:true,pages:[page(1,'𠀋😀 Revenue'),page(2,'')]});
  expect(a.json).toMatchObject({extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,content_sha256:SHA,has_text_layer:true});
  expect(a.sha256).toBe(createHash('sha256').update(a.bytes).digest('hex'));
  expect(a.sha256).toBe(b.sha256);
  expect(new TextDecoder().decode(a.bytes)).toBe(serializePagesJson(a.json));
  expect(sha256Hex(new TextEncoder().encode(serializePagesJson(JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(a.bytes)))))).toBe(a.sha256);   // parse → serialise is byte-stable
 });
 it('page rows: char_count in code points, text_hash = sha256(utf8(text)), line_count, has_tables',()=>{
  const {json}=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:SHA,code_version:'x',has_text_layer:true,pages:[page(1,'𠀋😀 Revenue'),page(2,'')]});
  const rows=pageInsertsOf(json);
  expect(rows[0]).toEqual({page_no:1,text:'𠀋😀 Revenue',text_hash:createHash('sha256').update('𠀋😀 Revenue','utf8').digest('hex'),char_count:10,width:612,height:792,line_count:1,has_tables:false});
  expect(rows[1]).toMatchObject({page_no:2,text:'',char_count:0,line_count:0});
 });
});

describe('parseRecordedFixture',()=>{
 it('returns the pages.json bytes and hash a test uses as the extraction output; rejects inconsistent headers',()=>{
  const {json,sha256}=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:SHA,code_version:'x',has_text_layer:true,pages:[page(1,'a')]});
  const file={recorded_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z',source_url:'https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0903/2026090300863_c.pdf',source_ref:'2026090300863_c',content_sha256:SHA,bytes:1,page_count:1,extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,pages_json:json};
  expect(parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify(file,null,1)).pagesJsonSha256).toBe(sha256);
  expect(()=>parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify({...file,page_count:2}))).toThrow('invalid_fixture');
  expect(()=>parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify({...file,content_sha256:'b'.repeat(64)}))).toThrow('invalid_fixture');
  // --pages subset: page_count describes the whole PDF, stored pages keep their numbers
  expect(parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify({...file,page_count:84,pages_subset:true})).fixture.page_count).toBe(84);
  expect(()=>parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify({...file,page_count:0,pages_subset:true}))).toThrow('invalid_fixture');
 });
});

  expect(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(FIX+'no-text.pdf'))).toEqual(noTextPdf());

 });

  expect(l0.items.map(i=>[i.text,i.char_start,i.char_end])).toEqual([['𠀋😀',0,2],['Revenue',3,10]]);
  expect(l1).toMatchObject({index:1,char_start:11,char_end:30});

  expect(hasTextLayer).toBe(false);

  await expect(extractPdf(minimalTwoPagePdf(),{remainingMs:()=>0})).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ExtractTimeout);

  expect(await extractPdf(new Uint8Array([0x25]),open,{loader,assets:pdfjsAssets('/app')})).toEqual({pages:[],hasTextLayer:false});

  await extractPdf(new Uint8Array([0x25]),open,{loader});
  expect(params).toMatchObject(pdfjsAssets());                                                // default: the app's node_modules
  const real=pdfjsAssets();
  expect(existsSync(join(real.cMapUrl,'UniCNS-UCS2-H.bcmap'))).toBe(true);                   // Traditional Chinese CMap ships with pdfjs-dist
  expect(existsSync(join(real.cMapUrl,'UniGB-UCS2-H.bcmap'))).toBe(true);
  expect(existsSync(real.standardFontDataUrl)).toBe(true);
 });
});

describe('layoutFromItems (synthetic items)',()=>{

 it('clusters by |Δy| <= half the item height, sorts by x, inserts one space only past a quarter-em gap',()=>{

 });
 it('folds whitespace, applies NFKC, drops whitespace-only items and fake-bold duplicates',()=>{

 });
 it('splits a multi-word item into word pieces with interpolated x and keeps its spaces',()=>{

  expect(lines[0].text).toBe('Total 1,234');
  expect(lines[0].items.map(i=>[i.text,i.char_start,i.char_end,Math.round(i.x0),Math.round(i.x1)])).toEqual([['Total',0,5,0,50],['1,234',6,11,60,110]]);
 });
});

import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';

 it('accepts figures, bracketed negatives and lone dashes; rejects years-with-text, note refs and bare punctuation',()=>{
  for(const s of ['1,234','(5,678)','-12','–','—','-','0.25','(1,000.5)','2025'])expect(isNumericItem(s)).toBe(true);
  for(const s of [',','()','6(a)','HK$\'000','二零二五年','12%','1.2.3'])expect(isNumericItem(s)).toBe(false);
 });
});

 });

 it('columns: label, note, current year, prior year; sub-heading and dash rows are rows of the table',()=>{

 });

  const pages=extractHtml(enc('<p>one</p><div style="page-break-before: always">two</div><div style="break-after:page"></div><p>three</p><hr/><hr/>'));
  expect(pages.map(p=>p.text)).toEqual(['one','two','three']);
 });
 it('no marker → one page; no text → one empty page',()=>{

  expect(extractHtml(enc('<html><body> </body></html>'))).toEqual([{page_no:1,width:null,height:null,text:'',lines:[],tables:[]}]);

 });

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现**

`src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json.ts
// pages.json and code-point helpers (spec §4.4, §7.2). Every character offset in the pipeline is a
// Unicode code point offset (Array.from), equal to PostgreSQL length/substr on UTF-8 text; nothing
// here uses String.prototype.slice/substring/length for offsets. Item text is normalised once
// (NFKC, whitespace runs folded to one space, trimmed) and offsets are recorded while the page text
// is concatenated, never searched for afterwards. pages.json is serialised with JSON.stringify in
// the object-literal key order below, so parse → serialise reproduces the same bytes and hash.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {LayoutItem,LayoutLine,PageInsert,PageLayout,PagesJson} from '../types';

export const sha256Hex=(bytes:Uint8Array|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
export const cpLength=(s:string)=>Array.from(s).length;
export const cpSlice=(s:string,start:number,end:number)=>Array.from(s).slice(start,end).join('');
/** NFKC, every whitespace run (incl. U+3000 and NBSP) folded to one ASCII space, trimmed. */
export const normalizeText=(s:string)=>s.normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();

/** One positioned piece of a line; text is already normalised and non-empty. */
export interface LinePiece{text:string;x0:number;x1:number;y:number;h:number;spaceBefore:boolean}

/**
 * Concatenates rows into the page text ('\n' between rows, one ' ' before a piece whose spaceBefore
 * is set, except the first piece of a row) and records every offset while doing so.
 */
export function assemblePage(rows:{y:number;pieces:LinePiece[]}[]):{text:string;lines:LayoutLine[]}{
 const parts:string[]=[];const lines:LayoutLine[]=[];let pos=0;
 for(const row of rows){
  if(row.pieces.length===0)continue;
  if(lines.length>0){parts.push('\n');pos+=1;}
  const lineStart=pos;const items:LayoutItem[]=[];const lineParts:string[]=[];
  row.pieces.forEach((p,i)=>{
   if(i>0&&p.spaceBefore){parts.push(' ');lineParts.push(' ');pos+=1;}
   const start=pos;parts.push(p.text);lineParts.push(p.text);pos+=cpLength(p.text);
   items.push({text:p.text,x0:p.x0,x1:p.x1,y:p.y,h:p.h,char_start:start,char_end:pos});
  });
  lines.push({index:lines.length,y:row.y,x0:Math.min(...items.map(i=>i.x0)),x1:Math.max(...items.map(i=>i.x1)),text:lineParts.join(''),char_start:lineStart,char_end:pos,items});
 }
 return {text:parts.join(''),lines};
}

export const serializePagesJson=(json:PagesJson)=>JSON.stringify(json);

export function buildPagesJson(input:{content_sha256:string;code_version:string;has_text_layer:boolean;pages:PageLayout[]}):{json:PagesJson;bytes:Uint8Array;sha256:string}{
 const json:PagesJson={extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:input.code_version,content_sha256:input.content_sha256,has_text_layer:input.has_text_layer,
  pages:input.pages.map(p=>({page_no:p.page_no,width:p.width,height:p.height,text:p.text,lines:p.lines,tables:p.tables}))};
 const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(serializePagesJson(json));
 return {json,bytes,sha256:sha256Hex(bytes)};
}

/** document_pages rows of one extraction: char_count in code points, text_hash = sha256(utf8(text)). */
export function pageInsertsOf(json:PagesJson):PageInsert[]{
 return json.pages.map(p=>({page_no:p.page_no,text:p.text,text_hash:sha256Hex(p.text),char_count:cpLength(p.text),width:p.width,height:p.height,line_count:p.lines.length,has_tables:p.tables.length>0}));
}

/** File written by scripts/documents/record-fixture.ts (spec §11.3): header fields plus the pages.json it produced.
 * pages_subset: only the pages chosen with --pages are stored (an 84-page report's full pages.json is ~4.9 MB);
 * page_count and content_sha256 still describe the whole PDF, the stored pages keep their page_no. */
export interface RecordedPagesFixture{recorded_at:string;source_url:string;source_ref:string;content_sha256:string;bytes:number;page_count:number;extractor_version:string;table_algo_version:string;pages_subset?:true;pages_json:PagesJson}
const HEX64=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
/** A subset's page numbers are strictly ascending inside 1..page_count. */
const subsetOk=(f:RecordedPagesFixture)=>f.pages_json.pages.every((p,i,a)=>Number.isInteger(p.page_no)&&p.page_no>=1&&p.page_no<=f.page_count&&(i===0||p.page_no>a[i-1].page_no));
export function parseRecordedFixture(text:string):{fixture:RecordedPagesFixture;pagesJsonBytes:Uint8Array;pagesJsonSha256:string}{
 const f=JSON.parse(text) as RecordedPagesFixture;
 if(!f||typeof f!=='object'||!HEX64.test(String(f.content_sha256))||!f.pages_json||!Array.isArray(f.pages_json.pages))throw new Error('invalid_fixture');
 if(f.pages_json.content_sha256!==f.content_sha256||(f.pages_subset===true?!subsetOk(f):f.pages_json.pages.length!==f.page_count))throw new Error('invalid_fixture');
 const pagesJsonBytes=new TextEncoder().encode(serializePagesJson(f.pages_json));
 return {fixture:f,pagesJsonBytes,pagesJsonSha256:sha256Hex(pagesJsonBytes)};
}
```

`src/lib/documents/extract/tables.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/tables.ts
// Table detection on one page's lines (spec §7.2, TABLE_ALGO_VERSION 'tables/1.0').
// - Numeric item: /^\(?[-–—]?[\d,]+(\.\d+)?\)?$/ containing a digit, or a lone dash.
// - Numeric tail of a line: the longest suffix of numeric items whose first item stands at least
//   TAIL_GAP_EM × height to the right of the item before it (shrunk from the left until it does).
//   Only tail items are cells; numbers and dashes inside a label ("Balance at 1 January 2026",
//   "Other income and gains – net", "– Basic") stay label text (checked on a recorded 0268.HK
//   interim report: without this rule label dashes became spurious columns).
// - Year row: every tail item is a bare 19xx/20xx year (an English header such as "2025 2024");
//   it is header text, never body.
// - Body line: not a year row and >= 2 tail items. A table is a run of body lines in which every
//   body line has a numeric item whose x-interval overlaps one of the previous body line's; up to
//   MAX_GAP_LINES non-body lines (sub-headings such as 以下人士應佔 / Attributable to, one-value rows)
//   between two aligned body lines are rows of the table; a year row ends the run. A run needs
//   MIN_BODY_ROWS body lines.
// - Header block: every line between the previous table's last row (or the page top) and the first
//   row, kept verbatim with offsets (titles, Chinese-numeral year rows, currency and multiplier words,
//   附註/Notes). Spec §7.2 says "up to the previous blank line"; the text layer has no blank lines,
//   so the block runs to the previous table or the page top (Part C note).
// - Columns: numeric items of body lines clustered by x-interval (overlap, or |Δx0| or |Δx1| within
//   half the narrower item: left- and right-aligned figures both cluster); col 0 is the label cell =
//   every item before the numeric tail; numeric columns are 1..k by x.
// Cell offsets are page offsets taken from the items; text = the code-point slice of the line text.
import type {LayoutCell,LayoutItem,LayoutLine,LayoutTable} from '../types';
import {cpSlice} from './pages-json';

export const MIN_BODY_ROWS=2;
export const MAX_GAP_LINES=3;
export const TAIL_GAP_EM=1;
const NUMERIC=/^\(?[-–—]?[\d,]+(\.\d+)?\)?$/;
const DASH=/^[-–—]$/;
const YEAR=/^(19|20)\d{2}$/;

export const isNumericItem=(s:string)=>(NUMERIC.test(s)&&/\d/.test(s))||DASH.test(s);
/** Items of the numeric tail (see header). */
function numericItems(l:LayoutLine):LayoutItem[]{
 const its=l.items;let k=its.length;
 while(k>0&&isNumericItem(its[k-1].text))k--;
 while(k>0&&k<its.length&&its[k].x0-its[k-1].x1<TAIL_GAP_EM*Math.max(its[k].h,its[k-1].h))k++;
 return its.slice(k);
}
const isYearRow=(l:LayoutLine)=>{const n=numericItems(l);return n.length>0&&n.every(i=>YEAR.test(i.text));};
const isBodyLine=(l:LayoutLine)=>!isYearRow(l)&&numericItems(l).length>=2;

interface Span{x0:number;x1:number}
function sameColumn(a:Span,b:Span):boolean{
 if(a.x0<=b.x1&&b.x0<=a.x1)return true;
 const tol=Math.min(a.x1-a.x0,b.x1-b.x0)/2;
 return Math.abs(a.x0-b.x0)<=tol||Math.abs(a.x1-b.x1)<=tol;
}
const aligned=(a:LayoutLine,b:LayoutLine)=>numericItems(a).some(x=>numericItems(b).some(y=>sameColumn(x,y)));

function clusterColumns(items:LayoutItem[]):Span[]{
 const cols:Span[]=[];
 for(const it of [...items].sort((a,b)=>a.x0-b.x0)){
  const c=cols.find(c=>sameColumn(c,it));
  if(c){c.x0=Math.min(c.x0,it.x0);c.x1=Math.max(c.x1,it.x1);}else cols.push({x0:it.x0,x1:it.x1});
 }
 cols.sort((a,b)=>a.x0-b.x0);
 const merged:Span[]=[];
 for(const c of cols){const last=merged.at(-1);if(last&&c.x0<=last.x1)last.x1=Math.max(last.x1,c.x1);else merged.push({...c});}
 return merged;
}
function columnOf(cols:Span[],it:LayoutItem):number{
 const hit=cols.findIndex(c=>it.x0<=c.x1&&c.x0<=it.x1);
 if(hit>=0)return hit;
 const mid=(it.x0+it.x1)/2;let best=0;
 cols.forEach((c,i)=>{if(Math.abs((c.x0+c.x1)/2-mid)<Math.abs((cols[best].x0+cols[best].x1)/2-mid))best=i;});
 return best;
}
function cellOf(line:LayoutLine,items:LayoutItem[],row:number,col:number,numeric:boolean):LayoutCell{
 const start=Math.min(...items.map(i=>i.char_start)),end=Math.max(...items.map(i=>i.char_end));
 return {row,col,text:cpSlice(line.text,start-line.char_start,end-line.char_start),
  bbox:{x0:Math.min(...items.map(i=>i.x0)),y0:Math.min(...items.map(i=>i.y)),x1:Math.max(...items.map(i=>i.x1)),y1:Math.max(...items.map(i=>i.y+i.h))},
  line_index:line.index,char_start:start,char_end:end,numeric};
}

function buildTable(lines:LayoutLine[],header:LayoutLine[],body:LayoutLine[]):LayoutTable{
 const cols=clusterColumns(body.flatMap(numericItems));
 const cells:LayoutCell[]=[];let labelX0=Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 lines.forEach((line,row)=>{
  const tail=numericItems(line);
  const label=line.items.slice(0,line.items.length-tail.length);
  if(label.length>0){cells.push(cellOf(line,label,row,0,false));labelX0=Math.min(labelX0,label[0].x0);}
  const byCol=new Map<number,LayoutItem[]>();
  for(const it of tail){const c=columnOf(cols,it);byCol.set(c,[...(byCol.get(c)??[]),it]);}
  for(const [c,its] of [...byCol.entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]))cells.push(cellOf(line,its,row,c+1,true));
 });
 if(!Number.isFinite(labelX0))labelX0=Math.min(...lines.map(l=>l.x0));
 return {header_lines:header,cells,row_count:lines.length,col_count:cols.length+1,col_x0:[labelX0,...cols.map(c=>c.x0)]};
}

export function detectTables(lines:LayoutLine[]):LayoutTable[]{
 const tables:LayoutTable[]=[];let prevEnd=-1;let i=0;
 while(i<lines.length){
  if(!isBodyLine(lines[i])){i++;continue;}
  let last=i,bodyCount=1,j=i+1,gaps=0;
  while(j<lines.length){
   const l=lines[j];
   if(isBodyLine(l)){
    if(!aligned(l,lines[last]))break;
    last=j;bodyCount++;gaps=0;j++;continue;
   }
   if(isYearRow(l)||gaps>=MAX_GAP_LINES)break;
   gaps++;j++;
  }
  if(bodyCount<MIN_BODY_ROWS){i++;continue;}
  const rows=lines.slice(i,last+1);
  tables.push(buildTable(rows,lines.slice(prevEnd+1,i),rows.filter(isBodyLine)));
  prevEnd=last;i=last+1;
 }
 return tables;
}
```

`src/lib/documents/extract/pdf.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/pdf.ts
// PDF text layer → PageLayout[] (spec §7.1–7.2, EXTRACTOR_VERSION 'docs-extract/1.0').
// pdfjs-dist legacy build, in-process: importing pdf.worker.mjs first sets globalThis.pdfjsWorker,
// which pdf.js uses as its "fake worker" (no worker thread, no workerSrc, no canvas). Per page:
// getTextContent() items → normalised (NFKC, whitespace folded, trimmed; whitespace-only items
// dropped) → an item holding several words is split at its spaces into word pieces whose x range is
// interpolated by code-point position → pieces clustered into lines (same line: |Δy| <= 0.5 × the
// item height; pieces sorted by y descending, then x) → within a line sorted by x, one space where
// the gap to the previous piece exceeds SPACE_EM × height (a "space width"), an identical piece
// drawn again within half a height (fake bold) dropped → lines joined with '\n' in descending y.
// Offsets are code points recorded during concatenation (assemblePage). Coordinates are PDF user
// space (pt, origin bottom-left, page.view), as pdf.js reports them, rounded to 0.01 pt. hasTextLayer = some page has
// text; an all-empty document is 'no_text_layer' upstream. The budget is checked before each page
// (ExtractTimeout → 'extract_timeout').
// CMaps: HKEX / cninfo reports use CID-keyed CJK fonts whose text pdf.js can only map to Unicode with
// the packed CMaps; without cMapUrl a real 0268.HK interim report extracted 0 Chinese characters
// (pdftotext had them). getDocument therefore always gets cMapUrl + cMapPacked + standardFontDataUrl:
// directories inside node_modules/pdfjs-dist (pdfjsAssets; on Vercel next.config.mjs ships them with
// outputFileTracingIncludes, Task 10). The pdf.js loader and the asset locations are injectable
// (tests assert the options without parsing a CID font).
import {join,sep} from 'node:path';
import type {LayoutLine,PageLayout} from '../types';
import {assemblePage,cpLength,normalizeText} from './pages-json';
import type {LinePiece} from './pages-json';
import {detectTables} from './tables';

export interface ExtractBudget{remainingMs():number}
export class ExtractTimeout extends Error{constructor(){super('extract_timeout');this.name='ExtractTimeout';}}
/** One text item as pdf.js reports it: string, origin (transform[4], transform[5]), advance width, height. */
export interface RawItem{str:string;x:number;y:number;w:number;h:number}
export const SPACE_EM=0.25;
/** Coordinates are kept to 0.01 pt: enough for clustering, and pages.json stays compact and stable. */
const r2=(v:number)=>Math.round(v*100)/100;

type PdfJs=typeof import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
let pdfjsPromise:Promise<PdfJs>|null=null;
function loadPdfJs():Promise<PdfJs>{
 pdfjsPromise??=(async()=>{
  await import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs');
  return import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs');
 })();
 return pdfjsPromise;
}
export interface PdfJsAssets{cMapUrl:string;cMapPacked:true;standardFontDataUrl:string}
/** CMap and standard-font directories of pdfjs-dist under `root` (default: the process cwd, which is the app root locally and on Vercel); trailing separator as pdf.js expects. */
export function pdfjsAssets(root:string=process.cwd()):PdfJsAssets{
 const base=join(root,'node_modules','pdfjs-dist');
 return {cMapUrl:join(base,'cmaps')+sep,cMapPacked:true,standardFontDataUrl:join(base,'standard_fonts')+sep};
}
export interface ExtractPdfOptions{loader?:()=>Promise<Pick<PdfJs,'getDocument'>>;assets?:PdfJsAssets}

/** Splits a normalised item into word pieces; x0/x1 interpolated by code-point position within the item. */
function piecesOf(it:RawItem):LinePiece[]{
 const text=normalizeText(it.str);
 if(text==='')return [];
 const total=cpLength(text);const words=text.split(' ');const out:LinePiece[]=[];let at=0;
 for(const [k,w] of words.entries()){
  const n=cpLength(w);
  out.push({text:w,x0:r2(it.x+it.w*at/total),x1:r2(it.x+it.w*(at+n)/total),y:r2(it.y),h:r2(it.h),spaceBefore:k>0});
  at+=n+1;
 }
 return out;
}

/** Pure layout step (unit-tested without pdf.js): raw items of one page → page text and lines. */
export function layoutFromItems(raw:RawItem[]):{text:string;lines:LayoutLine[]}{
 const pieces=raw.flatMap(piecesOf).sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y||a.x0-b.x0);
 const rows:{y:number;h:number;pieces:LinePiece[]}[]=[];
 for(const p of pieces){
  const row=rows.at(-1);
  if(row&&Math.abs(p.y-row.y)<=0.5*(p.h>0?p.h:row.h))row.pieces.push(p);
  else rows.push({y:p.y,h:p.h,pieces:[p]});
 }
 for(const row of rows){
  const sorted=[...row.pieces].sort((a,b)=>a.x0-b.x0);const kept:LinePiece[]=[];
  for(const p of sorted){
   const prev=kept.at(-1);
   if(prev&&prev.text===p.text&&Math.abs(prev.x0-p.x0)<0.5*Math.max(prev.h,p.h,1))continue;
   if(prev&&!p.spaceBefore)p.spaceBefore=p.x0-prev.x1>SPACE_EM*Math.max(prev.h,p.h);   // words after the first of one item keep their space
   kept.push(p);
  }
  row.pieces=kept;
 }
 return assemblePage(rows);
}

export async function extractPdf(bytes:Uint8Array,budget:ExtractBudget,opts:ExtractPdfOptions={}):Promise<{pages:PageLayout[];hasTextLayer:boolean}>{
 if(budget.remainingMs()<=0)throw new ExtractTimeout();
 const pdfjs=await (opts.loader??loadPdfJs)();
 // pdf.js may transfer (detach) the buffer it is given: hand it a copy. CMaps: see the header.
 const task=pdfjs.getDocument({data:new Uint8Array(bytes),isEvalSupported:false,disableFontFace:true,useSystemFonts:false,verbosity:0,...(opts.assets??pdfjsAssets())});
 try{
  const doc=await task.promise;
  const pages:PageLayout[]=[];
  for(let n=1;n<=doc.numPages;n++){
   if(budget.remainingMs()<=0)throw new ExtractTimeout();
   const page=await doc.getPage(n);
   const content=await page.getTextContent();
   const raw:RawItem[]=[];
   for(const it of content.items){
    if(!('str' in it))continue;   // TextMarkedContent
    const t=it.transform as number[];
    raw.push({str:it.str,x:t[4],y:t[5],w:it.width,h:it.height>0?it.height:Math.hypot(t[2],t[3])});
   }
   const {text,lines}=layoutFromItems(raw);
   const [vx0,vy0,vx1,vy1]=page.view;
   pages.push({page_no:n,width:vx1-vx0,height:vy1-vy0,text,lines,tables:detectTables(lines)});
   page.cleanup();
  }
  return {pages,hasTextLayer:pages.some(p=>p.text!=='')};
 }finally{
  await task.destroy();
 }
}
```

`src/lib/documents/extract/html.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/html.ts
// HTML / iXBRL / XML text → PageLayout[] (spec §7.2). Pages split at page-break markers: an <hr>
// element (split after it), or any element whose style has page-break-before|page-break-after|
// break-before|break-after set to always|page (before → split at the start tag, after → split after
// the start tag; EDGAR writes these markers on empty elements, so the element's content is not
// tracked). No marker → one page. Text rules are collectors/edgar.ts::htmlToText's (script/style
// removed, tags dropped, the same entity table, numeric entities decoded) WITHOUT the 200,000
// truncation, plus line structure: block-level boundaries and <br> become line breaks (htmlToText
// folds everything to one line, so it cannot be reused as is). Each line is normalised like PDF
// items (NFKC, whitespace folded, trimmed); empty lines are dropped; a segment without text is not a
// page (pages are numbered after dropping; an all-empty document is one empty page). Lines carry one
// item spanning the line; HTML has no coordinates: y/x0/x1/h are 0, width/height null, no tables.
import type {PageLayout} from '../types';
import {assemblePage,normalizeText} from './pages-json';

const ENTITIES:Record<string,string>={amp:'&',lt:'<',gt:'>',quot:'"',apos:"'",nbsp:' '};
const BREAK_STYLE=/(?:page-break-before|page-break-after|break-before|break-after)\s*:\s*(?:always|page)/i;
const BLOCK=/<\/?(?:p|div|tr|li|ul|ol|h[1-6]|table|thead|tbody|tfoot|section|article|header|footer|blockquote|pre|dl|dt|dd|center|title)\b[^>]*>|<br\b[^>]*>/gi;

function decodeEntity(m:string,e:string):string{
 if(e[0]!=='#')return ENTITIES[e.toLowerCase()]??m;
 const cp=e[1].toLowerCase()==='x'?parseInt(e.slice(2),16):parseInt(e.slice(1),10);
 return Number.isInteger(cp)&&cp>0&&cp<=0x10ffff&&!(cp>=0xd800&&cp<=0xdfff)?String.fromCodePoint(cp):m;
}

/** Positions (UTF-16 indexes into the raw markup; never used as text offsets) where a new page starts. */
function pageCuts(html:string):number[]{
 const cuts:number[]=[];
 for(const m of html.matchAll(/<([a-z][\w:-]*)\b[^>]*>/gi)){
  const tag=m[0],start=m.index??0,end=start+tag.length;
  if(m[1].toLowerCase()==='hr'){cuts.push(end);continue;}
  const style=/\bstyle\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|'[^']*')/i.exec(tag)?.[1];
  if(!style||!BREAK_STYLE.test(style))continue;
  cuts.push(/(?:page-break-before|break-before)/i.test(style)?start:end);
 }
 return [...new Set(cuts)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
}

function segmentLines(markup:string):string[]{
 const text=markup.replace(BLOCK,'\n').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|[a-z]+);/gi,decodeEntity);
 return text.split('\n').map(normalizeText).filter(l=>l!=='');
}

export function extractHtml(bytes:Uint8Array):PageLayout[]{
 const html=new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes).replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g,' ').replace(/<(script|style)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi,' ');
 const cuts=[0,...pageCuts(html),html.length];
 const segments:string[][]=[];
 for(let k=0;k+1<cuts.length;k++){const lines=segmentLines(html.slice(cuts[k],cuts[k+1]));if(lines.length>0)segments.push(lines);}
 if(segments.length===0)segments.push([]);
 return segments.map((lines,k)=>{
  const {text,lines:layout}=assemblePage(lines.map(l=>({y:0,pieces:[{text:l,x0:0,x1:0,y:0,h:0,spaceBefore:false}]})));
  return {page_no:k+1,width:null,height:null,text,lines:layout,tables:[]};
 });
}
```

`src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/build.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/build.ts
// Deterministic builder of the hand-written PDF fixtures (spec §11.1). Two fonts: /FL = Helvetica
// (WinAnsi, Latin runs) and /FU = a Type0 font with Identity-H encoding and a ToUnicode CMap but NO
// embedded font program — pdf.js's text layer comes from ToUnicode alone, so code 0001 → U+2000B 𠀋
// (supplementary plane), 0002 → U+1F600 😀 (emoji), 0003 → U+FF11 '１' (fullwidth, NFKC → '1').
// scripts/documents/make-fixture-pdf.ts writes minimal-two-pages.pdf and no-text.pdf from here; the
// tests assert the committed bytes equal this builder's output.
export type PdfOp={font:'L';x:number;y:number;text:string}|{font:'U';x:number;y:number;codes:number[]};

const CMAP=['begincmap','1 begincodespacerange','<0000><FFFF>','endcodespacerange','3 beginbfchar','<0001><D840DC0B>','<0002><D83DDE00>','<0003><FF11>','endbfchar','endcmap'].join('\n');

/** Latin text: printable ASCII, balanced parentheses, no backslash (a PDF literal string as is); every op is one BT … ET at size 10. */
export function buildPdf(pages:PdfOp[][]):Uint8Array{
 const objs:string[]=[];
 const add=(s:string)=>{objs.push(s);return objs.length;};
 const catalog=add(''),pagesObj=add('');
 const fl=add('<</Type/Font/Subtype/Type1/BaseFont/Helvetica/Encoding/WinAnsiEncoding>>');
 const tou=add(`<</Length ${CMAP.length}>>\nstream\n${CMAP}\nendstream`);
 const desc=add('<</Type/FontDescriptor/FontName/U/Flags 4/FontBBox[0 0 1000 1000]>>');
 const cid=add(`<</Type/Font/Subtype/CIDFontType2/BaseFont/U/CIDSystemInfo<</Registry(Adobe)/Ordering(Identity)/Supplement 0>>/FontDescriptor ${desc} 0 R/DW 1000/CIDToGIDMap/Identity>>`);
 const fu=add(`<</Type/Font/Subtype/Type0/BaseFont/U/Encoding/Identity-H/DescendantFonts[${cid} 0 R]/ToUnicode ${tou} 0 R>>`);
 const kids:number[]=[];
 for(const ops of pages){
  const body=ops.map(o=>o.font==='L'?`BT/FL 10 Tf ${o.x} ${o.y} Td(${o.text})Tj ET`:`BT/FU 10 Tf ${o.x} ${o.y} Td<${o.codes.map(c=>c.toString(16).padStart(4,'0')).join('')}>Tj ET`).join('\n');
  const content=add(`<</Length ${body.length}>>\nstream\n${body}\nendstream`);
  kids.push(add(`<</Type/Page/Parent ${pagesObj} 0 R/MediaBox[0 0 300 300]/Resources<</Font<</FL ${fl} 0 R/FU ${fu} 0 R>>>>/Contents ${content} 0 R>>`));
 }
 objs[catalog-1]=`<</Type/Catalog/Pages ${pagesObj} 0 R>>`;
 objs[pagesObj-1]=`<</Type/Pages/Kids[${kids.map(k=>`${k} 0 R`).join(' ')}]/Count ${kids.length}>>`;
 let out='%PDF-1.4\n';const offsets:number[]=[];
 objs.forEach((o,i)=>{offsets.push(out.length);out+=`${i+1} 0 obj\n${o}\nendobj\n`;});   // ASCII only: string length = byte offset
 const xref=out.length;
 out+=`xref\n0 ${objs.length+1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n${offsets.map(n=>`${String(n).padStart(10,'0')} 00000 n \n`).join('')}`;
 out+=`trailer\n<</Size ${objs.length+1}/Root ${catalog} 0 R>>\nstartxref\n${xref}\n%%EOF\n`;
 return new TextEncoder().encode(out);
}

/**
 * Page 1: "𠀋😀 Revenue" (two supplementary-plane code points before the cited word), a two-row table
 * "Total 1,234 (5,678)" / "Cost (100) 90", and a fullwidth '１' line. Page 2: "Page two" and
 * "𠀋cash 42" (no gap between the CJK glyph and the Latin run → no space).
 */
export const minimalTwoPagePdf=()=>buildPdf([
 [{font:'U',x:20,y:270,codes:[1,2]},{font:'L',x:44,y:270,text:'Revenue'},
  {font:'L',x:20,y:250,text:'Total'},{font:'L',x:150,y:250,text:'1,234'},{font:'L',x:220,y:250,text:'(5,678)'},
  {font:'L',x:20,y:235,text:'Cost'},{font:'L',x:155,y:235,text:'(100)'},{font:'L',x:235,y:235,text:'90'},
  {font:'U',x:20,y:200,codes:[3]}],
 [{font:'L',x:20,y:270,text:'Page two'},{font:'U',x:20,y:250,codes:[1]},{font:'L',x:30,y:250,text:'cash 42'}],
]);
/** One page with no text operators: the no_text_layer case. */
export const noTextPdf=()=>buildPdf([[]]);
```

/**
 * Writes the hand-built PDF fixtures (spec §11.1) from src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/build.ts:
 *   npx tsx scripts/documents/make-fixture-pdf.ts
 * → src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/minimal-two-pages.pdf, no-text.pdf. Deterministic: re-running
 * produces identical bytes (extract/pdf.test.ts asserts the committed files equal the builder).
 */
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {minimalTwoPagePdf,noTextPdf} from '../../src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/build';

const dir=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../src/lib/documents/fixtures/pdf/',import.meta.url));
for(const [name,bytes] of [['minimal-two-pages.pdf',minimalTwoPagePdf()],['no-text.pdf',noTextPdf()]] as const){
 writeFileSync(dir+name,bytes);
 console.log(`wrote ${dir}${name} (${bytes.length} bytes)`);
}

**Files:** Create: `src/lib/documents/citations.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/run.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/deps.ts`、`src/lib/documents/test-seed.ts`、`src/app/api/cron/documents-extract/route.ts`、`scripts/documents/extract.ts`、`scripts/documents/record-fixture.ts` / Modify: `next.config.mjs`（`// F3` 块：pdf.js CMaps 与标准字体随路由打包） / Test: `src/lib/documents/citations.test.ts`、`src/lib/documents/extract/run.test.ts`、`src/app/api/cron/documents-extract/route.test.ts`
**Spec:** §4.5、§7.3（第一条）、§7.4、§6.3、§10、§11.1、§11.3
**Depends on:** Task 9；Task 2（`memoryDocumentsDb`、`db.ts` 游标）、Task 3、Task 4（`ObjectStore`、`pagesJsonPath`、`blobPath`）

要点：`claimExtractLease` 返回 false → 本文档不做任何写入（claim 可能刚把它终态化为 `extract_failed`）；`pages.json` 上传失败 → 不调 `failExtract` 也不调 `finishExtract`，租约到期后重试（次数已在 claim 计）；字节哈希与 `content_sha256` 不符 → `failExtract('content_hash_mismatch')`；`application/xml|text/xml|application/xhtml+xml` 走 HTML 抽取，`application/json` → `failExtract('unsupported_mime')`（三次后 `extract_failed`）。cron 路由的门：secret → 鉴权 → 参数 → `DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED==='1'`（否则 403 `extract_disabled`）→ `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`（否则 503）。
