`src/lib/documents/test-seed.ts`（测试专用助手，后续 Task 11/12 与 D-Part 复用；`rlsView` 模拟 anon 经 RLS 能看到的读结果，`readDocuments` 先过滤再分页）：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/test-seed.ts
// Test-only seeding helpers for Part C's unit and route tests (not imported by production code).
// Everything goes through the DocumentsDb contract of memoryDocumentsDb (Task 2), so the memory
// implementation's leases and status rules apply: public documents via reconcileScope →
// claimSyncLease → insertDocumentVersion; uploads via insertUploadDocument; extractions via
// claimExtractLease → finishExtract. rlsView() imitates what an anon client sees (spec §4.12)
// for the read methods the routes use; withOverride() replaces single methods (bound to the target,
// so class-based implementations keep their private state).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from './types';
import type {CitationRow,DocumentInsert,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ExtractionRow,PageLayout} from './types';
import {assemblePage,buildPagesJson,pageInsertsOf,sha256Hex} from './extract/pages-json';
import {blobPath,pagesJsonPath} from './object-store';
import {decodeCursor,encodeCursor} from './db';
import type {ObjectStore} from './types';

export const ISSUER='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
export const OWNER_A='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';
export const OWNER_B='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';
export const SEED_BATCH='99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999';

/** A public HKEX zh annual report insert; bytes default to a tiny PDF-looking body whose sha256 is real. */
export function docInsertFor(bytes:Uint8Array,o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={}):DocumentInsert{
 const sha=sha256Hex(bytes);const mime=o.mime??'application/pdf';
 return {issuer_id:ISSUER,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_ref:'2026090300863_c',form_type:'年報',doc_class:'annual_report',classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,
  title:'2025 年報',language:'zh',source_url:'https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0903/2026090300863_c.pdf',content_sha256:sha,bytes:bytes.length,mime,
  storage_path:blobPath(sha,mime),acquisition:{fetched_at:'2026-09-03T10:00:00.000Z',http_status:200},published_at:'2026-09-03T08:30:00.000Z',published_at_precision:'instant',
  available_at:'2026-09-03T08:30:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-09-03',fiscal_year:2025,fiscal_period:'FY',period_end:'2025-12-31',filing_source_ref:null,
  permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,batch_id:SEED_BATCH,code_version:'c'.repeat(40),...o};
}

/** Inserts a public listed document (scope row + sync lease are created on the way and the lease released); stores the bytes when a store is given. */
export async function seedPublicDocument(db:DocumentsDb,bytes:Uint8Array,o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={},store?:ObjectStore):Promise<string>{
 const doc=docInsertFor(bytes,o);const source=doc.source==='upload'?'hkexnews':doc.source;
 await db.reconcileScope(source,[{issuer_id:doc.issuer_id!,reasons:['test'],priority:1,fetch_key:'00268'}]);
 const batch=randomUUID();
 if(!await db.claimSyncLease(doc.issuer_id!,source,batch,600))throw new Error('seed_lease');
 const r=await db.insertDocumentVersion(doc.issuer_id!,source,batch,doc,[]);
 await db.releaseSyncLease(doc.issuer_id!,source,batch,'success',new Date().toISOString());   // the next seed of the same issuer claims again
 if(store)await store.put(doc.storage_path,bytes,doc.mime);
 return r.document_id;
}

/** Inserts an owner's licensed/private upload directly (ingestUpload is tested separately). */
export async function seedUpload(db:DocumentsDb,owner:string,bytes:Uint8Array,o:Partial<DocumentInsert>={},store?:ObjectStore):Promise<string>{
 const doc=docInsertFor(bytes,{issuer_id:null,source:'upload',market:'other',source_ref:`${owner}/${sha256Hex(bytes)}`,form_type:null,doc_class:'other',title:'broker note.pdf',language:null,source_url:null,
  acquisition:{uploaded_at:'2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z',filename:'broker note.pdf'},fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:null,permission:'licensed',owner_user_id:owner,license_ref:'lic-1',...o});
 const r=await db.insertUploadDocument(owner,doc);
 if(store)await store.put(doc.storage_path,bytes,doc.mime);
 return r.document_id;
}

/** One extraction whose page n has text pageTexts[n-1] (one line per text line) — or exactly `layouts` when given; returns its id. Writes pages.json to the store when given. */
export async function seedExtraction(db:DocumentsDb,documentId:string,pageTexts:string[],o:{extractorVersion?:string;store?:ObjectStore;layouts?:PageLayout[]}={}):Promise<string>{
 const doc=(await db.documentById(documentId))!;const batch=randomUUID();
 if(!await db.claimExtractLease(documentId,batch,600))throw new Error('seed_extract_lease');
 const pages=o.layouts??pageTexts.map((t,k)=>{const {text,lines}=assemblePage(t.split('\n').filter(l=>l!=='').map((l,i)=>({y:700-i*12,pieces:[{text:l,x0:50,x1:50+10*Array.from(l).length,y:700-i*12,h:10,spaceBefore:false}]})));return {page_no:k+1,width:595,height:842,text,lines,tables:[]};});
 const built=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:doc.content_sha256,code_version:'c'.repeat(40),has_text_layer:pages.some(p=>p.text!==''),pages});
 const path=pagesJsonPath(doc.content_sha256,built.sha256);
 if(o.store)await o.store.put(path,built.bytes,'application/json');
 return db.finishExtract(documentId,batch,{extractor_version:o.extractorVersion??EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:'c'.repeat(40),has_text_layer:built.json.has_text_layer,page_count:pages.length,pages_json_path:path,pages_json_sha256:built.sha256},pageInsertsOf(built.json));
}

/** Replaces some methods of a DocumentsDb; every other method is the target's, bound to it. */
export function withOverride<T extends object>(target:T,over:Partial<T>):T{
 return new Proxy(target,{get(t,k){if(k in over)return (over as Record<string|symbol,unknown>)[k];const v=Reflect.get(t,k,t);return typeof v==='function'?v.bind(t):v;}});
}

/**
 * What the anon role sees through RLS (spec §4.12), for the reads the routes use: public documents
 * only; their extractions/pages/assets; citations of public documents with visibility 'public'
 * (the fact_citations clause is not imitated). read_documents is security invoker: public rows only,
 * filtered before pagination (offset cursor built with db.ts::encodeCursor).
 */
export function rlsView(db:DocumentsDb):DocumentsDb{
 const pub=async(id:string)=>(await db.documentById(id))?.permission==='public';
 const pubEx=async(e:ExtractionRow|null)=>!!e&&await pub(e.document_id);
 const visibleCitation=async(c:CitationRow|null)=>!!c&&c.visibility==='public'&&await pub(c.document_id);
 return withOverride(db,{
  documentById:async(id:string):Promise<DocumentRow|null>=>{const d=await db.documentById(id);return d&&d.permission==='public'?d:null;},
  assetsOf:async(id:string)=>await pub(id)?db.assetsOf(id):[],
  extractionsOf:async(id:string,p)=>await pub(id)?db.extractionsOf(id,p):{rows:[],nextCursor:null},
  extractionById:async(id:string)=>{const e=await db.extractionById(id);return await pubEx(e)?e:null;},
  pagesOf:async(eid:string,nos:number[])=>await pubEx(await db.extractionById(eid))?db.pagesOf(eid,nos):[],
  citationById:async(id:string)=>{const c=await db.citationById(id);return await visibleCitation(c)?c:null;},
  documentVersions:async(source,ref,p)=>{const r=await db.documentVersions(source,ref,p);return {rows:r.rows.filter(d=>d.permission==='public'),nextCursor:r.nextCursor};},
  // RLS filters BEFORE pagination: read everything through the target, keep public rows, page with an offset cursor
  readDocuments:async(issuer,o)=>{
   const all:DocumentRow[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
   do{const r=await db.readDocuments(issuer,{...o,cursor,limit:1000});all.push(...r.rows);cursor=r.nextCursor;}while(cursor);
   const pub=all.filter(d=>d.permission==='public');const off=o.cursor?Number(decodeCursor(o.cursor)[1]):0;
   return {rows:pub.slice(off,off+o.limit),nextCursor:off+o.limit<pub.length?encodeCursor(['rls',off+o.limit]):null};
  },
 } as Partial<DocumentsDb>);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/citations.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {cite,citationView,integrityOf,verify} from './citations';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from './memory-documents-db';
import {seedExtraction,seedPublicDocument,seedUpload,withOverride,OWNER_A} from './test-seed';
import {DocumentsDbError} from './types';
import type {DocumentsDb} from './types';

const PAGE1='𠀋😀 Revenue 1,234\nCost (100)';
const bytes=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
async function setup(){
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();
 const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,bytes('%PDF-a'));
 const ext=await seedExtraction(db,doc,[PAGE1,'第二頁'],{extractorVersion:'docs-extract/0.9'});
 return {db,doc,ext};
}
const base=(doc:string,ext:string)=>({document_id:doc,extraction_id:ext,page_no:1,created_by:'extractor' as const,created_ref:'hk-facts/1/hk-facts/1.0'});
const code=async(p:Promise<unknown>)=>{try{await p;return null;}catch(e){return e instanceof DocumentsDbError?e.code:String(e);}};

describe('cite',()=>{
 it('slices code points: 3..10 is "Revenue" although the UTF-16 index of R is 5',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const id=await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10});
  const c=(await db.citationById(id))!;
  expect(c).toMatchObject({snippet:'Revenue',char_start:3,char_end:10,page_no:1,visibility:'internal',bbox:null});
  expect(PAGE1.indexOf('Revenue')).toBe(5);
  const [page]=await db.pagesOf(ext,[1]);
  expect(c.text_hash).toBe(page.text_hash);
  expect((await db.citationById(await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:0,char_end:2})))!.snippet).toBe('𠀋😀');
 });
 it('rejects out-of-range, empty or whitespace-only spans, a missing page and a foreign extraction',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const len=Array.from(PAGE1).length;
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:0,char_end:len+1}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:5,char_end:5}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:-1,char_end:2}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:2,char_end:3}))).toBe('invalid_citation');   // ' '
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),page_no:9,char_start:0,char_end:1}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
  const other=await seedPublicDocument(db,bytes('%PDF-b'),{source_ref:'2026090300864_c'});
  expect(await code(cite(db,{...base(other,ext),char_start:0,char_end:1}))).toBe('invalid_citation');
  expect(await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:0,char_end:len})).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
 });
});

describe('verify / citationView',()=>{
 it('ok and current; after a re-extraction the old citation stays ok but is no longer current',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const id=await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10,bbox:{x0:1,y0:2,x1:3,y1:4}});
  expect(await verify(db,id)).toEqual({integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true});
  await db.requestExtract(doc,OWNER_A);
  const ext2=await seedExtraction(db,doc,[PAGE1]);
  expect(ext2).not.toBe(ext);
  expect(await verify(db,id)).toEqual({integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:false});
  const view=(await citationView(db,(await db.citationById(id))!))!;
  expect(view).toMatchObject({citationId:id,documentId:doc,extractionId:ext,pageNo:1,charStart:3,charEnd:10,bbox:{x0:1,y0:2,x1:3,y1:4},snippet:'Revenue',integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:false,createdBy:'extractor',
   document:{title:'2025 年報',sourceUrl:expect.stringContaining('hkexnews'),publishedAt:'2026-09-03T08:30:00.000Z',availableAt:'2026-09-03T08:30:00.000Z',docClass:'annual_report',language:'zh'}});
  expect(await verify(db,'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000')).toBeNull();
 });
 it('corrupt when the stored page text no longer hashes to the recorded text_hash or no longer slices to the snippet',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const id=await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10});
  const tampered=withOverride<DocumentsDb>(db,{pagesOf:async(e,n)=>(await db.pagesOf(e,n)).map(p=>({...p,text:p.text.replace('Revenue','Revenux')}))});
  expect(await verify(tampered,id)).toEqual({integrity:'corrupt',currentExtraction:true});
  const c=(await db.citationById(id))!;
  expect(integrityOf(undefined,c)).toBe('corrupt');
 });
 it('citationView is null when the document is not visible through the given db',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const c=(await db.citationById(await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10})))!;
  expect(await citationView(withOverride<DocumentsDb>(db,{documentById:async()=>null}),c)).toBeNull();
 });
});

describe('publish_citations (contract behaviour the read routes rely on)',()=>{
 it('only human/module citations of public documents can be made public',async()=>{
  const {db,doc,ext}=await setup();
  const extractor=await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10});
  const human=await cite(db,{...base(doc,ext),char_start:3,char_end:10,created_by:'human',created_ref:OWNER_A});
  expect(await code(db.publishCitations([extractor]))).toBe('not_publishable');
  expect(await db.publishCitations([human])).toBe(1);
  expect((await db.citationById(human))!.visibility).toBe('public');
  const up=await seedUpload(db,OWNER_A,bytes('%PDF-up'));
  const upExt=await seedExtraction(db,up,['licensed text']);
  const mine=await cite(db,{document_id:up,extraction_id:upExt,page_no:1,char_start:0,char_end:8,created_by:'module',created_ref:'foreign-research'});
  expect(await code(db.publishCitations([mine]))).toBe('not_publishable');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/run.test.ts
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../../db/memory-table-client';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from '../memory-documents-db';
import {memoryObjectStore} from '../object-store';
import {seedPublicDocument,withOverride} from '../test-seed';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {ObjectStore,PageLayout} from '../types';
import {runDocumentsExtract,MIN_DOC_MS} from './run';
import type {ExtractDeps} from './run';
import {assemblePage,parseRecordedFixture,pageInsertsOf,sha256Hex} from './pages-json';
import {extractHtml} from './html';
import {ExtractTimeout} from './pdf';

const CODE='c'.repeat(40);
const enc=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const layoutPage=(no:number,text:string):PageLayout=>{const a=assemblePage(text?[{y:700,pieces:[{text,x0:0,x1:10,y:700,h:10,spaceBefore:false}]}]:[]);return {page_no:no,width:595,height:842,text:a.text,lines:a.lines,tables:[]};};

function harness(over:Partial<ExtractDeps>={}){
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();const store=memoryObjectStore();
 const tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_freshness:['dataset']});
 const calls:string[]=[];
 const deps:ExtractDeps={db,tables,store,now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE,
  extractPdf:async(bytes)=>{calls.push(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));return {pages:[layoutPage(1,'𠀋😀 綜合損益表'),layoutPage(2,'')],hasTextLayer:true};},
  extractHtml,...over};
 return {db,store,tables,deps,calls};
}
const run=(deps:ExtractDeps,o:Partial<Parameters<typeof runDocumentsExtract>[1]>={})=>runDocumentsExtract(deps,{limit:10,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script',...o});

describe('runDocumentsExtract',()=>{
 it('extracts a stored PDF: pages.json stored under its content hash, version + pages written, batch success, freshness ok',async()=>{
  const {db,store,tables,deps}=harness();
  const pdf=enc('%PDF-one');
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,pdf,{},store);
  const r=await run(deps);
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'success',idle:false,counts:{fetched:1,inserted:1,failed:0}});
  expect(r.documents).toEqual([{documentId:doc,outcome:'extracted',pageCount:2,extractionId:expect.any(String)}]);
  const d=(await db.documentById(doc))!;
  expect(d).toMatchObject({status:'extracted',current_extraction_id:r.documents[0].extractionId,extract_lease_until:null,extract_attempts:1});
  const e=(await db.extractionById(d.current_extraction_id!))!;
  expect(e).toMatchObject({extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:CODE,has_text_layer:true,page_count:2,candidates_role:'primary',candidates_status:'pending'});
  const blob=store.objects().get(e.pages_json_path)!.bytes;
  expect(e.pages_json_path).toBe(`extractions/${sha256Hex(pdf)}/${e.pages_json_sha256}.pages.json`);
  expect(sha256Hex(blob)).toBe(e.pages_json_sha256);
  const json=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(blob));
  expect(json).toMatchObject({extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,content_sha256:sha256Hex(pdf),code_version:CODE,has_text_layer:true});
  expect(await db.pagesOf(e.extraction_id,[1,2])).toEqual(pageInsertsOf(json).map(p=>({...p,extraction_id:e.extraction_id})));
  expect((await db.pagesOf(e.extraction_id,[1]))[0].char_count).toBe(8);   // code points: 𠀋😀 + space + 5 hanzi (UTF-16 length 10)
  const [batch]=(tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).rows('ingest_batches');
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({producer:'documents-extract',dataset:'documents.extract',status:'success',code_version:CODE,tool_versions:{extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION}});
  expect((tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).rows('dq_freshness')[0]).toMatchObject({dataset:'documents.extract',consecutive_errors:0});
 });
 it('HTML goes through extractHtml (no pdf.js); a document without text is no_text_layer and an info skip',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps,calls}=harness({extractPdf:async()=>({pages:[layoutPage(1,'')],hasTextLayer:false})});
  const html=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('<p>one</p><hr/><p>two</p>'),{source:'edgar',market:'US',source_ref:'0001-26-1/x.htm',mime:'text/html',language:'en'},store);
  const scan=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-scan'),{source_ref:'2026090300865_c'},store);
  const r=await run(deps);
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:2,inserted:2});
  expect((await db.documentById(html))!.status).toBe('extracted');
  expect((await db.extractionById((await db.documentById(html))!.current_extraction_id!))!).toMatchObject({page_count:2,candidates_role:'none',candidates_status:'n/a'});
  expect((await db.documentById(scan))!.status).toBe('no_text_layer');
  expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'skipped_summary',key:scan,message:'no_text_layer'});
 });
 it('extractor errors call failExtract; the third claim turns the document extract_failed and it is never picked again',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness({extractPdf:async()=>{throw new Error('bad xref');}});
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-bad'),{},store);
  for(let k=1;k<=3;k++){
   const r=await run(deps);
   expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'failed',counts:{fetched:1,failed:1}});
   expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'extract_error',key:doc,message:'bad xref'});
  }
  expect((await db.documentById(doc))!).toMatchObject({status:'extract_failed',extract_attempts:3});
  const idle=await run(deps);
  expect(idle).toMatchObject({idle:true,status:'success',documents:[]});
 });
 it('P2-7: an extraction that outlives its lease while another batch takes over gets lease_lost and writes nothing',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(h.db,enc('%PDF-long'),{},h.store);
  const OTHER=randomUUID();
  const r=await run({...h.deps,extractPdf:async()=>{
   h.db.expireExtractLease(doc);                                               // the 600 s lease ran out during a long extraction …
   expect(await h.db.claimExtractLease(doc,OTHER,600)).toBe(true);           // … and another batch claimed the document
   return {pages:[layoutPage(1,'綜合損益表')],hasTextLayer:true};
  }});
  expect(r.documents).toEqual([{documentId:doc,outcome:'failed',code:'lease_lost'}]);
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,failed:1,inserted:0});
  expect([...h.store.objects().keys()].some(k=>k.startsWith('extractions/'))).toBe(false);   // no pages.json
  expect(await h.db.documentById(doc)).toMatchObject({status:'stored',current_extraction_id:null,extract_lease_batch_id:OTHER});
  expect(h.db.extractions()).toEqual([]);
  // the holder renews: an extraction that outlives an untaken lease still finishes
  const g=harness();
  const d2=await seedPublicDocument(g.db,enc('%PDF-slow-but-alone'),{},g.store);
  const r2=await run({...g.deps,extractPdf:async()=>{g.db.expireExtractLease(d2);return {pages:[layoutPage(1,'x')],hasTextLayer:true};}});
  expect(r2.documents[0]).toMatchObject({documentId:d2,outcome:'extracted'});
 });
 it('extract_timeout, content hash mismatch, missing object and unsupported MIME are coded failures',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness({extractPdf:async()=>{throw new ExtractTimeout();}});
  const slow=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-slow'),{},store);
  const swapped=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-real'),{source_ref:'2026090300866_c'});
  await store.put((await db.documentById(swapped))!.storage_path,enc('%PDF-other'),'application/pdf');
  const missing=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-missing'),{source_ref:'2026090300867_c'});
  const json=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('{}'),{source_ref:'2026090300868_c',mime:'application/json'},store);
  const r=await run(deps);
  const byDoc=Object.fromEntries(r.documents.map(d=>[d.documentId,d.code]));
  expect(byDoc).toEqual({[slow]:'extract_timeout',[swapped]:'content_hash_mismatch',[missing]:'object_get_failed',[json]:'unsupported_mime'});
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:4,failed:4,inserted:0});
  for(const id of [slow,swapped,missing,json])expect((await db.documentById(id))!).toMatchObject({status:'stored',extract_lease_until:null});
 });
 it('a pages.json put failure neither fails nor finishes: the lease is left to expire and the attempt stays counted',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-put'),{},store);
  const broken=withOverride<ObjectStore>(store,{put:async(p:string)=>{if(p.startsWith('extractions/'))throw new Error('storage down');return 'created';}});
  const r=await run({...deps,store:broken});
  expect(r.documents).toEqual([{documentId:doc,outcome:'failed',code:'object_put_failed'}]);
  const d=(await db.documentById(doc))!;
  expect(d).toMatchObject({status:'stored',extract_attempts:1,current_extraction_id:null});
  expect(d.extract_lease_until).not.toBeNull();
  expect(await db.storedDue(10)).toEqual([]);   // leased: not due until the lease expires
  db.expireExtractLease(doc);
  expect((await run(deps)).documents[0]).toMatchObject({outcome:'extracted'});
  expect((await db.documentById(doc))!.extract_attempts).toBe(2);
 });
 it('a claim held by another batch is skipped without any write',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-held'),{},store);
  const other=randomUUID();
  const due=await db.storedDue(10);
  expect(await db.claimExtractLease(doc,other,600)).toBe(true);
  const r=await run({...deps,db:withOverride(db,{storedDue:async()=>due})});
  expect(r.documents).toEqual([{documentId:doc,outcome:'skipped',code:'leased_or_exhausted'}]);
  expect(r.counts.fetched).toBe(0);
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
 });
 it('documentIds: only listed documents that are still stored; others reported as info skips',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  const a=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-a'),{},store);
  const b=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-b'),{source_ref:'2026090300869_c'},store);
  await run(deps,{documentIds:[a]});
  expect((await db.documentById(b))!.status).toBe('stored');
  const again=await run(deps,{documentIds:[a]});
  expect(again.errors).toContainEqual({code:'skipped_summary',key:a,message:'not_stored:extracted'});
  expect(again.idle).toBe(true);
 });
 it('deadline: under MIN_DOC_MS left, nothing is claimed and deadline_hit is reported',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-late'),{},store);
  const now=new Date();
  const r=await run({...deps,now:()=>now,deadline:new Date(now.getTime()+MIN_DOC_MS-1)});
  expect(r.errors.map(e=>e.code)).toEqual(['deadline_hit']);
  expect(r.counts.fetched).toBe(0);
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
 });
 it('dry run: no batch, no claim, no writes; page counts reported. Apply without a code version is refused',async()=>{
  const {db,store,tables,deps}=harness();
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-dry'),{},store);
  const r=await run(deps,{dryRun:true});
  expect(r).toMatchObject({batchId:null,status:'dry_run',documents:[{documentId:doc,outcome:'planned',pageCount:2}]});
  expect((tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).rows('ingest_batches')).toEqual([]);
  expect((await db.documentById(doc))!).toMatchObject({status:'stored',extract_attempts:0});
  expect([...store.objects().keys()].filter(k=>k.startsWith('extractions/'))).toEqual([]);
  await expect(run({...deps,codeVersion:null})).rejects.toThrow('code_version_unavailable');
  await expect(run(deps,{limit:0})).rejects.toThrow('invalid_limit');
 });
 it('the pages.json bytes written equal what parseRecordedFixture re-serialises (fixture hashes are the real ones)',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  const pdf=enc('%PDF-fixture');
  const doc=await seedPublicDocument(db,pdf,{},store);
  await run(deps);
  const e=(await db.extractionById((await db.documentById(doc))!.current_extraction_id!))!;
  const json=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(store.objects().get(e.pages_json_path)!.bytes));
  const file={recorded_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z',source_url:'https://x/y_c.pdf',source_ref:'y_c',content_sha256:sha256Hex(pdf),bytes:pdf.length,page_count:2,extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,pages_json:json};
  expect(parseRecordedFixture(JSON.stringify(file,null,1)).pagesJsonSha256).toBe(e.pages_json_sha256);
 });
});
```

`src/lib/documents/citations.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/citations.ts
// Citations (spec §4.5, §7.4): cite() reads the cited extraction's page, takes the code-point slice
// [char_start, char_end) as the snippet (empty/whitespace-only or out of range → invalid_citation),
// records the page's text_hash and inserts through insert_citation (which re-checks both). verify()
// recomputes integrity against the immutable page row: 'ok' iff sha256(page text) equals the recorded
// text_hash and the code-point slice equals the snippet; currentExtraction = the citation's
// extraction is the document's current one. citationView() is the GET /api/citations/[id] body; it
// returns null when the document is not visible through `db` (anon RLS) so callers answer 404.
// Convention: cite before you publish a number (the citation id travels with the number).
import {DocumentsDbError} from './types';
import type {CitationCreator,CitationRow,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,PageRow} from './types';
import {cpLength,cpSlice,sha256Hex} from './extract/pages-json';

export interface CiteInput{document_id:string;extraction_id:string;page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox?:{x0:number;y0:number;x1:number;y1:number}|null;created_by:CitationCreator;created_ref:string}
export interface Verification{integrity:'ok'|'corrupt';currentExtraction:boolean}
export interface CitationView{
 citationId:string;documentId:string;extractionId:string;pageNo:number;charStart:number;charEnd:number;bbox:CitationRow['bbox'];snippet:string;textHash:string;
 integrity:'ok'|'corrupt';currentExtraction:boolean;createdBy:CitationCreator;createdRef:string;
 document:{title:string;sourceUrl:string|null;publishedAt:string;availableAt:string;docClass:DocumentRow['doc_class'];language:DocumentRow['language']};
}

const invalid=(why:string)=>new DocumentsDbError('invalid_citation',`invalid_citation:${why}`);
const isOffset=(n:unknown):n is number=>Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&(n as number)>=0;

export async function cite(db:Pick<DocumentsDb,'extractionById'|'pagesOf'|'insertCitation'>,input:CiteInput):Promise<string>{
 if(!isOffset(input.char_start)||!isOffset(input.char_end)||input.char_end<=input.char_start)throw invalid('range');
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(input.page_no)||input.page_no<1)throw invalid('page_no');
 if(typeof input.created_ref!=='string'||input.created_ref.length===0)throw invalid('created_ref');
 const extraction=await db.extractionById(input.extraction_id);
 if(!extraction||extraction.document_id!==input.document_id)throw invalid('extraction');
 const [page]=await db.pagesOf(input.extraction_id,[input.page_no]);
 if(!page)throw invalid('page');
 if(input.char_end>cpLength(page.text))throw invalid('range');
 const snippet=cpSlice(page.text,input.char_start,input.char_end);
 if(snippet.trim()==='')throw invalid('empty');
 return db.insertCitation({document_id:input.document_id,extraction_id:input.extraction_id,page_no:input.page_no,char_start:input.char_start,char_end:input.char_end,
  bbox:input.bbox??null,snippet,text_hash:page.text_hash,created_by:input.created_by,created_ref:input.created_ref});
}

/** Integrity of one citation against its page row (null page = corrupt: pages are never deleted). */
export function integrityOf(page:PageRow|undefined,c:CitationRow):'ok'|'corrupt'{
 if(!page)return 'corrupt';
 return sha256Hex(page.text)===c.text_hash&&page.text_hash===c.text_hash&&cpSlice(page.text,c.char_start,c.char_end)===c.snippet?'ok':'corrupt';
}

export async function verify(db:Pick<DocumentsDb,'citationById'|'pagesOf'|'documentById'>,citationId:string):Promise<Verification|null>{
 const c=await db.citationById(citationId);
 if(!c)return null;
 const [[page],doc]=await Promise.all([db.pagesOf(c.extraction_id,[c.page_no]),db.documentById(c.document_id)]);
 return {integrity:integrityOf(page,c),currentExtraction:doc?.current_extraction_id===c.extraction_id};
}

export async function citationView(db:Pick<DocumentsDb,'pagesOf'|'documentById'>,c:CitationRow):Promise<CitationView|null>{
 const [[page],doc]=await Promise.all([db.pagesOf(c.extraction_id,[c.page_no]),db.documentById(c.document_id)]);
 if(!doc)return null;
 return {citationId:c.citation_id,documentId:c.document_id,extractionId:c.extraction_id,pageNo:c.page_no,charStart:c.char_start,charEnd:c.char_end,bbox:c.bbox,snippet:c.snippet,textHash:c.text_hash,
  integrity:integrityOf(page,c),currentExtraction:doc.current_extraction_id===c.extraction_id,createdBy:c.created_by,createdRef:c.created_ref,
  document:{title:doc.title,sourceUrl:doc.source_url,publishedAt:doc.published_at,availableAt:doc.available_at,docClass:doc.doc_class,language:doc.language}};
}
```

`src/lib/documents/extract/run.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/run.ts
// Extraction scheduler (spec §7.3 first bullet, §10). One ingest_batches row (producer
// documents-extract, dataset documents.extract). Documents: storedDue(limit) (status 'stored', lease
// free or expired, NOT filtered by attempts), or the given documentIds (only those still 'stored').
// Per document, while at least MIN_DOC_MS of budget remains (else deadline_hit):
//   claimExtractLease(doc, batch, 600) — the only attempt counter; false → skip every write for this
//   document (the claim may just have made it 'extract_failed' on the third attempt);
//   store.get(storage_path) and check its sha256 = content_sha256;
//   extractPdf (application/pdf) | extractHtml (text/html, application/xhtml+xml, application/xml,
//   text/xml); other MIME → failExtract('unsupported_mime'); a throw → failExtract('extract_error'),
//   the budget → failExtract('extract_timeout');
//   renewExtractLease before each mutating phase (codex plan round 1 P2-7: an extraction may outlive
//   the 600 s lease — local scripts have no deadline): false → lease_lost, nothing more is written;
//   buildPagesJson → store.put(pagesJsonPath(content_sha256, sha)) — a put failure leaves the lease to
//   expire (no failExtract, no finishExtract; the claim already counted the attempt);
//   finishExtract(doc, batch, extraction, pageInsertsOf(json)) (role/status decided in SQL).
// Counts: fetched = documents claimed; inserted = versions written (extracted or no_text_layer, the
// latter also reported as skipped_summary(no_text_layer)); failed = everything else. Freshness
// documents.extract (daily): ok when idle or at least one document got a version. A run that applies
// needs a code version (null → refused). dryRun: no batch, no claim, no writes — reads and extracts
// the due documents and reports page counts.
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../dq/freshness';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {pagesJsonPath} from '../object-store';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ObjectStore,PageLayout} from '../types';
import {buildPagesJson,pageInsertsOf,sha256Hex} from './pages-json';
import {ExtractTimeout} from './pdf';
import type {ExtractBudget} from './pdf';

export const EXTRACT_LEASE_TTL_S=600;
export const MIN_DOC_MS=90_000;
/** Budget handed to the extractor: the deadline minus this reserve for the pages.json put and finishExtract. */
export const FINISH_RESERVE_MS=20_000;
const HTML_MIMES=new Set(['text/html','application/xhtml+xml','application/xml','text/xml']);

export interface ExtractDeps{
 db:DocumentsDb;tables:TableClient;store:ObjectStore;
 extractPdf:(bytes:Uint8Array,budget:ExtractBudget)=>Promise<{pages:PageLayout[];hasTextLayer:boolean}>;
 extractHtml:(bytes:Uint8Array)=>PageLayout[];
 now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;
}
export interface ExtractOptions{limit:number;documentIds?:string[];dryRun:boolean;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy}
export type DocOutcome='extracted'|'no_text_layer'|'failed'|'skipped'|'planned';
export interface DocExtractResult{documentId:string;outcome:DocOutcome;code?:string;pageCount?:number;extractionId?:string}
export interface ExtractReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];documents:DocExtractResult[];idle:boolean}

const remaining=(deps:ExtractDeps)=>deps.deadline===null?Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY:deps.deadline.getTime()-deps.now().getTime();
const errCode=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof DocumentsDbError?e.code:e instanceof ExtractTimeout?'extract_timeout':'extract_error';

async function dueDocuments(db:DocumentsDb,opts:ExtractOptions,errors:BatchError[]):Promise<DocumentRow[]>{
 if(!opts.documentIds)return db.storedDue(opts.limit);
 const out:DocumentRow[]=[];
 for(const id of opts.documentIds.slice(0,opts.limit)){
  const d=await db.documentById(id);
  if(d&&d.status==='stored')out.push(d);else errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:id,message:d?`not_stored:${d.status}`:'not_found'});
 }
 return out;
}

/** Bytes → layout by MIME; throws ExtractTimeout / any extractor error; 'unsupported_mime' as an Error message. */
async function layoutOf(deps:ExtractDeps,doc:DocumentRow,bytes:Uint8Array):Promise<{pages:PageLayout[];hasTextLayer:boolean}>{
 if(doc.mime==='application/pdf'){
  const budget:ExtractBudget={remainingMs:()=>remaining(deps)-FINISH_RESERVE_MS};
  return deps.extractPdf(bytes,budget);
 }
 if(HTML_MIMES.has(doc.mime)){const pages=deps.extractHtml(bytes);return {pages,hasTextLayer:pages.some(p=>p.text!=='')};}
 throw new Error('unsupported_mime');
}

export async function runDocumentsExtract(deps:ExtractDeps,opts:ExtractOptions):Promise<ExtractReceipt>{
 const {db,tables,store}=deps;
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(opts.limit)||opts.limit<1||opts.limit>1000)throw new Error('invalid_limit');
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const documents:DocExtractResult[]=[];
 if(opts.dryRun){
  const due=await dueDocuments(db,opts,errors);
  for(const doc of due){
   if(remaining(deps)<MIN_DOC_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:`${due.length-documents.length} documents not started`});break;}
   try{const l=await layoutOf(deps,doc,await store.get(doc.storage_path));documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'planned',pageCount:l.pages.length});}
   catch(e){documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'failed',code:e instanceof Error&&e.message==='unsupported_mime'?'unsupported_mime':errCode(e)});}
  }
  return {batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts,errors,documents,idle:due.length===0};
 }
 const codeVersion=deps.codeVersion;
 if(!codeVersion)throw new Error('code_version_unavailable');
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'documents-extract',dataset:'documents.extract',toolVersions:{extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION},codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy});
 const due=await dueDocuments(db,opts,errors);
 const fail=async(doc:DocumentRow,code:string,message?:string,callFail=true)=>{
  counts.failed++;errors.push({code,key:doc.document_id,...(message?{message}:{})});documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'failed',code});
  if(callFail){try{await db.failExtract(doc.document_id,batchId,code);}catch(e){errors.push({code:errCode(e),key:doc.document_id,message:'fail_extract'});}}
 };
 /** P2-7: the holder renews before a mutating phase; taken over (false) or a failing call → the document fails, nothing more is written. */
 const keep=async(doc:DocumentRow):Promise<boolean>=>{
  let ok=false;let code='lease_lost';
  try{ok=await db.renewExtractLease(doc.document_id,batchId,EXTRACT_LEASE_TTL_S);}catch(e){code=errCode(e);}
  if(!ok){counts.failed++;errors.push({code,key:doc.document_id});documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'failed',code});}
  return ok;
 };
 let started=0;
 for(const doc of due){
  if(remaining(deps)<MIN_DOC_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:`${due.length-started} documents not started`});break;}
  started++;
  let claimed:boolean;
  try{claimed=await db.claimExtractLease(doc.document_id,batchId,EXTRACT_LEASE_TTL_S);}
  catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:errCode(e),key:doc.document_id,message:'claim'});documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'failed',code:errCode(e)});continue;}
  if(!claimed){errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:doc.document_id,message:'leased_or_exhausted'});documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:'skipped',code:'leased_or_exhausted'});continue;}
  counts.fetched++;
  let bytes:Uint8Array;
  try{bytes=await store.get(doc.storage_path);}
  catch{await fail(doc,'object_get_failed');continue;}
  if(sha256Hex(bytes)!==doc.content_sha256){await fail(doc,'content_hash_mismatch');continue;}
  let layout:{pages:PageLayout[];hasTextLayer:boolean};
  try{layout=await layoutOf(deps,doc,bytes);}
  catch(e){
   const code=e instanceof Error&&e.message==='unsupported_mime'?'unsupported_mime':errCode(e);
   await fail(doc,code,code==='extract_error'&&e instanceof Error?e.message:undefined);continue;
  }
  const built=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:doc.content_sha256,code_version:codeVersion,has_text_layer:layout.hasTextLayer,pages:layout.pages});
  const path=pagesJsonPath(doc.content_sha256,built.sha256);
  if(!await keep(doc))continue;
  try{await store.put(path,built.bytes,'application/json');}
  catch{await fail(doc,'object_put_failed',undefined,false);continue;}
  if(!await keep(doc))continue;
  try{
   const extractionId=await db.finishExtract(doc.document_id,batchId,{extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:codeVersion,
    has_text_layer:layout.hasTextLayer,page_count:layout.pages.length,pages_json_path:path,pages_json_sha256:built.sha256},pageInsertsOf(built.json));
   counts.inserted++;
   if(!layout.hasTextLayer)errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:doc.document_id,message:'no_text_layer'});
   documents.push({documentId:doc.document_id,outcome:layout.hasTextLayer?'extracted':'no_text_layer',pageCount:layout.pages.length,extractionId});
  }catch(e){await fail(doc,errCode(e),undefined,false);}
 }
 const idle=due.length===0;
 const status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
 await recordAttempt(tables,'documents.extract',{ok:idle||counts.inserted>0,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{batch_id:batchId,idle}});
 return {batchId,status,counts,errors,documents,idle};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/extract/deps.ts
// Production wiring of ExtractDeps (spec §7.3) shared by /api/cron/documents-extract,
// POST /api/admin/documents/[id]/reprocess and scripts/documents/extract.ts: service-role
// DocumentsDb / TableClient / ObjectStore (bucket disclosure-docs) and the real extractors.
// codeVersion comes from the caller (src/lib/facts/deps.ts::resolveCodeVersion); null = refuse to apply.
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../supabase/admin';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '../db';
import {supabaseObjectStore} from '../object-store';
import {extractHtml} from './html';
import {extractPdf} from './pdf';
import type {ExtractDeps} from './run';

export interface ExtractDepsOptions{deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;now?:()=>Date;/** Reuse an existing admin client (scripts hold one). */admin?:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>}
export function productionExtractDeps(opts:ExtractDepsOptions):ExtractDeps{
 const sb=opts.admin??getAdminSupabase();
 return {db:supabaseDocumentsDb(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),store:supabaseObjectStore(sb),extractPdf,extractHtml,
  now:opts.now??(()=>new Date()),deadline:opts.deadline,codeVersion:opts.codeVersion};
}
```

`src/app/api/cron/documents-extract/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/documents-extract/route.ts
// Extraction trigger (spec §6.3, §7.3): CRON_SECRET bearer (same check as facts-sync; missing secret
// → 503), limit 1..100 (default 10), maxDuration 300 with a 240 s deadline handed to the core (no
// new document under 90 s left → deadline_hit). Gated: DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED must be '1', else
// 403 extract_disabled (spec §12 degradation: until the Vercel pdf.js smoke passes, extraction runs
// only through scripts/documents/extract.ts). A missing VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA refuses the run (503).
// The HTTP receipt carries codes, keys and counts only, never error messages.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {productionExtractDeps} from '@/lib/documents/extract/deps';
import {runDocumentsExtract} from '@/lib/documents/extract/run';
import type {ExtractReceipt} from '@/lib/documents/extract/run';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000,DEFAULT_LIMIT=10,MAX_LIMIT=100;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function publicReceipt(r:ExtractReceipt){
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,idle:r.idle,
  errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key}),
  documents:r.documents.map(d=>({documentId:d.documentId,outcome:d.outcome,code:d.code,pageCount:d.pageCount,extractionId:d.extractionId}))};
}
function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 const limits=url.searchParams.getAll('limit');
 if(limits.length>1)return err('invalid_parameter:limit','limit may be given once',400);
 let limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT;
 if(limits.length===1){const v=limits[0];if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(v)||Number(v)<1||Number(v)>MAX_LIMIT)return err('invalid_parameter:limit',`limit must be 1..${MAX_LIMIT}`,400);limit=Number(v);}
 if(process.env.DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED!=='1')return err('extract_disabled','Document extraction is not enabled (DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED)',403);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const receipt=await runDocumentsExtract(productionExtractDeps({deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion}),{limit,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',limit,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[cron/documents-extract]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return err('extract_failed','Document extraction failed',500);
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

`scripts/documents/extract.ts`：

```ts
/**
 * Document extraction from the command line (spec §6.3, §7.3). No deadline; dry run by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/extract.ts [--limit n] [--document <uuid>]... [--apply]
 *
 * Dry run: reads the due documents (or the listed ones that are still 'stored'), downloads their
 * bytes and extracts them in memory — no batch, no lease, no pages.json, no rows; prints page counts.
 * --apply runs runDocumentsExtract (ingest_batches dataset documents.extract, triggered_by script)
 * and needs a code version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git checkout, '-dirty' when the tree has
 * changes). This is the extraction path while DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED is off (spec §12).
 * Exit 0 on success, 1 when the batch (or any document in a dry run) failed, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {productionExtractDeps} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/deps';
import {runDocumentsExtract} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/run';

const USAGE='usage: extract.ts [--limit n] [--document <uuid>]... [--apply]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
interface Args{limit:number;documentIds:string[];apply:boolean}

function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={limit:25,documentIds:[],apply:false};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--')){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}return v;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--document')a.documentIds.push(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>1000){console.error('--limit must be 1..1000');process.exit(2);}
 if(a.documentIds.some(id=>!UUID.test(id))){console.error('--document must be a uuid');process.exit(2);}
 return a;
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true});
 if(args.apply&&!codeVersion){console.error('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');process.exit(2);}
 const receipt=await runDocumentsExtract(productionExtractDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion}),{limit:Math.max(args.limit,args.documentIds.length),documentIds:args.documentIds.length?args.documentIds:undefined,dryRun:!args.apply,triggeredBy:'script'});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({batchId:receipt.batchId,status:receipt.status,counts:receipt.counts,idle:receipt.idle,documents:receipt.documents,errors:receipt.errors},null,1));
 const failed=receipt.status==='dry_run'?receipt.documents.some(d=>d.outcome==='failed'):receipt.status==='failed'||receipt.status==='partial';
 process.exit(failed?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`scripts/documents/record-fixture.ts`（只在指挥手动执行；PDF 不进仓库；写 `src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/<source_ref>.pages.json`）：

```ts
/**
 * Record an HKEXnews PDF as a pages.json fixture (spec §11.3). Network; never run in CI.
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/documents/record-fixture.ts --hkex <https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/…/<file id>.pdf> [--pages 44-47,51-52] [--out <dir>]
 *
 * --pages keeps only those pages in pages_json (pages_subset: true; page_count and content_sha256 stay
 * those of the whole PDF): the committed 0268.HK fixture stores only its primary-statement pages.
 * The summary line reports cjk_chars over ALL pages — a smoke signal for the pdf.js CMaps (a Chinese
 * report with 0 CJK characters means cMapUrl did not resolve; exit 1).
 * Downloads the PDF (User-Agent = EDGAR_USER_AGENT ?? DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, ≤ 52,428,800 bytes),
 * runs extractPdf with no deadline, builds pages.json exactly as runDocumentsExtract does
 * (code_version = git HEAD, '-dirty' when the tree has changes, else 'unknown') and writes
 * src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/<source_ref>.pages.json =
 *   {recorded_at, source_url, source_ref, content_sha256, bytes, page_count, extractor_version, table_algo_version, pages_json}
 * The PDF itself is NOT written anywhere in the repo (licence and size); validate-extraction.ts later
 * re-downloads it and compares content_sha256 and per-page text_hash. source_ref is the file id of the
 * URL (…/2026090300863_c.pdf → 2026090300863_c), the same rule as the hkexnews source adapter.
 * Exit 2 on bad arguments, 1 on download/extraction failure.
 */
import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {extractPdf} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/pdf';
import {buildPagesJson,sha256Hex} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json';
import type {RecordedPagesFixture} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,MAX_DOC_BYTES,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';

const USAGE='usage: record-fixture.ts --hkex <hkexnews pdf url> [--pages a-b,c] [--out <dir>]';
/** '44-47,51' → {44,45,46,47,51}; null on any malformed part. */
function parsePages(spec:string):Set<number>|null{
 const out=new Set<number>();
 for(const part of spec.split(',')){
  const m=/^(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?$/.exec(part.trim());if(!m)return null;
  const a=Number(m[1]),b=Number(m[2]??m[1]);if(a<1||b<a||b-a>2000)return null;
  for(let n=a;n<=b;n++)out.add(n);
 }
 return out.size>0?out:null;
}
const DEFAULT_OUT=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/',import.meta.url));
const fail=(msg:string,code=2):never=>{console.error(msg);process.exit(code);};

function hkexSourceRef(url:string):string|null{
 let u:URL;try{u=new URL(url);}catch{return null;}
 if(u.protocol!=='https:'||u.hostname!=='www1.hkexnews.hk')return null;
 const m=/^\/listedco\/listconews\/[a-z]+\/\d{4}\/\d{4}\/([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\.pdf$/i.exec(u.pathname);
 return m?m[1]:null;
}

async function download(url:string):Promise<Uint8Array>{
 const res=await fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT,Accept:'application/pdf'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(120_000)});
 if(!res.ok||!res.body)fail(`download failed: HTTP ${res.status}`,1);
 const declared=Number(res.headers.get('content-length')??'0');
 if(declared>MAX_DOC_BYTES)fail(`document_too_large: ${declared} bytes`,1);
 const chunks:Uint8Array[]=[];let n=0;
 for await(const c of res.body as unknown as AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>){n+=c.length;if(n>MAX_DOC_BYTES)fail('document_too_large while streaming',1);chunks.push(c);}
 const out=new Uint8Array(n);let at=0;for(const c of chunks){out.set(c,at);at+=c.length;}
 return out;
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let url:string|undefined;let outDir=DEFAULT_OUT;let only:Set<number>|null=null;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  if(argv[i]==='--hkex'&&argv[i+1])url=argv[++i];
  else if(argv[i]==='--out'&&argv[i+1])outDir=argv[++i];
  else if(argv[i]==='--pages'&&argv[i+1])only=parsePages(argv[++i])??fail(USAGE);
  else fail(USAGE);
 }
 if(!url)fail(USAGE);
 const sourceRef=hkexSourceRef(url!)??fail(`not an HKEXnews listedco PDF url: ${url}`);
 const bytes=await download(url!);
 if(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0,5))!=='%PDF-')fail('downloaded bytes are not a PDF',1);
 const contentSha=sha256Hex(bytes);
 const {pages,hasTextLayer}=await extractPdf(bytes,{remainingMs:()=>Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY});
 const cjkChars=pages.reduce((k,p)=>k+(p.text.match(/\p{Script=Han}/gu)?.length??0),0);
 if(only!==null&&[...only].some(n=>n>pages.length))fail(`--pages beyond the document's ${pages.length} pages`);
 const kept=only===null?pages:pages.filter(p=>only!.has(p.page_no));
 const built=buildPagesJson({content_sha256:contentSha,code_version:resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??'unknown',has_text_layer:hasTextLayer,pages:kept});
 const fixture:RecordedPagesFixture={recorded_at:new Date().toISOString(),source_url:url!,source_ref:sourceRef,content_sha256:contentSha,bytes:bytes.length,page_count:pages.length,
  extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,...(only===null?{}:{pages_subset:true as const}),pages_json:built.json};
 mkdirSync(outDir,{recursive:true});
 const path=join(outDir,`${sourceRef}.pages.json`);
 writeFileSync(path,`${JSON.stringify(fixture,null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({wrote:path,source_ref:sourceRef,content_sha256:contentSha,bytes:bytes.length,page_count:pages.length,stored_pages:kept.map(p=>p.page_no),has_text_layer:hasTextLayer,cjk_chars:cjkChars,pages_json_sha256:built.sha256,tables:kept.reduce((k,p)=>k+p.tables.length,0)}));
 if(/_c$/i.test(sourceRef)&&cjkChars===0)fail('cjk_chars=0 on a Chinese HKEX document: pdf.js CMaps not found (pdfjsAssets)',1);
}

main().catch(e=>fail(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e),1));
```

```js
  },
  // end F3
```

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/read-routes.test.ts
// Public branches of the document read routes (Task 11) over memoryDocumentsDb: the anon client is
// rlsView(db) (spec §4.12 imitation), the service client is db itself, the private bucket a memory

import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import type {DocumentsDb,ObjectStore} from '@/lib/documents/types';

const S=vi.hoisted(()=>({anon:null as unknown,db:null as unknown,store:null as unknown,user:null as string|null,resolve:vi.fn()}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/anon',()=>({getAnonSupabase:()=>({__role:'anon'})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/admin',()=>({getAdminSupabase:()=>({__role:'service'})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/server',()=>({getServerSupabase:async()=>({auth:{getUser:async()=>({data:{user:S.user?{id:S.user}:null},error:null})}})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/documents/db',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/documents/db')>(),supabaseDocumentsDb:(c:{__role:string})=>c.__role==='anon'?S.anon:S.db}));
vi.mock('@/lib/documents/object-store',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/documents/object-store')>(),supabaseObjectStore:()=>S.store}));
vi.mock('@/lib/entities/resolve',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/entities/resolve')>(),resolveIssuer:S.resolve}));

import {GET as listGET} from './[ticker]/route';
import {GET as docGET} from './doc/[id]/route';
import {GET as pageGET} from './doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route';
import {GET as fileGET} from './doc/[id]/file/route';
import {GET as citationGET} from '../citations/[id]/route';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/memory-documents-db';
import type {MemoryDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/memory-documents-db';
import {memoryObjectStore} from '@/lib/documents/object-store';
import {ISSUER,OWNER_A,rlsView,seedExtraction,seedPublicDocument,seedUpload,withOverride} from '@/lib/documents/test-seed';
import {cite} from '@/lib/documents/citations';
import {layoutFromItems} from '@/lib/documents/extract/pdf';
import {detectTables} from '@/lib/documents/extract/tables';
import {cpSlice} from '@/lib/documents/extract/pages-json';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,EXTRACTOR_VERSION} from '@/lib/documents/types';

const BASE='https://alpha.example';
const enc=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const TODAY=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const PUBLIC_SHORT=/^public, s-maxage=\d+, stale-while-revalidate=600$/;
const list=(ticker:string,qs='')=>listGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/${ticker}?${qs}`),{params:Promise.resolve({ticker})});
const doc=(id:string,qs='')=>docGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}?${qs}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});
const page=(id:string,n:string,qs='')=>pageGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}/pages/${n}?${qs}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id,n})});
const file=(id:string)=>fileGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}/file`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});
const citation=(id:string)=>citationGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/citations/${id}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});

let db:MemoryDocumentsDb,store:ReturnType<typeof memoryObjectStore>;
let v1:string,v2:string,licensed:string;
beforeEach(async()=>{
 vi.clearAllMocks();
 db=memoryDocumentsDb();store=memoryObjectStore();
 S.db=db;S.anon=rlsView(db as DocumentsDb);S.store=store;S.user=null;
 S.resolve.mockImplementation(async(_c:unknown,q:{ticker:string})=>q.ticker==='9999.HK'?null:({issuer_id:ISSUER,status:'active',names:{zh:'金蝶',en:'Kingdee'},identifiers:{cik:null,lei:null,usci:null},
  securities:[{ticker:'00268.HK',isin:null,figi:null,share_class:null,is_primary:true,valid_from:'2005-01-01',valid_to:null}]}));
 v1=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-v1'),{available_at:'2026-01-10T02:00:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-01-10',published_at:'2026-01-10T02:00:00.000Z'},store);
 v2=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-v2'),{available_at:'2026-03-05T02:00:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-03-05',published_at:'2026-01-10T02:00:00.000Z'},store);
 licensed=await seedUpload(db,OWNER_A,enc('%PDF-licensed'),{issuer_id:ISSUER,available_at:'2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-02-01'},store);
});

describe('GET /api/documents/[ticker]',()=>{
 it('HK ticker resolves; asOf picks the version available then; a past asOf is cached long; licensed rows never appear',async()=>{
  const res=await list('0268.HK','asOf=2026-02-01');
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('public, max-age=600, s-maxage=3600');
  const body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toMatchObject({issuerId:ISSUER,ticker:'00268.HK',asOf:'2026-02-01',extractorVersion:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,classifierGen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,nextCursor:null});
  expect(body.documents.map((d:{documentId:string})=>d.documentId)).toEqual([v1]);
  expect(body.documents[0]).toMatchObject({source:'hkexnews',sourceRef:'2026090300863_c',sourceVersion:1,observedReplacement:false,docClass:'annual_report',language:'zh',status:'stored',currentExtractionId:null,availableDate:'2026-01-10'});
  expect(body.documents[0]).not.toHaveProperty('ownerUserId');
  expect(S.resolve).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.anything(),{ticker:'0268.HK'},{today:TODAY});
 });
 it('default asOf = today → latest version (short public cache); versions=1 → all versions; cursor pages',async()=>{
  let res=await list('00268.HK');
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(PUBLIC_SHORT);
  expect((await res.json()).documents.map((d:{documentId:string;observedReplacement:boolean})=>[d.documentId,d.observedReplacement])).toEqual([[v2,true]]);
  res=await list('00268.HK','versions=1&limit=1');
  const first=await res.json();
  expect(first.documents.map((d:{documentId:string})=>d.documentId)).toEqual([v2]);
  expect(first.nextCursor).toEqual(expect.any(String));
  const second=await (await list('00268.HK',`versions=1&limit=1&cursor=${encodeURIComponent(first.nextCursor)}`)).json();
  expect(second.documents.map((d:{documentId:string})=>d.documentId)).toEqual([v1]);
  expect(second.nextCursor).toBeNull();
 });
 it('filters: source/class/from/to; an empty result is no-store',async()=>{
  expect((await (await list('00268.HK','source=edgar')).json()).documents).toEqual([]);
  const res=await list('00268.HK','asOf=2025-12-31');
  expect((await res.json()).documents).toEqual([]);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
  expect((await (await list('00268.HK','from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-31')).json()).documents.map((d:{documentId:string})=>d.documentId)).toEqual([v2]);
  expect((await (await list('00268.HK','class=interim_report')).json()).documents).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('400 on invalid or repeated parameters, 404 unknown_ticker, 409 ambiguous owner',async()=>{
  for(const qs of ['source=upload','class=memo','asOf=2999-01-01','asOf=2026-02-30','from=2026-03-01&to=2026-01-01','versions=true','limit=0','limit=1001','limit=1&limit=2','cursor=%%%','cursor=bm90LWpzb24'])
   expect((await list('00268.HK',qs)).status,qs).toBe(400);
  expect((await list('bad%ticker!')).status).toBe(400);
  const res=await list('9999.HK');
  expect(res.status).toBe(404);
  expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('unknown_ticker');
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
  S.resolve.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('ambiguous_owner'));
  expect((await list('00268.HK')).status).toBe(409);
 });
});

describe('GET /api/documents/doc/[id]',()=>{
 it('public document: metadata, assets, extractions page, supersedes / supersededBy, public cache',async()=>{
  const ext=await seedExtraction(db,v1,['a']);
  let res=await doc(v1);
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(PUBLIC_SHORT);
  let body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toMatchObject({extractorVersion:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,classifierGen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,document:{documentId:v1,status:'extracted',currentExtractionId:ext},assets:[],supersedes:null,supersededBy:v2});
  expect(body.extractions).toEqual({rows:[{extractionId:ext,extractorVersion:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,tableAlgoVersion:'tables/1.0',pageCount:1,hasTextLayer:true,createdAt:expect.any(String)}],nextCursor:null});
  res=await doc(v2);
  body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toMatchObject({supersedes:v1,supersededBy:null,extractions:{rows:[],nextCursor:null}});
 });
 it('licensed and unknown ids are 404 (no-store); malformed id or cursor 400',async()=>{
  for(const id of [licensed,'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000']){
   const res=await doc(id);
   expect(res.status).toBe(404);
   expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
  }
  expect((await doc('nope')).status).toBe(400);
  expect((await doc(v1,'extractionsCursor=%%%')).status).toBe(400);
 });
});

describe('GET /api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n]',()=>{
 it('current extraction by default; layout=1 adds lines and tables whose cell offsets slice the page text by code point',async()=>{
  const {text,lines}=layoutFromItems([
   {str:'𠀋😀 綜合損益表',x:50,y:800,w:80,h:12},
   {str:'收益',x:50,y:760,w:20,h:10},{str:'1,234',x:300,y:760,w:25,h:10},{str:'1,100',x:400,y:760,w:25,h:10},
   {str:'銷售成本',x:50,y:745,w:40,h:10},{str:'(800)',x:300,y:745,w:25,h:10},{str:'(700)',x:400,y:745,w:25,h:10},
  ]);
  const ext=await seedExtraction(db,v1,[],{store,layouts:[{page_no:1,width:595,height:842,text,lines,tables:detectTables(lines)}]});
  let res=await page(v1,'1');
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  let body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toEqual({documentId:v1,extractionId:ext,pageNo:1,text,textHash:expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/),charCount:Array.from(text).length,width:595,height:842});
  res=await page(v1,'1','layout=1');
  body=await res.json();
  expect(body.lines[0]).toEqual({index:0,y:800,x0:50,x1:130,text:'𠀋😀 綜合損益表',charStart:0,charEnd:8});
  const cell=body.tables[0].cells.find((c:{text:string})=>c.text==='1,234');
  expect(cell).toMatchObject({row:0,col:1,numeric:true});
  expect(cpSlice(body.text,cell.charStart,cell.charEnd)).toBe('1,234');
  expect(body.tables[0].headerLines.map((l:{text:string})=>l.text)).toEqual(['𠀋😀 綜合損益表']);
 });
 it('explicit older extraction; foreign extraction, missing page, licensed document → 404; corrupt pages.json → 500',async()=>{
  const old=await seedExtraction(db,v1,['old text'],{store,extractorVersion:'docs-extract/0.9'});
  await db.requestExtract(v1,OWNER_A);
  const cur=await seedExtraction(db,v1,['new text'],{store});
  expect((await (await page(v1,'1',`extraction=${old}`)).json()).text).toBe('old text');
  expect((await (await page(v1,'1')).json()).extractionId).toBe(cur);
  const other=await seedExtraction(db,v2,['v2 text'],{store});
  expect((await page(v1,'1',`extraction=${other}`)).status).toBe(404);
  expect((await page(v1,'2')).status).toBe(404);
  expect((await page(v2,'1','extraction=not-a-uuid')).status).toBe(400);
  expect((await page(v2,'0')).status).toBe(400);
  expect((await page(v2,'x')).status).toBe(400);
  expect((await page(v2,'1','layout=yes')).status).toBe(400);
  await seedExtraction(db,licensed,['secret'],{store});
  expect((await page(licensed,'1')).status).toBe(404);
  const e=(await db.extractionById(cur))!;
  store.objects().set(e.pages_json_path,{bytes:enc('{"tampered":true}'),mime:'application/json'});
  expect((await page(v1,'1','layout=1')).status).toBe(500);
  expect((await page(v1,'1')).status).toBe(200);   // plain text does not need pages.json
 });
 it('a document without any extraction is 404',async()=>{
  expect((await page(v2,'1')).status).toBe(404);
 });
});

describe('GET /api/documents/doc/[id]/file',()=>{
 it('401 without a session; signed URL (300 s, private no-store) for a public document; licensed → 404',async()=>{
  let res=await file(v1);
  expect(res.status).toBe(401);
  expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('unauthenticated');
  S.user='cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc';
  const signedCalls:[string,number][]=[];
  S.store=withOverride<ObjectStore>(store,{signedUrl:async(p:string,s:number)=>{signedCalls.push([p,s]);return `https://signed.example/${p}?e=${s}`;}});
  const before=Date.now();
  res=await file(v1);
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  const body=await res.json();
  expect(signedCalls).toEqual([[(await db.documentById(v1))!.storage_path,300]]);
  expect(body.url).toBe(`https://signed.example/${(await db.documentById(v1))!.storage_path}?e=300`);
  expect(Date.parse(body.expiresAt)-before).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(299_000);
  expect((await file(licensed)).status).toBe(404);
  expect((await file('bad')).status).toBe(400);
 });
});

describe('GET /api/citations/[id]',()=>{

  await db.publishCitations([human]);
  const internal=await cite(db,{document_id:v1,extraction_id:ext,page_no:1,char_start:11,char_end:16,created_by:'extractor',created_ref:'hk-facts/1/hk-facts/1.0'});
  const res=await citation(human);
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(PUBLIC_SHORT);
  expect(await res.json()).toMatchObject({citationId:human,documentId:v1,extractionId:ext,pageNo:1,charStart:3,charEnd:10,snippet:'Revenue',integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,createdBy:'human',
   document:{title:'2025 年報',docClass:'annual_report',language:'zh',publishedAt:'2026-01-10T02:00:00.000Z',availableAt:'2026-01-10T02:00:00.000Z'}});
  for(const id of [internal,'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000']){const r=await citation(id);expect(r.status).toBe(404);expect(r.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');}
  expect((await citation('x')).status).toBe(400);
 });
});
```

`src/lib/documents/read-route.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/read-route.ts
// Conventions shared by the document read routes (spec §9, §8.1): public reads go through the ANON
// client (RLS shows public documents, their extractions/pages/assets and visible citations only;
// read_documents is security invoker); parameters are parsed strictly with the facts route helpers
// (repeated parameter → 400 invalid_parameter:<name>); cursors are opaque and must decode
// (db.ts::decodeCursor); error bodies {error:{code,message}} with no-store. Cache headers by
// response class: anonymous-visible success → past asOf 'public, max-age=600, s-maxage=3600',
// otherwise successCacheControl(now); empty → no-store; anything answered after a session check
// (owner reads, signed URLs) → 'private, no-store'. Tickers resolve by today's ownership through
// resolveIssuer, INCLUDING .HK (the facts public-route resolver rejects HK; documents do not).
// The page/layout body is shared with the owner branch (Task 12), which passes the service db.
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {isCurrentSecurity,resolveIssuer,successCacheControl} from '../entities/resolve';
import {inferCoreMarket,normalizeSecurityTicker} from '../securities/ticker';
import {QueryError,asOfParam,dateParam,errorResponse,flagParam,intParam,readParams,utcDate} from '../facts/public-route';
import {decodeCursor,supabaseDocumentsDb} from './db';
import {supabaseObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {cpLength,sha256Hex} from './extract/pages-json';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX} from './types';
import type {AssetRow,DocClass,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ExtractionRow,LayoutLine,LayoutTable,ListedSource,ObjectStore,PagesJson} from './types';

export const LISTED_SOURCES:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set<ListedSource>(['edgar','cninfo','hkexnews']);
export const DOC_CLASSES:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set<DocClass>(['annual_report','interim_report','quarterly_report','results_announcement','current_report','registration','proxy','ownership','other']);
export const DEFAULT_LIMIT=100;
export const EXTRACTIONS_PAGE=100;
export const SIGNED_URL_SECONDS=300;
const MAX_CURSOR=1024;
export const PRIVATE_HEADERS={'Cache-Control':'private, no-store'} as const;

export interface DocListParams{asOf:string;source?:ListedSource;docClass?:DocClass;from?:string;to?:string;versions:boolean;cursor:string|null;limit:number}

/** An opaque cursor that our db layer can decode; anything else → invalid_parameter:<name>. */
export function cursorParam(p:Map<string,string>,name:string):string|null{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return null;
 if(v.length===0||v.length>MAX_CURSOR)throw new QueryError(name);
 try{decodeCursor(v);}catch{throw new QueryError(name);}
 return v;
}
/** GET /api/documents/[ticker] parameters (spec §9). */
export function docParams(url:URL,today:string):DocListParams{
 const p=readParams(url,['asOf','source','class','from','to','versions','cursor','limit']);
 const source=p.get('source');if(source!==undefined&&!LISTED_SOURCES.has(source))throw new QueryError('source');
 const docClass=p.get('class');if(docClass!==undefined&&!DOC_CLASSES.has(docClass))throw new QueryError('class');
 const from=dateParam(p,'from'),to=dateParam(p,'to');
 if(from!==undefined&&to!==undefined&&from>to)throw new QueryError('from');
 return {asOf:asOfParam(p,today),source:source as ListedSource|undefined,docClass:docClass as DocClass|undefined,from,to,versions:flagParam(p,'versions'),cursor:cursorParam(p,'cursor'),limit:intParam(p,'limit',DEFAULT_LIMIT,PAGE_LIMIT_MAX)};
}

export type ResponseClass='public'|'private'|'empty';
export function cacheHeadersFor(kind:ResponseClass,asOf:string|undefined,now:Date):Record<string,string>{
 if(kind==='private')return {...PRIVATE_HEADERS};
 if(kind==='empty')return {'Cache-Control':'no-store'};
 if(asOf!==undefined&&asOf<utcDate(now))return {'Cache-Control':'public, max-age=600, s-maxage=3600'};
 return {'Cache-Control':successCacheControl(now)};
}
export const notFound=()=>errorResponse('not_found','not found',404);

export const publicDocumentView=(r:DocumentRow)=>({documentId:r.document_id,source:r.source,sourceRef:r.source_ref,sourceVersion:r.source_version,observedReplacement:r.observed_replacement,
 docClass:r.doc_class,formType:r.form_type,title:r.title,language:r.language,sourceUrl:r.source_url,contentSha256:r.content_sha256,bytes:r.bytes,mime:r.mime,
 publishedAt:r.published_at,publishedAtPrecision:r.published_at_precision,availableAt:r.available_at,availableDate:r.available_date,fiscalYear:r.fiscal_year,fiscalPeriod:r.fiscal_period,
 periodEnd:r.period_end,filingSourceRef:r.filing_source_ref,status:r.status,currentExtractionId:r.current_extraction_id});
export const assetView=(a:AssetRow)=>({role:a.role,filename:a.filename,sourceUrl:a.source_url,contentSha256:a.content_sha256,bytes:a.bytes,mime:a.mime});
export const extractionView=(e:ExtractionRow)=>({extractionId:e.extraction_id,extractorVersion:e.extractor_version,tableAlgoVersion:e.table_algo_version,pageCount:e.page_count,hasTextLayer:e.has_text_layer,createdAt:e.created_at});
const lineView=(l:LayoutLine)=>({index:l.index,y:l.y,x0:l.x0,x1:l.x1,text:l.text,charStart:l.char_start,charEnd:l.char_end});
const tableView=(t:LayoutTable)=>({headerLines:t.header_lines.map(lineView),rowCount:t.row_count,colCount:t.col_count,colX0:t.col_x0,
 cells:t.cells.map(c=>({row:c.row,col:c.col,text:c.text,bbox:c.bbox,lineIndex:c.line_index,charStart:c.char_start,charEnd:c.char_end,numeric:c.numeric}))});

/** Ticker → issuer by today's ownership, every market (US, CN, HK); the echoed ticker is the matching security row. Throws 'ambiguous_owner' through. */
export async function resolveDocIssuer(tables:TableClient,rawTicker:string,today:string):Promise<{issuerId:string;ticker:string}|null>{
 const given=rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
 const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:given},{today});
 if(!r)return null;
 const core=inferCoreMarket(given);
 const normalised=core?normalizeSecurityTicker(given,core):null;
 const hit=r.securities.find(x=>x.ticker.toUpperCase()===given)??(normalised?r.securities.find(x=>x.ticker.toUpperCase()===normalised):undefined);
 if(hit)return {issuerId:r.issuer_id,ticker:hit.ticker};
 // merged issuer: resolveIssuer returned the target's securities; read the source row (first form with rows is authoritative)
 for(const t of normalised&&normalised!==given?[given,normalised]:[given]){
  const rows=await tables.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:t});
  if(rows.length===0)continue;
  return rows.some(x=>isCurrentSecurity(x,today))?{issuerId:r.issuer_id,ticker:t}:null;
 }
 return null;
}

/** Anon (RLS) clients for the public branch. */
export function publicDocs():{tables:TableClient;db:DocumentsDb}{
 const sb=getAnonSupabase();
 return {tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),db:supabaseDocumentsDb(sb)};
}
/** Service-role object store: the bucket is private; only the server reads pages.json or signs URLs. */
export const serviceStore=():ObjectStore=>supabaseObjectStore(getAdminSupabase());

/** Supabase session user id, or null (no session / auth error). next/headers is imported lazily. */
export async function sessionUserId():Promise<string|null>{
 const {getServerSupabase}=await import('../supabase/server');
 const sb=await getServerSupabase();
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.getUser();
 return error||!data.user?null:data.user.id;
}

/** The version that superseded this one (same source/source_ref, source_version + 1), if visible through db. */
async function supersededBy(db:DocumentsDb,row:DocumentRow):Promise<string|null>{
 let cursor:string|null=null;
 for(let k=0;k<20;k++){
  const page=await db.documentVersions(row.source,row.source_ref,{cursor,limit:PAGE_LIMIT_MAX});
  const next=page.rows.find(d=>d.source_version===row.source_version+1);
  if(next)return next.document_id;
  if(!page.nextCursor)return null;
  cursor=page.nextCursor;
 }
 return null;
}

/** GET /api/documents/doc/[id] body for a row already visible to the caller through db. */
export async function docDetail(db:DocumentsDb,row:DocumentRow,extractionsCursor:string|null){
 const [assets,extractions,next]=await Promise.all([db.assetsOf(row.document_id),db.extractionsOf(row.document_id,{cursor:extractionsCursor,limit:EXTRACTIONS_PAGE}),supersededBy(db,row)]);
 return {extractorVersion:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,classifierGen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,document:publicDocumentView(row),assets:assets.map(assetView),
  extractions:{rows:extractions.rows.map(extractionView),nextCursor:extractions.nextCursor},supersedes:row.supersedes_document_id,supersededBy:next};
}

/**
 * GET /api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n] body, or null when the extraction (default: current) does not
 * belong to the document or the page does not exist. layout=1 reads the extraction's pages.json from
 * the private bucket, checks its sha256 against the extraction row (mismatch → Error('pages_json_corrupt'))
 * and returns that page's lines and tables in camelCase (offsets are code points of `text`).
 */
export async function pageDetail(db:DocumentsDb,store:ObjectStore,row:DocumentRow,pageNo:number,extractionParam:string|null,layout:boolean){
 const extractionId=extractionParam??row.current_extraction_id;
 if(!extractionId)return null;
 const ex=await db.extractionById(extractionId);
 if(!ex||ex.document_id!==row.document_id)return null;
 const [page]=await db.pagesOf(ex.extraction_id,[pageNo]);
 if(!page)return null;
 const body={documentId:row.document_id,extractionId:ex.extraction_id,pageNo:page.page_no,text:page.text,textHash:page.text_hash,charCount:page.char_count,width:page.width,height:page.height};
 if(!layout)return body;
 const bytes=await store.get(ex.pages_json_path);
 if(sha256Hex(bytes)!==ex.pages_json_sha256)throw new Error('pages_json_corrupt');
 const json=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)) as PagesJson;
 const pl=json.pages.find(p=>p.page_no===pageNo);
 if(!pl||pl.text!==page.text||cpLength(pl.text)!==page.char_count)throw new Error('pages_json_corrupt');
 return {...body,lines:pl.lines.map(lineView),tables:pl.tables.map(tableView)};
}
```
