`src/app/api/documents/[ticker]/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/[ticker]/route.ts
// Public document list (spec §9): ticker (US, CN or HK) → issuer by today's ownership; read_documents
// (security invoker, anon → public rows only) picks per (source, source_ref) the highest version
// available on asOf, then applies the from/to window on available_date; versions=1 lists every
// version; cursor pagination (limit default 100, max 1000). Top level carries extractorVersion and
// classifierGen. Empty pages and errors are no-store.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {TICKER_RE,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {cacheHeadersFor,docParams,publicDocs,publicDocumentView,resolveDocIssuer} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import type {DocListParams} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION} from '@/lib/documents/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const {ticker:raw}=await params;const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
 if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400);
 let q:DocListParams;
 try{q=docParams(new URL(req.url),today);}catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {tables,db}=publicDocs();
  const issuer=await resolveDocIssuer(tables,ticker,today);
  if(!issuer)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
  const page=await db.readDocuments(issuer.issuerId,{asOf:q.asOf,source:q.source,docClass:q.docClass,from:q.from,to:q.to,allVersions:q.versions,cursor:q.cursor,limit:q.limit});
  const rows=page.rows.filter(r=>r.permission==='public');   // RLS already does this; defence in depth
  const body={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,asOf:q.asOf,extractorVersion:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,classifierGen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,documents:rows.map(publicDocumentView),nextCursor:page.nextCursor};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:cacheHeadersFor(rows.length===0?'empty':'public',q.asOf,now)});
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='invalid_input')return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:cursor','invalid cursor',400);
  return failureResponse(e,'documents','documents read failed');
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/route.ts
// One document (spec §9): metadata, assets, extractions (cursor `extractionsCursor`, 100 per page),
// supersedes / supersededBy. Public documents through the anon client with a public cache; any other
// id is 404 (the owner branch for licensed/private documents is added by Task 12).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {cacheHeadersFor,cursorParam,docDetail,notFound,publicDocs} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 let extractionsCursor:string|null;
 try{extractionsCursor=cursorParam(readParams(new URL(req.url),['extractionsCursor']),'extractionsCursor');}catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public')return NextResponse.json(await docDetail(db,row,extractionsCursor),{headers:cacheHeadersFor('public',undefined,now)});
  return notFound();   // owner branch: Task 12
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'documents/doc','document read failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route.ts
// One page of one extraction (spec §9): `extraction` (default: the document's current extraction;
// must belong to the document), `layout=1` adds lines and tables from pages.json (read from the
// private bucket by the server and hash-checked). Public documents only here (owner branch: Task 12).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {QueryError,UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,flagParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {cacheHeadersFor,notFound,pageDetail,publicDocs,serviceStore} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;n:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id,n}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 if(!/^\d{1,6}$/.test(n)||Number(n)<1)return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:n','invalid page number',400);
 const pageNo=Number(n);
 let extraction:string|null,layout:boolean;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),['extraction','layout']);
  extraction=p.get('extraction')??null;
  if(extraction!==null&&!UUID_RE.test(extraction))throw new QueryError('extraction');
  layout=flagParam(p,'layout');
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public'){
   const body=await pageDetail(db,serviceStore(),row,pageNo,extraction,layout);
   return body?NextResponse.json(body,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('public',undefined,now)}):notFound();
  }
  return notFound();   // owner branch: Task 12
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'documents/page','page read failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/file/route.ts
// Our copy of a document (spec §8.1, §9): signed-in users only (401 unauthenticated otherwise), a
// signed URL valid 300 s for the browser's immediate download; private, no-store. Public documents
// here; licensed/private documents are 404 for non-owners (owner branch: Task 12).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {PRIVATE_HEADERS,SIGNED_URL_SECONDS,notFound,publicDocs,serviceStore,sessionUserId} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(_req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 try{
  const userId=await sessionUserId();
  if(!userId)return errorResponse('unauthenticated','sign in required',401);
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public'){
   const issued=Date.now();
   const url=await serviceStore().signedUrl(row.storage_path,SIGNED_URL_SECONDS);
   return NextResponse.json({url,expiresAt:new Date(issued+SIGNED_URL_SECONDS*1000).toISOString()},{headers:{...PRIVATE_HEADERS}});
  }
  return notFound();   // owner branch: Task 12
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'documents/file','file link failed');}
}
```

`src/app/api/admin/documents/[id]/reprocess/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/[id]/reprocess/route.ts
// Admin reprocess (spec §9): requireAdminUser, JSON content type and same-origin check as
// /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]. body {stage:'extract'|'classify'}.
// extract → requestExtract (a version for the current EXTRACTOR_VERSION/TABLE_ALGO_VERSION already
//   exists → 409 revision_exists), then, when DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED=1 and a deployment SHA is
//   known, one runDocumentsExtract({documentIds:[id]}) right away; otherwise the document waits in
//   'stored' for the cron or scripts/documents/extract.ts (run.state 'skipped' with the reason).
// classify → classify() on the stored form_type/title/source_ref (listed sources only; uploads 409
//   not_classifiable) → reclassifyDocument with classifier_gen = CLASSIFIER_GEN.
// Audit 'document.reprocess' through research_audit_log after the change is committed; an audit
// failure is logged (the change stands). Responses private, no-store.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {audit} from '@/lib/research/store';
import type {ResearchSupabase} from '@/lib/research/store';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/db';
import {classify} from '@/lib/documents/classify';
import {productionExtractDeps} from '@/lib/documents/extract/deps';
import {runDocumentsExtract} from '@/lib/documents/extract/run';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,DocumentsDbError} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import type {DocumentRow} from '@/lib/documents/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const UUID_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000;
const H={'Cache-Control':'private, no-store'};
const json=(body:unknown,status=200)=>NextResponse.json(body,{status,headers:H});
type Run={state:'extracted'|'no_text_layer'|'failed'|'skipped';code?:string;extractionId?:string};

async function extractNow(admin:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>,id:string):Promise<Run>{
 if(process.env.DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED!=='1')return {state:'skipped',code:'extract_disabled'};
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return {state:'skipped',code:'code_version_unavailable'};
 try{
  const r=await runDocumentsExtract(productionExtractDeps({deadline:new Date(Date.now()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion,admin}),{limit:1,documentIds:[id],dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'manual'});
  const d=r.documents[0];
  if(!d)return {state:'skipped',code:'not_due'};
  return d.outcome==='extracted'||d.outcome==='no_text_layer'?{state:d.outcome,extractionId:d.extractionId}:{state:d.outcome==='failed'?'failed':'skipped',code:d.code};
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[admin/documents/reprocess] extract',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return {state:'failed',code:'extract_failed'};
 }
}

function classifyPatch(row:DocumentRow){
 if(row.source==='upload')return null;
 const c=classify(row.source,{form_type:row.form_type??undefined,title:row.title,headline:row.form_type??undefined,source_ref:row.source_ref});
 return {doc_class:c.doc_class,classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,fiscal_year:c.fiscal_year,fiscal_period:c.fiscal_period,period_end:c.period_end,filing_source_ref:c.filing_source_ref};
}

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  if(!(request.headers.get('content-type')??'').toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json'))return json({error:'unsupported_media_type'},415);
  const origin=request.headers.get('origin');
  if(origin!==null&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)return json({error:'forbidden_origin'},403);
  const {id}=await params;
  if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return json({error:'invalid_id'},400);
  const body:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const stage=(body as {stage?:unknown}|null)?.stage;
  if(stage!=='extract'&&stage!=='classify')return json({error:'invalid_stage'},400);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const db=supabaseDocumentsDb(admin);
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(!row)return json({id,error:'not_found'},404);
  let result:Record<string,unknown>;
  if(stage==='classify'){
   const patch=classifyPatch(row);
   if(!patch)return json({id,error:'not_classifiable'},409);
   await db.reclassifyDocument(id,patch,user.id);
   result={id,stage,patch};
  }else{
   try{await db.requestExtract(id,user.id);}
   catch(e){if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='revision_exists')return json({id,error:'revision_exists'},409);throw e;}
   result={id,stage,run:await extractNow(admin,id)};
  }
  try{await audit({supabase:admin as unknown as ResearchSupabase,userId:user.id},'document.reprocess',id,result);}
  catch(auditError){console.error('[admin/documents/reprocess] audit failed',auditError instanceof Error?auditError.message:auditError);}
  return json(result);
 }catch(error){
  if(error instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return json({error:'authentication required'},401);
  if(error instanceof AdminForbidden)return json({error:'admin role required'},403);
  console.error('[admin/documents/reprocess]',error instanceof Error?error.message:error);
  return json({error:'reprocess unavailable'},500);
 }
}
```

### Task 12: 授权上传与持有人读取路径

**Files:** Create: `src/lib/documents/upload.ts` / Modify: `src/lib/documents/read-route.ts`（Task 11）、`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/route.ts`、`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route.ts`、`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/file/route.ts`、`src/app/api/citations/[id]/route.ts`（均 Task 11） / Test: `src/lib/documents/upload.test.ts`、`src/app/api/documents/owner-routes.test.ts`
**Spec:** §8.2、§8.3、§1.1 第 5 条、§11.1（owner A → owner B）、§12 F3-5、验收样例 6
**Depends on:** Task 11

要点：持有人分支 = 公共查询未命中 → 会话 → `readOwnedDocument`（service 读文档 → 非公共且 `owner_user_id = 会话用户`，否则 null → 与"不存在"相同的 404）→ `load()` 读出全部要返回的内容（service db / service store）→ `research_audit_log` 审计（`src/lib/research/store.ts::audit(ctx,action,objectId,detail)`，ctx = `{supabase: admin, userId: owner}`，`object_type` 由 action 前缀得 `document`）→ 返回 `private, no-store`；审计失败 → 500 `audit_failed`，不返回内容（签名 URL 也不返回）。真实角色层面"anon/authenticated 直接查表读不到 licensed 行"由 Task 1/3 的 `documents.integration.test.ts` 覆盖；本任务覆盖路由与审计行为。

```ts
// src/lib/documents/upload.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from './memory-documents-db';
import {blobPath,memoryObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {OWNER_A,OWNER_B,ISSUER,seedPublicDocument,seedUpload,withOverride} from './test-seed';
import {ingestUpload,readOwnedDocument,OwnerAuditError,UploadError} from './upload';
import type {UploadDeps,UploadInput} from './upload';
import {sha256Hex} from './extract/pages-json';
import {MAX_DOC_BYTES} from './types';
import type {DocumentsDb,ObjectStore} from './types';

const NOW=new Date('2026-11-05T20:00:00.000Z');   // 2026-11-06 in UTC+8
const pdf=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(`%PDF-1.7 ${s}`);
function harness(){
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();const store=memoryObjectStore();
 const tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id']});
 const deps:UploadDeps={db,store,tables,now:()=>NOW,codeVersion:'c'.repeat(40)};
 return {db,store,tables,deps};
}
const input=(o:Partial<UploadInput>={}):UploadInput=>({ownerUserId:OWNER_A,bytes:pdf('note'),filename:'C:\\reports\\GS note.pdf',mime:'application/pdf',permission:'licensed',license:{ref:'gs-2026-11'},...o});
const code=async(p:Promise<unknown>)=>{try{await p;return null;}catch(e){return e instanceof UploadError?e.code:String(e);}};

describe('ingestUpload',()=>{
 it('object first, then an upload row owned by the uploader; batch receipt; UTC+8 available_date',async()=>{
  const {db,store,tables,deps}=harness();
  const bytes=pdf('note');const sha=sha256Hex(bytes);
  const r=await ingestUpload(deps,input({issuerId:ISSUER,title:'GS initiation'}));
  expect(r.duplicate).toBe(false);
  expect(store.objects().get(blobPath(sha,'application/pdf'))?.bytes).toEqual(bytes);
  expect((await db.documentById(r.documentId))!).toMatchObject({source:'upload',market:'other',source_ref:`${OWNER_A}/${sha}`,source_version:1,doc_class:'other',title:'GS initiation',language:null,source_url:null,
   content_sha256:sha,bytes:bytes.length,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:`blobs/${sha}.pdf`,acquisition:{uploaded_at:NOW.toISOString(),filename:'GS note.pdf'},published_at:NOW.toISOString(),
   published_at_precision:'instant',available_at:NOW.toISOString(),available_date:'2026-11-06',permission:'licensed',owner_user_id:OWNER_A,license_ref:'gs-2026-11',issuer_id:ISSUER,status:'stored'});
  const [batch]=(tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).rows('ingest_batches');
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({producer:'documents-upload',dataset:'documents.upload',triggered_by:'manual',status:'success',counts:{fetched:1,inserted:1}});
 });
 it('same owner + same bytes → duplicate; another owner → own row sharing the object',async()=>{
  const {db,store,deps}=harness();
  const a=await ingestUpload(deps,input());
  const again=await ingestUpload(deps,input({filename:'renamed.pdf'}));
  expect(again).toEqual({documentId:a.documentId,duplicate:true});
  const b=await ingestUpload(deps,input({ownerUserId:OWNER_B,permission:'private',license:undefined}));
  expect(b.duplicate).toBe(false);
  expect(b.documentId).not.toBe(a.documentId);
  expect((await db.documentById(b.documentId))!).toMatchObject({owner_user_id:OWNER_B,permission:'private',license_ref:null,title:'GS note.pdf'});
  expect(store.objects().size).toBe(1);
 });
 it('validates owner, mime, permission, issuer, licence, size, magic and filename',async()=>{
  const {deps}=harness();
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({ownerUserId:'me'})))).toBe('invalid_input');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({mime:'text/html'})))).toBe('unsupported_mime');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({permission:'public' as 'licensed'})))).toBe('invalid_input');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({issuerId:'0268.HK'})))).toBe('invalid_input');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({license:{ref:' '}})))).toBe('invalid_input');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({bytes:new Uint8Array(0)})))).toBe('empty');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({bytes:new Uint8Array(MAX_DOC_BYTES+1)})))).toBe('too_large');
  expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({bytes:new TextEncoder().encode('<html>')})))).toBe('not_pdf');
  for(const filename of ['','dir/','a\u0000b.pdf','x'.repeat(256)])expect(await code(ingestUpload(deps,input({filename}))),JSON.stringify(filename)).toBe('invalid_input');
 });
 it('a failed object put writes no row and finishes the batch failed',async()=>{
  const {db,tables,deps}=harness();
  const broken=withOverride<ObjectStore>(deps.store,{put:async()=>{throw new Error('storage down');}});
  await expect(ingestUpload({...deps,store:broken},input())).rejects.toThrow('storage down');
  expect(db.documents()).toEqual([]);
  expect((tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).rows('ingest_batches')[0]).toMatchObject({status:'failed',counts:{failed:1}});
 });
});

describe('readOwnedDocument',()=>{
 async function setup(){
  const db=memoryDocumentsDb();
  const mine=await seedUpload(db,OWNER_A,pdf('a'));
  const pub=await seedPublicDocument(db,pdf('p'));
  const audit=vi.fn(async()=>{});
  return {db,mine,pub,audit,deps:{db:db as DocumentsDb,audit}};
 }
 it('owner: load, then audit document.read with the route detail, then return',async()=>{
  const {mine,audit,deps}=await setup();
  const order:string[]=[];
  audit.mockImplementation(async()=>{order.push('audit');});
  const r=await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:mine,requester:OWNER_A,route:'documents/page',pageNo:3,load:async d=>{order.push('load');return d.title;}});
  expect(r?.data).toBe('broker note.pdf');
  expect(order).toEqual(['load','audit']);
  expect(audit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(OWNER_A,'document.read',mine,{route:'documents/page',requester:OWNER_A,page_no:3});
  await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:mine,requester:OWNER_A,route:'documents/file',signedUrlIssued:true,load:async()=>'u'});
  expect(audit).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(OWNER_A,'document.read',mine,{route:'documents/file',requester:OWNER_A,signed_url_issued:true});
 });
 it('another owner, a public document, a missing id or a null load → null and no audit',async()=>{
  const {mine,pub,audit,deps}=await setup();
  const load=vi.fn(async()=>'x');
  expect(await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:mine,requester:OWNER_B,route:'documents/doc',load})).toBeNull();
  expect(await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:pub,requester:OWNER_A,route:'documents/doc',load})).toBeNull();
  expect(await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',requester:OWNER_A,route:'documents/doc',load})).toBeNull();
  expect(load).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:mine,requester:OWNER_A,route:'documents/page',load:async()=>null})).toBeNull();
  expect(audit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('an audit failure throws OwnerAuditError and returns nothing',async()=>{
  const {mine,audit,deps}=await setup();
  audit.mockRejectedValue(new Error('insert failed'));
  await expect(readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:mine,requester:OWNER_A,route:'citations',citationId:'c',load:async()=>'secret'})).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(OwnerAuditError);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/owner-routes.test.ts
// Owner branches (Task 12, spec §8.2): a licensed document of owner A is invisible to anon (404, file
// 401) and to owner B (404, nothing audited); owner A gets doc/page/file/citation with
// 'private, no-store' and one research_audit_log row per read; an audit failure is a 500.
import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import type {DocumentsDb,ObjectStore} from '@/lib/documents/types';

const S=vi.hoisted(()=>({anon:null as unknown,db:null as unknown,store:null as unknown,user:null as string|null,audit:vi.fn()}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/anon',()=>({getAnonSupabase:()=>({__role:'anon'})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/admin',()=>({getAdminSupabase:()=>({__role:'service'})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/server',()=>({getServerSupabase:async()=>({auth:{getUser:async()=>({data:{user:S.user?{id:S.user}:null},error:null})}})}));
vi.mock('@/lib/documents/db',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/documents/db')>(),supabaseDocumentsDb:(c:{__role:string})=>c.__role==='anon'?S.anon:S.db}));
vi.mock('@/lib/documents/object-store',async(orig)=>({...await orig<typeof import('@/lib/documents/object-store')>(),supabaseObjectStore:()=>S.store}));
vi.mock('@/lib/research/store',()=>({audit:S.audit}));

import {GET as docGET} from './doc/[id]/route';
import {GET as pageGET} from './doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route';
import {GET as fileGET} from './doc/[id]/file/route';
import {GET as citationGET} from '../citations/[id]/route';
import {memoryDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/memory-documents-db';
import {memoryObjectStore} from '@/lib/documents/object-store';
import {OWNER_A,OWNER_B,rlsView,seedExtraction,seedPublicDocument,seedUpload,withOverride} from '@/lib/documents/test-seed';
import {cite} from '@/lib/documents/citations';

const BASE='https://alpha.example';
const enc=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const doc=(id:string)=>docGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});
const page=(id:string,n:string,qs='')=>pageGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}/pages/${n}?${qs}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id,n})});
const file=(id:string)=>fileGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/documents/doc/${id}/file`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});
const citation=(id:string)=>citationGET(new Request(`${BASE}/api/citations/${id}`),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});

let licensed:string,ext:string,cid:string,pub:string,internalPublic:string;
beforeEach(async()=>{
 vi.clearAllMocks();
 const db=memoryDocumentsDb();const store=memoryObjectStore();
 S.db=db;S.anon=rlsView(db as DocumentsDb);S.user=null;S.audit.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
 S.store=withOverride<ObjectStore>(store,{signedUrl:async(p:string,s:number)=>`https://signed.example/${p}?e=${s}`});
 licensed=await seedUpload(db,OWNER_A,enc('%PDF-licensed'),{},store);
 ext=await seedExtraction(db,licensed,['𠀋😀 target price 120'],{store});
 cid=await cite(db,{document_id:licensed,extraction_id:ext,page_no:1,char_start:3,char_end:15,created_by:'module',created_ref:'foreign-research'});
 pub=await seedPublicDocument(db,enc('%PDF-public'),{},store);
 const pubExt=await seedExtraction(db,pub,['public text'],{store});
 internalPublic=await cite(db,{document_id:pub,extraction_id:pubExt,page_no:1,char_start:0,char_end:6,created_by:'extractor',created_ref:'x'});
});

describe('licensed document, owner A',()=>{
 it('anonymous: 404 for doc/page/citation, 401 for file; nothing audited',async()=>{
  for(const r of [await doc(licensed),await page(licensed,'1'),await citation(cid)]){expect(r.status).toBe(404);expect(r.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');}
  expect((await file(licensed)).status).toBe(401);
  expect(S.audit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('owner B: the same 404 for all four; nothing audited',async()=>{
  S.user=OWNER_B;
  for(const r of [await doc(licensed),await page(licensed,'1'),await file(licensed),await citation(cid)]){
   expect(r.status).toBe(404);
   expect(await r.json()).toEqual({error:{code:'not_found',message:'not found'}});
  }
  expect(S.audit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('owner A: all four with private, no-store, each audited once as document.read (audit scoped to the owner)',async()=>{
  S.user=OWNER_A;
  const d=await doc(licensed);
  expect(d.status).toBe(200);
  expect(d.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  expect((await d.json()).document).toMatchObject({documentId:licensed,permission:'licensed',licenseRef:'lic-1',sourceUrl:null});
  const p=await page(licensed,'1','layout=1');
  expect(p.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  expect(await p.json()).toMatchObject({pageNo:1,text:'𠀋😀 target price 120',lines:[{charStart:0,charEnd:19}]});
  const f=await file(licensed);
  expect(f.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  expect((await f.json()).url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/signed\.example\/blobs\/[0-9a-f]{64}\.pdf\?e=300$/);
  const c=await citation(cid);
  expect(c.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  expect(await c.json()).toMatchObject({citationId:cid,snippet:'target price',integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,createdBy:'module'});
  const calls=S.audit.mock.calls.map(([ctx,action,id,detail])=>[(ctx as {userId:string}).userId,action,id,detail]);
  expect(calls).toEqual([
   [OWNER_A,'document.read',licensed,{route:'documents/doc',requester:OWNER_A}],
   [OWNER_A,'document.read',licensed,{route:'documents/page',requester:OWNER_A,page_no:1}],
   [OWNER_A,'document.read',licensed,{route:'documents/file',requester:OWNER_A,signed_url_issued:true}],
   [OWNER_A,'document.read',licensed,{route:'citations',requester:OWNER_A,citation_id:cid}],
  ]);
 });
 it('owner A: a missing page is 404 and not audited; an audit failure is 500 audit_failed with no content',async()=>{
  S.user=OWNER_A;
  expect((await page(licensed,'2')).status).toBe(404);
  expect(S.audit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  S.audit.mockRejectedValue(new Error('insert failed'));
  for(const r of [await doc(licensed),await page(licensed,'1'),await file(licensed),await citation(cid)]){
   expect(r.status).toBe(500);
   const body=JSON.stringify(await r.json());
   expect(body).toContain('audit_failed');
   expect(body).not.toContain('target price');
   expect(body).not.toContain('signed.example');
  }
 });
});

describe('public documents are not affected by the owner branch',()=>{
 it('signed-in users read public documents without audit; an internal citation of a public document stays 404 even for a signed-in user',async()=>{
  S.user=OWNER_A;
  expect((await doc(pub)).headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(/^public, s-maxage=/);
  expect((await file(pub)).status).toBe(200);
  expect((await citation(internalPublic)).status).toBe(404);
  expect(S.audit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
});
```

`src/lib/documents/upload.ts`：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/upload.ts
// Licensed / private documents (spec §8.2–8.3).
// ingestUpload: the interface the foreign-research spec calls. PDF only (mime and %PDF- magic),
//   1..MAX_DOC_BYTES bytes, permission 'licensed'|'private' (never public), optional issuer and licence
//   ref. One ingest_batches row (producer documents-upload, dataset documents.upload, triggered_by
//   manual) → object first (blobs/<sha256>.pdf, content-addressed: an object shared with another
//   owner answers 'exists') → insert_upload_document (source 'upload', source_ref
//   '<owner>/<sha256>', published_at = available_at = now, precision instant, available_date = the
//   UTC+8 calendar day, source_url null, acquisition {uploaded_at, filename}, doc_class 'other') →
//   duplicate for the same owner and hash. Extraction picks the row up like any stored document
//   (candidates_role 'none').
// readOwnedDocument: the owner read path of the doc/pages/file/citations routes. Not public, owner =
//   requester (else null → the route answers 404, indistinguishable from a missing id) → load() the
//   response through the service db → audit 'document.read' (research_audit_log, object_type
//   'document', detail {route, requester, page_no?, citation_id?, signed_url_issued?}) → return. The
//   audit is written after everything that will be returned is loaded and before it is returned; an
//   audit failure throws OwnerAuditError (route → 500 audit_failed), so nothing is returned unaudited.
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {blobPath} from './object-store';
import {sha256Hex} from './extract/pages-json';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN,MAX_DOC_BYTES} from './types';
import type {DocumentInsert,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ObjectStore} from './types';

export type UploadErrorCode='invalid_input'|'unsupported_mime'|'empty'|'too_large'|'not_pdf';
export class UploadError extends Error{constructor(public code:UploadErrorCode,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='UploadError';}}
export interface UploadDeps{db:Pick<DocumentsDb,'insertUploadDocument'>;store:ObjectStore;tables:TableClient;now:()=>Date;codeVersion:string}
export interface UploadInput{ownerUserId:string;bytes:Uint8Array;filename:string;mime:string;permission:'licensed'|'private';license?:{ref:string};issuerId?:string;title?:string}

const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const CONTROL=/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/;
/** Last path component, trimmed; 1..255 code points, no control characters. */
function cleanFilename(name:string):string{
 const base=(name.split(/[\\/]/).pop()??'').trim();
 if(base===''||Array.from(base).length>255||CONTROL.test(base))throw new UploadError('invalid_input','filename');
 return base;
}
const utc8Date=(d:Date)=>new Date(d.getTime()+8*3_600_000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

export async function ingestUpload(deps:UploadDeps,input:UploadInput):Promise<{documentId:string;duplicate:boolean}>{
 if(!UUID.test(input.ownerUserId))throw new UploadError('invalid_input','owner');
 if(input.mime!=='application/pdf')throw new UploadError('unsupported_mime');
 if(input.permission!=='licensed'&&input.permission!=='private')throw new UploadError('invalid_input','permission');
 if(input.issuerId!==undefined&&!UUID.test(input.issuerId))throw new UploadError('invalid_input','issuer');
 if(input.license!==undefined&&(typeof input.license.ref!=='string'||input.license.ref.trim()===''||input.license.ref.length>200))throw new UploadError('invalid_input','license');
 if(input.bytes.length===0)throw new UploadError('empty');
 if(input.bytes.length>MAX_DOC_BYTES)throw new UploadError('too_large');
 if(new TextDecoder().decode(input.bytes.subarray(0,5))!=='%PDF-')throw new UploadError('not_pdf');
 const filename=cleanFilename(input.filename);
 const title=(input.title??filename).trim();
 if(title===''||Array.from(title).length>500)throw new UploadError('invalid_input','title');
 const sha=sha256Hex(input.bytes);const now=deps.now();const at=now.toISOString();
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'documents-upload',dataset:'documents.upload',codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:'manual'});
 const counts={...emptyCounts(),fetched:1};
 try{
  const storage_path=blobPath(sha,'application/pdf');
  await deps.store.put(storage_path,input.bytes,'application/pdf');
  const doc:DocumentInsert={issuer_id:input.issuerId??null,source:'upload',market:'other',source_ref:`${input.ownerUserId}/${sha}`,form_type:null,doc_class:'other',classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,
   title,language:null,source_url:null,content_sha256:sha,bytes:input.bytes.length,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path,acquisition:{uploaded_at:at,filename},
   published_at:at,published_at_precision:'instant',available_at:at,available_date:utc8Date(now),fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:null,filing_source_ref:null,
   permission:input.permission,owner_user_id:input.ownerUserId,license_ref:input.license?.ref.trim()??null,batch_id:batchId,code_version:deps.codeVersion};
  const r=await deps.db.insertUploadDocument(input.ownerUserId,doc);
  if(r.outcome==='duplicate')counts.duplicates++;else counts.inserted++;
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[]},deps.now());
  return {documentId:r.document_id,duplicate:r.outcome==='duplicate'};
 }catch(e){
  counts.failed++;
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[{code:'upload_failed',message:e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}]},deps.now()).catch(()=>undefined);
  throw e;
 }
}

export class OwnerAuditError extends Error{readonly code='audit_failed';constructor(message:string){super(message);this.name='OwnerAuditError';}}
export interface OwnerReadDeps{db:DocumentsDb;audit:(userId:string,action:string,objectId:string,detail:Record<string,unknown>)=>Promise<void>}
export interface OwnerReadInput<T>{documentId:string;requester:string;route:string;pageNo?:number;citationId?:string;signedUrlIssued?:boolean;load:(doc:DocumentRow)=>Promise<T|null>}

export async function readOwnedDocument<T>(deps:OwnerReadDeps,input:OwnerReadInput<T>):Promise<{doc:DocumentRow;data:T}|null>{
 const doc=await deps.db.documentById(input.documentId);
 if(!doc||doc.permission==='public'||doc.owner_user_id===null||doc.owner_user_id!==input.requester)return null;
 const data=await input.load(doc);
 if(data===null)return null;
 const detail:Record<string,unknown>={route:input.route,requester:input.requester};
 if(input.pageNo!==undefined)detail.page_no=input.pageNo;
 if(input.citationId!==undefined)detail.citation_id=input.citationId;
 if(input.signedUrlIssued)detail.signed_url_issued=true;
 try{await deps.audit(doc.owner_user_id,'document.read',doc.document_id,detail);}
 catch(e){throw new OwnerAuditError(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e));}
 return {doc,data};
}
```

`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/route.ts
// One document (spec §9): metadata, assets, extractions (cursor `extractionsCursor`, 100 per page),
// supersedes / supersededBy. Public documents through the anon client with a public cache. Owner
// branch (spec §8.2): a licensed/private document is returned only to its owner's session, read with
// the service client, audited before it is returned ('private, no-store'; audit failure → 500).
// Everyone else gets the same 404 as for a missing id.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {auditFailedResponse,cacheHeadersFor,cursorParam,docDetail,notFound,ownerDocumentView,ownerReadDeps,publicDocs,sessionUserId} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import {OwnerAuditError,readOwnedDocument} from '@/lib/documents/upload';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 let extractionsCursor:string|null;
 try{extractionsCursor=cursorParam(readParams(new URL(req.url),['extractionsCursor']),'extractionsCursor');}catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public')return NextResponse.json(await docDetail(db,row,extractionsCursor),{headers:cacheHeadersFor('public',undefined,now)});
  const userId=await sessionUserId();
  if(userId){
   const deps=ownerReadDeps();
   const owned=await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:id,requester:userId,route:'documents/doc',load:async d=>({...await docDetail(deps.db,d,extractionsCursor),document:ownerDocumentView(d)})});
   if(owned)return NextResponse.json(owned.data,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('private',undefined,now)});
  }
  return notFound();
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof OwnerAuditError)return auditFailedResponse();
  return failureResponse(e,'documents/doc','document read failed');
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/pages/[n]/route.ts
// One page of one extraction (spec §9): `extraction` (default: the document's current extraction;
// must belong to the document), `layout=1` adds lines and tables from pages.json (read from the
// private bucket by the server and hash-checked). Public documents with a public cache; the owner of
// a licensed/private document through the audited owner branch (spec §8.2, private, no-store).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {QueryError,UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,flagParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {auditFailedResponse,cacheHeadersFor,notFound,ownerReadDeps,pageDetail,publicDocs,serviceStore,sessionUserId} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import {OwnerAuditError,readOwnedDocument} from '@/lib/documents/upload';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;n:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id,n}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 if(!/^\d{1,6}$/.test(n)||Number(n)<1)return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:n','invalid page number',400);
 const pageNo=Number(n);
 let extraction:string|null,layout:boolean;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),['extraction','layout']);
  extraction=p.get('extraction')??null;
  if(extraction!==null&&!UUID_RE.test(extraction))throw new QueryError('extraction');
  layout=flagParam(p,'layout');
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public'){
   const body=await pageDetail(db,serviceStore(),row,pageNo,extraction,layout);
   return body?NextResponse.json(body,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('public',undefined,now)}):notFound();
  }
  const userId=await sessionUserId();
  if(userId){
   const deps=ownerReadDeps();
   const owned=await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:id,requester:userId,route:'documents/page',pageNo,load:d=>pageDetail(deps.db,serviceStore(),d,pageNo,extraction,layout)});
   if(owned)return NextResponse.json(owned.data,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('private',undefined,now)});
  }
  return notFound();
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof OwnerAuditError)return auditFailedResponse();
  return failureResponse(e,'documents/page','page read failed');
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/file/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/documents/doc/[id]/file/route.ts
// Our copy of a document (spec §8.1, §9): signed-in users only (401 unauthenticated otherwise), a
// signed URL valid 300 s for the browser's immediate download; private, no-store. Public documents
// for any signed-in user; a licensed/private document only for its owner, the URL issued and the
// read audited (signed_url_issued) before it is returned (audit failure → 500, no URL). Everyone
// else: 404.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {PRIVATE_HEADERS,SIGNED_URL_SECONDS,auditFailedResponse,notFound,ownerReadDeps,publicDocs,serviceStore,sessionUserId} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import {OwnerAuditError,readOwnedDocument} from '@/lib/documents/upload';
import type {DocumentRow} from '@/lib/documents/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

async function signed(row:DocumentRow){
 const issued=Date.now();
 const url=await serviceStore().signedUrl(row.storage_path,SIGNED_URL_SECONDS);
 return {url,expiresAt:new Date(issued+SIGNED_URL_SECONDS*1000).toISOString()};
}

export async function GET(_req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 try{
  const userId=await sessionUserId();
  if(!userId)return errorResponse('unauthenticated','sign in required',401);
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const row=await db.documentById(id);
  if(row&&row.permission==='public')return NextResponse.json(await signed(row),{headers:{...PRIVATE_HEADERS}});
  const owned=await readOwnedDocument(ownerReadDeps(),{documentId:id,requester:userId,route:'documents/file',signedUrlIssued:true,load:signed});
  if(owned)return NextResponse.json(owned.data,{headers:{...PRIVATE_HEADERS}});
  return notFound();
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof OwnerAuditError)return auditFailedResponse();
  return failureResponse(e,'documents/file','file link failed');
 }
}
```

`src/app/api/citations/[id]/route.ts`：

```ts
// src/app/api/citations/[id]/route.ts
// One citation (spec §4.5, §9): snippet, offsets (code points), bbox, integrity (page text hash and
// slice re-checked), currentExtraction, creator and the document summary. Visible to anon only when
// RLS shows it (public document and: visibility public, or cited by an ok fact), with a public cache.
// A citation of a licensed/private document is returned only to the document's owner (service read,
// audited with citation_id before it is returned; private, no-store). Everyone else: 404.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {auditFailedResponse,cacheHeadersFor,notFound,ownerReadDeps,publicDocs,sessionUserId} from '@/lib/documents/read-route';
import {citationView} from '@/lib/documents/citations';
import {OwnerAuditError,readOwnedDocument} from '@/lib/documents/upload';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(_req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 try{
  const {db}=publicDocs();
  const c=await db.citationById(id);
  if(c){
   const view=await citationView(db,c);
   if(view)return NextResponse.json(view,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('public',undefined,now)});
  }
  const userId=await sessionUserId();
  if(userId){
   const deps=ownerReadDeps();
   const own=await deps.db.citationById(id);
   if(own){
    const owned=await readOwnedDocument(deps,{documentId:own.document_id,requester:userId,route:'citations',citationId:id,load:()=>citationView(deps.db,own)});
    if(owned)return NextResponse.json(owned.data,{headers:cacheHeadersFor('private',undefined,now)});
   }
  }
  return notFound();
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof OwnerAuditError)return auditFailedResponse();
  return failureResponse(e,'citations','citation read failed');
 }
}
```

## Part D1（Task 13–14）：迁移二、`HkFactsPort` 与港股候选生成

本 Part 的两个任务都只新增 `src/lib/documents/hk-facts/*`、迁移二与夹具，并在共享文件里加 `// F3` 块；不改 `src/lib/facts/*` 任何已有文件、不替换规格二任何 SQL 函数或触发器。

### Part D1 契约变更请求（已整合）

> 整合状态：本节保留各 Part 的原始提案以便追溯；每条的裁决见文末「整合记录」，定稿签名以本计划头部「共享契约」与「契约补充」为准。

| # | 名称 / 签名 | 理由 |
|---|---|---|
| D1-1 | `pgHkFactsPort(pool:Pool):HkFactsPort` 放在 **`src/lib/documents/hk-facts/pg-facts-port.ts`**（仅测试用），不在 `facts-port.ts` | `pg` 实现要 import `src/lib/facts/pg-facts-db.ts` → `src/lib/db/pg-table-client.ts`（运行时 `import {types} from 'pg'`），两者文件头都声明"src/app 与 src/lib 生产代码不 import"。`facts-port.ts` 会被晋升与管理路由 import，因此把 pg 实现拆到同目录独立文件，与 `facts/pg-facts-db.ts` 同一纪律。名字与签名不变，只是路径。Task 18 的 `sync-hk.integration.test.ts` 从 `./hk-facts/pg-facts-port` import |
| D1-2 | `facts-port.ts` 额外导出：`HK_MARKET:Market`（`'HK'` 的唯一类型断言）、`toFilingInsert(row:HkFilingInsert):FilingInsert`、`planHkFactWrites(input:Omit<PlanInput,'market'>):PlanResult`、`evaluateHkFactRules(input:Omit<FactRulesInput,'market'>):FactRulesResult`、`asDocumentsDbError(e:unknown):DocumentsDbError`、类型 `HkPublicationOutcome={published;still_staged;abandoned}`、`HkResolveOutcome={promoted;skipped;chosenFactIds}` | 规格 §7.7 要求 "`planFactWrites` 经同一文件调用"、"identity_bs/identity_gp 经端口调用规格二 rules.ts 的纯函数"，且 HK 类型断言只出现在 `facts-port.ts`。Task 16 的 `promote.ts` 必须用 `planHkFactWrites` / `evaluateHkFactRules` / `toFilingInsert`（`filingCandidates` 用 `rows.map(toFilingInsert)`），不得自己写 `'HK' as …` |
| D1-3 | `HkFactsPort` 的错误类型：**透传方法**（`claimLease … openConflicts`）抛 `FactsDbError`（与 `FactsDb` 一致，三实现相同）；**F3 自有方法**（`ensureHkScope … hkFilingOfDocument`、`runStatus`）抛 `DocumentsDbError`。`publishHkRun` 内部来自规格二的 `stale_plan`/`lease_lost` 也以 `DocumentsDbError` 抛出（pg/Supabase 经 `toDocumentsDbError`，内存经 `asDocumentsDbError`）；规格二其他码（`run_published` 等）归一为 `DocumentsDbError('unknown', '<code>')` | 骨架未规定；Task 16 的错误分支按此处理 |
| D1-4 | `generate.ts` 的 `ctx.cite` 具体签名：`cite:(input:CiteInput)=>Promise<string>`，`CiteInput={page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox?:{x0;y0;x1;y1}|null}`（文档、抽取版本、`created_by='extractor'`、`created_ref=HK_EXTRACTOR_REF` 由调用方 Task 15 绑定，即 `cite:(i)=>cite(db,{document_id,extraction_id,...i,created_by:'extractor',created_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF})`）；同一区间在一次生成内只调用一次（记忆化）。另导出 `naturalKey(payload)`、`canonicalJson(v)`、`GenerateContext`、`HkInfoCode` | 骨架写的是 `cite:(…)=>Promise<string>` |
| D1-5 | 新信息码不进 `INFO_CODES`，而是 `src/lib/dq/batches.ts` 的 `// F3` 块导出 **`F3_INFO_CODES`**，`isInfoError` 同时查两张表 | `src/lib/facts/rules.test.ts:64`（F3 不得修改）与 `batches.test.ts:16` 用 `toEqual` 钉死了 `INFO_CODES` 的五个值；扩数组会让规格二测试失败。`batchStatusFromCounts` 只经 `isInfoError` 判定，语义与规格 §10 相同 |
| D1-6 | SQL 侧 `hk_promotion_due(p_pub_gen int, p_extractor_ref text, p_limit int) returns uuid[]`（端口的 `promotionDue(pubGen,limit)` 传 `HK_EXTRACTOR_REF`）、`hk_zero_output_documents(p_issuer uuid, p_pub_gen int) returns uuid[]` | 条件 (ab) 需要"当前 extractor_ref"，常量只在 TS 侧；端口签名不变 |
| D1-7 | `memoryDocumentsDb` 的 `_raw` 至少含 `candidates:Map<string,CandidateRow>` 与 `publications:Map<string,PublicationRow>`，**值是活对象**（原地改字段即改库状态）；`memoryHkFactsPort` 只遍历 `.values()`，不依赖键格式 | 骨架写 `_raw:{…可变 Map，供 memoryHkFactsPort}`；`finish/abandonCandidatePublications` 要改发布行状态与候选 `confirmed→promoted`，这两个函数不在 `DocumentsDb` 里 |

### 跨 Part 假设（Part A/C 落地时需满足；不满足由集成者对齐）

- `src/lib/documents/db.ts::toDocumentsDbError(e)`：`e.code==='55P03'` 或消息首词（按 `/[\s:]/` 切）为 `lease_lost` → `'lease_lost'`；消息首词属于 `DocumentsDbErrorCode` → 该码；其余 → `'unknown'`（与 `facts/db.ts::toFactsDbError` 同法）。迁移二的异常消息**恰好是码本身**（`raise exception 'evidence_incomplete' using errcode=…, detail=…`）。
- 迁移一：表与列名按规格 §4.1–4.7；`document_citations` 的匿名/登录策略名为 **`"document_citations public read"`**，service_role 策略名为 `"document_citations service read"`（规格二同款命名 `"%s public read"`）——迁移二 `drop policy if exists "document_citations public read"` 后重建；集成测试断言 `document_citations` 上恰好这两条策略。
- 迁移一的 `extraction_candidates` 触发器允许 `confirmed→promoted`（只改 `status`），`candidate_publications` 触发器允许 `staged→published`、`staged→abandoned`、`abandoned→staged` 并允许改 `updated_at`；两者只按"列 + 状态迁移"判定，不按调用者（没有会话变量闸门）。
- `src/lib/documents/decimal.ts`（Task 4）：`parsePresented('(1,234)')={digits:'1234',negative:true}`、`parsePresented('12.34')={digits:'12.34',negative:false}`、`parsePresented('–'|'-'|'—')==='dash'`、`parsePresented('n/a')===null`；`scaleDecimal('1234','1000')==='1234000'`、`scaleDecimal('12.34','0.01')==='0.1234'`、`scaleDecimal('10.50','0.01')==='0.105'`；`negate('5')==='-5'`、`negate('-5')==='5'`；结果都是 `canonicalDecimal` 形式。
- `memoryDocumentsDb()` 不校验 `issuer_id`/`batch_id`/`decided_by` 外键；其 `finishExtract` 按规格 §7.3 判定 `candidates_role`（`market='HK'` 年报/中报且有文本层 → `language='zh'` 为 `primary`，否则 `comparison`）；检查方法 `documents()/extractions()/pages()/citations()/candidates()/publications()` 返回克隆。
- `pgDocumentsDb(pool)`（Task 3）调用迁移一的函数；`insertDocumentVersion` 的 `p_doc` 含 `batch_id`；`insertUploadDocument(owner,doc)` 接受 `source='upload'`、`market='other'`、`permission='private'`。
- Task 1 已在 `scripts/ci/research-checks.ts` 建立 `// F3` 的 `criticalSuites` 块（含 `src/lib/documents/documents.integration.test.ts`），在 `database.types.ts` 建立 `// F3 document pipeline` 接口块与 `Tables` 条目块。本 Part 往这两个块里追加。
- 本地测试库必须是 **UTF8** 编码：`scripts/s4/local-db.ts` 现在以 `LC_ALL=C` 运行 `initdb`，得到 `SQL_ASCII` 库，`length/substr` 按字节计（`length('𠀋')=4`），码点引用、`insert_citation` 校验与本迁移 `assert_run_evidence_complete` 的 `substr` 都会失败。F3 的较早任务（Part A Task 1）须给 `initdb` 加 `--encoding=UTF8`（`LC_ALL=C` 仍保留给 postmaster 启动）；本 Part 的集成测试依赖它。已在草稿区用加了该参数的 harness 副本 + 迁移一桩表实跑本迁移：重放两次、约束名、绑定/冲突、证据校验、`invalid_expected_rev`/`stale_plan`、直接删除被拒、级联删除、anon 可见性、`finish`/`promoted`、`hk_promotion_due`/`hk_zero_output_documents`、`resolve_hk_facts_quarantine` 钩子、`financial_metrics` 拒绝 HK 全部通过。

### 规格中发现的问题与本 Part 的处理

1. §4.9 "`delete` 仅当 `pg_trigger_depth() > 0`"：在 BEFORE DELETE 触发器函数内部，直接 `delete` 时深度已是 1（本触发器自己），级联（外键 RI 触发器 → 本触发器）时为 2。按字面 `> 0` 会放行直接删除。迁移二用 **`pg_trigger_depth() < 2` → 拒绝**，集成测试同时证明"直接删除被拒、级联删除成功"。
2. §10 要把九个信息码"加入 `INFO_CODES`"：与不可改的 `src/lib/facts/rules.test.ts` 冲突，按契约变更请求 D1-5 处理。
3. §7.5-3 "`scale=null`"：共享契约 `FinancialFactPayload.scale` 不允许 null，`value` 也无法在不知倍数时算出。处理：单位/倍数不明（无货币、无倍数词、多货币、多倍数、eps 无子单位）→ **不产候选**，记 `unit_ambiguous`（消息 `IS:no_multiplier` 等）；`unit_known` 检查因此对规则候选恒通过（Task 15 仍按 §7.6 检查，作为纵深防御）。
4. §7.5-3 `元|dollars（且不是 港元|千元|人民幣元 的一部分）→ 1`：按字面把 `人民幣元/人民币元` 当作整体货币词先剔除，所以金额表头只有"人民幣元"时倍数为空 → 不产候选（保守）。eps 的 `人民幣元` 仍按 §7.5-3 第二段为 `scale='1'`。另补 eps 子单位 `RMB cents|人民幣分 → CNY, 0.01`（否则 `RMB cents` 会先命中 `RMB` 被误判为 1）。
5. §7.5-2 "年份列按 `x` 与数值列对齐"：整合后 `LayoutLine.items`（C-1）带逐项 x，表头年份/日期按记号的 x 区间落到其下方的数值列（区间重叠 ± 20pt、取中心最近；双语表头同一列的同一记号只计一次；落空或两个不同记号争一列 → `period_unparsed`）；只有没有 items 的旧 pages.json 才退回"最右侧 k 个数值列"。没有年份的后续表（如"以下人士應佔："之后的小表）按数值列右边缘（`bbox.x1` 中位数，容差 20pt）继承上一张表的列期间。
6. §7.5-4 `equity_parent`"归属小节内"：港股 BS 的该行标签自身就是"本公司擁有人應佔權益"，前面通常没有"應佔"小节标题。处理：`equity_parent` 不要求小节（标签正则已足够专一）；`net_income_parent` 要求处在"應佔"小节内且该小节**不是**全面收益归属小节（标题含 `全面收益|comprehensive`，或标题泛指"以下人士應佔"而上一行是全面收益总额），否则 損益及其他全面收益表 里的两处"本公司擁有人"必然 `label_ambiguous`。
7. §7.5-4 "一个概念被同表多行命中 → label_ambiguous"：合并的 損益表 + 全面收益表 会重复列示"年內溢利"。处理：同一报表内命中同一概念的多行若在全部映射列上**原文完全相同**→ 视为同一披露，取第一行；否则 `label_ambiguous`。
8. §7.5-4 `net_change_in_cash` "标签含減少且值为正取负"：港股常见"增加/(減少)淨額"同时含两词，正值即增加。处理：只对**只含减少不含增加**的标签取负。
9. 期间证据 `statement_title` 有**两条**（整合时定，见整合记录）：报表名称行（如"綜合損益表"/"CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED INTERIM INCOME STATEMENT"，规格 §7.5 的"报表标题行"，Task 15 的 `consolidated` 检查读它）与标题区里的**期间短语**（如"截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度"，期间推导的依据）；两者是同一区间时只记一条。`column_header` 引用年份/日期记号本身。金额单位引用整行（货币与倍数可能分属不同记号），eps 单位引用子单位记号。
10. `bind_filing_documents` 的 `binding_conflict`：若先校验文档再查冲突，第二份文档必然先因 `source_ref` 不符被 `invalid_input` 拒绝，冲突码不可达。处理：校验 filing 之后**先**查已有绑定（不同文档 → `binding_conflict`），再校验文档与 `source_ref`。
11. `finish_candidate_publications` 对 `staged` 运行 → `run_pending`，对 `abandoned` 运行 → `invalid_input`；`abandon_candidate_publications` 对 `staged` → `run_pending`，对 `published` → `invalid_input`；运行不存在 → `not_found`。规格未写这些分支。
12. `zeroOutputDocuments(issuer,pubGen)` 精确等于条件 (d) 命中的文档（含同时有活动候选的文档）；Task 16 与活动候选集文档取并集，`stageFilings`/`bindFilingDocuments` 对重复是幂等的。

共用契约（非测试文件，同 `src/lib/facts/db-contract.ts` 的做法）：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/facts-port-contract.ts
// Shared HkFactsPort contract (spec §4.8, §4.9, §7.7; plan F3 Task 13): the same scenarios run
// against memoryHkFactsPort (facts-port.test.ts) and pgHkFactsPort (fact-citations.integration.test.ts),
// so the in-memory rules the promote.ts unit tests rely on are exactly migration two's functions.
// Not a test file: it registers describe/it only when called. Documents, extractions, citations
// and candidates are created through the DocumentsDb contract (migration one's functions), facts
// through the port, quarantine items with plan-1 quarantine() on the harness TableClient. The
// world helpers are exported for the pg-only cases of the integration test.
import {createHash,randomInt,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {quarantine} from '../../dq/quarantine';
import {FactsDbError} from '../../facts/types';
import type {FactInsert} from '../../facts/types';
import {DocumentsDbError,EXTRACTOR_VERSION,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_LABEL_GEN,HK_PUB_GEN,HK_RULES_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {CandidateInsert,CitationRole,DocumentInsert,DocumentsDb,FinancialFactPayload} from '../types';
import {HK_MARKET} from './facts-port';
import type {HkFactsPort,HkFilingInsert} from './facts-port';

export interface HkPortHarness{
 port:HkFactsPort;docs:DocumentsDb;tables:TableClient;
 issuer():Promise<string>;batch():Promise<string>;user():Promise<string>;
 expireHkLease(issuer:string):Promise<void>;
 close?():Promise<void>;
}
/** Extractor version of a world's first extraction: older than EXTRACTOR_VERSION, so request_document_extract may open a current one. */
export const OLD_EXTRACTOR_VERSION='docs-extract/0.9';
/** One statement page; supplementary-plane characters precede every cited range (code-point offsets, §4.4). */
export const HK_PAGE_TEXT=['😀𠀋 綜合損益表','截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度','附註 二零二五年 二零二四年','人民幣千元','收益 5 1,234 1,000'].join('\n');
export const sha256=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');
/** Code-point index of `needle` in `text` at or after code point `from`; -1 if absent. */
export function cpIndexOf(text:string,needle:string,from=0):number{
 const t=Array.from(text),n=Array.from(needle);
 outer:for(let i=from;i+n.length<=t.length;i++){for(let j=0;j<n.length;j++)if(t[i+j]!==n[j])continue outer;return i;}
 return -1;
}
/** Code of a DocumentsDbError rejection, 'facts:<code>' of a FactsDbError, 'resolved' when it did not reject. */
export const code=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>'resolved',e=>e instanceof DocumentsDbError?e.code:e instanceof FactsDbError?`facts:${e.code}`:`other:${String(e)}`);
export const hkSourceRef=(lang:'zh'|'en'='zh')=>`2026${String(randomInt(1_000_000_000)).padStart(9,'0')}_${lang==='zh'?'c':'e'}`;
const byRoleThenId=(a:{role:string;citation_id:string},b:{role:string;citation_id:string})=>a.role<b.role?-1:a.role>b.role?1:a.citation_id<b.citation_id?-1:a.citation_id>b.citation_id?1:0;

export interface HkDoc{docId:string;sourceRef:string;sourceVersion:number;content:string}
/** A public HKEXnews annual report of `iss`, inserted under the sync lease of `batch`. */
export async function hkDocument(h:HkPortHarness,iss:string,batch:string,o:{lang?:'zh'|'en';sourceRef?:string;seed?:string}={}):Promise<HkDoc>{
 const lang=o.lang??'zh';const sourceRef=o.sourceRef??hkSourceRef(lang);const content=sha256(`${sourceRef}:${o.seed??'v1'}`);
 await h.docs.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:iss,reasons:['test'],priority:1,fetch_key:'00268'}]);
 expect(await h.docs.claimSyncLease(iss,'hkexnews',batch,600)).toBe(true);
 const doc:DocumentInsert={issuer_id:iss,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_ref:sourceRef,form_type:'年報',doc_class:'annual_report',classifier_gen:1,title:'年報 2025',language:lang,
  source_url:`https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0320/${sourceRef}.pdf`,content_sha256:content,bytes:1024,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:`blobs/${content}.pdf`,
  acquisition:{fetched_at:'2026-03-20T10:00:00.000Z',http_status:200,content_type:'application/pdf',user_agent:'test'},published_at:'2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z',published_at_precision:'instant',
  available_at:'2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z',available_date:'2026-03-20',fiscal_year:2025,fiscal_period:'FY',period_end:'2025-12-31',filing_source_ref:null,permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,batch_id:batch,code_version:'test'};
 const r=await h.docs.insertDocumentVersion(iss,'hkexnews',batch,doc,[]);
 expect(r.outcome).not.toBe('duplicate');
 const row=await h.docs.documentById(r.document_id);
 return {docId:r.document_id,sourceRef,sourceVersion:row!.source_version,content};
}
/** Extracts one page under the extract lease of `batch`; returns the extraction id. */
export async function hkExtraction(h:HkPortHarness,docId:string,batch:string,content:string,extractorVersion=OLD_EXTRACTOR_VERSION,text=HK_PAGE_TEXT):Promise<string>{
 expect(await h.docs.claimExtractLease(docId,batch,600)).toBe(true);
 const pagesSha=sha256(`${docId}:${extractorVersion}`);
 return h.docs.finishExtract(docId,batch,{extractor_version:extractorVersion,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:'test',has_text_layer:true,page_count:1,pages_json_path:`extractions/${content}/${pagesSha}.pages.json`,pages_json_sha256:pagesSha},
  [{page_no:1,text,text_hash:sha256(text),char_count:Array.from(text).length,width:595,height:842,line_count:text.split('\n').length,has_tables:true}]);
}
export async function hkCite(h:HkPortHarness,docId:string,extractionId:string,needle:string,from=0,text=HK_PAGE_TEXT):Promise<string>{
 const start=cpIndexOf(text,needle,from);expect(start).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
 return h.docs.insertCitation({document_id:docId,extraction_id:extractionId,page_no:1,char_start:start,char_end:start+Array.from(needle).length,bbox:null,snippet:needle,text_hash:sha256(text),created_by:'extractor',created_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF});
}

export interface HkWorld extends HkDoc{iss:string;docBatch:string;user:string;extractionId:string;
 cit:{title:string;col25:string;col24:string;label:string;unit:string;v25:string;v24:string};cand25:string;cand24:string}
const payload=(year:'2025'|'2024',value:string,presented:string):FinancialFactPayload=>({concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',period_start:`${year}-01-01`,period_end:`${year}-12-31`,duration:'12M',value,presented,unit:'CNY',scale:'1000',sign_flip:false,
 period_derivation:{rule:year==='2025'?'title_duration':'title_year_substitution',title_date:'2025-12-31',column_text:year==='2025'?'二零二五年':'二零二四年'},consolidation:'consolidated'});
/** One HK issuer with a public Chinese annual report, one extraction, seven citations and two confirmed revenue candidates (2025, 2024); candidates_status done. */
export async function hkWorld(h:HkPortHarness):Promise<HkWorld>{
 const iss=await h.issuer();const docBatch=await h.batch();const user=await h.user();
 const doc=await hkDocument(h,iss,docBatch);
 const ext=await hkExtraction(h,doc.docId,docBatch,doc.content);
 const after=cpIndexOf(HK_PAGE_TEXT,'附註');
 const cit={title:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度'),col25:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'二零二五年',after),col24:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'二零二四年'),
  label:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'收益'),unit:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'人民幣千元'),v25:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'1,234'),v24:await hkCite(h,doc.docId,ext,'1,000')};
 const e=(await h.docs.extractionById(ext))!;
 expect(await h.docs.claimCandidatesLease(ext,docBatch,600)).toBe(true);
 const cand=(y:'2025'|'2024',value:string,presented:string,valueCit:string,colCit:string):CandidateInsert=>({kind:'financial_fact',extractor_kind:'rule',extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,natural_key:`revenue:${y}-01-01:${y}-12-31:12M:CNY`,
  citations:{value:valueCit,label:cit.label,unit:cit.unit,period:[{role:'statement_title',citation_id:cit.title},{role:'column_header',citation_id:colCit}]},payload:payload(y,value,presented),fingerprint:sha256(`${doc.docId}:${y}`),
  input_snapshot:{content_sha256:doc.content,pages_json_sha256:e.pages_json_sha256,page_nos:[1],extractor_version:e.extractor_version,table_algo_version:e.table_algo_version,code_version:e.code_version,hk_label_gen:HK_LABEL_GEN,hk_rules_version:HK_RULES_VERSION}});
 expect(await h.docs.insertCandidates(ext,docBatch,[cand('2025','1234000','1,234',cit.v25,cit.col25),cand('2024','1000000','1,000',cit.v24,cit.col24)])).toEqual({inserted:2});
 const rows=(await h.docs.candidatesOf({extractionId:ext},{limit:100})).rows;
 expect(rows).toHaveLength(2);
 expect(await h.docs.writeCandidateChecks(ext,docBatch,rows.map(c=>({candidate_id:c.candidate_id,checks:[{check:'unit_known',blocking:true,passed:true}],checks_passed:true})))).toEqual({written:2,inherited:0});
 for(const c of rows)expect(await h.docs.decideCandidate(c.candidate_id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user,status:'confirmed'})).toEqual({status:'confirmed'});
 await h.docs.finishCandidates(ext,docBatch,'done');
 const id=(y:string)=>rows.find(c=>c.natural_key.startsWith(`revenue:${y}`))!.candidate_id;
 return {...doc,iss,docBatch,user,extractionId:ext,cit,cand25:id('2025'),cand24:id('2024')};
}
/** Opens a current extraction (EXTRACTOR_VERSION) for the world's document; the world's citations become non-current. */
export async function hkReextract(h:HkPortHarness,w:HkWorld):Promise<string>{
 await h.docs.requestExtract(w.docId,w.user);
 return hkExtraction(h,w.docId,w.docBatch,w.content,EXTRACTOR_VERSION);
}
export function hkFilingRow(w:HkWorld,o:Partial<HkFilingInsert>={}):HkFilingInsert{
 return {filing_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:w.iss,source:'hkex',origin:'hkex',formType:'annual',fiscalYear:2025,fiscalPeriod:'FY',periodEnd:'2025-12-31',availableDate:'2026-03-20',sourceRef:`hkex:${w.sourceRef}:v${w.sourceVersion}`,url:null,...o};
}
export function hkFact(w:HkWorld,filingId:string,year:'2025'|'2024',value:string):FactInsert{
 return {fact_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:w.iss,market:HK_MARKET,filing_id:filingId,concept:'revenue',source_concept:'收益',statement:'IS',period_start:`${year}-01-01`,period_end:`${year}-12-31`,duration:'12M',value,unit:'CNY',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:'2026-03-20',mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN,mapping_version:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,raw_hash:`hkex:test:${year}`};
}
/** value, label, unit and two period rows per fact (10 rows for the two facts). */
export function evidenceRows(w:HkWorld,fact25:string,fact24:string):{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}[]{
 const rows=(fact:string,value:string,col:string)=>[{fact_id:fact,citation_id:value,role:'value' as const},{fact_id:fact,citation_id:w.cit.label,role:'label' as const},{fact_id:fact,citation_id:w.cit.unit,role:'unit' as const},
  {fact_id:fact,citation_id:w.cit.title,role:'period' as const},{fact_id:fact,citation_id:col,role:'period' as const}];
 return [...rows(fact25,w.cit.v25,w.cit.col25),...rows(fact24,w.cit.v24,w.cit.col24)];
}
export const sortedEvidence=(rows:{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}[],fact:string)=>rows.filter(r=>r.fact_id===fact).map(({role,citation_id})=>({role,citation_id})).sort(byRoleThenId);
export interface HkRun{batch:string;run:string;filingId:string;fact25:FactInsert;fact24:FactInsert;bound:number}
/** ensureHkScope → claimLease (new batch) → beginRun → stageFilings → bind → stageFacts → candidate links → evidence; nothing published. */
export async function hkStagedRun(h:HkPortHarness,w:HkWorld,o:{bind?:boolean;link?:boolean;evidence?:boolean}={}):Promise<HkRun>{
 await h.port.ensureHkScope(w.iss,'00268');
 const batch=await h.batch();expect(await h.port.claimLease(w.iss,batch,600)).toBe(true);
 const run=await h.port.beginRun(w.iss,batch,HK_PUB_GEN);
 const f=hkFilingRow(w);const filingId=(await h.port.stageFilings(run,[f])).get(f.sourceRef)!;
 const bound=o.bind===false?0:await h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:filingId,document_id:w.docId}]);
 const fact25=hkFact(w,filingId,'2025','1234000');const fact24=hkFact(w,filingId,'2024','1000000');
 expect(await h.port.stageFacts(run,[fact25,fact24])).toBe(2);
 if(o.link!==false){await h.docs.stageCandidatePublication(w.cand25,HK_PUB_GEN,run,fact25.fact_id);await h.docs.stageCandidatePublication(w.cand24,HK_PUB_GEN,run,fact24.fact_id);}
 if(o.evidence!==false)expect(await h.port.insertFactCitations(run,evidenceRows(w,fact25.fact_id,fact24.fact_id))).toBe(10);
 return {batch,run,filingId,fact25,fact24,bound};
}
export const stateRev=async(h:HkPortHarness,iss:string)=>(await h.port.readFacts(iss,{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2030-01-01',history:true,includeNonOk:true})).stateRev;
const dueIds=async(h:HkPortHarness,gen:number)=>(await h.port.promotionDue(gen,1000)).map(x=>x.issuerId);
const itemRow=async(h:HkPortHarness,id:string)=>(await h.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id}))[0];

export function hkFactsPortContract(label:string,setup:()=>Promise<HkPortHarness>):void{
 describe(label,()=>{
  let h:HkPortHarness;
  beforeAll(async()=>{h=await setup();},60000);
  afterAll(async()=>{await h?.close?.();},30000);

  it('an HK run end to end: stage, bind, link, evidence, publishHkRun, finishCandidatePublications; reads, links and promotionDue follow',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).toContain(w.iss);                                          // (ab) confirmed, never linked
   const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w);
   expect(r.bound).toBe(1);
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(r.run)).toBe('staged');
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(randomUUID())).toBeNull();
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).toContain(w.iss);                                          // (c) staged links
   const rev=await stateRev(h,w.iss);
   expect(await code(h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r.batch,r.run,[r.filingId],rev,[{document_id:w.docId,extraction_id:'x'}]))).toBe('invalid_input');
   expect(await h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r.batch,r.run,[r.filingId],rev,[{document_id:w.docId,extraction_id:w.extractionId}])).toBe(2);   // the zero-output selection still holds
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(r.run)).toBe('published');
   expect(await h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run)).toEqual({published:2,still_staged:0,abandoned:0});
   expect(await h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run)).toEqual({published:0,still_staged:0,abandoned:0});   // idempotent (crash recovery)
   expect((await h.docs.candidateById(w.cand25))?.status).toBe('promoted');
   expect((await h.docs.candidateById(w.cand24))?.status).toBe('promoted');
   const read=await h.port.readFacts(w.iss,{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2030-01-01',history:true});
   expect(read.stateRev).toBe(rev+1);
   expect(read.rows.map(f=>[f.fact_id,String(f.market),f.status,f.value]).sort()).toEqual([[r.fact24.fact_id,'HK','ok','1000000'],[r.fact25.fact_id,'HK','ok','1234000']].sort());
   expect((await h.port.factsByIds([r.fact25.fact_id]))[0]).toMatchObject({status:'ok',mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN,filing_id:r.filingId});
   expect(await h.port.citationsOfFact(r.fact25.fact_id)).toEqual(sortedEvidence(evidenceRows(w,r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id),r.fact25.fact_id));
   expect(await h.port.citationsOfFact(randomUUID())).toEqual([]);
   expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(w.docId)).toEqual({filing_id:r.filingId,mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN});
   expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(randomUUID())).toBeNull();
   expect(await h.port.openConflicts(w.iss)).toEqual([]);
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).not.toContain(w.iss);                                      // everything published under this generation
   expect(await h.port.zeroOutputDocuments(w.iss,HK_PUB_GEN)).toEqual([]);
   expect(await h.port.zeroOutputDocuments(w.iss,HK_PUB_GEN+1)).toEqual([w.docId]);              // (d) the filing sits on an older generation
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN+1)).toContain(w.iss);
   await h.port.releaseLease(w.iss,r.batch,'success','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
   expect(await code(h.port.releaseLease(w.iss,r.batch,'success','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'))).toBe('facts:lease_lost');
  });

  it('ensureHkScope creates the HK scope row once and never changes it (the lease survives); a malformed fetch key is invalid_input',async()=>{
   const iss=await h.issuer();
   expect(await code(h.port.ensureHkScope(iss,'268'))).toBe('invalid_input');
   expect(await h.port.claimLease(iss,await h.batch(),600)).toBe(false);                        // no scope row yet
   await h.port.ensureHkScope(iss,'00268');
   const b1=await h.batch();const b2=await h.batch();
   expect(await h.port.claimLease(iss,b1,600)).toBe(true);
   await h.port.ensureHkScope(iss,'99999');
   expect(await h.port.claimLease(iss,b2,600)).toBe(false);
   await h.expireHkLease(iss);
   expect(await h.port.claimLease(iss,b2,600)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('bindFilingDocuments: validates filing and document, is idempotent per pair, refuses a second document; a pruned gen-0 filing takes its binding along',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);
   const en=await hkDocument(h,w.iss,w.docBatch,{lang:'en'});
   const other=await hkDocument(h,w.iss,w.docBatch);
   await h.port.ensureHkScope(w.iss,'00268');const b=await h.batch();expect(await h.port.claimLease(w.iss,b,600)).toBe(true);
   const run=await h.port.beginRun(w.iss,b,HK_PUB_GEN);
   const f=hkFilingRow(w);const g=hkFilingRow(w,{sourceRef:`hkex:${en.sourceRef}:v${en.sourceVersion}`});
   const m=await h.port.stageFilings(run,[f,g]);const fid=m.get(f.sourceRef)!;const gid=m.get(g.sourceRef)!;
   expect(await code(h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:gid,document_id:en.docId}]))).toBe('invalid_input');        // English version: no filing
   expect(await code(h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:fid,document_id:other.docId}]))).toBe('invalid_input');     // source_ref names another document
   expect(await code(h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:randomUUID(),document_id:w.docId}]))).toBe('invalid_input'); // unknown filing
   expect(await h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:fid,document_id:w.docId},{filing_id:fid,document_id:w.docId}])).toBe(1);
   expect(await h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:fid,document_id:w.docId}])).toBe(0);
   expect(await code(h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:fid,document_id:other.docId}]))).toBe('binding_conflict');
   expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(w.docId)).toEqual({filing_id:fid,mapping_gen:0});
   await h.expireHkLease(w.iss);
   expect(await code(h.port.bindFilingDocuments(run,[{filing_id:fid,document_id:w.docId}]))).toBe('lease_lost');            // the run's batch lost its lease
   const b2=await h.batch();expect(await h.port.claimLease(w.iss,b2,600)).toBe(true);
   await h.port.beginRun(w.iss,b2,HK_PUB_GEN);                                                   // abandons `run`, prunes its empty gen-0 filings
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(run)).toBe('abandoned');
   expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(w.docId)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('insertFactCitations refuses bad roles, unknown facts, facts of another run, foreign documents, unbound filings and non-current extractions; it is idempotent',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);const w2=await hkWorld(h);
   const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w,{evidence:false});
   const r2=await hkStagedRun(h,w2,{bind:false,evidence:false});
   const row=(o:Partial<{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}>={})=>({fact_id:r.fact25.fact_id,citation_id:w.cit.v25,role:'value' as CitationRole,...o});
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,[row({role:'bogus' as CitationRole})]))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,[row({fact_id:randomUUID()})]))).toBe('invalid_citation');
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,[row({fact_id:r2.fact25.fact_id})]))).toBe('invalid_citation');     // staged in another run
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,[row({citation_id:w2.cit.v25})]))).toBe('invalid_citation');        // another document
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r2.run,[{fact_id:r2.fact25.fact_id,citation_id:w2.cit.v25,role:'value'}]))).toBe('invalid_citation');   // filing never bound
   expect(await h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,evidenceRows(w,r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id))).toBe(10);
   expect(await h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,evidenceRows(w,r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id))).toBe(0);
   await hkReextract(h,w);
   expect(await code(h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,[row()]))).toBe('invalid_citation');                                 // extraction no longer current
  });

  it('publishHkRun refuses a missing revision, incomplete evidence, a foreign batch and a stale plan without publishing anything',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w,{evidence:false});const rev=await stateRev(h,w.iss);
   const publish=(batch=r.batch,expected=rev)=>h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,batch,r.run,[r.filingId],expected,[]);
   expect(await code(publish(r.batch,Number.NaN))).toBe('invalid_expected_rev');
   expect(await code(publish())).toBe('evidence_incomplete');
   const rows=evidenceRows(w,r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id);
   expect(await h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,rows.filter(x=>!(x.fact_id===r.fact24.fact_id&&x.role==='unit')))).toBe(9);
   expect(await code(publish())).toBe('evidence_incomplete');                                    // fact24 lacks its unit
   expect(await h.port.insertFactCitations(r.run,rows)).toBe(1);
   expect(await code(publish(await h.batch()))).toBe('lease_lost');
   expect(await code(publish(r.batch,rev+1))).toBe('stale_plan');
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(r.run)).toBe('staged');
   expect((await h.port.factsByIds([r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id])).map(f=>f.status)).toEqual(['staged','staged']);
   expect(await stateRev(h,w.iss)).toBe(rev);
   expect(await publish()).toBe(2);
   // evidence complete but no candidate_publications link: still incomplete
   const v=await hkWorld(h);const s=await hkStagedRun(h,v,{link:false});
   expect(await code(h.port.publishHkRun(v.iss,s.batch,s.run,[s.filingId],await stateRev(h,v.iss),[]))).toBe('evidence_incomplete');
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(s.run)).toBe('staged');
  });

  it('mixed outcome: a quarantined fact keeps its link staged until resolveHkFactsQuarantine promotes it with the hook done; non-HK items are refused',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w);
   const item=await quarantine(h.tables,{dataset:'facts.hk',table:'financial_facts',naturalKey:`${w.iss}:HK:revenue:2024-01-01:2024-12-31:consolidated:CNY:2026-03-20`,reasonCode:'identity_gp',batchId:r.batch,payload:{fact_ids:[],run_id:r.run}});
   expect(await h.port.quarantineFacts(r.run,[r.fact24.fact_id],item)).toBe(1);
   expect(await h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r.batch,r.run,[r.filingId],await stateRev(h,w.iss),[])).toBe(1);
   expect(await h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run)).toEqual({published:1,still_staged:1,abandoned:0});
   expect((await h.docs.candidateById(w.cand25))?.status).toBe('promoted');
   expect((await h.docs.candidateById(w.cand24))?.status).toBe('confirmed');
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).not.toContain(w.iss);                                      // (c) the staged link waits on the owner's decision: not due (P2-6)
   expect(await code(h.port.abandonCandidatePublications(r.run))).toBe('invalid_input');          // a published run is never abandoned
   const stray=await quarantine(h.tables,{dataset:'facts.hk',table:'financial_facts',naturalKey:`${w.iss}:HK:stray`,reasonCode:'identity_bs',batchId:r.batch,payload:{fact_ids:[],run_id:randomUUID()}});
   expect(await code(h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(stray,[],w.user))).toBe('not_hk_item');
   expect((await itemRow(h,stray)).status).toBe('open');
   expect(await code(h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(randomUUID(),[],w.user))).toBe('not_found');
   expect(await h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item,[],w.user)).toEqual({promoted:1,skipped:0,chosenFactIds:[r.fact24.fact_id]});
   const it1=await itemRow(h,item);
   expect(it1.status).toBe('resolved_accept');
   expect((it1.detail as {hook?:unknown}).hook).toMatchObject({stage:'done',state:'done',message:'hk_no_metrics'});
   expect(await code(h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item,[],w.user))).toBe('item_not_open');
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).toContain(w.iss);                                          // (c) the decision made the link actionable
   expect(await h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run)).toEqual({published:1,still_staged:0,abandoned:0});
   expect((await h.docs.candidateById(w.cand24))?.status).toBe('promoted');
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).not.toContain(w.iss);
  });

  it('publishHkRun revalidates the zero-output selection under the document locks (P1-4): a switched extraction is stale_plan and publishes nothing',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w);const rev=await stateRev(h,w.iss);
   const planned=[{document_id:w.docId,extraction_id:w.extractionId}];
   const next=await hkReextract(h,w);                                                            // between selection and publish: a new extraction, candidates pending
   expect((await h.docs.extractionById(next))?.candidates_status).toBe('pending');
   expect(await code(h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r.batch,r.run,[r.filingId],rev,planned))).toBe('stale_plan');
   expect(await code(h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r.batch,r.run,[r.filingId],rev,[{document_id:w.docId,extraction_id:next}]))).toBe('stale_plan');   // current, but candidates not done
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(r.run)).toBe('staged');
   expect(await stateRev(h,w.iss)).toBe(rev);                                                    // no generation advance, nothing published
   expect((await h.port.factsByIds([r.fact25.fact_id,r.fact24.fact_id])).map(f=>f.status)).toEqual(['staged','staged']);
   expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(w.docId)).toMatchObject({filing_id:r.filingId});
   await h.port.abandonRun(r.run);await h.port.releaseLease(w.iss,r.batch,'failed','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('abandoned runs: links of a staged run cannot be closed; after abandonRun they are abandoned, evidence is gone, and a later run re-stages them',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);const r=await hkStagedRun(h,w);
   expect(await code(h.port.abandonCandidatePublications(r.run))).toBe('run_pending');
   expect(await code(h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run))).toBe('run_pending');
   await h.port.abandonRun(r.run);
   expect(await h.port.runStatus(r.run)).toBe('abandoned');
   expect(await h.port.citationsOfFact(r.fact25.fact_id)).toEqual([]);                           // cascaded with the deleted staged facts
   expect(await code(h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r.run))).toBe('invalid_input');
   expect(await h.port.abandonCandidatePublications(r.run)).toBe(2);
   expect(await h.port.abandonCandidatePublications(r.run)).toBe(0);
   expect(await code(h.port.abandonCandidatePublications(randomUUID()))).toBe('not_found');
   await h.port.releaseLease(w.iss,r.batch,'failed','2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
   const r2=await hkStagedRun(h,w);                                                              // abandoned → staged with the new run's facts
   expect(r2.filingId).toBe(r.filingId);                                                          // abandonRun keeps filings; stage_filings reuses it …
   expect(r2.bound).toBe(0);                                                                      // … with its binding
   expect(await h.port.publishHkRun(w.iss,r2.batch,r2.run,[r2.filingId],await stateRev(h,w.iss),[])).toBe(2);
   expect(await h.port.finishCandidatePublications(r2.run)).toEqual({published:2,still_staged:0,abandoned:0});
  });

  it('promotionDue: unlinked confirmed candidates are due, rejected ones are not; limit 0 and ascending order; (d) needs a published filing',async()=>{
   const w=await hkWorld(h);
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).toContain(w.iss);
   expect(await h.port.promotionDue(HK_PUB_GEN,0)).toEqual([]);
   const all=await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN);
   expect(all).toEqual([...all].sort());
   expect(await h.port.zeroOutputDocuments(w.iss,HK_PUB_GEN+1)).toEqual([]);                     // never bound to a filing
   for(const id of [w.cand25,w.cand24]){
    await h.docs.decideCandidate(id,{kind:'human',decided_by:w.user,status:'candidate'});
    await h.docs.decideCandidate(id,{kind:'human',decided_by:w.user,status:'rejected'});
   }
   expect(await dueIds(h,HK_PUB_GEN)).not.toContain(w.iss);
  });
 });
}
```
