- [ ] **Step 3: Write migration two**

```sql
-- supabase/migrations/20261108091000_fact_citations.sql
-- F3 migration two (spec §4.8, §4.9, §4.12; plan F3 Task 13). Joins the document pipeline to the
-- landed spec-2 facts layer WITHOUT replacing any spec-2 function or trigger:
--   1. additive extension of the spec-2 check constraints (drop if exists + add, under the landed
--      names PostgreSQL derived from the inline column checks: <table>_<column>_check): market +=
--      'HK' on fact_sync_runs, filings, financial_facts, fact_sync_scope — NOT financial_metrics (HK
--      is not materialised, R5-3); filings.source += 'hkex'; filings.origin += 'hkex';
--   2. filing_documents (R5-6): HK filing ↔ the Chinese document it was cut from; written only by
--      bind_filing_documents; removed only by the cascade of begin_sync_run pruning an empty gen-0 filing;
--   3. fact_citations: evidence per fact and role; written only by insert_fact_citations; removed
--      only by the cascade of spec-2 deleting the staged rows of an abandoned run (ok rows are never
--      deleted, so published evidence never disappears);
--   4. document_citations: migration one's public policy replaced by the fact-linked one (§4.12);
--   5. F3 functions: bind_filing_documents, insert_fact_citations, assert_run_evidence_complete
--      (internal), publish_hk_run (the only HK publish path), finish/abandon_candidate_publications,
--      ensure_hk_fact_scope, resolve_hk_facts_quarantine, hk_promotion_due, hk_zero_output_documents.
-- Run-level spec-2 helpers check the RUN's batch lease (fact_run_lock), and so does every run-level
-- F3 function. Lock order everywhere: fact_sync_scope → filings → filing_documents →
-- disclosure_documents (publish_hk_run takes all four, in that order, before the evidence check).
-- Errors carry the code as the message (detail says why): invalid_input, invalid_citation,
-- invalid_expected_rev (22023); binding_conflict, evidence_incomplete, run_pending, not_hk_item
-- (P0001); not_found (P0002); spec-2 codes (lease_lost, stale_plan, run_published, item_not_open, …)
-- propagate unchanged. Triggers refuse with 23514, prefix `append_only:`. Replayable; the hosted
-- `postgres` role is not a superuser (owner = migration role, search_path = public, every relation
-- qualified, no `alter function … owner`). Only storage.buckets exists locally: not referenced here.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. spec-2 check constraints (additive, R5-2)
alter table public.fact_sync_runs drop constraint if exists fact_sync_runs_market_check;
alter table public.fact_sync_runs add constraint fact_sync_runs_market_check check (market in ('US','CN','HK'));
alter table public.filings drop constraint if exists filings_market_check;
alter table public.filings add constraint filings_market_check check (market in ('US','CN','HK'));
alter table public.filings drop constraint if exists filings_source_check;
alter table public.filings add constraint filings_source_check check (source in ('edgar','tushare','hkex'));
alter table public.filings drop constraint if exists filings_origin_check;
alter table public.filings add constraint filings_origin_check check (origin in ('sec','sse','szse','bse','hkex'));
alter table public.financial_facts drop constraint if exists financial_facts_market_check;
alter table public.financial_facts add constraint financial_facts_market_check check (market in ('US','CN','HK'));
alter table public.fact_sync_scope drop constraint if exists fact_sync_scope_market_check;
alter table public.fact_sync_scope add constraint fact_sync_scope_market_check check (market in ('US','CN','HK'));
-- financial_metrics.market stays ('US','CN').

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. filing_documents (R5-6)
create table if not exists public.filing_documents (
  filing_id    uuid primary key references public.filings(filing_id) on delete cascade,
  document_id  uuid not null references public.disclosure_documents(document_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists filing_documents_document_idx on public.filing_documents(document_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. fact_citations
create table if not exists public.fact_citations (
  fact_id      uuid not null references public.financial_facts(fact_id) on delete cascade,
  citation_id  uuid not null references public.document_citations(citation_id) on delete restrict,
  role         text not null check (role in ('value','label','period','unit')),
  primary key (fact_id, role, citation_id)
);
create index if not exists fact_citations_citation_idx on public.fact_citations(citation_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- guards
-- Inside a BEFORE trigger pg_trigger_depth() is already 1 for a direct statement; a delete issued by
-- a foreign-key cascade runs inside the RI trigger, so this trigger then sees depth 2. Hence `< 2`.
create or replace function public.fact_citations_guard() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    raise exception 'append_only: fact_citations rows are never updated' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  if pg_trigger_depth() < 2 then
    raise exception 'append_only: fact_citations rows are deleted only with their fact (cascade)' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return old;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.fact_citations_guard() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop trigger if exists fact_citations_guard on public.fact_citations;
create trigger fact_citations_guard before update or delete on public.fact_citations
  for each row execute function public.fact_citations_guard();

create or replace function public.filing_documents_guard() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    raise exception 'append_only: filing_documents rows are never updated' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  if pg_trigger_depth() < 2 then
    raise exception 'append_only: filing_documents rows are deleted only with their filing (cascade)' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return old;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.filing_documents_guard() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop trigger if exists filing_documents_guard on public.filing_documents;
create trigger filing_documents_guard before update or delete on public.filing_documents
  for each row execute function public.filing_documents_guard();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- privileges and policies (§4.12)
do $$ declare t text; begin
  foreach t in array array['fact_citations','filing_documents'] loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t);
    execute format('revoke all on public.%I from public, anon, authenticated, service_role', t);
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to anon, authenticated, service_role', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s service read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('create policy "%s service read" on public.%I for select to service_role using (true)', t, t);
  end loop;
end $$;
drop policy if exists "fact_citations public read" on public.fact_citations;
create policy "fact_citations public read" on public.fact_citations for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.financial_facts f where f.fact_id = fact_citations.fact_id and f.status = 'ok'));
drop policy if exists "filing_documents public read" on public.filing_documents;
create policy "filing_documents public read" on public.filing_documents for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.filings g where g.filing_id = filing_documents.filing_id and g.mapping_gen > 0));
-- Migration one created this policy without the fact clause; this is the complete §4.12 rule:
-- public document AND (published by a module/human OR cited by an ok fact).
drop policy if exists "document_citations public read" on public.document_citations;
create policy "document_citations public read" on public.document_citations for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.disclosure_documents d where d.document_id = document_citations.document_id and d.permission = 'public')
         and (visibility = 'public'
              or exists (select 1 from public.fact_citations fc join public.financial_facts f on f.fact_id = fc.fact_id
                         where fc.citation_id = document_citations.citation_id and f.status = 'ok')));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. functions
-- p_rows = [{filing_id, document_id}]. Under the run's lease (fact_run_lock), existing bindings of the
-- requested filings are locked in filing_id order; per row: the filing must be an HK 'hkex' filing of
-- the run's issuer; an existing binding to the same document is skipped, to another one is
-- binding_conflict; the document must be a public Chinese HKEXnews document of the same issuer and
-- the filing's source_ref must be 'hkex:<document source_ref>:v<source_version>'. Returns inserted rows.
create or replace function public.bind_filing_documents(p_run uuid, p_rows jsonb)
returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r public.fact_sync_runs; x record; g public.filings; d public.disclosure_documents; v_have uuid; n int := 0;
begin
  if p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'rows'; end if;
  r := public.fact_run_lock(p_run);
  if r.market <> 'HK' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'run_market'; end if;
  perform 1 from public.filing_documents fd
  where fd.filing_id in (select (e ->> 'filing_id')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) e)
  order by fd.filing_id for update of fd;
  for x in select (e ->> 'filing_id')::uuid as filing_id, (e ->> 'document_id')::uuid as document_id
           from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) e order by 1, 2 loop
    if x.filing_id is null or x.document_id is null then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'row'; end if;
    select * into g from public.filings where filing_id = x.filing_id;
    if not found or g.issuer_id <> r.issuer_id or g.market <> 'HK' or g.source <> 'hkex' then
      raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'filing';
    end if;
    select fd.document_id into v_have from public.filing_documents fd where fd.filing_id = x.filing_id;
    if found then
      if v_have <> x.document_id then raise exception 'binding_conflict' using errcode = 'P0001', detail = x.filing_id::text; end if;
      continue;
    end if;
    select * into d from public.disclosure_documents where document_id = x.document_id;
    if not found or d.source <> 'hkexnews' or d.language is distinct from 'zh' or d.permission <> 'public' or d.issuer_id is distinct from r.issuer_id then
      raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'document';
    end if;
    if g.source_ref <> 'hkex:' || d.source_ref || ':v' || d.source_version then
      raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'source_ref';
    end if;
    insert into public.filing_documents (filing_id, document_id) values (x.filing_id, x.document_id);
    n := n + 1;
  end loop;
  return n;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.bind_filing_documents(uuid, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.bind_filing_documents(uuid, jsonb) to service_role;

-- p_rows = [{fact_id, citation_id, role}]. Under the run's lease; every row is validated before any
-- insert (first failure → invalid_citation, detail = reason): role; the fact exists, belongs to p_run
-- and is staged; the citation exists; the fact's filing is bound; the citation's document is that
-- bound document, public, and the citation sits on its CURRENT extraction. Duplicates are skipped.
-- Returns inserted rows.
create or replace function public.insert_fact_citations(p_run uuid, p_rows jsonb)
returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r public.fact_sync_runs; v_bad text; n int;
begin
  if p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'rows'; end if;
  r := public.fact_run_lock(p_run);
  if r.market <> 'HK' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'run_market'; end if;
  select x.reason into v_bad from (
    select case
      when e ->> 'role' is null or e ->> 'role' not in ('value','label','period','unit') then 'role'
      when f.fact_id is null then 'fact'
      when f.run_id <> p_run or f.status <> 'staged' then 'fact_state'
      when c.citation_id is null then 'citation'
      when fd.filing_id is null then 'unbound_filing'
      when c.document_id <> fd.document_id then 'document'
      when d.permission <> 'public' then 'permission'
      when c.extraction_id is distinct from d.current_extraction_id then 'extraction'
      else null end as reason
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) e
    left join public.financial_facts f on f.fact_id = (e ->> 'fact_id')::uuid
    left join public.document_citations c on c.citation_id = (e ->> 'citation_id')::uuid
    left join public.filing_documents fd on fd.filing_id = f.filing_id
    left join public.disclosure_documents d on d.document_id = fd.document_id
  ) x where x.reason is not null limit 1;
  if v_bad is not null then raise exception 'invalid_citation' using errcode = '22023', detail = v_bad; end if;
  insert into public.fact_citations (fact_id, citation_id, role)
  select distinct (e ->> 'fact_id')::uuid, (e ->> 'citation_id')::uuid, e ->> 'role' from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) e
  on conflict (fact_id, role, citation_id) do nothing;
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.insert_fact_citations(uuid, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.insert_fact_citations(uuid, jsonb) to service_role;

-- Internal (R4-3): over run_id = p_run AND status IN ('staged','quarantined') — quarantine does not
-- exempt — every fact needs exactly one value, label and unit citation and at least one period
-- citation, exactly one staged candidate_publications row of this run pointing at it, a bound filing,
-- and every citation on the bound document, public, on its current extraction, intact (page
-- text_hash and code-point substr equal the stored values). First failure → evidence_incomplete
-- (detail = '<reason>:<fact_id>'). Called only by publish_hk_run after its locks.
create or replace function public.assert_run_evidence_complete(p_run uuid)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_fact uuid; v_reason text;
begin
  select x.fact_id, x.reason into v_fact, v_reason from (
    select f.fact_id,
      case
        when (select count(*) from public.fact_citations fc where fc.fact_id = f.fact_id and fc.role = 'value') <> 1 then 'value'
        when (select count(*) from public.fact_citations fc where fc.fact_id = f.fact_id and fc.role = 'label') <> 1 then 'label'
        when (select count(*) from public.fact_citations fc where fc.fact_id = f.fact_id and fc.role = 'unit') <> 1 then 'unit'
        when not exists (select 1 from public.fact_citations fc where fc.fact_id = f.fact_id and fc.role = 'period') then 'period'
        when (select count(*) from public.candidate_publications cp where cp.run_id = p_run and cp.fact_id = f.fact_id and cp.state = 'staged') <> 1 then 'publication'
        when not exists (select 1 from public.filing_documents fd where fd.filing_id = f.filing_id) then 'unbound_filing'
        when exists (
          select 1 from public.fact_citations fc
          join public.document_citations c on c.citation_id = fc.citation_id
          join public.filing_documents fd on fd.filing_id = f.filing_id
          join public.disclosure_documents d on d.document_id = fd.document_id
          left join public.document_pages p on p.extraction_id = c.extraction_id and p.page_no = c.page_no
          where fc.fact_id = f.fact_id
            and (c.document_id <> d.document_id or d.permission <> 'public'
                 or c.extraction_id is distinct from d.current_extraction_id
                 or p.text_hash is distinct from c.text_hash
                 or substr(p.text, c.char_start + 1, c.char_end - c.char_start) is distinct from c.snippet)) then 'citation'
        else null end as reason
    from public.financial_facts f
    where f.run_id = p_run and f.status in ('staged','quarantined')
  ) x where x.reason is not null order by x.fact_id limit 1;
  if v_reason is not null then
    raise exception 'evidence_incomplete' using errcode = 'P0001', detail = v_reason || ':' || v_fact;
  end if;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.assert_run_evidence_complete(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- The only HK publish path (§4.8, R4-2, R5-6, R5-7). p_expected_rev is mandatory. Locks, in order:
-- the issuer's HK scope row with the caller's lease (fact_scope_lock), the run (must be this issuer's
-- staged HK run of p_batch), every filing of the run, of its facts or of the manifest (filing_id
-- order), their filing_documents rows (filing_id order), the bound disclosure_documents (document_id
-- order). p_zero_output = the planned zero-output selection [{document_id, extraction_id}] (codex plan
-- round 1 P1-4): under the document locks, and with the expected extraction rows share-locked
-- (extraction_id order; documents → extractions everywhere), each entry must still be a public
-- Chinese HKEXnews document of this issuer bound to one of the run's filings whose current
-- extraction is the expected one, primary, candidates done — else stale_plan (the caller replans).
-- Then the evidence check, then the unchanged spec-2 publish_sync_run under the same locks
-- (stale_plan propagates; any failure rolls the whole call back). Returns the rows that became ok.
create or replace function public.publish_hk_run(p_issuer uuid, p_batch uuid, p_run uuid, p_manifest uuid[], p_expected_rev bigint, p_zero_output jsonb)
returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r public.fact_sync_runs; v_manifest uuid[] := coalesce(p_manifest, '{}'::uuid[]); v_filings uuid[]; v_docs uuid[]; v_stale uuid;
  c_uuid constant text := '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
begin
  if p_expected_rev is null then raise exception 'invalid_expected_rev' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  if p_zero_output is null or jsonb_typeof(p_zero_output) <> 'array'
     or exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_zero_output) z
                where jsonb_typeof(z) <> 'object' or coalesce(z ->> 'document_id', '') !~* c_uuid or coalesce(z ->> 'extraction_id', '') !~* c_uuid) then
    raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'zero_output';
  end if;
  perform public.fact_scope_lock(p_issuer, 'HK', p_batch);
  select * into r from public.fact_sync_runs where run_id = p_run for update;
  if not found or r.issuer_id <> p_issuer or r.market <> 'HK' or r.batch_id <> p_batch or r.status <> 'staged' then
    raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'run';
  end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(x.filing_id order by x.filing_id), '{}'::uuid[]) into v_filings from (
    select g.filing_id from public.filings g
    where g.issuer_id = p_issuer and g.market = 'HK'
      and (g.run_id = p_run or g.filing_id = any(v_manifest)
           or g.filing_id in (select f.filing_id from public.financial_facts f where f.run_id = p_run))
    order by g.filing_id for update of g) x;
  select coalesce(array_agg(x.document_id order by x.document_id), '{}'::uuid[]) into v_docs from (
    select fd.document_id from public.filing_documents fd where fd.filing_id = any(v_filings)
    order by fd.filing_id for update of fd) x;
  perform 1 from public.disclosure_documents d where d.document_id = any(v_docs) order by d.document_id for update of d;
  perform 1 from public.document_extractions e
  where e.extraction_id in (select (z ->> 'extraction_id')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(p_zero_output) z)
  order by e.extraction_id for share of e;
  select x.document_id into v_stale from (
    select (z ->> 'document_id')::uuid as document_id, (z ->> 'extraction_id')::uuid as extraction_id from jsonb_array_elements(p_zero_output) z
  ) x
  where not exists (
    select 1 from public.disclosure_documents d
    join public.document_extractions e on e.extraction_id = d.current_extraction_id
    where d.document_id = x.document_id and d.document_id = any(v_docs)
      and d.issuer_id = p_issuer and d.source = 'hkexnews' and d.language = 'zh' and d.permission = 'public'
      and d.current_extraction_id = x.extraction_id and e.candidates_role = 'primary' and e.candidates_status = 'done')
  order by x.document_id limit 1;
  if v_stale is not null then
    raise exception 'stale_plan' using errcode = 'P0001', detail = 'zero_output:' || v_stale;
  end if;
  perform public.assert_run_evidence_complete(p_run);
  return public.publish_sync_run(p_run, v_manifest, p_expected_rev);
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.publish_hk_run(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid[], bigint, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.publish_hk_run(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid[], bigint, jsonb) to service_role;

-- Requires a published run (staged → run_pending, abandoned → invalid_input, absent → not_found).
-- Locks the candidates behind this run's staged links (candidate_id order), then decides each link:
-- fact ok → published (candidate confirmed → promoted); fact quarantined → stays staged; fact gone →
-- abandoned. Idempotent: normal completion and crash recovery are the same call.
create or replace function public.finish_candidate_publications(p_run uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r public.fact_sync_runs; v_pub int; v_ab int; v_still int;
begin
  select * into r from public.fact_sync_runs where run_id = p_run;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found' using errcode = 'P0002', detail = 'run'; end if;
  if r.status = 'staged' then raise exception 'run_pending' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  if r.status <> 'published' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'run_abandoned'; end if;
  perform 1 from public.extraction_candidates c
  where c.candidate_id in (select cp.candidate_id from public.candidate_publications cp where cp.run_id = p_run and cp.state = 'staged')
  order by c.candidate_id for update of c;
  update public.candidate_publications cp set state = 'published', updated_at = now()
  from public.financial_facts f
  where cp.run_id = p_run and cp.state = 'staged' and f.fact_id = cp.fact_id and f.status = 'ok';
  get diagnostics v_pub = row_count;
  update public.extraction_candidates c set status = 'promoted'
  where c.status = 'confirmed'
    and exists (select 1 from public.candidate_publications cp where cp.candidate_id = c.candidate_id and cp.run_id = p_run and cp.state = 'published');
  update public.candidate_publications cp set state = 'abandoned', updated_at = now()
  where cp.run_id = p_run and cp.state = 'staged' and not exists (select 1 from public.financial_facts f where f.fact_id = cp.fact_id);
  get diagnostics v_ab = row_count;
  select count(*) into v_still from public.candidate_publications where run_id = p_run and state = 'staged';
  return jsonb_build_object('published', v_pub, 'still_staged', v_still, 'abandoned', v_ab);
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.finish_candidate_publications(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_candidate_publications(uuid) to service_role;

-- Requires an abandoned run (staged → run_pending, published → invalid_input, absent → not_found):
-- every staged link of the run → abandoned (candidate statuses unchanged). Returns the count.
create or replace function public.abandon_candidate_publications(p_run uuid)
returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r public.fact_sync_runs; n int;
begin
  select * into r from public.fact_sync_runs where run_id = p_run;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found' using errcode = 'P0002', detail = 'run'; end if;
  if r.status = 'staged' then raise exception 'run_pending' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  if r.status <> 'abandoned' then raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'run_published'; end if;
  perform 1 from public.extraction_candidates c
  where c.candidate_id in (select cp.candidate_id from public.candidate_publications cp where cp.run_id = p_run and cp.state = 'staged')
  order by c.candidate_id for update of c;
  update public.candidate_publications set state = 'abandoned', updated_at = now() where run_id = p_run and state = 'staged';
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.abandon_candidate_publications(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.abandon_candidate_publications(uuid) to service_role;

-- R5-2, R5-11: spec-2 reconcile_fact_sync_scope refuses HK, so the HK lease row is created here —
-- unleased, priority 0 (never picked by spec-2 scopeDue), reasons ['documents'] — and an existing row
-- is never changed (schedule inputs, lease and state_rev stay as they are).
create or replace function public.ensure_hk_fact_scope(p_issuer uuid, p_fetch_key text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if p_issuer is null or p_fetch_key is null or p_fetch_key !~ '^[0-9]{5}$' then
    raise exception 'invalid_input' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'fetch_key';
  end if;
  insert into public.fact_sync_scope (issuer_id, market, reasons, priority, fetch_key)
  values (p_issuer, 'HK', '["documents"]'::jsonb, 0, p_fetch_key)
  on conflict (issuer_id, market) do nothing;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.ensure_hk_fact_scope(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.ensure_hk_fact_scope(uuid, text) to service_role;

-- R5-12: only financial_facts items whose member facts are all HK (or, with no member left, whose
-- payload.run_id is an HK run) — else not_hk_item, nothing changes. Calls the unchanged spec-2
-- resolve_facts_quarantine (its locks and checks as they are) and, in the same transaction, closes
-- the hook: detail.hook = {stage:'done', state:'done', at, message:'hk_no_metrics'} (HK is not
-- materialised, R5-3). Returns the spec-2 result.
create or replace function public.resolve_hk_facts_quarantine(p_item uuid, p_chosen uuid[], p_resolved_by uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare q public.dq_quarantine; v_ids uuid[]; v_markets text[]; v_run_market text; v_out jsonb;
begin
  select * into q from public.dq_quarantine where id = p_item;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found' using errcode = 'P0002', detail = 'item'; end if;
  if q.table_name <> 'financial_facts' then raise exception 'not_hk_item' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  v_ids := public.fact_item_members(q.payload);
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct f.market), '{}'::text[]) into v_markets from public.financial_facts f where f.fact_id = any(v_ids);
  if cardinality(v_markets) = 0 then
    select r.market into v_run_market from public.fact_sync_runs r
    where r.run_id = case when coalesce(q.payload ->> 'run_id', '') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then (q.payload ->> 'run_id')::uuid end;
    if v_run_market is distinct from 'HK' then raise exception 'not_hk_item' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  elsif v_markets <> array['HK']::text[] then
    raise exception 'not_hk_item' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  v_out := public.resolve_facts_quarantine(p_item, p_chosen, p_resolved_by);
  update public.dq_quarantine
  set detail = detail || jsonb_build_object('hook', jsonb_build_object('stage', 'done', 'state', 'done', 'at', to_jsonb(now()), 'message', 'hk_no_metrics'))
  where id = p_item;
  return v_out;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.resolve_hk_facts_quarantine(uuid, uuid[], uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.resolve_hk_facts_quarantine(uuid, uuid[], uuid) to service_role;

-- §4.11 promotionDue, at most p_limit (≤ 1000) issuers ascending, due by any of:
-- (ab) an active candidate — financial_fact, rule, extractor_ref = p_extractor_ref, checks_passed,
--      confirmed|promoted, on the current extraction of a public Chinese HKEXnews document — without a
--      staged|published link under p_pub_gen;
-- (c)  a staged link under p_pub_gen that recovery can act on (crash recovery; a quarantined fact
--      that became ok or disappeared). A link whose run is published and whose fact is still
--      quarantined waits on the owner's decision — step 0a would leave it staged — and is NOT due,
--      so unchanged quarantine waits never occupy the batch (codex plan round 1 P2-6);
-- (d)  (R5-13) a public Chinese HKEXnews document whose current extraction is primary and done and
--      whose bound filing sits on 1 <= mapping_gen < p_pub_gen (zero-output generation activation).
create or replace function public.hk_promotion_due(p_pub_gen int, p_extractor_ref text, p_limit int)
returns uuid[] language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with docs as (
    select d.document_id, d.issuer_id, d.current_extraction_id from public.disclosure_documents d
    where d.source = 'hkexnews' and d.language = 'zh' and d.permission = 'public' and d.issuer_id is not null and d.current_extraction_id is not null
  ), ab as (
    select docs.issuer_id from docs
    join public.extraction_candidates c on c.extraction_id = docs.current_extraction_id and c.document_id = docs.document_id
    where c.kind = 'financial_fact' and c.extractor_kind = 'rule' and c.extractor_ref = p_extractor_ref and c.checks_passed
      and c.status in ('confirmed','promoted')
      and not exists (select 1 from public.candidate_publications cp where cp.candidate_id = c.candidate_id and cp.pub_gen = p_pub_gen and cp.state in ('staged','published'))
  ), staged as (
    select d.issuer_id from public.candidate_publications cp
    join public.extraction_candidates c on c.candidate_id = cp.candidate_id
    join public.disclosure_documents d on d.document_id = c.document_id
    left join public.fact_sync_runs r on r.run_id = cp.run_id
    left join public.financial_facts f on f.fact_id = cp.fact_id
    where cp.pub_gen = p_pub_gen and cp.state = 'staged' and d.issuer_id is not null
      and not (coalesce(r.status, '') = 'published' and coalesce(f.status, '') = 'quarantined')
  ), zero as (
    select docs.issuer_id from docs
    join public.document_extractions e on e.extraction_id = docs.current_extraction_id
    join public.filing_documents fd on fd.document_id = docs.document_id
    join public.filings g on g.filing_id = fd.filing_id
    where e.candidates_role = 'primary' and e.candidates_status = 'done' and g.mapping_gen >= 1 and g.mapping_gen < p_pub_gen
  )
  select coalesce(array_agg(u.issuer_id order by u.issuer_id), '{}'::uuid[]) from (
    select issuer_id from ab union select issuer_id from staged union select issuer_id from zero
    order by issuer_id limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 0), 0), 1000)
  ) u
$$;
revoke execute on function public.hk_promotion_due(int, text, int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.hk_promotion_due(int, text, int) to service_role;

-- Condition (d) of hk_promotion_due for one issuer: the document ids, ascending.
create or replace function public.hk_zero_output_documents(p_issuer uuid, p_pub_gen int)
returns uuid[] language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct d.document_id order by d.document_id), '{}'::uuid[])
  from public.disclosure_documents d
  join public.document_extractions e on e.extraction_id = d.current_extraction_id
  join public.filing_documents fd on fd.document_id = d.document_id
  join public.filings g on g.filing_id = fd.filing_id
  where d.issuer_id = p_issuer and d.source = 'hkexnews' and d.language = 'zh' and d.permission = 'public'
    and e.candidates_role = 'primary' and e.candidates_status = 'done' and g.mapping_gen >= 1 and g.mapping_gen < p_pub_gen
$$;
revoke execute on function public.hk_zero_output_documents(uuid, int) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.hk_zero_output_documents(uuid, int) to service_role;
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the port (Supabase + memory) and the test-only pg port**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/facts-port.ts
// HkFactsPort (plan F3 §共享契约; spec §7.7 "规格二接口的适配", R5-2): the one module where the HK
// market meets the landed spec-2 facts layer, whose TS types know only 'US'|'CN' and whose files F3
// may not edit. Pass-through methods call FactsDb with market 'HK' — the cast lives here and nowhere
// else (HK_MARKET) — and throw FactsDbError exactly like FactsDb; F3-owned methods call migration
// two (ensure_hk_fact_scope, bind_filing_documents, insert_fact_citations, publish_hk_run,
// finish/abandon_candidate_publications, resolve_hk_facts_quarantine, hk_promotion_due,
// hk_zero_output_documents) and throw DocumentsDbError (spec-2 codes raised inside them, e.g.
// stale_plan, arrive as DocumentsDbError too). Implementations: supabaseHkFactsPort (rpc +
// service-role reads), memoryHkFactsPort (unit tests: wraps memoryFactsDb + memoryDocumentsDb and
// reproduces the SQL rules, the fact_citations / filing_documents cascades included; leases are
// compared with opts.now — pass the clock memoryFactsDb.setNow pinned — else the wall clock), and the test-only
// pgHkFactsPort in pg-facts-port.ts. Also the HK wrappers of the pure spec-2 planners so callers
// never spell the cast. Never through this port: reconcileScope, scopeDue, materialize,
// replaceMetrics, public-route helpers (spec §7.7).
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {supabaseFactsDb} from '../../facts/db';
import type {MemoryFactsDb} from '../../facts/memory-facts-db';
import {planFactWrites} from '../../facts/plan';
import type {PlanInput,PlanResult} from '../../facts/plan';
import {evaluateFactRules} from '../../facts/rules';
import type {FactRulesInput,FactRulesResult} from '../../facts/rules';
import {FactsDbError} from '../../facts/types';
import type {ConflictItem,FactInsert,FactRow,FactsDb,FilingInsert,Market,Origin,ReadFactsOptions,ReadFactsResult,Source} from '../../facts/types';
import {toDocumentsDbError} from '../db';
import type {MemoryDocumentsDb} from '../memory-documents-db';
import {DocumentsDbError,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF} from '../types';
import type {CitationRole,CitationRow,DocumentRow,DocumentsDbErrorCode,PageRow} from '../types';

export type HkMarket='HK';
/** The HK market string typed as the spec-2 Market — the only such cast (spec §16 interface request (4) removes it). */
export const HK_MARKET:Market='HK' as HkMarket as unknown as Market;
export interface HkFilingInsert{filing_id:string;issuer_id:string;source:'hkex';origin:'hkex';formType:'annual'|'semiannual';fiscalYear:number|null;fiscalPeriod:'FY'|'H1'|null;periodEnd:string|null;availableDate:string;sourceRef:string;url:string|null}
export interface HkPublicationOutcome{published:number;still_staged:number;abandoned:number}
export interface HkResolveOutcome{promoted:number;skipped:number;chosenFactIds:string[]}
export type HkRunStatus='staged'|'published'|'abandoned';
/** A zero-output document of the plan and the current extraction planning saw (codex plan round 1 P1-4). */
export interface HkZeroOutput{document_id:string;extraction_id:string}
export interface HkFactsPort{
 // pass-through to spec-2 rpc with market='HK' (cast lives only in this file)
 claimLease(issuer:string,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;
 beginRun(issuer:string,batch:string,mappingGen:number):Promise<string>;
 stageFilings(run:string,rows:HkFilingInsert[]):Promise<Map<string,string>>;
 stageFacts(run:string,rows:FactInsert[]):Promise<number>;                // FactInsert from src/lib/facts/types (market typed 'US'|'CN'; port casts)
 quarantineFacts(run:string,factIds:string[],itemId:string):Promise<number>;
 abandonRun(run:string):Promise<void>;
 releaseLease(issuer:string,batch:string,outcome:'success'|'failed',nextDue:string):Promise<void>;
 readFacts(issuer:string,opts:ReadFactsOptions):Promise<ReadFactsResult>;
 factsByIds(ids:string[]):Promise<FactRow[]>;
 openConflicts(issuer:string):Promise<ConflictItem[]>;
 runStatus(run:string):Promise<HkRunStatus|null>;
 // F3-owned functions of migration two
 ensureHkScope(issuer:string,fetchKey:string):Promise<void>;
 bindFilingDocuments(run:string,rows:{filing_id:string;document_id:string}[]):Promise<number>;
 insertFactCitations(run:string,rows:{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}[]):Promise<number>;
 publishHkRun(issuer:string,batch:string,run:string,manifest:string[],expectedRev:number,zeroOutput:readonly HkZeroOutput[]):Promise<number>;   // zeroOutput: the planned zero-output selection, revalidated under the document locks (P1-4)
 finishCandidatePublications(run:string):Promise<HkPublicationOutcome>;
 abandonCandidatePublications(run:string):Promise<number>;
 promotionDue(pubGen:number,limit:number):Promise<{issuerId:string}[]>;
 zeroOutputDocuments(issuer:string,pubGen:number):Promise<string[]>;      // document ids hitting promotionDue condition (d) for this issuer
 resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item:string,chosen:string[],resolvedBy:string):Promise<HkResolveOutcome>;
 citationsOfFact(factId:string):Promise<{role:CitationRole;citation_id:string}[]>;
 hkFilingOfDocument(documentId:string):Promise<{filing_id:string;mapping_gen:number}|null>;
}
type PassThrough=Pick<HkFactsPort,'claimLease'|'beginRun'|'stageFilings'|'stageFacts'|'quarantineFacts'|'abandonRun'|'releaseLease'|'readFacts'|'factsByIds'|'openConflicts'>;

export const CITATION_ROLES:readonly CitationRole[]=['value','label','period','unit'];
const SHARED_CODES:readonly DocumentsDbErrorCode[]=['lease_lost','stale_plan','run_pending','invalid_chosen','item_not_open'];
/** FactsDbError (memory spec-2 paths inside an F3 method) → DocumentsDbError with the same code when both know it, else 'unknown' carrying the message. */
export function asDocumentsDbError(e:unknown):DocumentsDbError{
 if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError)return e;
 if(e instanceof FactsDbError)return new DocumentsDbError((SHARED_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(e.code)?e.code as DocumentsDbErrorCode:'unknown',e.message);
 return new DocumentsDbError('unknown',e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e));
}
export function toFilingInsert(r:HkFilingInsert):FilingInsert{
 return {filing_id:r.filing_id,issuer_id:r.issuer_id,sourceRef:r.sourceRef,market:HK_MARKET,source:r.source as string as Source,origin:r.origin as string as Origin,formType:r.formType,fiscalYear:r.fiscalYear,fiscalPeriod:r.fiscalPeriod,periodEnd:r.periodEnd,availableDate:r.availableDate,url:r.url};
}
/** spec-2 planFactWrites with market 'HK' (spec §7.7 step 2, used verbatim). */
export const planHkFactWrites=(input:Omit<PlanInput,'market'>):PlanResult=>planFactWrites({...input,market:HK_MARKET});
/** spec-2 identity_bs / identity_gp (exact decimals) with market 'HK' (spec §7.7 step 4). */
export const evaluateHkFactRules=(input:Omit<FactRulesInput,'market'>):FactRulesResult=>evaluateFactRules({...input,market:HK_MARKET});
export function hkPassThrough(facts:FactsDb):PassThrough{
 return {
  claimLease:(issuer,batch,ttl)=>facts.claimLease(issuer,HK_MARKET,batch,ttl),
  beginRun:(issuer,batch,gen)=>facts.beginRun(issuer,HK_MARKET,batch,gen),
  stageFilings:(run,rows)=>facts.stageFilings(run,rows.map(toFilingInsert)),
  stageFacts:(run,rows)=>facts.stageFacts(run,rows.map(r=>({...r,market:HK_MARKET}))),
  quarantineFacts:(run,ids,item)=>facts.quarantineFacts(run,ids,item),
  abandonRun:run=>facts.abandonRun(run),
  releaseLease:(issuer,batch,outcome,nextDue)=>facts.releaseLease(issuer,HK_MARKET,batch,outcome,nextDue),
  readFacts:(issuer,opts)=>facts.readFacts(issuer,HK_MARKET,opts),
  factsByIds:ids=>facts.factsByIds(ids),
  openConflicts:issuer=>facts.openConflicts(issuer,HK_MARKET),
 };
}
export const publicationOutcomeOf=(x:Record<string,unknown>|null):HkPublicationOutcome=>({published:Number(x?.published??0),still_staged:Number(x?.still_staged??0),abandoned:Number(x?.abandoned??0)});
export const resolveOutcomeOf=(x:{promoted?:unknown;skipped?:unknown;chosen_fact_ids?:unknown}):HkResolveOutcome=>({promoted:Number(x.promoted),skipped:Number(x.skipped),chosenFactIds:Array.isArray(x.chosen_fact_ids)?x.chosen_fact_ids.map(String):[]});
export function assertExpectedRev(rev:number):void{if(!Number.isSafeInteger(rev)||rev<0)throw new DocumentsDbError('invalid_expected_rev');}

interface RpcResult{data:unknown;error:{message?:string;code?:string|null}|null}
// The query builder is left untyped on purpose (same as facts/db.ts): the hand-maintained Database type lacks what supabase-js inference needs.
interface NarrowClient{rpc:(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>PromiseLike<RpcResult>;from:(table:string)=>any}

export function supabaseHkFactsPort(admin:SupabaseClient):HkFactsPort{
 const c=admin as unknown as NarrowClient;
 const call=async<T>(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<T>=>{const {data,error}=await c.rpc(fn,args);if(error)throw toDocumentsDbError(error);return data as T;};
 const rows=async<T>(q:PromiseLike<RpcResult>):Promise<T[]>=>{const {data,error}=await q;if(error)throw toDocumentsDbError(error);return (data??[]) as T[];};
 return {
  ...hkPassThrough(supabaseFactsDb(admin)),
  async runStatus(run){const [r]=await rows<{status:HkRunStatus}>(c.from('fact_sync_runs').select('status').eq('run_id',run).limit(1));return r?.status??null;},
  async ensureHkScope(issuer,fetchKey){await call('ensure_hk_fact_scope',{p_issuer:issuer,p_fetch_key:fetchKey});},
  async bindFilingDocuments(run,input){return Number(await call('bind_filing_documents',{p_run:run,p_rows:input}));},
  async insertFactCitations(run,input){return Number(await call('insert_fact_citations',{p_run:run,p_rows:input}));},
  async publishHkRun(issuer,batch,run,manifest,expectedRev,zeroOutput){assertExpectedRev(expectedRev);return Number(await call('publish_hk_run',{p_issuer:issuer,p_batch:batch,p_run:run,p_manifest:manifest,p_expected_rev:expectedRev,p_zero_output:zeroOutput}));},
  async finishCandidatePublications(run){return publicationOutcomeOf(await call<Record<string,unknown>|null>('finish_candidate_publications',{p_run:run}));},
  async abandonCandidatePublications(run){return Number(await call('abandon_candidate_publications',{p_run:run}));},
  async promotionDue(pubGen,limit){return ((await call<string[]|null>('hk_promotion_due',{p_pub_gen:pubGen,p_extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,p_limit:limit}))??[]).map(issuerId=>({issuerId:String(issuerId)}));},
  async zeroOutputDocuments(issuer,pubGen){return ((await call<string[]|null>('hk_zero_output_documents',{p_issuer:issuer,p_pub_gen:pubGen}))??[]).map(String);},
  async resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item,chosen,by){return resolveOutcomeOf(await call<Record<string,unknown>>('resolve_hk_facts_quarantine',{p_item:item,p_chosen:chosen,p_resolved_by:by}));},
  async citationsOfFact(factId){
   // ≤ a few rows per fact (one value, label, unit + period evidence): one page is complete
   return (await rows<{role:CitationRole;citation_id:string}>(c.from('fact_citations').select('role,citation_id').eq('fact_id',factId).order('role').order('citation_id').limit(1000))).map(r=>({role:r.role,citation_id:String(r.citation_id)}));
  },
  async hkFilingOfDocument(documentId){
   const [b]=await rows<{filing_id:string}>(c.from('filing_documents').select('filing_id').eq('document_id',documentId).order('filing_id').limit(1));
   if(!b)return null;
   const [g]=await rows<{mapping_gen:number}>(c.from('filings').select('mapping_gen').eq('filing_id',b.filing_id).limit(1));
   return g?{filing_id:String(b.filing_id),mapping_gen:Number(g.mapping_gen)}:null;
  },
 };
}

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const cpSlice=(s:string,start:number,end:number)=>Array.from(s).slice(start,end).join('');
const fail=(code:DocumentsDbErrorCode,message?:string)=>new DocumentsDbError(code,message);

/** In-memory port: same rules as migration two, over the two in-memory stores (single-threaded tests). */
export function memoryHkFactsPort(facts:MemoryFactsDb,docs:MemoryDocumentsDb,opts:{now?:()=>Date}={}):HkFactsPort{
 const evidence:{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}[]=[];
 const bindings=new Map<string,{filing_id:string;document_id:string;created_at:string}>();
 const nowIso=()=>(opts.now?opts.now():new Date()).toISOString();
 // cascades (§4.9): a binding lives while its filing exists, an evidence row while its fact exists
 const liveBindings=()=>{const ids=new Set(facts.filings().map(g=>g.filing_id));for(const k of [...bindings.keys()])if(!ids.has(k))bindings.delete(k);return bindings;};
 const liveEvidence=()=>{const ids=new Set(facts.facts().map(f=>f.fact_id));for(let i=evidence.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(!ids.has(evidence[i].fact_id))evidence.splice(i,1);return evidence;};
 const runOf=(run:string)=>facts.runs().find(r=>r.run_id===run);
 const leaseHeld=(issuer:string,market:Market,batch:string)=>{const s=facts.scope().find(x=>x.issuer_id===issuer&&x.market===market);return !!s&&s.lease_batch_id===batch&&s.lease_until!==null&&s.lease_until>nowIso();};
 /** fact_run_lock: the run's batch must hold the run's scope lease; the run must be staged. */
 const runLock=(run:string)=>{
  const r=runOf(run);if(!r)throw fail('unknown','run_not_found');
  if(!leaseHeld(r.issuer_id,r.market,r.batch_id))throw fail('lease_lost');
  if(r.status==='published')throw fail('unknown','run_published');
  if(r.status==='abandoned')throw fail('unknown','run_abandoned');
  if(r.market!==HK_MARKET)throw fail('invalid_input','run_market');
  return r;
 };
 const docMap=()=>new Map<string,DocumentRow>(docs.documents().map(d=>[d.document_id,d]));
 const intact=(c:CitationRow,pages:PageRow[])=>{const p=pages.find(x=>x.extraction_id===c.extraction_id&&x.page_no===c.page_no);return !!p&&p.text_hash===c.text_hash&&cpSlice(p.text,c.char_start,c.char_end)===c.snippet;};
 const eligibleDoc=(d:DocumentRow)=>d.source==='hkexnews'&&d.language==='zh'&&d.permission==='public'&&d.issuer_id!==null&&d.current_extraction_id!==null;
 const ZERO_UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
 /** promotionDue condition (d): document id → issuer id. */
 const zeroOutput=(pubGen:number)=>{
  const out=new Map<string,string>();const ext=new Map(docs.extractions().map(e=>[e.extraction_id,e]));const filings=new Map(facts.filings().map(g=>[g.filing_id,g]));
  const live=[...liveBindings().values()];
  for(const d of docs.documents()){
   if(!eligibleDoc(d))continue;
   const e=ext.get(d.current_extraction_id!);
   if(!e||e.candidates_role!=='primary'||e.candidates_status!=='done')continue;
   if(live.some(b=>{const g=b.document_id===d.document_id?filings.get(b.filing_id):undefined;return !!g&&g.mapping_gen>=1&&g.mapping_gen<pubGen;}))out.set(d.document_id,d.issuer_id!);
  }
  return out;
 };
 const assertEvidence=(run:string)=>{
  const fc=liveEvidence();const B=liveBindings();const D=docMap();const C=new Map(docs.citations().map(c=>[c.citation_id,c]));const P=docs.pages();const pubs=docs.publications();
  const rows=facts.facts().filter(f=>f.run_id===run&&(f.status==='staged'||f.status==='quarantined')).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.fact_id,b.fact_id));
  for(const f of rows){
   const mine=fc.filter(x=>x.fact_id===f.fact_id);
   const n=(role:CitationRole)=>mine.filter(x=>x.role===role).length;
   const b=B.get(f.filing_id);const d=b?D.get(b.document_id):undefined;
   const reason=n('value')!==1?'value':n('label')!==1?'label':n('unit')!==1?'unit':n('period')<1?'period'
    :pubs.filter(p=>p.run_id===run&&p.fact_id===f.fact_id&&p.state==='staged').length!==1?'publication'
    :!b?'unbound_filing'
    :mine.some(x=>{const c=C.get(x.citation_id);return !c||!d||c.document_id!==d.document_id||d.permission!=='public'||c.extraction_id!==d.current_extraction_id||!intact(c,P);})?'citation'
    :null;
   if(reason!==null)throw fail('evidence_incomplete',`${reason}:${f.fact_id}`);
  }
 };
 return {
  ...hkPassThrough(facts),
  async runStatus(run){return runOf(run)?.status??null;},
  async ensureHkScope(issuer,fetchKey){
   if(!/^[0-9]{5}$/.test(fetchKey))throw fail('invalid_input','fetch_key');
   if((await facts.scopeRows(HK_MARKET,[issuer])).length===0)await facts.reconcileScope(HK_MARKET,[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:['documents'],priority:0,fetch_key:fetchKey}]);
  },
  async bindFilingDocuments(run,input){
   const r=runLock(run);
   const filings=new Map(facts.filings().map(g=>[g.filing_id,g]));const D=docMap();const live=liveBindings();const pending=new Map<string,string>();
   for(const x of [...input].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.filing_id,b.filing_id)||cmp(a.document_id,b.document_id))){
    const g=filings.get(x.filing_id);
    if(!g||g.issuer_id!==r.issuer_id||g.market!==HK_MARKET||String(g.source)!=='hkex')throw fail('invalid_input','filing');
    const have=live.get(x.filing_id)?.document_id??pending.get(x.filing_id);
    if(have!==undefined){if(have!==x.document_id)throw fail('binding_conflict',x.filing_id);continue;}
    const d=D.get(x.document_id);
    if(!d||d.source!=='hkexnews'||d.language!=='zh'||d.permission!=='public'||d.issuer_id!==r.issuer_id)throw fail('invalid_input','document');
    if(g.source_ref!==`hkex:${d.source_ref}:v${d.source_version}`)throw fail('invalid_input','source_ref');
    pending.set(x.filing_id,x.document_id);
   }
   const at=nowIso();for(const [filing_id,document_id] of pending)bindings.set(filing_id,{filing_id,document_id,created_at:at});
   return pending.size;
  },
  async insertFactCitations(run,input){
   runLock(run);
   const F=new Map(facts.facts().map(f=>[f.fact_id,f]));const C=new Map(docs.citations().map(c=>[c.citation_id,c]));const D=docMap();const B=liveBindings();
   for(const x of input){
    const f=F.get(x.fact_id);const c=C.get(x.citation_id);const b=f?B.get(f.filing_id):undefined;const d=b?D.get(b.document_id):undefined;
    const reason=!CITATION_ROLES.includes(x.role)?'role':!f?'fact':f.run_id!==run||f.status!=='staged'?'fact_state':!c?'citation':!b?'unbound_filing'
     :c.document_id!==b.document_id?'document':!d||d.permission!=='public'?'permission':c.extraction_id!==d.current_extraction_id?'extraction':null;
    if(reason!==null)throw fail('invalid_citation',reason);
   }
   const have=liveEvidence();let n=0;
   for(const x of input){if(have.some(y=>y.fact_id===x.fact_id&&y.role===x.role&&y.citation_id===x.citation_id))continue;have.push({fact_id:x.fact_id,citation_id:x.citation_id,role:x.role});n++;}
   return n;
  },
  async publishHkRun(issuer,batch,run,manifest,expectedRev,zeroOutput){
   assertExpectedRev(expectedRev);
   if(!Array.isArray(zeroOutput)||zeroOutput.some(z=>typeof z!=='object'||z===null||!ZERO_UUID.test(String(z.document_id))||!ZERO_UUID.test(String(z.extraction_id))))throw fail('invalid_input','zero_output');
   if(!leaseHeld(issuer,HK_MARKET,batch))throw fail('lease_lost');
   const r=runOf(run);
   if(!r||r.issuer_id!==issuer||r.market!==HK_MARKET||r.batch_id!==batch||r.status!=='staged')throw fail('invalid_input','run');
   // P1-4: the zero-output selection is revalidated (SQL: under the document and extraction locks)
   const runFilings=new Set([...facts.filings().filter(g=>g.run_id===run).map(g=>g.filing_id),...manifest,...facts.facts().filter(f=>f.run_id===run).map(f=>f.filing_id)]);
   const boundDocs=new Set([...liveBindings().values()].filter(b=>runFilings.has(b.filing_id)).map(b=>b.document_id));
   const D=docMap();const ext=new Map(docs.extractions().map(e=>[e.extraction_id,e]));
   for(const z of [...zeroOutput].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.document_id,b.document_id))){
    const d=D.get(z.document_id);const e=ext.get(z.extraction_id);
    const ok=!!d&&boundDocs.has(d.document_id)&&eligibleDoc(d)&&d.issuer_id===issuer&&d.current_extraction_id===z.extraction_id&&!!e&&e.candidates_role==='primary'&&e.candidates_status==='done';
    if(!ok)throw fail('stale_plan',`zero_output:${z.document_id}`);
   }
   assertEvidence(run);
   try{return await facts.publishRun(run,manifest,expectedRev);}catch(e){throw asDocumentsDbError(e);}
  },
  async finishCandidatePublications(run){
   const r=runOf(run);
   if(!r)throw fail('not_found','run');
   if(r.status==='staged')throw fail('run_pending');
   if(r.status!=='published')throw fail('invalid_input','run_abandoned');
   const F=new Map(facts.facts().map(f=>[f.fact_id,f]));const at=nowIso();let published=0,abandoned=0;
   const links=[...docs._raw.publications.values()].filter(p=>p.run_id===run);
   for(const p of links){
    if(p.state!=='staged')continue;
    const f=F.get(p.fact_id);
    if(f?.status==='ok'){p.state='published';p.updated_at=at;published++;}
   }
   const promoted=new Set(links.filter(p=>p.state==='published').map(p=>p.candidate_id));
   for(const c of docs._raw.candidates.values())if(c.status==='confirmed'&&promoted.has(c.candidate_id))c.status='promoted';
   for(const p of links)if(p.state==='staged'&&!F.has(p.fact_id)){p.state='abandoned';p.updated_at=at;abandoned++;}
   return {published,still_staged:links.filter(p=>p.state==='staged').length,abandoned};
  },
  async abandonCandidatePublications(run){
   const r=runOf(run);
   if(!r)throw fail('not_found','run');
   if(r.status==='staged')throw fail('run_pending');
   if(r.status!=='abandoned')throw fail('invalid_input','run_published');
   const at=nowIso();let n=0;
   for(const p of docs._raw.publications.values())if(p.run_id===run&&p.state==='staged'){p.state='abandoned';p.updated_at=at;n++;}
   return n;
  },
  async promotionDue(pubGen,limit){
   const D=docMap();const ext=new Map(docs.extractions().map(e=>[e.extraction_id,e]));const pubs=docs.publications();const due=new Set<string>();
   for(const c of docs.candidates()){
    const d=D.get(c.document_id);
    if(!d||!eligibleDoc(d)||d.current_extraction_id!==c.extraction_id||!ext.has(c.extraction_id))continue;
    if(c.kind!=='financial_fact'||c.extractor_kind!=='rule'||c.extractor_ref!==HK_EXTRACTOR_REF||!c.checks_passed||(c.status!=='confirmed'&&c.status!=='promoted'))continue;
    if(!pubs.some(p=>p.candidate_id===c.candidate_id&&p.pub_gen===pubGen&&(p.state==='staged'||p.state==='published')))due.add(d.issuer_id!);   // (ab)
   }
   const byCandidate=new Map(docs.candidates().map(c=>[c.candidate_id,c]));
   const factStatus=new Map(facts.facts().map(f=>[f.fact_id,f.status]));
   for(const p of pubs){
    if(p.pub_gen!==pubGen||p.state!=='staged')continue;
    if(runOf(p.run_id)?.status==='published'&&factStatus.get(p.fact_id)==='quarantined')continue;   // waits on the owner's decision: recovery cannot act (P2-6)
    const c=byCandidate.get(p.candidate_id);const iss=c?D.get(c.document_id)?.issuer_id:null;if(iss)due.add(iss);   // (c)
   }
   for(const iss of zeroOutput(pubGen).values())due.add(iss);                                                                                                // (d)
   return [...due].sort(cmp).slice(0,Math.min(Math.max(limit,0),1000)).map(issuerId=>({issuerId}));
  },
  async zeroOutputDocuments(issuer,pubGen){return [...zeroOutput(pubGen).entries()].filter(([,iss])=>iss===issuer).map(([doc])=>doc).sort(cmp);},
  async resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item,chosen,resolvedBy){
   const [it]=await facts.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:item},{limit:1});
   if(!it)throw fail('not_found','item');
   if(it.table_name!=='financial_facts')throw fail('not_hk_item');
   const p=(it.payload??{}) as {fact_ids?:unknown;run_id?:unknown};
   const ids=Array.isArray(p.fact_ids)?p.fact_ids.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'):[];
   const markets=new Set((await facts.factsByIds(ids)).map(f=>String(f.market)));
   if(markets.size===0){if(String(typeof p.run_id==='string'?runOf(p.run_id)?.market:undefined)!=='HK')throw fail('not_hk_item');}
   else if(markets.size!==1||!markets.has('HK'))throw fail('not_hk_item');
   let out:HkResolveOutcome;
   try{out=await facts.resolveFactsQuarantine(item,chosen,resolvedBy);}catch(e){throw asDocumentsDbError(e);}
   const [fresh]=await facts.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:item},{limit:1});
   await facts.tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:item},{detail:{...((fresh?.detail as Record<string,unknown>|undefined)??{}),hook:{stage:'done',state:'done',at:nowIso(),message:'hk_no_metrics'}}});
   return out;
  },
  async citationsOfFact(factId){return liveEvidence().filter(x=>x.fact_id===factId).map(({role,citation_id})=>({role,citation_id})).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.role,b.role)||cmp(a.citation_id,b.citation_id));},
  async hkFilingOfDocument(documentId){
   const b=[...liveBindings().values()].filter(x=>x.document_id===documentId).sort((a,c)=>cmp(a.filing_id,c.filing_id))[0];
   if(!b)return null;
   const g=facts.filings().find(x=>x.filing_id===b.filing_id);
   return g?{filing_id:g.filing_id,mapping_gen:g.mapping_gen}:null;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/pg-facts-port.ts
// TEST-ONLY HkFactsPort over node-postgres (plan F3 Task 13, 契约变更请求 D1-1): pass-through via
// pgFactsDb (FactsDbError), F3 functions via the same SQL the Supabase port calls through rpc
// (DocumentsDbError via toDocumentsDbError). Kept out of facts-port.ts so production modules never
// import `pg` (same discipline as src/lib/facts/pg-facts-db.ts). Nothing in src/app imports this.
import type {Pool} from 'pg';
import {typeParsers} from '../../db/pg-table-client';
import {pgFactsDb} from '../../facts/pg-facts-db';
import {toDocumentsDbError} from '../db';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF} from '../types';
import type {CitationRole} from '../types';
import {assertExpectedRev,hkPassThrough,publicationOutcomeOf,resolveOutcomeOf} from './facts-port';
import type {HkFactsPort,HkRunStatus} from './facts-port';

export function pgHkFactsPort(pool:Pool):HkFactsPort{
 const run=async(text:string,values:unknown[])=>{
  try{return await pool.query({text,values,types:typeParsers});}
  catch(e){throw toDocumentsDbError(e as {message?:string;code?:string});}
 };
 const fn=async<T>(call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>(await run(`select ${call} as v`,values)).rows[0].v as T;
 return {
  ...hkPassThrough(pgFactsDb(pool)),
  async runStatus(id){const r=(await run(`select status from public.fact_sync_runs where run_id=$1::uuid`,[id])).rows[0] as {status:HkRunStatus}|undefined;return r?.status??null;},
  async ensureHkScope(issuer,fetchKey){await fn('public.ensure_hk_fact_scope($1::uuid,$2::text)',[issuer,fetchKey]);},
  async bindFilingDocuments(id,rows){return Number(await fn('public.bind_filing_documents($1::uuid,$2::jsonb)',[id,JSON.stringify(rows)]));},
  async insertFactCitations(id,rows){return Number(await fn('public.insert_fact_citations($1::uuid,$2::jsonb)',[id,JSON.stringify(rows)]));},
  async publishHkRun(issuer,batch,id,manifest,expectedRev,zeroOutput){assertExpectedRev(expectedRev);return Number(await fn('public.publish_hk_run($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::uuid,$4::uuid[],$5::bigint,$6::jsonb)',[issuer,batch,id,manifest,expectedRev,JSON.stringify(zeroOutput)]));},
  async finishCandidatePublications(id){return publicationOutcomeOf(await fn<Record<string,unknown>|null>('public.finish_candidate_publications($1::uuid)',[id]));},
  async abandonCandidatePublications(id){return Number(await fn('public.abandon_candidate_publications($1::uuid)',[id]));},
  async promotionDue(pubGen,limit){return ((await fn<string[]|null>('public.hk_promotion_due($1::int,$2::text,$3::int)',[pubGen,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,limit]))??[]).map(issuerId=>({issuerId:String(issuerId)}));},
  async zeroOutputDocuments(issuer,pubGen){return ((await fn<string[]|null>('public.hk_zero_output_documents($1::uuid,$2::int)',[issuer,pubGen]))??[]).map(String);},
  async resolveHkFactsQuarantine(item,chosen,by){return resolveOutcomeOf(await fn<Record<string,unknown>>('public.resolve_hk_facts_quarantine($1::uuid,$2::uuid[],$3::uuid)',[item,chosen,by]));},
  async citationsOfFact(factId){
   return ((await run(`select role, citation_id::text as citation_id from public.fact_citations where fact_id=$1::uuid order by role collate "C", citation_id`,[factId])).rows as {role:CitationRole;citation_id:string}[]).map(r=>({role:r.role,citation_id:r.citation_id}));
  },
  async hkFilingOfDocument(documentId){
   const r=(await run(`select fd.filing_id::text as filing_id, g.mapping_gen from public.filing_documents fd join public.filings g on g.filing_id=fd.filing_id where fd.document_id=$1::uuid order by fd.filing_id limit 1`,[documentId])).rows[0] as {filing_id:string;mapping_gen:number}|undefined;
   return r?{filing_id:r.filing_id,mapping_gen:Number(r.mapping_gen)}:null;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/_synthetic/build.ts
// Deterministic synthetic HK pages.json fixtures (plan F3 Task 14; spec §11.1 hk-facts tests). A
// fixture is a list of page specs: a string is a plain line (one item at the label x), a HeaderSpec
// a header line whose tokens sit right-aligned over the two value columns (optional lead over the
// notes column — the x positions period.ts maps header years/dates by), a RowSpec a table body row
// (label, optional note number, two values right-aligned to the value columns; '' = no item; both
// values '' = a label-only row, the shape extract/tables.ts gives sub-headings such as
// "Profit attributable to:" inside a table). Every line carries its items (LayoutItem, contract
// change C-1). The builder lays lines out top-down, computes code-point offsets for every line,
// item and cell, groups consecutive rows into tables whose header block is every non-row line since
// the previous table (or the page top), and numbers columns like extract/tables.ts: col 0 is the
// label cell, numeric columns 1..k by right edge (notes column first); col_x0[0] is the label x.
// scripts/documents/write-synthetic-fixtures.ts writes the JSON files next to this module;
// generate.test.ts checks that the committed files equal this builder's output.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../../../types';
import type {LayoutCell,LayoutLine,LayoutTable,PageLayout,PagesJson} from '../../../types';

export interface RowSpec{label:string;note?:string;values:[string,string]}
/** A header line: tokens right-aligned over the two value columns ('' = none), an optional lead right-aligned over the notes column. */
export interface HeaderSpec{header:[string,string];lead?:string}
export type LineSpec=string|RowSpec|HeaderSpec;
export interface PageSpec{page_no:number;lines:LineSpec[]}
const CHAR_W=6,LABEL_X=50,NOTE_RIGHT=320,VALUE_RIGHT=[420,500],TOP=800,LINE_H=14,ITEM_H=10;
const cpLen=(s:string)=>Array.from(s).length;
interface Part{text:string;x0:number;x1:number;numeric:boolean}
interface Item extends Part{char_start:number;char_end:number}
const isRow=(ls:LineSpec):ls is RowSpec=>typeof ls!=='string'&&'values' in ls;
const right=(text:string,x1:number,numeric:boolean):Part=>({text,x0:x1-cpLen(text)*CHAR_W,x1,numeric});

export function buildPage(spec:PageSpec):PageLayout{
 const lines:LayoutLine[]=[];const rows=new Map<number,Item[]>();let offset=0;
 spec.lines.forEach((ls,index)=>{
  const y=TOP-index*LINE_H;const parts:Part[]=[];
  if(typeof ls==='string')parts.push({text:ls,x0:LABEL_X,x1:LABEL_X+cpLen(ls)*CHAR_W,numeric:false});
  else if(isRow(ls)){
   parts.push({text:ls.label,x0:LABEL_X,x1:LABEL_X+cpLen(ls.label)*CHAR_W,numeric:false});
   if(ls.note!==undefined)parts.push(right(ls.note,NOTE_RIGHT,true));
   ls.values.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v!=='')parts.push(right(v,VALUE_RIGHT[i],true));});
  }else{
   if(ls.lead!==undefined)parts.push(right(ls.lead,NOTE_RIGHT,false));
   ls.header.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v!=='')parts.push(right(v,VALUE_RIGHT[i],false));});
  }
  const items:Item[]=[];let c=offset;
  for(const p of parts){items.push({...p,char_start:c,char_end:c+cpLen(p.text)});c+=cpLen(p.text)+1;}
  const text=parts.map(p=>p.text).join(' ');const n=cpLen(text);
  lines.push({index,y,x0:Math.min(...parts.map(p=>p.x0)),x1:Math.max(...parts.map(p=>p.x1)),text,char_start:offset,char_end:offset+n,
   items:items.map(it=>({text:it.text,x0:it.x0,x1:it.x1,y,h:ITEM_H,char_start:it.char_start,char_end:it.char_end}))});
  if(isRow(ls))rows.set(index,items);
  offset+=n+1;
 });
 const tables:LayoutTable[]=[];let headerFrom=0;
 for(let i=0;i<spec.lines.length;){
  if(!rows.has(i)){i++;continue;}
  let j=i;while(rows.has(j))j++;
  const body=Array.from({length:j-i},(_,k)=>i+k);
  const anchors=[...new Set(body.flatMap(k=>rows.get(k)!.filter(it=>it.numeric).map(it=>it.x1)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const cells:LayoutCell[]=[];
  body.forEach((k,row)=>{for(const it of rows.get(k)!){const y=lines[k].y;cells.push({row,col:it.numeric?anchors.indexOf(it.x1)+1:0,text:it.text,bbox:{x0:it.x0,y0:y,x1:it.x1,y1:y+ITEM_H},line_index:k,char_start:it.char_start,char_end:it.char_end,numeric:it.numeric});}});
  const col_x0=[LABEL_X,...anchors.map(a=>Math.min(...cells.filter(c=>c.numeric&&c.bbox!==null&&c.bbox.x1===a).map(c=>c.bbox!.x0)))];
  tables.push({header_lines:lines.slice(headerFrom,i),cells,row_count:j-i,col_count:anchors.length+1,col_x0});
  headerFrom=j;i=j;
 }
 return {page_no:spec.page_no,width:595,height:842,text:lines.map(l=>l.text).join('\n'),lines,tables};
}
export function buildPagesJson(name:string,pages:PageSpec[]):PagesJson{
 return {extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:'synthetic',content_sha256:createHash('sha256').update(`synthetic:${name}`).digest('hex'),has_text_layer:true,pages:pages.map(buildPage)};
}
const row=(label:string,a:string,b:string,note?:string):RowSpec=>note===undefined?{label,values:[a,b]}:{label,note,values:[a,b]};
const hdr=(a:string,b:string,lead?:string):HeaderSpec=>lead===undefined?{header:[a,b]}:{header:[a,b],lead};
const labelRow=(label:string):RowSpec=>({label,values:['','']});
export const SYNTHETIC_NAMES=['annual-zh','interim-en','interim-zh-bs-years','edge-cases','interim-bilingual'] as const;
export type SyntheticName=typeof SYNTHETIC_NAMES[number];
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/exact.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {exactIdentity,sumDecimals,toScaled} from './exact';

const BS={num:5n,den:1000n},CF={num:2n,den:100n};
describe('exact decimal arithmetic (spec §7.6, R5-8)',()=>{
 it('scales two decimals to a common number of fractional digits',()=>{
  expect(toScaled('1.5','2')).toEqual({a:15n,b:20n,scale:1});
  expect(toScaled('-0.125','3.4')).toEqual({a:-125n,b:3400n,scale:3});
  expect(toScaled('12345678901234567890','1')).toEqual({a:12345678901234567890n,b:1n,scale:0});
 });
 it('identity: |l − r| × den ≤ max(|l|,|r|,1) × num, with the exact difference kept',()=>{
  expect(exactIdentity('2000000','1999000',BS)).toEqual({passed:true,diff:'1000'});
  expect(exactIdentity('100','89',BS)).toEqual({passed:false,diff:'11'});
  expect(exactIdentity('50','51',CF)).toEqual({passed:true,diff:'-1'});
  expect(exactIdentity('50','52',CF)).toEqual({passed:false,diff:'-2'});
  expect(exactIdentity('0.001','0',BS)).toEqual({passed:true,diff:'0.001'});                 // the max(…,1) floor
  expect(exactIdentity('12345678901234567890','12345678901234567891',{num:0n,den:1n})).toEqual({passed:false,diff:'-1'});
  expect(exactIdentity('12345678901234567890','12345678901234567890.0',{num:0n,den:1n})).toEqual({passed:true,diff:'0'});
  expect(()=>exactIdentity('1','1',{num:-1n,den:1n})).toThrow('invalid_tolerance');
  expect(()=>exactIdentity('1','1',{num:1n,den:0n})).toThrow('invalid_tolerance');
  expect(()=>exactIdentity('1e3','1',BS)).not.toThrow();                                       // canonicalDecimal accepts exponents
  expect(()=>exactIdentity('abc','1',BS)).toThrow(/invalid_decimal/);
 });
 it('sums signed decimals exactly',()=>{
  expect(sumDecimals(['1.5','-0.25','3'])).toBe('4.25');
  expect(sumDecimals(['250000000','-120000000','-80000000'])).toBe('50000000');
  expect(sumDecimals(['0.1','0.2'])).toBe('0.3');
  expect(sumDecimals([])).toBe('0');
 });
});
```

```ts
import {cpIndex,cpSlice,locateStatements,matchesIn,titleRegion} from './locate';

  expect(cpIndex(s,5)).toBe(3);                                        // '綜' sits after two surrogate pairs and a space
  expect(cpSlice(s,3,5)).toBe('綜合');
  expect(matchesIn(s,/損益表/)).toEqual([{text:'損益表',start:5,end:8,groups:[]}]);
  expect(matchesIn(s,/(綜)(合)/g).map(m=>m.groups)).toEqual([['綜','合']]);

});

  expect(r.info).toEqual([]);
  expect(r.statements.map(s=>[s.statement,s.pages.map(p=>p.page_no),s.title.page_no,s.title.line.text,s.consolidated])).toEqual([
   ['IS',[3],3,'綜合損益表',true],['BS',[4],4,'綜合財務狀況表',true],['CF',[5],5,'綜合現金流量表',true]]);
 });
 it('reads English titles; a statement that is not there is simply missing',()=>{
  const r=locateStatements(fixture('interim-en'));
  expect(r.info).toEqual([]);
  expect(r.statements.map(s=>[s.statement,s.pages.map(p=>p.page_no)])).toEqual([['IS',[2]],['BS',[3]]]);
 });
 it('not consolidated and non-consecutive pages produce info and no statement',()=>{
  const r=locateStatements(fixture('edge-cases'));
  expect(r.statements.map(s=>s.statement)).toEqual(['BS']);
  expect(r.info).toEqual([{code:'not_consolidated',detail:'IS:p1'},{code:'locate_ambiguous',detail:'CF:3,5'}]);
 });
 it('bilingual interim (0268-shaped): titles in either script with 簡明/中期 and Condensed/Interim; the separate comprehensive-income statement is not the IS',()=>{
  const r=locateStatements(fixture('interim-bilingual'));
  expect(r.info).toEqual([]);
  expect(r.statements.map(s=>[s.statement,s.pages.map(p=>p.page_no),s.title.line.text])).toEqual([
   ['IS',[45],'CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED INTERIM INCOME STATEMENT'],['BS',[44],'CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED INTERIM STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION'],['CF',[47],'CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED INTERIM CASH FLOW STATEMENT']]);
 });
 it('a combined profit-or-loss and comprehensive-income statement is used when no plain income statement exists',()=>{
  const json=fixture('interim-bilingual');
  const only={...json,pages:json.pages.filter(p=>p.page_no!==45)};
  expect(locateStatements(only).statements.find(s=>s.statement==='IS')?.pages.map(p=>p.page_no)).toEqual([46]);
  const zhOnly={...only,pages:only.pages.map(p=>p.page_no!==46?p:{...p,lines:p.lines.map(l=>l.index===0?{...l,text:'綜合損益及其他全面收益表'}:l)})};
  expect(locateStatements(zhOnly).statements.find(s=>s.statement==='IS')?.title.line.text).toBe('綜合損益及其他全面收益表');
 });
 it('the title region is every line above the first table body row',()=>{
  const p=fixture('annual-zh').pages.find(x=>x.page_no===3)!;
  expect(titleRegion(p).map(l=>l.text)).toEqual(['綜合損益表','截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度','附註 二零二五年 二零二四年','人民幣千元 人民幣千元']);
  expect(titleRegion({...p,tables:[]})).toEqual([]);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/period.test.ts
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {buildPage} from '../fixtures/hkex/_synthetic/build';
import type {LayoutLine,PagesJson} from '../types';
import {cpSlice} from './locate';
import {columnPeriod,findDates,findYears,headerColumns,mapColumns,numericColumns,parseDate,periodStart,titlePeriod,withYear} from './period';
import type {ColumnRef,TitlePeriod} from './period';

const fixture=(name:string)=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(`src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/_synthetic/${name}.json`,'utf8')) as PagesJson;
const ln=(text:string,index=0,char_start=0):LayoutLine=>({index,y:0,x0:0,x1:0,text,char_start,char_end:char_start+Array.from(text).length,items:[]});

describe('dates and years',()=>{
 it('parses Chinese numerals, Arabic Chinese and English dates; refuses impossible ones',()=>{
  expect(parseDate('二零二五年十二月三十一日')).toBe('2025-12-31');
  expect(parseDate('二〇二四年六月三十日')).toBe('2024-06-30');
  expect(parseDate('二零二五年 十二月 三十一日')).toBe('2025-12-31');
  expect(parseDate('2025年6月30日')).toBe('2025-06-30');
  expect(parseDate('31 December 2025')).toBe('2025-12-31');
  expect(parseDate('June 30, 2025')).toBe('2025-06-30');
  expect(parseDate('二零二五年二月三十日')).toBeNull();
  expect(parseDate('二零二五年十二月')).toBeNull();
  expect(parseDate('31 Decembre 2025')).toBeNull();
 });
 it('finds dates and standalone years (dates masked) with code-point positions',()=>{
  const t='😀 截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度 二零二四年 2023 1,2024';
  expect(findDates(t)).toEqual([{iso:'2025-12-31',text:'二零二五年十二月三十一日',start:4,end:16}]);
  expect(findYears(t)).toEqual([{year:2024,text:'二零二四年',start:20,end:25},{year:2023,text:'2023',start:26,end:30}]);
  expect(findYears('30 June 2025 31 December 2024')).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('withYear and periodStart (month ends start on the 1st; other days N months back + 1 day)',()=>{
  expect(withYear('2025-12-31',2024)).toBe('2024-12-31');
  expect(withYear('2024-02-29',2023)).toBeNull();
  expect(periodStart('2025-12-31','12M')).toBe('2025-01-01');
  expect(periodStart('2025-06-30','6M')).toBe('2025-01-01');
  expect(periodStart('2025-03-31','12M')).toBe('2024-04-01');
  expect(periodStart('2025-06-15','6M')).toBe('2024-12-16');
 });
});

describe('titlePeriod (spec §7.5 step 2)',()=>{
 it('duration titles in Chinese and English, instant titles for the balance sheet, offsets on the page',()=>{
  expect(titlePeriod('IS',3,[ln('綜合損益表'),ln('截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度',1,6)])).toEqual({duration:'12M',date:'2025-12-31',page_no:3,start:6,end:23,text:'截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度'});
  expect(titlePeriod('CF',2,[ln('For the six months ended 30 June 2025')])).toMatchObject({duration:'6M',date:'2025-06-30',start:0,end:37});
  expect(titlePeriod('IS',2,[ln('截至二零二五年六月三十日止六個月')])).toMatchObject({duration:'6M',date:'2025-06-30'});
  expect(titlePeriod('BS',4,[ln('於二零二五年十二月三十一日')])).toMatchObject({duration:'INSTANT',date:'2025-12-31',text:'於二零二五年十二月三十一日'});
  expect(titlePeriod('BS',3,[ln('As at 30 June 2025')])).toMatchObject({duration:'INSTANT',date:'2025-06-30'});
  expect(titlePeriod('BS',3,[ln('截至二零二五年六月三十日止六個月')])).toBeNull();
  expect(titlePeriod('IS',3,[ln('於二零二五年十二月三十一日')])).toBeNull();
  expect(titlePeriod('IS',3,[ln('綜合損益表')])).toBeNull();
 });
});

describe('columns',()=>{
 const title:TitlePeriod={duration:'12M',date:'2025-12-31',page_no:3,start:0,end:1,text:'x'};
 const ref=(o:Partial<ColumnRef>={}):ColumnRef=>({anchor:420,kind:'year',year:2025,date:null,text:'二零二五年',page_no:3,start:10,end:15,...o});
 it('maps header years onto the numeric columns under them; years-less tables inherit by right edge',()=>{
  const p=fixture('annual-zh').pages.find(x=>x.page_no===3)!;
  const [t1,t2,t3]=p.tables;
  expect(numericColumns(t1).map(c=>c.anchor)).toEqual([320,420,500]);                       // notes, 2025, 2024
  const refs=headerColumns('IS',t1,3);
  expect(Array.isArray(refs)&&refs.map(r=>[r.kind,r.year,r.anchor,cpSlice(p.text,r.start,r.end)])).toEqual([['year',2025,420,'二零二五年'],['year',2024,500,'二零二四年']]);
  expect(headerColumns('IS',t2,3)).toBeNull();                                               // '以下人士應佔：'
  expect(headerColumns('IS',t3,3)).toBeNull();                                               // '每股盈利（人民幣元）'
  expect([...mapColumns(t2,refs as ColumnRef[]).values()].map(r=>r.year)).toEqual([2025,2024]);
  expect([...mapColumns(t1,refs as ColumnRef[]).keys()]).toEqual([2,3]);                    // col 0 = label, col 1 = notes (maps to nothing)
 });
 it('balance sheets prefer full-date headers and skip the title phrase',()=>{
  const p=fixture('interim-en').pages.find(x=>x.page_no===3)!;
  const refs=headerColumns('BS',p.tables[0],3);
  expect(Array.isArray(refs)&&refs.map(r=>[r.kind,r.date,r.text])).toEqual([['date','2025-06-30','30 June 2025'],['date','2024-12-31','31 December 2024']]);
 });
 it('more header tokens than numeric columns is unmappable',()=>{
  const page=buildPage({page_no:1,lines:['2025 2024',{label:'收益',values:['1','']}]});
  expect(headerColumns('IS',page.tables[0],1)).toBe('unmappable');
 });
 it('places header tokens by their item x (C-1); the rightmost rule is only the fallback for lines without items',()=>{
  const page=buildPage({page_no:1,lines:[{header:['2025','']},{label:'收益',note:'5',values:['1','2']},{label:'毛利',values:['3','4']}]});
  const refs=headerColumns('IS',page.tables[0],1);
  expect(Array.isArray(refs)&&refs.map(r=>[r.year,r.anchor])).toEqual([[2025,420]]);          // over the middle column, not the rightmost
  const bare={...page.tables[0],header_lines:page.tables[0].header_lines.map(l=>({...l,items:[]}))};
  const fallback=headerColumns('IS',bare,1);
  expect(Array.isArray(fallback)&&fallback.map(r=>[r.year,r.anchor])).toEqual([[2025,500]]);
  const away=buildPage({page_no:1,lines:['2025',{label:'收益',values:['1','2']}]});              // a plain line: one item at the label x, over no column
  expect(headerColumns('IS',away.tables[0],1)).toBe('unmappable');
 });
 it('bilingual headers: two year lines over the same columns map once; BS dates over the columns',()=>{
  const json=fixture('interim-bilingual');
  const is=json.pages.find(x=>x.page_no===45)!;
  const refs=headerColumns('IS',is.tables[0],45);
  expect(Array.isArray(refs)&&refs.map(r=>[r.year,r.anchor,r.text])).toEqual([[2026,420,'二零二六年'],[2025,500,'二零二五年']]);
  const bs=json.pages.find(x=>x.page_no===44)!;
  const d=headerColumns('BS',bs.tables[0],44);
  expect(Array.isArray(d)&&d.map(r=>[r.kind,r.date,r.anchor])).toEqual([['date','2026-06-30',420],['date','2025-12-31',500]]);
 });
 it('derives the period of a column (rules title_duration, title_year_substitution, title_instant, column_date)',()=>{
  expect(columnPeriod(title,ref(),true)).toMatchObject({period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'12M',rule:'title_duration',title_date:'2025-12-31',column_text:'二零二五年'});
  expect(columnPeriod(title,ref({year:2024,text:'二零二四年'}),true)).toMatchObject({period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'12M',rule:'title_year_substitution',column_text:'二零二四年'});
  const half={...title,duration:'6M' as const,date:'2025-06-30'};
  expect(columnPeriod(half,ref({year:2024}),false)).toMatchObject({period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-06-30',duration:'6M',rule:'title_year_substitution'});
  const bs={...title,duration:'INSTANT' as const};
  expect(columnPeriod(bs,ref(),true)).toMatchObject({period_start:null,period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'INSTANT',rule:'title_instant'});
  expect(columnPeriod(bs,ref({year:2024}),true)).toMatchObject({period_start:null,period_end:'2024-12-31',rule:'title_year_substitution'});
  const interimBs={...bs,date:'2025-06-30'};
  expect(columnPeriod(interimBs,ref(),false)).toMatchObject({period_end:'2025-06-30',rule:'title_instant'});
  expect(columnPeriod(interimBs,ref({year:2024}),false)).toBe('interim_year_only');
  expect(columnPeriod(interimBs,ref({kind:'date',year:2024,date:'2024-12-31',text:'31 December 2024'}),false)).toMatchObject({period_end:'2024-12-31',rule:'column_date',column_text:'31 December 2024'});
  expect(columnPeriod(interimBs,ref({kind:'date',year:2025,date:'2025-06-30'}),false)).toMatchObject({rule:'title_instant'});
  expect(columnPeriod({...title,date:'2024-02-29'},ref({year:2023}),true)).toBe('invalid_date');
 });
});
```
