```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/scale.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import type {LayoutLine} from '../types';
import {detectAmountUnit,detectEpsUnit} from './scale';

const u=(text:string,char_start=0,page_no=1)=>({page_no,line:{index:0,y:0,x0:0,x1:0,text,char_start,char_end:char_start+Array.from(text).length} as LayoutLine});
describe('amount unit (spec §7.5 step 3: currency words removed first, then the longest multiplier)',()=>{
 it('currency and multiplier, cited as the whole line',()=>{
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('人民幣千元 人民幣千元',30,3)])).toEqual({ok:true,currency:'CNY',scale:'1000',cite:{page_no:3,char_start:30,char_end:41}});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('千港元 千港元')])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'HKD',scale:'1000'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u("HK$'000 HK$'000")])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'HKD',scale:'1000'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('RMB million')])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'CNY',scale:'1000000'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u("US$'000,000")])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'USD',scale:'1000000'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('人民幣百萬元')])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'CNY',scale:'1000000'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('綜合損益表'),u('港幣千元',8)])).toMatchObject({ok:true,currency:'HKD',scale:'1000',cite:{char_start:8}});
 });
 it("'港元' never becomes the multiplier 元; currency without multiplier, several currencies or multipliers are refused",()=>{
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('港元 港元')])).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'no_multiplier'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('人民幣元')])).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'no_multiplier'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('附註 二零二五年')])).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'no_currency'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('人民幣千元 港元')])).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'currencies:CNY,HKD'});
  expect(detectAmountUnit([u('人民幣千元'),u('人民幣百萬元')])).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'multipliers:1000,1000000'});
 });
});
describe('per-share sub-unit (eps never inherits the table multiplier)',()=>{
 const s=(text:string,char_start=0)=>({page_no:2,text,char_start});
 it('港仙 / HK cents → HKD/share 0.01; 仙 / cents take the table currency; 元 forms → 1; the token is cited',()=>{
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本（港仙）',10)],null)).toEqual({ok:true,unit:'HKD/share',scale:'0.01',cite:{page_no:2,char_start:13,char_end:15}});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('Basic'),s('Earnings per share (HK cents)')],'CNY')).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'HKD/share',scale:'0.01'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本'),s('每股盈利（仙）')],'HKD')).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'HKD/share',scale:'0.01'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本'),s('每股盈利（仙）')],null)).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'eps_currency'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本'),s('每股盈利（人民幣元）')],'HKD')).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'CNY/share',scale:'1'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('Basic (RMB cents)')],null)).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'CNY/share',scale:'0.01'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('Basic (RMB)')],null)).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'CNY/share',scale:'1'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本（港元）')],null)).toMatchObject({ok:true,unit:'HKD/share',scale:'1'});
  expect(detectEpsUnit([s('基本'),s('每股盈利')],'HKD')).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'eps_no_subunit'});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/labels.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {FACT_CONCEPTS} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {LABEL_RULES,headingSection,labelCore,labelVariants,matchConcepts,normalizeLabel} from './labels';
import type {Section} from './labels';

describe('labels (spec §7.5 step 4)',()=>{
 it('covers exactly the 18 concepts, all landed spec-2 FACT_CONCEPTS on their statement',()=>{
  const ids=[...new Set(LABEL_RULES.map(r=>r.concept))];
  expect(ids).toHaveLength(18);
  for(const r of LABEL_RULES)expect({concept:r.concept,statement:FACT_CONCEPTS.find(c=>c.id===r.concept)?.statement}).toEqual({concept:r.concept,statement:r.statement});
 });
 it('normalizes labels: NFKC, bullets, trailing note numbers and colons; the core drops a trailing parenthesis',()=>{
  expect(normalizeLabel(' — 基本 ')).toBe('基本');
  expect(normalizeLabel('所得稅開支 9')).toBe('所得稅開支');
  expect(normalizeLabel('收益（附註5）')).toBe('收益(附註5)');
  expect(normalizeLabel('以下人士應佔：')).toBe('以下人士應佔');
  expect(labelCore('收益(附註5)')).toBe('收益');
  expect(labelCore('攤薄(港仙)')).toBe('攤薄');
 });
 it('matches whole labels in traditional, simplified and English, honouring statements and sections',()=>{
  const cases:[string,'IS'|'BS'|'CF',Section,string[]][]=[
   ['收益','IS',null,['revenue']],['Turnover','IS',null,['revenue']],['营业额','IS',null,['revenue']],['其他收益','IS',null,[]],
   ['銷售成本','IS',null,['cost_of_revenue']],['Cost of sales','IS',null,['cost_of_revenue']],['毛利','IS',null,['gross_profit']],
   ['經營溢利','IS',null,['operating_income']],['Operating profit','IS',null,['operating_income']],
   ['所得稅開支','IS',null,['income_tax']],['所得税','IS',null,['income_tax']],['Income tax expense','IS',null,['income_tax']],
   ['年內溢利','IS',null,['net_income']],['期内利润','IS',null,['net_income']],['Profit for the period','IS',null,['net_income']],
   ['本公司擁有人','IS','attribution',['net_income_parent']],['本公司擁有人','IS','attribution_ci',[]],['本公司擁有人','IS',null,[]],
   ['Owners of the Company','IS','attribution',['net_income_parent']],['Equity holders of the Company','IS','attribution',['net_income_parent']],
   ['基本','IS','eps',['eps_basic']],['基本','IS',null,[]],['Diluted','IS','eps',['eps_diluted']],['攤薄（港仙）','IS','eps',['eps_diluted']],
   ['資產總值','BS',null,['total_assets']],['Total liabilities','BS',null,['total_liabilities']],['本公司擁有人應佔權益','BS',null,['equity_parent']],
   ['Equity attributable to owners of the Company','BS',null,['equity_parent']],['權益總額','BS',null,['equity_total']],['現金及現金等價物','BS',null,['cash']],
   ['經營活動所得現金淨額','CF',null,['operating_cash_flow']],['投資活動所用之現金淨額','CF',null,['investing_cash_flow']],
   ['Net cash used in financing activities','CF',null,['financing_cash_flow']],['現金及現金等價物增加/(減少)淨額','CF',null,['net_change_in_cash']],
   ['Net decrease in cash and cash equivalents','CF',null,['net_change_in_cash']],['現金及現金等價物','CF',null,[]],['收益','BS',null,[]],
   // bilingual HKEX label cells and the variants of the recorded 0268.HK interim (one concept through both scripts is not ambiguous)
   ['Revenue from contracts with customers 與客戶之間的合同產生的收入','IS',null,['revenue']],['Cost of sales 銷售成本','IS',null,['cost_of_revenue']],
   ['Income tax credit 所得稅沖回','IS',null,['income_tax']],['Profit/(loss) for the period 當期盈利╱（虧損）','IS',null,['net_income']],
   ['Owners of the Company 本公司權益持有人','IS','attribution',['net_income_parent']],['– Basic －基本','IS','eps',['eps_basic']],['– Diluted －稀釋','IS','eps',['eps_diluted']],
   ['Total assets 總資產','BS',null,['total_assets']],['Total equity 總權益','BS',null,['equity_total']],['Cash and cash equivalents 現金及現金等價物','BS',null,['cash']],
   ['Net cash inflow/(outflow) from 經營活動產生╱（所用）淨現金 operating activities','CF',null,['operating_cash_flow']],
   ['Net cash outflow from financing activities 融資活動所用淨現金','CF',null,['financing_cash_flow']],
   ['Net (decrease)/increase in cash and cash 現金及現金等價物淨（減少）╱增加 equivalents','CF',null,['net_change_in_cash']],
   ['Gross profit 收益','IS',null,['gross_profit','revenue']],                                   // two scripts naming two concepts: ambiguous
  ];
  for(const [label,st,section,want] of cases)expect({label,st,section,got:matchConcepts(label,st,section)}).toEqual({label,st,section,got:want});
 });
 it('splits a bilingual label into its scripts',()=>{
  expect(labelVariants('Revenue 收益')).toEqual(['Revenue 收益','Revenue','收益']);
  expect(labelVariants('– Basic －基本')).toEqual(['Basic -基本','Basic','基本']);
  expect(labelVariants('收益')).toEqual(['收益']);
 });
 it('section headings: attribution (profit or comprehensive income, generic decided by the previous row) and EPS',()=>{
  expect(headingSection('以下人士應佔：',null)).toBe('attribution');
  expect(headingSection('以下人士應佔：','年內溢利')).toBe('attribution');
  expect(headingSection('以下人士應佔：','年內全面收益總額')).toBe('attribution_ci');
  expect(headingSection('以下人士應佔全面收益總額：',null)).toBe('attribution_ci');
  expect(headingSection('Profit for the period attributable to:',null)).toBe('attribution');
  expect(headingSection('Total comprehensive income attributable to:',null)).toBe('attribution_ci');
  expect(headingSection('每股盈利（人民幣元）',null)).toBe('eps');
  expect(headingSection('Earnings per share (HK cents)',null)).toBe('eps');
  expect(headingSection('Earnings/(losses) per share for 本公司權益持有人應佔',null)).toBe('eps');
  expect(headingSection('Profit/(loss) attributable to: 應佔當期盈利╱（虧損）：',null)).toBe('attribution');
  expect(headingSection('Total comprehensive income/(loss) attributable to: 應佔當期總綜合收益╱（虧損）：',null)).toBe('attribution_ci');
  expect(headingSection('其他全面收益',null)).toBeUndefined();
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/values.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {applySign,cellValue} from './values';

describe('values (spec §7.5 step 5): exact decimal strings, brackets negative, dashes absent',()=>{
 it('reads cells and applies the scale without floating point',()=>{
  expect(cellValue('1,234,567','1000')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'1,234,567',value:'1234567000'});
  expect(cellValue('(734,567)','1000')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'(734,567)',value:'-734567000'});
  expect(cellValue('12.34','0.01')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'12.34',value:'0.1234'});
  expect(cellValue('10.50','0.01')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'10.50',value:'0.105'});
  expect(cellValue('0.32','1')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'0.32',value:'0.32'});
  expect(cellValue('12345678901234567890','1000000')).toEqual({kind:'value',presented:'12345678901234567890',value:'12345678901234567890000000'});
  for(const d of ['–','-','—'])expect(cellValue(d,'1000')).toEqual({kind:'dash'});
  expect(cellValue('n/a','1')).toEqual({kind:'invalid'});
 });
 it('sign rules: cost and tax shown negative become positive; decrease-only cash change shown positive becomes negative',()=>{
  expect(applySign('cost_of_revenue','-734567000','銷售成本')).toEqual({value:'734567000',sign_flip:true});
  expect(applySign('cost_of_revenue','734567000','銷售成本')).toEqual({value:'734567000',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('income_tax','-30000000','所得稅開支')).toEqual({value:'30000000',sign_flip:true});
  expect(applySign('net_change_in_cash','5000','現金及現金等價物減少淨額')).toEqual({value:'-5000',sign_flip:true});
  expect(applySign('net_change_in_cash','5000','Net decrease in cash and cash equivalents')).toEqual({value:'-5000',sign_flip:true});
  expect(applySign('net_change_in_cash','5000','現金及現金等價物增加/(減少)淨額')).toEqual({value:'5000',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('net_change_in_cash','-5000','現金及現金等價物減少淨額')).toEqual({value:'-5000',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('net_change_in_cash','0','現金及現金等價物減少淨額')).toEqual({value:'0',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('investing_cash_flow','-120000000','投資活動所用現金淨額')).toEqual({value:'-120000000',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('income_tax','10185000','Income tax credit 所得稅沖回')).toEqual({value:'-10185000',sign_flip:true});   // a credit is a negative expense
  expect(applySign('income_tax','-5000','所得稅抵免')).toEqual({value:'-5000',sign_flip:false});   // already printed negative: −|x|, no flip (P1-3)
  expect(applySign('income_tax','0','Income tax credit')).toEqual({value:'0',sign_flip:false});
  expect(applySign('income_tax','-10185000','Income tax credit 所得稅沖回')).toEqual({value:'-10185000',sign_flip:false});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/exact.ts
// Exact decimal arithmetic for the HK checks (spec §7.6, R5-8): decimal strings → scaled BigInts,
// never Number. identity: |left − right| × tol.den ≤ max(|left|, |right|, 1) × tol.num (BS/GP and
// comparatives 5/1000, CF 2/100); the exact difference is kept as a canonical decimal string for
// the check detail. Inputs go through spec-2 canonicalDecimal (imported, not modified), which also
// rejects malformed text. Slicing here works on digit strings, never on page text offsets.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';

interface Dec{n:bigint;s:number}
const pow10=(k:number)=>10n**BigInt(k);
const abs=(v:bigint)=>v<0n?-v:v;
function dec(v:string):Dec{
 const c=canonicalDecimal(v);const neg=c.startsWith('-');
 const [i,f='']=c.replace(/^-/,'').split('.');
 const n=BigInt(i+f);
 return {n:neg?-n:n,s:f.length};
}
function format(n:bigint,s:number):string{
 const digits=abs(n).toString().padStart(s+1,'0');
 const i=digits.slice(0,digits.length-s),f=digits.slice(digits.length-s);
 return canonicalDecimal(`${n<0n?'-':''}${i}${f?`.${f}`:''}`);
}
/** Both decimals at a common number of fractional digits. */
export function toScaled(a:string,b:string):{a:bigint;b:bigint;scale:number}{
 const x=dec(a),y=dec(b);const s=Math.max(x.s,y.s);
 return {a:x.n*pow10(s-x.s),b:y.n*pow10(s-y.s),scale:s};
}
export function exactIdentity(left:string,right:string,tol:{num:bigint;den:bigint}):{passed:boolean;diff:string}{
 if(tol.num<0n||tol.den<=0n)throw new Error('invalid_tolerance');
 const {a,b,scale}=toScaled(left,right);
 const d=a-b;
 const bound=[abs(a),abs(b),pow10(scale)].reduce((m,v)=>v>m?v:m);
 return {passed:abs(d)*tol.den<=bound*tol.num,diff:format(d,scale)};
}
export function sumDecimals(xs:string[]):string{
 let acc:Dec={n:0n,s:0};
 for(const x of xs){const v=dec(x);const s=Math.max(acc.s,v.s);acc={n:acc.n*pow10(s-acc.s)+v.n*pow10(s-v.s),s};}
 return format(acc.n,acc.s);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/locate.ts
// Statement location for HK periodic reports (spec §7.5 step 1) and the code-point text helpers
// shared by the hk-facts modules. A statement (IS / BS / CF) is the consecutive run of pages whose
// title region — the page lines above the first table body row — carries one of its titles
// (traditional, simplified or English; HKEX reports are often bilingual, both scripts on the same
// page, e.g. "Condensed Consolidated Interim Income Statement" over 簡明綜合中期利潤表 — any title line
// of either script counts) and that have at least one table. Titles tolerate 簡明/Condensed and
// 中期/Interim (the patterns are unanchored): IS 損益表/利潤表/收益表/Income Statement/Statement of
// Profit or Loss (or Comprehensive Income); BS 財務狀況表/資產負債表/Statement of Financial
// Position/Balance Sheet; CF 現金流量表/Statement of Cash Flows/Cash Flow Statement. A separate
// statement of comprehensive income (a title naming 全面 / 綜合收益表 / Comprehensive) is not the income
// statement when pages titled as a plain income statement exist; only when none exist is the
// combined 損益及其他全面收益表 / "profit or loss and other comprehensive income" statement used.
// Notes pages (a title-region line with 表附註 / 表附注 / Notes to) never count; a bare "附註/Notes"
// column header does not make a notes page. Non-consecutive hits → locate_ambiguous; no title line
// with 綜合 / 综合 / Consolidated on the first page → not_consolidated; no hit → the statement is
// missing (no info). Offsets are Unicode code points relative to the page text (plan F3
// conventions): regex indexes (UTF-16) are converted with cpIndex, never used as offsets directly.
import type {LayoutLine,PageLayout,PagesJson} from '../types';

export type StatementKind='IS'|'BS'|'CF';
export const STATEMENTS:readonly StatementKind[]=['IS','BS','CF'];
const TITLE:Record<StatementKind,RegExp>={
 IS:/損益表|损益表|利潤表|利润表|收益表|income statement|statement of (?:profit or loss|comprehensive income)/i,
 BS:/財務狀況表|财务状况表|資產負債表|资产负债表|statement of financial position|balance sheet/i,
 CF:/現金流量表|现金流量表|statement of cash flows|cash flow statement/i,
};
/** An IS title naming comprehensive income: a separate CI statement or the combined P&L + OCI statement. */
const COMPREHENSIVE=/全面|綜合收益表|综合收益表|comprehensive/i;
const CONSOLIDATED=/綜合|综合|consolidated/i;
const NOTES=/表附註|表附注|notes to/i;

export interface LocatedStatement{statement:StatementKind;pages:PageLayout[];title:{page_no:number;line:LayoutLine};consolidated:boolean}
export interface LocateInfo{code:'locate_ambiguous'|'not_consolidated';detail:string}
export interface LocateResult{statements:LocatedStatement[];info:LocateInfo[]}
export interface TextMatch{text:string;start:number;end:number;groups:(string|undefined)[]}

/** Code points of `s` before UTF-16 index `utf16`. */
export function cpIndex(s:string,utf16:number):number{let cp=0,u=0;for(const ch of s){if(u>=utf16)break;u+=ch.length;cp++;}return cp;}
export function cpSlice(s:string,start:number,end:number):string{return Array.from(s).slice(start,end).join('');}
/** Every match of `re` (global flag added when missing) with code-point start/end inside `s`. */
export function matchesIn(s:string,re:RegExp):TextMatch[]{
 const g=new RegExp(re.source,re.flags.includes('g')?re.flags:`${re.flags}g`);const out:TextMatch[]=[];
 for(const m of s.matchAll(g)){const start=cpIndex(s,m.index??0);out.push({text:m[0],start,end:start+Array.from(m[0]).length,groups:m.slice(1)});}
 return out;
}
/** Line indexes that are table body rows (any table of the page). */
export function bodyLines(page:PageLayout):Set<number>{const s=new Set<number>();for(const t of page.tables)for(const c of t.cells)s.add(c.line_index);return s;}
/** Lines above the first table body row; empty when the page has no table. */
export function titleRegion(page:PageLayout):LayoutLine[]{
 const body=bodyLines(page);if(body.size===0)return [];
 const first=Math.min(...body);
 return page.lines.filter(l=>l.index<first).sort((a,b)=>a.index-b.index);
}

export function locateStatements(json:PagesJson):LocateResult{
 const info:LocateInfo[]=[];const statements:LocatedStatement[]=[];
 const pages=[...json.pages].sort((a,b)=>a.page_no-b.page_no);
 const regions=new Map(pages.map(p=>[p.page_no,titleRegion(p)]));
 for(const statement of STATEMENTS){
  let hits:{page:PageLayout;lines:LayoutLine[];plain:boolean}[]=[];
  for(const page of pages){
   const region=regions.get(page.page_no)!;
   if(region.some(l=>NOTES.test(l.text)))continue;
   const lines=region.filter(l=>TITLE[statement].test(l.text));
   if(lines.length>0)hits.push({page,lines,plain:statement!=='IS'||lines.some(l=>!COMPREHENSIVE.test(l.text))});
  }
  if(hits.some(h=>h.plain))hits=hits.filter(h=>h.plain);     // a separate comprehensive-income statement is not the IS
  if(hits.length===0)continue;
  const nos=hits.map(x=>x.page.page_no);
  if(nos.some((n,i)=>i>0&&n!==nos[i-1]+1)){info.push({code:'locate_ambiguous',detail:`${statement}:${nos.join(',')}`});continue;}
  const title=hits[0].lines.find(l=>CONSOLIDATED.test(l.text));
  if(!title){info.push({code:'not_consolidated',detail:`${statement}:p${nos[0]}`});continue;}
  statements.push({statement,pages:hits.map(x=>x.page),title:{page_no:hits[0].page.page_no,line:title},consolidated:true});
 }
 return {statements,info};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/period.ts
// Column periods of HK statements (spec §7.5 step 2). Dates: 二零二五年十二月三十一日 (Chinese
// numerals, 〇/零), 2025年12月31日, 31 December 2025, December 31, 2025. The statement title region
// gives the main period: 截至<date>止(年度|六個月) / for the (year|six months) ended <date> → 12M/6M
// for IS and CF; 於<date> / as at <date> → INSTANT for BS. A table's header block gives its columns:
// full dates (balance sheets only, title-phrase lines skipped) or standalone years (dates masked
// first, Chinese-numeral years 二零二四年 included). Each token is placed by its x-span, taken from
// the header line's items (LayoutLine.items, contract change C-1; proportional inside a multi-token
// item), onto the numeric column whose span [min cell x0, median cell x1] it overlaps (± COL_TOLERANCE)
// with the nearest centre: a token over no column, or two different tokens over one column →
// 'unmappable'; the same token repeated over one column (bilingual headers) counts once. Only a
// header line without items (older pages.json) falls back to the RIGHTMOST numeric columns in order.
// A table without header tokens inherits the previous table's columns by the numeric columns' right
// edge (median bbox.x1, tolerance COL_TOLERANCE). Column rules: duration — the title year → title_duration, another
// year → title_year_substitution (same month/day); instant — a full date → column_date (title_instant
// when it is the title date), a year → title_instant for the title year, title_year_substitution in
// annual reports, interim_year_only otherwise (interim comparatives are often another month). Offsets
// are code points on the page text.
import type {LayoutItem,LayoutLine,LayoutTable} from '../types';
import {matchesIn} from './locate';
import type {StatementKind} from './locate';

const ZH_DIGIT:Record<string,number>={'〇':0,'零':0,'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4,'五':5,'六':6,'七':7,'八':8,'九':9};
const MONTHS=['january','february','march','april','may','june','july','august','september','october','november','december'];
const MONTH_RE='January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December';
const ZH_MONTH='十[一二]?|[一二三四五六七八九]';
const ZH_DAY='三十一?|二十[一二三四五六七八九]?|十[一二三四五六七八九]?|[一二三四五六七八九]';
/** No capturing groups: embeddable. */
export const DATE_SOURCE=[
 `[〇零一二三四五六七八九]{4}\\s*年\\s*(?:${ZH_MONTH})\\s*月\\s*(?:${ZH_DAY})\\s*日`,
 `\\d{4}\\s*年\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s*月\\s*\\d{1,2}\\s*日`,
 `\\d{1,2}\\s+(?:${MONTH_RE}),?\\s+\\d{4}`,
 `(?:${MONTH_RE})\\s+\\d{1,2},?\\s+\\d{4}`,
].join('|');
const DATE_RE=new RegExp(DATE_SOURCE,'gi');
const YEAR_RE=/([一二][〇零一二三四五六七八九]{3})\s*年|(?<![\d.,])((?:19|20)\d{2})(?:\s*年)?(?![\d.,年月])/g;
const DURATION_ZH=new RegExp(`截至\\s*(${DATE_SOURCE})\\s*止\\s*(年度|六個月|六个月)`,'i');
const DURATION_EN=new RegExp(`for\\s+the\\s+(year|six\\s+months)\\s+ended\\s+(${DATE_SOURCE})`,'i');
const INSTANT_ZH=new RegExp(`(?:於|于)\\s*(${DATE_SOURCE})`,'i');
const INSTANT_EN=new RegExp(`as\\s+(?:at|of)\\s+(${DATE_SOURCE})`,'i');
const PERIOD_PHRASE=new RegExp([DURATION_ZH,DURATION_EN,INSTANT_ZH,INSTANT_EN].map(r=>r.source).join('|'),'i');
export const COL_TOLERANCE=20;

const zhNumber=(s:string):number=>{
 if(!s.includes('十'))return ZH_DIGIT[s]??Number.NaN;
 const [a,b]=s.split('十');
 return (a?ZH_DIGIT[a]??Number.NaN:1)*10+(b?ZH_DIGIT[b]??Number.NaN:0);
};
function iso(y:number,m:number,d:number):string|null{
 if(!Number.isInteger(y)||!Number.isInteger(m)||!Number.isInteger(d)||m<1||m>12||d<1||d>31)return null;
 const t=new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d));
 if(t.getUTCFullYear()!==y||t.getUTCMonth()!==m-1||t.getUTCDate()!==d)return null;
 return `${String(y).padStart(4,'0')}-${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
const isoOf=(t:Date)=>t.toISOString().split('T')[0];
const monthOf=(name:string)=>MONTHS.indexOf(name.toLowerCase())+1;
export function parseDate(token:string):string|null{
 const t=token.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
 let m=/^([〇零一二三四五六七八九]{4}) ?年 ?(十[一二]?|[一二三四五六七八九]) ?月 ?(\S+?) ?日$/.exec(t);
 if(m)return iso(Number([...m[1]].map(c=>ZH_DIGIT[c]).join('')),zhNumber(m[2]),zhNumber(m[3]));
 m=/^(\d{4}) ?年 ?(\d{1,2}) ?月 ?(\d{1,2}) ?日$/.exec(t);
 if(m)return iso(Number(m[1]),Number(m[2]),Number(m[3]));
 m=/^(\d{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]+),? (\d{4})$/.exec(t);
 if(m){const mo=monthOf(m[2]);return mo>0?iso(Number(m[3]),mo,Number(m[1])):null;}
 m=/^([A-Za-z]+) (\d{1,2}),? (\d{4})$/.exec(t);
 if(m){const mo=monthOf(m[1]);return mo>0?iso(Number(m[3]),mo,Number(m[2])):null;}
 return null;
}
export function findDates(text:string):{iso:string;text:string;start:number;end:number}[]{
 const out:{iso:string;text:string;start:number;end:number}[]=[];
 for(const m of matchesIn(text,DATE_RE)){const d=parseDate(m.text);if(d!==null)out.push({iso:d,text:m.text,start:m.start,end:m.end});}
 return out;
}
/** Standalone years; full dates are blanked first (same UTF-16 length, so positions are unchanged). */
export function findYears(text:string):{year:number;text:string;start:number;end:number}[]{
 const masked=text.replace(DATE_RE,m=>' '.repeat(m.length));
 return matchesIn(masked,YEAR_RE).map(m=>({year:m.groups[0]!==undefined?Number([...m.groups[0]].map(c=>ZH_DIGIT[c]).join('')):Number(m.groups[1]),text:m.text,start:m.start,end:m.end}));
}
export function withYear(date:string,year:number):string|null{const [,m,d]=date.split('-').map(Number);return iso(year,m,d);}
/** period_end − N months + 1 day; a month end starts on the first day of the month N − 1 months earlier. */
export function periodStart(end:string,duration:'12M'|'6M'):string{
 const [y,m,d]=end.split('-').map(Number);const months=duration==='12M'?12:6;
 const last=new Date(Date.UTC(y,m,0)).getUTCDate();
 if(d===last)return isoOf(new Date(Date.UTC(y,m-months,1)));
 const tm=m-1-months;const len=new Date(Date.UTC(y,tm+1,0)).getUTCDate();
 return isoOf(new Date(Date.UTC(y,tm,Math.min(d,len)+1)));
}

export interface TitlePeriod{duration:'12M'|'6M'|'INSTANT';date:string;page_no:number;start:number;end:number;text:string}
/** The statement's main period from its title-region lines (offsets on the page text). */
export function titlePeriod(statement:StatementKind,page_no:number,lines:LayoutLine[]):TitlePeriod|null{
 for(const line of lines){
  const at=(m:{start:number;end:number;text:string},duration:TitlePeriod['duration'],date:string|null):TitlePeriod|null=>date===null?null:{duration,date,page_no,start:line.char_start+m.start,end:line.char_start+m.end,text:m.text};
  if(statement==='BS'){
   for(const re of [INSTANT_ZH,INSTANT_EN]){const m=matchesIn(line.text,re)[0];const hit=m?at(m,'INSTANT',parseDate(m.groups[0]??'')):null;if(hit)return hit;}
   continue;
  }
  const zh=matchesIn(line.text,DURATION_ZH)[0];
  const zhHit=zh?at(zh,/年度/.test(zh.groups[1]??'')?'12M':'6M',parseDate(zh.groups[0]??'')):null;
  if(zhHit)return zhHit;
  const en=matchesIn(line.text,DURATION_EN)[0];
  const enHit=en?at(en,/year/i.test(en.groups[0]??'')?'12M':'6M',parseDate(en.groups[1]??'')):null;
  if(enHit)return enHit;
 }
 return null;
}

export interface NumericColumn{col:number;anchor:number;x0:number}
export interface ColumnRef{anchor:number;kind:'year'|'date';year:number;date:string|null;text:string;page_no:number;start:number;end:number}
const median=(xs:number[])=>{const s=[...xs].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const k=Math.floor(s.length/2);return s.length%2?s[k]:(s[k-1]+s[k])/2;};
/** Numeric columns of a table, left to right, anchored at the median right edge of their cells; x0 = the leftmost cell edge. */
export function numericColumns(table:LayoutTable):NumericColumn[]{
 const by=new Map<number,{x0:number[];x1:number[]}>();
 for(const c of table.cells){
  if(!c.numeric)continue;
  const x1=c.bbox!==null?c.bbox.x1:table.col_x0[c.col];const x0=c.bbox!==null?c.bbox.x0:table.col_x0[c.col];
  if(x1===undefined||x0===undefined||!Number.isFinite(x1)||!Number.isFinite(x0))continue;
  const l=by.get(c.col)??{x0:[],x1:[]};l.x0.push(x0);l.x1.push(x1);by.set(c.col,l);
 }
 return [...by.entries()].map(([col,xs])=>({col,anchor:median(xs.x1),x0:Math.min(...xs.x0)})).sort((a,b)=>a.anchor-b.anchor);
}
/** x-span of the line's code points [start, end) (line-relative) from its items, proportional inside an item; null when no item covers it. */
export function spanOf(line:LayoutLine,start:number,end:number):{x0:number;x1:number}|null{
 const a=line.char_start+start,b=line.char_start+end;
 const items=line.items.filter(i=>i.char_start<b&&a<i.char_end);
 if(items.length===0)return null;
 const at=(it:LayoutItem,p:number)=>{const n=it.char_end-it.char_start;const q=Math.min(Math.max(p,it.char_start),it.char_end);return n<=0?it.x0:it.x0+(it.x1-it.x0)*(q-it.char_start)/n;};
 return {x0:Math.min(...items.map(i=>at(i,a))),x1:Math.max(...items.map(i=>at(i,b)))};
}
/** The table's own header tokens placed on its numeric columns by x (see header); null without tokens; 'unmappable' when a token sits over no column, two different tokens share a column, or there are fewer numeric columns than tokens. */
export function headerColumns(statement:StatementKind,table:LayoutTable,page_no:number):ColumnRef[]|'unmappable'|null{
 type Token={kind:'year'|'date';year:number;date:string|null;text:string;start:number;end:number};
 let best:{line:LayoutLine;tokens:Token[]}|null=null;
 if(statement==='BS'){
  for(const line of table.header_lines){
   if(PERIOD_PHRASE.test(line.text))continue;
   const tokens:Token[]=findDates(line.text).map(d=>({kind:'date',year:Number(d.iso.split('-')[0]),date:d.iso,text:d.text,start:d.start,end:d.end}));
   if(tokens.length>0&&(best===null||tokens.length>=best.tokens.length))best={line,tokens};
  }
 }
 if(best===null){
  for(const line of table.header_lines){
   const tokens:Token[]=findYears(line.text).map(y=>({kind:'year',year:y.year,date:null,text:y.text,start:y.start,end:y.end}));
   if(tokens.length>0&&(best===null||tokens.length>=best.tokens.length))best={line,tokens};
  }
 }
 if(best===null)return null;
 const cols=numericColumns(table);
 if(cols.length<best.tokens.length)return 'unmappable';
 const line=best.line;
 const ref=(t:Token,anchor:number):ColumnRef=>({anchor,kind:t.kind,year:t.year,date:t.date,text:t.text,page_no,start:line.char_start+t.start,end:line.char_start+t.end});
 if(line.items.length===0){const right=cols.slice(cols.length-best.tokens.length);return best.tokens.map((t,i)=>ref(t,right[i].anchor));}   // no positions: rightmost rule
 const out:ColumnRef[]=[];const used=new Map<number,Token>();
 for(const t of best.tokens){
  const span=spanOf(line,t.start,t.end);if(span===null)return 'unmappable';
  const mid=(span.x0+span.x1)/2;const centre=(c:NumericColumn)=>(c.x0+c.anchor)/2;let pick:NumericColumn|null=null;
  for(const c of cols){
   if(span.x1<c.x0-COL_TOLERANCE||span.x0>c.anchor+COL_TOLERANCE)continue;
   if(pick===null||Math.abs(centre(c)-mid)<Math.abs(centre(pick)-mid))pick=c;
  }
  if(pick===null)return 'unmappable';
  const prev=used.get(pick.col);
  if(prev!==undefined){if(prev.kind===t.kind&&prev.year===t.year&&prev.date===t.date)continue;return 'unmappable';}
  used.set(pick.col,t);out.push(ref(t,pick.anchor));
 }
 return out.sort((x,y)=>x.anchor-y.anchor);
}
/** numeric column index → the nearest reference column within COL_TOLERANCE (unmatched columns, e.g. notes, are left out). */
export function mapColumns(table:LayoutTable,refs:ColumnRef[]):Map<number,ColumnRef>{
 const out=new Map<number,ColumnRef>();
 for(const c of numericColumns(table)){
  let best:{r:ColumnRef;d:number}|null=null;
  for(const r of refs){const d=Math.abs(r.anchor-c.anchor);if(d<=COL_TOLERANCE&&(best===null||d<best.d))best={r,d};}
  if(best!==null)out.set(c.col,best.r);
 }
 return out;
}
export type PeriodRule='title_duration'|'title_year_substitution'|'column_date'|'title_instant';
export interface ColumnPeriod{period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:'12M'|'6M'|'INSTANT';rule:PeriodRule;title_date:string;column_text:string;header:ColumnRef}
export function columnPeriod(title:TitlePeriod,ref:ColumnRef,annual:boolean):ColumnPeriod|'interim_year_only'|'invalid_date'{
 const titleYear=Number(title.date.split('-')[0]);
 const base={title_date:title.date,column_text:ref.text,header:ref};
 if(title.duration==='INSTANT'){
  if(ref.kind==='date'&&ref.date!==null)return {...base,period_start:null,period_end:ref.date,duration:'INSTANT',rule:ref.date===title.date?'title_instant':'column_date'};
  if(ref.year===titleYear)return {...base,period_start:null,period_end:title.date,duration:'INSTANT',rule:'title_instant'};
  if(!annual)return 'interim_year_only';
  const end=withYear(title.date,ref.year);
  return end===null?'invalid_date':{...base,period_start:null,period_end:end,duration:'INSTANT',rule:'title_year_substitution'};
 }
 const end=ref.year===titleYear?title.date:withYear(title.date,ref.year);
 if(end===null)return 'invalid_date';
 return {...base,period_start:periodStart(end,title.duration),period_end:end,duration:title.duration,rule:ref.year===titleYear?'title_duration':'title_year_substitution'};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/scale.ts
// Units and multipliers of HK statements (spec §7.5 step 3). Amounts: the statement's first-page
// title region and first table header block are searched; currency words (港幣/港币/港元/HK$ →
// HKD, 人民幣元/人民币元/人民幣/人民币/RMB → CNY, 美元/US$ → USD; 人民幣元 is taken whole, see plan
// D1 note 4) are removed BEFORE the multiplier search, longest first ('000,000 / 百萬元 / 百萬 /
// million → 1000000; '000 / 千元 / 千 → 1000; 元 / dollars → 1), so 港元 never yields 元. Exactly one
// currency and one multiplier, else the reason (no_currency, no_multiplier, currencies:…,
// multipliers:…) — the caller emits unit_ambiguous and produces no candidate (payload.scale cannot be
// null). Per-share rows never inherit the table multiplier: the row label, then the EPS heading, must
// carry a sub-unit (港仙 / HK cents → HKD 0.01; RMB cents / 人民幣分 → CNY 0.01; 仙 / cents → the
// table currency 0.01; 人民幣元 / RMB → CNY 1; 港元 / HK$ → HKD 1). Units are spec-2 units.ts strings:
// HKD/CNY/USD and <CCY>/share. Amount evidence is the whole unit line; per-share evidence the token.
import type {LayoutLine} from '../types';
import {matchesIn} from './locate';

export type Currency='HKD'|'CNY'|'USD';
export type Scale='1'|'0.01'|'1000'|'1000000';
export interface CiteRange{page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number}
export type AmountUnit={ok:true;currency:Currency;scale:Scale;cite:CiteRange}|{ok:false;reason:string};
export type EpsUnit={ok:true;unit:string;scale:Scale;cite:CiteRange}|{ok:false;reason:string};

const CURRENCY_RE=/人民幣元|人民币元|港幣|港币|港元|HK\$|人民幣|人民币|\bRMB\b|美元|US\$/gi;
const currencyOf=(w:string):Currency=>/^(港幣|港币|港元|HK\$)$/i.test(w)?'HKD':/^(美元|US\$)$/i.test(w)?'USD':'CNY';
const MULTIPLIER_RE=/['’]000,000|百萬元|百万元|百萬|百万|\bmillions?\b|['’]000|千元|千|元|\bdollars?\b/gi;
const multiplierOf=(w:string):Scale=>/000,000|百萬|百万|million/i.test(w)?'1000000':/000|千/.test(w)?'1000':'1';
const EPS_SUBUNIT_RE=/港仙|\bHK\s?cents?\b|\bRMB\s?cents?\b|人民幣分|人民币分|人民幣元|人民币元|港元|HK\$|\bRMB\b|仙|\bcents?\b/i;

export function detectAmountUnit(lines:{page_no:number;line:LayoutLine}[]):AmountUnit{
 const currencies=new Set<Currency>();const scales=new Map<Scale,{page_no:number;line:LayoutLine}>();
 for(const u of lines){
  for(const m of u.line.text.matchAll(CURRENCY_RE))currencies.add(currencyOf(m[0]));
  for(const m of u.line.text.replace(CURRENCY_RE,' ').matchAll(MULTIPLIER_RE)){const s=multiplierOf(m[0]);if(!scales.has(s))scales.set(s,u);}
 }
 if(currencies.size>1)return {ok:false,reason:`currencies:${[...currencies].sort().join(',')}`};
 if(currencies.size===0)return {ok:false,reason:'no_currency'};
 if(scales.size>1)return {ok:false,reason:`multipliers:${[...scales.keys()].join(',')}`};
 if(scales.size===0)return {ok:false,reason:'no_multiplier'};
 const [[scale,u]]=[...scales.entries()];
 return {ok:true,currency:[...currencies][0],scale,cite:{page_no:u.page_no,char_start:u.line.char_start,char_end:u.line.char_end}};
}
export function detectEpsUnit(sources:{page_no:number;text:string;char_start:number}[],tableCurrency:Currency|null):EpsUnit{
 for(const s of sources){
  const m=matchesIn(s.text,EPS_SUBUNIT_RE)[0];
  if(!m)continue;
  const w=m.text;let currency:Currency|null;let scale:Scale;
  if(/^(港仙|HK\s?cents?)$/i.test(w)){currency='HKD';scale='0.01';}
  else if(/^(RMB\s?cents?|人民幣分|人民币分)$/i.test(w)){currency='CNY';scale='0.01';}
  else if(/^(仙|cents?)$/i.test(w)){currency=tableCurrency;scale='0.01';}
  else if(/^(港元|HK\$)$/i.test(w)){currency='HKD';scale='1';}
  else{currency='CNY';scale='1';}                                     // 人民幣元 / 人民币元 / RMB
  if(currency===null)return {ok:false,reason:'eps_currency'};
  return {ok:true,unit:`${currency}/share`,scale,cite:{page_no:s.page_no,char_start:s.char_start+m.start,char_end:s.char_start+m.end}};
 }
 return {ok:false,reason:'eps_no_subunit'};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/labels.ts
// Row labels → the 18 concepts (spec §7.5 step 4, 6th draft table; all ids are landed spec-2
// FACT_CONCEPTS). A label is NFKC-normalised (╱ → /), stripped of leading bullets/dashes, a trailing
// note number and a trailing colon, and matched as a WHOLE string (case-insensitive) — the label
// itself, or its core without a trailing parenthesis such as (港仙) / (附註5). Bilingual HKEX labels
// ("Revenue from contracts with customers 與客戶之間的合同產生的收入") are also split by script: the
// Latin words and the Han part are matched separately and the concepts united, so one row naming the
// same concept in both scripts is one concept (not ambiguous); two different concepts stay ambiguous.
// Variants seen in recorded HK reports (0268.HK 2026 interim) are in the rules: 與客戶之間的合同產生的
// 收入, 當期盈利╱（虧損）, Profit/(loss) for the period, 所得稅沖回 / income tax credit, 稀釋, Net cash
// inflow/(outflow) from … activities, 經營活動產生╱（所用）淨現金, Net (decrease)/increase in cash
// and cash equivalents, 總資產 / 總負債 / 總權益. Rules apply only on their own
// statement. net_income_parent only inside an attribution section about profit (not the
// comprehensive-income attribution); eps_* only inside an EPS section; equity_parent needs no section
// (its label already says 應佔). A heading is a non-row line: 應佔/应占/attributable to opens an
// attribution section — comprehensive-income when it names 全面收益/全面收入/comprehensive, profit when
// it names 溢利/利潤/利润/profit, otherwise decided by the previous row's label; 每股盈利/每股收益/
// earnings per share opens the EPS section. Unmatched labels are not "missing values": nothing is
// summed or guessed.
import type {StatementKind} from './locate';

export type Section='attribution'|'attribution_ci'|'eps'|null;
export interface LabelRule{concept:string;statement:StatementKind;re:RegExp;section?:'attribution'|'eps'}
const R=(src:string)=>new RegExp(`^(?:${src})$`,'i');
const cfFlow=(zhT:string,zhS:string,en:string)=>`${zhT}活動(?:所得|產生|所用)(?:\\/\\((?:所得|產生|所用)\\))?(?:[的之]?現金(?:流量)?淨額|淨現金)|${zhS}活动(?:所得|产生|所用)(?:\\/\\((?:所得|产生|所用)\\))?(?:[的之]?现金(?:流量)?净额|净现金)|net cash (?:(?:inflow|outflow)(?:\\/\\((?:inflow|outflow)\\))? (?:from|used in)|generated from|used in|from) ${en} activities`;
export const LABEL_RULES:readonly LabelRule[]=[
 {concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',re:R('收益|收入|營業額|营业额|與客戶之間的合同產生的收入|与客户之间的合同产生的收入|客戶合同收入|客户合同收入|revenue|turnover|revenue from contracts with customers')},
 {concept:'cost_of_revenue',statement:'IS',re:R('銷售成本|销售成本|cost of sales|cost of revenue')},
 {concept:'gross_profit',statement:'IS',re:R('毛利|gross profit')},
 {concept:'operating_income',statement:'IS',re:R('經營溢利|经营溢利|經營利潤|经营利润|operating profit')},
 {concept:'income_tax',statement:'IS',re:R('所得稅(?:開支|抵免|沖回)?|所得税(?:开支|抵免|冲回)?|income tax(?: expense| credit)?')},
 {concept:'net_income',statement:'IS',re:R('(?:年內|期內|本年度|本期間|當期|年内|期内|本期间|当期)(?:溢利|利潤|利润|盈利)(?:\\/\\((?:虧損|亏损)\\))?|(?:profit|profit\\/\\(loss\\)) for the (?:year|period)')},
 {concept:'net_income_parent',statement:'IS',section:'attribution',re:R('本公司(?:擁有人|拥有人|權益持有人|权益持有人|擁有者|拥有者)|owners of the company|equity holders of the company')},
 {concept:'eps_basic',statement:'IS',section:'eps',re:R('基本|basic')},
 {concept:'eps_diluted',statement:'IS',section:'eps',re:R('攤薄|摊薄|稀釋|稀释|diluted')},
 {concept:'total_assets',statement:'BS',re:R('資產總值|资产总值|總資產|总资产|total assets')},
 {concept:'total_liabilities',statement:'BS',re:R('負債總額|负债总额|總負債|总负债|total liabilities')},
 {concept:'equity_parent',statement:'BS',re:R('本公司(?:擁有人|拥有人|權益持有人|权益持有人)(?:應佔|应占)(?:權益|权益)|equity attributable to owners of the company')},
 {concept:'equity_total',statement:'BS',re:R('權益總額|权益总额|總權益|总权益|total equity')},
 {concept:'cash',statement:'BS',re:R('現金及現金等價物|现金及现金等价物|cash and cash equivalents')},
 {concept:'operating_cash_flow',statement:'CF',re:R(cfFlow('經營','经营','operating'))},
 {concept:'investing_cash_flow',statement:'CF',re:R(cfFlow('投資','投资','investing'))},
 {concept:'financing_cash_flow',statement:'CF',re:R(cfFlow('融資','融资','financing'))},
 {concept:'net_change_in_cash',statement:'CF',re:R('現金及現金等價物淨?\\(?(?:增加|減少)\\)?(?:\\/\\(?(?:增加|減少)\\)?)?(?:淨額)?|现金及现金等价物净?\\(?(?:增加|减少)\\)?(?:\\/\\(?(?:增加|减少)\\)?)?(?:净额)?|net \\(?(?:increase|decrease)\\)?(?: ?\\/ ?\\(?(?:increase|decrease)\\)?)? in cash and cash equivalents')},
];
export function normalizeLabel(raw:string):string{
 return raw.normalize('NFKC').replace(/╱/g,'/').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().replace(/^[-–—•·]+\s*/,'').replace(/\s*\d+(?:\(\w\))?$/,'').replace(/[:：]$/,'').trim();
}
export function labelCore(label:string):string{return label.replace(/\s*[（(][^（）()]*[）)]$/,'').trim();}
const HAN=/\p{Script=Han}/u,LATIN=/[A-Za-z]/;
/** The label itself and, for a label carrying both scripts, its Latin words and its Han part on their own. */
export function labelVariants(label:string):string[]{
 const full=normalizeLabel(label);
 if(!HAN.test(full)||!LATIN.test(full))return [full];
 const tokens=full.replace(/(\p{Script=Han})(?=[A-Za-z])/gu,'$1 ').replace(/([A-Za-z)])(?=\p{Script=Han})/gu,'$1 ').split(' ').filter(t=>t!=='');
 const latin=normalizeLabel(tokens.filter(t=>!HAN.test(t)).join(' '));
 const han=normalizeLabel(tokens.filter(t=>HAN.test(t)).join(''));
 return [full,...[latin,han].filter(v=>v!=='')];
}
export function matchConcepts(label:string,statement:StatementKind,section:Section):string[]{
 const out=new Set<string>();
 for(const v of labelVariants(label)){
  const core=labelCore(v);
  for(const r of LABEL_RULES)if(r.statement===statement&&(r.section===undefined||r.section===section)&&(r.re.test(core)||r.re.test(v)))out.add(r.concept);
 }
 return [...out];
}
const ATTRIBUTION=/應佔|应占|attributable to/i;
const COMPREHENSIVE=/全面收益|全面收入|綜合收益|综合收益|comprehensive/i;
const PROFIT=/溢利|利潤|利润|盈利|profit/i;
const EPS_HEADING=/每股盈利|每股收益|earnings(?:\/\(losses\))? per share/i;
/** The section a non-row line opens, or undefined when it is not a section heading (the current section continues). */
export function headingSection(text:string,previousRowLabel:string|null):Section|undefined{
 const t=text.normalize('NFKC');
 if(EPS_HEADING.test(t))return 'eps';
 if(!ATTRIBUTION.test(t))return undefined;
 if(COMPREHENSIVE.test(t))return 'attribution_ci';
 if(PROFIT.test(t))return 'attribution';
 return previousRowLabel!==null&&COMPREHENSIVE.test(previousRowLabel.normalize('NFKC'))?'attribution_ci':'attribution';
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/values.ts
// Cell values (spec §7.5 step 5): parsePresented (decimal.ts) reads `1,234` / `(1,234)` / `12.34`
// and the lone dashes – - — (no value for that period: no candidate, never 0); value = presented ×
// scale by decimal-string arithmetic (scaleDecimal), never a float. Sign rules: cost_of_revenue and
// income_tax shown negative → absolute value, sign_flip; income_tax under a credit label (credit /
// 抵免 / 沖回, e.g. "Income tax credit 所得稅沖回") is a negative expense → −|x| whatever the printed
// sign (`10,185` and `(10,185)` both give −10185000; 0 stays 0), and sign_flip records only an actual
// change of sign (codex plan round 1 P1-3); net_change_in_cash shown positive under a
// decrease-only label (減少/减少/decrease without 增加/increase) → negated, sign_flip; everything else as
// presented (cash flows keep their printed sign).
import {negate,parsePresented,scaleDecimal} from '../decimal';
import type {Scale} from './scale';

export type CellValue={kind:'value';presented:string;value:string}|{kind:'dash'}|{kind:'invalid'};
export function cellValue(text:string,scale:Scale):CellValue{
 const p=parsePresented(text);
 if(p==='dash')return {kind:'dash'};
 if(p===null)return {kind:'invalid'};
 const v=scaleDecimal(p.digits,scale);
 return {kind:'value',presented:text,value:p.negative&&v!=='0'?negate(v):v};
}
const ABS_IF_NEGATIVE=new Set(['cost_of_revenue','income_tax']);
const DECREASE=/減少|减少|decrease/i,INCREASE=/增加|increase/i,CREDIT=/credit|抵免|沖回|冲回/i;
export function applySign(concept:string,value:string,label:string):{value:string;sign_flip:boolean}{
 const negative=value.startsWith('-');
 if(concept==='income_tax'&&CREDIT.test(label)){const v=negative||value==='0'?value:negate(value);return {value:v,sign_flip:v!==value};}
 if(ABS_IF_NEGATIVE.has(concept)&&negative)return {value:negate(value),sign_flip:true};
 if(concept==='net_change_in_cash'&&DECREASE.test(label)&&!INCREASE.test(label)&&!negative&&value!=='0')return {value:negate(value),sign_flip:true};
 return {value,sign_flip:false};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/generate.ts
// HK financial-fact candidates of one pages.json (spec §7.5; plan F3 Task 14): locate the three
// primary statements, derive each column's period from the statement title and the table header,
// read the amount unit and the per-share sub-unit, map row labels to the 18 concepts inside their
// sections, read the cells as exact decimals, then cite every piece of evidence — value, label,
// unit, statement title (two statement_title entries: the title line carrying 綜合/Consolidated, which
// the `consolidated` check reads, and the period phrase the period was derived from, when it is a
// different range) and column header — through ctx.cite BEFORE returning the
// CandidateInsert rows (citations precede numbers, §7.4; each distinct range is cited once). Nothing
// is guessed: an ambiguous location, period, unit or label produces no candidate and one
// informational entry per code (key = extraction_id, details joined by '; '): locate_ambiguous /
// period_unparsed / unit_ambiguous / label_ambiguous / not_consolidated (F3_INFO_CODES). The same
// generator serves the primary (zh) and comparison (en) versions; candidates are inserted as
// 'candidate' by the caller (Task 15). natural_key = <concept>:<period_start|''>:<period_end>:
// <duration>:<unit>; fingerprint = sha256(canonical JSON of {natural_key, payload,
// snippets:{value, label, unit, period:[title line, period phrase, column header]}}) (§4.6).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import type {BatchError} from '../../dq/batches';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_LABEL_GEN,HK_RULES_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {CandidateInsert,DocumentRow,ExtractionRow,FactCitations,FinancialFactPayload,LayoutCell,LayoutLine,LayoutTable,PageLayout,PagesJson} from '../types';
import {headingSection,matchConcepts,normalizeLabel} from './labels';
import type {Section} from './labels';
import {bodyLines,cpSlice,locateStatements,titleRegion} from './locate';
import type {LocatedStatement} from './locate';
import {columnPeriod,headerColumns,mapColumns,titlePeriod} from './period';
import type {ColumnPeriod,ColumnRef} from './period';
import {detectAmountUnit,detectEpsUnit} from './scale';
import type {Scale} from './scale';
import {applySign,cellValue} from './values';

type Bbox={x0:number;y0:number;x1:number;y1:number};
export interface CiteInput{page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox?:Bbox|null}
export interface GenerateContext{document:DocumentRow;extraction:ExtractionRow;cite:(input:CiteInput)=>Promise<string>}
export type HkInfoCode='locate_ambiguous'|'period_unparsed'|'unit_ambiguous'|'label_ambiguous'|'not_consolidated';
type Note=(code:HkInfoCode,detail:string)=>void;
interface Range{page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox:Bbox|null}
interface Draft{payload:FinancialFactPayload;value:Range;label:Range;unit:Range;titleLine:Range;title:Range;header:Range}
interface RowHit{concept:string;page:PageLayout;cells:LayoutCell[];label:Range;labelText:string;columns:Map<number,ColumnRef>;sectionLines:{page_no:number;line:LayoutLine}[]}

const EPS=new Set(['eps_basic','eps_diluted']);
const sha256=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');
const firstLine=(t:LayoutTable)=>Math.min(...t.cells.map(c=>c.line_index));
const rangeOf=(page_no:number,x:{char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox?:Bbox|null}):Range=>({page_no,char_start:x.char_start,char_end:x.char_end,bbox:x.bbox??null});
const labelOf=(cells:LayoutCell[])=>cells.filter(c=>!c.numeric).sort((a,b)=>a.char_start-b.char_start)[0];
export const naturalKey=(p:Pick<FinancialFactPayload,'concept'|'period_start'|'period_end'|'duration'|'unit'>)=>`${p.concept}:${p.period_start??''}:${p.period_end}:${p.duration}:${p.unit}`;
/** JSON with object keys sorted at every level and no whitespace. */
export function canonicalJson(v:unknown):string{
 if(v===null||typeof v!=='object')return JSON.stringify(v);
 if(Array.isArray(v))return `[${v.map(canonicalJson).join(',')}]`;
 const o=v as Record<string,unknown>;
 return `{${Object.keys(o).sort().map(k=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJson(o[k])}`).join(',')}}`;
}

function draftsOf(st:LocatedStatement,annual:boolean,note:Note):Draft[]{
 const S=st.statement;const first=st.pages[0];
 const title=titlePeriod(S,first.page_no,titleRegion(first));
 if(title===null){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:title`);return [];}
 const titleRange:Range={page_no:title.page_no,char_start:title.start,char_end:title.end,bbox:null};
 const titleLineRange:Range={page_no:st.title.page_no,char_start:st.title.line.char_start,char_end:st.title.line.char_end,bbox:null};   // the statement title line (綜合…表 / Consolidated …)
 // amount unit: the first page's title region and its first table's header block
 const unitLines=new Map<number,LayoutLine>();
 for(const l of titleRegion(first))unitLines.set(l.index,l);
 const firstTable=[...first.tables].sort((a,b)=>firstLine(a)-firstLine(b))[0];
 for(const l of firstTable?.header_lines??[])unitLines.set(l.index,l);
 const amount=detectAmountUnit([...unitLines.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.index-b.index).map(line=>({page_no:first.page_no,line})));
 if(!amount.ok)note('unit_ambiguous',`${S}:${amount.reason}`);
 // rows in reading order with their section and column periods. A line without numeric cells — a
 // non-row line, or a label-only row that extract/tables.ts keeps inside a table — may open a
 // section (headingSection); otherwise it is remembered as the first half of a two-line label whose
 // numbers sit on the next line ("Net cash inflow/(outflow) from" + "operating activities"). The
 // lines since the current section opened are the EPS sub-unit sources ("(expressed in RMB cents
 // per share)" sits below the EPS heading).
 const hits:RowHit[]=[];let refs:ColumnRef[]|null=null;let section:Section=null;let sectionLines:RowHit['sectionLines']=[];let lastLabel:string|null=null;
 for(const page of st.pages){
  const tables=[...page.tables].sort((a,b)=>firstLine(a)-firstLine(b));
  const columnsOf=new Map<LayoutTable,Map<number,ColumnRef>>();const tableOfLine=new Map<number,LayoutTable>();
  for(const t of tables){
   for(const c of t.cells)tableOfLine.set(c.line_index,t);
   const own=headerColumns(S,t,page.page_no);
   if(own==='unmappable'){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:p${page.page_no}:columns`);columnsOf.set(t,new Map());continue;}
   if(own!==null)refs=own;
   if(refs===null){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:p${page.page_no}:no_header`);columnsOf.set(t,new Map());continue;}
   columnsOf.set(t,mapColumns(t,refs));
  }
  const body=bodyLines(page);let pending:LayoutLine|null=null;
  for(const line of [...page.lines].sort((a,b)=>a.index-b.index)){
   const t=body.has(line.index)?tableOfLine.get(line.index):undefined;
   const cells=t?t.cells.filter(c=>c.line_index===line.index):[];
   if(!cells.some(c=>c.numeric)){
    const s=headingSection(line.text,lastLabel);
    if(s!==undefined){section=s;sectionLines=[{page_no:page.page_no,line}];pending=null;}
    else{sectionLines.push({page_no:page.page_no,line});pending=line;}
    continue;
   }
   const prev=pending;pending=null;
   const cell=labelOf(cells);
   if(!t||!cell)continue;
   lastLabel=cell.text;
   let concepts=matchConcepts(cell.text,S,section);let label:Range=rangeOf(page.page_no,cell);let labelText=cell.text;
   if(concepts.length===0&&prev!==null&&prev.index===line.index-1){
    // two-line label: the previous text-only line + this row's label, cited as one range on the page
    const joined=`${prev.text} ${cell.text}`;const viaPrev=matchConcepts(joined,S,section);
    if(viaPrev.length>0){concepts=viaPrev;label={page_no:page.page_no,char_start:prev.char_start,char_end:cell.char_end,bbox:null};labelText=joined;}
   }
   if(concepts.length>1){note('label_ambiguous',`${S}:row:${normalizeLabel(labelText)}`);continue;}
   if(concepts.length===1)hits.push({concept:concepts[0],page,cells,label,labelText:normalizeLabel(labelText),columns:columnsOf.get(t)??new Map(),sectionLines:section==='eps'?[...sectionLines]:[]});
  }
 }
 // one row per concept and statement: identical repeats (same text in every mapped column) collapse, others are ambiguous
 const byConcept=new Map<string,RowHit[]>();
 for(const h of hits){const l=byConcept.get(h.concept)??[];l.push(h);byConcept.set(h.concept,l);}
 const signature=(r:RowHit)=>[...r.columns.entries()].map(([col,ref])=>`${ref.kind}:${ref.year}:${ref.date??''}=${r.cells.find(c=>c.numeric&&c.col===col)?.text??''}`).join('|');
 const drafts:Draft[]=[];
 for(const [concept,rows] of byConcept){
  if(rows.some(r=>signature(r)!==signature(rows[0]))){note('label_ambiguous',`${S}:${concept}`);continue;}
  const r=rows[0];
  let unit:string,scale:Scale,unitRange:Range;
  if(EPS.has(concept)){
   const text=new Map(st.pages.map(p=>[p.page_no,p.text]));
   const sources=[{page_no:r.label.page_no,text:cpSlice(text.get(r.label.page_no)??'',r.label.char_start,r.label.char_end),char_start:r.label.char_start},
    ...r.sectionLines.map(x=>({page_no:x.page_no,text:x.line.text,char_start:x.line.char_start}))];
   const eps=detectEpsUnit(sources,amount.ok?amount.currency:null);
   if(!eps.ok){note('unit_ambiguous',`${S}:${concept}:${eps.reason}`);continue;}
   unit=eps.unit;scale=eps.scale;unitRange={...eps.cite,bbox:null};
  }else{
   if(!amount.ok)continue;
   unit=amount.currency;scale=amount.scale;unitRange={...amount.cite,bbox:null};
  }
  const periods:{col:number;period:ColumnPeriod}[]=[];
  for(const [col,ref] of r.columns){
   const p=columnPeriod(title,ref,annual);
   if(p==='interim_year_only'||p==='invalid_date'){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:${p}`);continue;}
   periods.push({col,period:p});
  }
  if(periods.length===0)continue;
  if(!periods.some(x=>x.period.rule==='title_duration'||x.period.rule==='title_instant')){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:no_main_column`);continue;}
  if(new Set(periods.map(x=>x.period.period_end)).size!==periods.length){note('period_unparsed',`${S}:duplicate_column_period`);continue;}
  for(const {col,period} of periods){
   const cell=r.cells.find(c=>c.numeric&&c.col===col);if(!cell)continue;
   const v=cellValue(cell.text,scale);if(v.kind!=='value')continue;
   const signed=applySign(concept,v.value,r.labelText);
   drafts.push({
    payload:{concept,statement:S,period_start:period.period_start,period_end:period.period_end,duration:period.duration,value:signed.value,presented:v.presented,unit,scale,sign_flip:signed.sign_flip,
     period_derivation:{rule:period.rule,title_date:period.title_date,column_text:period.column_text},consolidation:'consolidated'},
    value:rangeOf(r.page.page_no,cell),label:r.label,unit:unitRange,titleLine:titleLineRange,title:titleRange,
    header:{page_no:period.header.page_no,char_start:period.header.start,char_end:period.header.end,bbox:null},
   });
  }
 }
 return drafts;
}

export async function generateHkCandidates(pages:PagesJson,ctx:GenerateContext):Promise<{candidates:CandidateInsert[];info:BatchError[]}>{
 const notes=new Map<HkInfoCode,string[]>();
 const note:Note=(code,detail)=>{const l=notes.get(code)??[];if(!l.includes(detail))l.push(detail);notes.set(code,l);};
 const located=locateStatements(pages);
 for(const i of located.info)note(i.code,i.detail);
 const annual=ctx.document.doc_class==='annual_report';
 const drafts=located.statements.flatMap(st=>draftsOf(st,annual,note));
 // the (extraction, kind, extractor_ref, natural_key) unique key: a clash with another value is ambiguous, an equal repeat collapses
 const byKey=new Map<string,Draft[]>();
 for(const d of drafts){const k=naturalKey(d.payload);byKey.set(k,[...(byKey.get(k)??[]),d]);}
 const kept:Draft[]=[];
 for(const [k,ds] of byKey){if(ds.some(d=>d.payload.value!==ds[0].payload.value)){note('label_ambiguous',`key:${k}`);continue;}kept.push(ds[0]);}
 const text=new Map(pages.pages.map(p=>[p.page_no,p.text]));
 const snippet=(r:Range)=>cpSlice(text.get(r.page_no)??'',r.char_start,r.char_end);
 const ids=new Map<string,string>();
 const cite=async(r:Range)=>{
  const k=`${r.page_no}:${r.char_start}:${r.char_end}`;const have=ids.get(k);if(have!==undefined)return have;
  const id=await ctx.cite({page_no:r.page_no,char_start:r.char_start,char_end:r.char_end,bbox:r.bbox});ids.set(k,id);return id;
 };
 const pageNos=[...new Set(kept.flatMap(d=>[d.value,d.label,d.unit,d.titleLine,d.title,d.header].map(r=>r.page_no)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
 const same=(a:Range,b:Range)=>a.page_no===b.page_no&&a.char_start===b.char_start&&a.char_end===b.char_end;
 /** statement_title evidence: the title line, then the period phrase when it is a different range. */
 const titlesOf=(d:Draft)=>same(d.titleLine,d.title)?[d.titleLine]:[d.titleLine,d.title];
 const candidates:CandidateInsert[]=[];
 for(const d of kept){
  const citations:FactCitations={value:await cite(d.value),label:await cite(d.label),unit:await cite(d.unit),
   period:[]};
  for(const t of titlesOf(d))citations.period.push({role:'statement_title',citation_id:await cite(t)});
  citations.period.push({role:'column_header',citation_id:await cite(d.header)});
  const natural_key=naturalKey(d.payload);
  const fingerprint=sha256(canonicalJson({natural_key,payload:d.payload,snippets:{value:snippet(d.value),label:snippet(d.label),unit:snippet(d.unit),period:[...titlesOf(d).map(snippet),snippet(d.header)]}}));
  candidates.push({kind:'financial_fact',extractor_kind:'rule',extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,natural_key,citations,payload:d.payload,fingerprint,
   input_snapshot:{content_sha256:ctx.document.content_sha256,pages_json_sha256:ctx.extraction.pages_json_sha256,page_nos:pageNos,extractor_version:ctx.extraction.extractor_version,
    table_algo_version:ctx.extraction.table_algo_version,code_version:ctx.extraction.code_version,hk_label_gen:HK_LABEL_GEN,hk_rules_version:HK_RULES_VERSION}});
 }
 const info:BatchError[]=[...notes.entries()].map(([code,details])=>({code,key:ctx.extraction.extraction_id,message:details.join('; ')}));
 return {candidates,info};
}
```

### 规格问题与处置（本 Part 内的决定）

1. §7.6 阻断性恒等式"缺任一不检"与 `CheckResult` 注释"`passed=null` 只给非阻断"冲突：本 Part 记为 `{blocking:true, passed:true, detail:{skipped:true, missing:[…]}}`。
2. §12 样例 10 写"1 条被规格二 `identity_bs` 隔离"：在本设计里不可达——候选级 `identity_bs` 是阻断的，规格二规则的输入（本运行新行 ∪ 同 filing 同代 ok 行）与候选检查用的同列值相同，候选检查通过时规格二规则也通过。混合结果样例改用**同日冲突**（同一 HKEX 文件同日替换为不同值）构造，断言形状不变（`{published:3, still_staged:1, abandoned:0}` → 接受隔离项 → 下次运行第 0 步 a 转 `published`）。
3. `stage_candidate_publication` 对已撤销审批：按 Part A（整合决定 6），SQL 函数先**提交**候选回 `candidate`，再返回 `{outcome:'approval_revoked'}`，三个 TS 适配器随后抛 `DocumentsDbError('approval_revoked')`。晋升对它的处理固定为：**废弃整个运行**（`abandonRun` + `abandonCandidatePublications`，本运行已暂存的发布行全部 `abandoned`）、释放租约（failed）、发行人结局 `failed/approval_revoked`；下次 cron 时该候选已是 `candidate`，不再进入活动集，其余候选重新晋升。测试断言候选已回 `candidate` 且无 `staged` 发布行。
4. §11.3 "`pages_json_sha256` 为夹具真实哈希"：抽取层替换为"返回录制 `pages`"，`runDocumentsExtract` 重新序列化 `pages.json`（含当前 `code_version`），哈希是重建字节的真实哈希而非录制文件哈希。
5. §11.4 召回定义的"被覆盖"按"存在值相等的 `checks_passed` 候选"判定（只出现不相等的候选算未覆盖）。
6. `comparative_consistent` 的"上一期文件主列的已发布事实"按 `readFacts(history:false)` 的当前行比较（同 K 的当前 ok 值），不区分来源 filing。

```ts
import type {CandidateInsert,CandidateRow,DocumentInsert,DocumentRow,ExtractionRow,FactCitations,FinancialFactPayload,InputSnapshot,LayoutLine,PagesJson} from '../types';

export const ADMIN='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000ad';
export const CODE='test-code-version';
export const NOW='2026-11-06T02:00:00.000Z';

export interface HkHarness{
 tables:TableClient&{rows(table:string):Row[]};facts:MemoryFactsDb;docs:MemoryDocumentsDb;store:ReturnType<typeof memoryObjectStore>;port:HkFactsPort;
 now:()=>Date;batch():Promise<string>;
}
export function hkHarness(o:{now?:string;issuers?:{issuer_id:string;code:string|null}[]}={}):HkHarness{
 const nowIso=o.now??NOW;
 const tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_quarantine:['id'],dq_freshness:['dataset'],issuers:['issuer_id']});
 const facts=memoryFactsDb(tables);facts.setNow(nowIso);
 const docs=memoryDocumentsDb({now:()=>new Date(nowIso)});
 const store=memoryObjectStore();
 const port=memoryHkFactsPort(facts,docs,{now:()=>new Date(nowIso)});   // same clock as the pinned memoryFactsDb leases
 for(const i of o.issuers??[{issuer_id:ISSUER,code:'00268'}])void tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id:i.issuer_id,hkex_stock_code_primary:i.code,status:'active'});
 return {tables,facts,docs,store,port,now:()=>new Date(nowIso),
  batch:async()=>(await startBatch(tables,{producer:'test',dataset:'test',codeVersion:CODE,triggeredBy:'script'})).batchId};
}
/** CandidatesDeps over the harness (also a valid PromoteDeps: same db/port/tables/now/deadline). */
export const candidatesDepsOf=(h:HkHarness):CandidatesDeps=>({db:h.docs,tables:h.tables,store:h.store,port:h.port,now:h.now,deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE});

export interface SeedFact{concept:string;statement:'IS'|'BS'|'CF';period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:'6M'|'12M'|'INSTANT';value:string;unit?:string;presented?:string;column?:'primary'|'comparative';label?:string}
const LABELS:Record<string,string>={revenue:'收益',cost_of_revenue:'銷售成本',gross_profit:'毛利',operating_income:'經營溢利',income_tax:'所得稅開支',net_income:'年內溢利',
 net_income_parent:'本公司擁有人',eps_basic:'基本',eps_diluted:'攤薄',total_assets:'資產總值',total_liabilities:'負債總額',equity_parent:'本公司擁有人應佔權益',equity_total:'權益總額',
 cash:'現金及現金等價物',operating_cash_flow:'經營活動所得現金淨額',investing_cash_flow:'投資活動所用現金淨額',financing_cash_flow:'融資活動所用現金淨額',net_change_in_cash:'現金及現金等價物增加淨額'};
const TITLES={IS:'綜合損益表',BS:'綜合財務狀況表',CF:'綜合現金流量表'} as const;
const D25={period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'12M' as const};
const I25={period_start:null,period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'INSTANT' as const};
/** A consistent FY2025 set: gross profit = revenue − cost; assets = liabilities + equity. */
export const FY25:readonly SeedFact[]=[
 {concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',...D25,value:'6256000'},
 {concept:'cost_of_revenue',statement:'IS',...D25,value:'2100000'},
 {concept:'gross_profit',statement:'IS',...D25,value:'4156000'},
 {concept:'total_assets',statement:'BS',...I25,value:'20000000'},
 {concept:'total_liabilities',statement:'BS',...I25,value:'8000000'},
 {concept:'equity_total',statement:'BS',...I25,value:'12000000'},
];
export const naturalKeyOf=(f:Pick<SeedFact,'concept'|'period_start'|'period_end'|'duration'|'unit'>)=>`${f.concept}:${f.period_start??''}:${f.period_end}:${f.duration}:${f.unit??'CNY'}`;
const labelOf=(f:SeedFact)=>f.label??LABELS[f.concept]??f.concept;
const presentedOf=(f:SeedFact)=>f.presented??(f.value.startsWith('-')?`(${f.value.slice(1)})`:f.value);

export interface Span{page_no:number;start:number;end:number}
export interface SeedLayout{pages:PagesJson;title:Map<string,Span>;header:Map<string,Span>;unit:Map<string,Span>;value:Map<string,Span>;label:Map<string,Span>}
/** One page per statement present (an empty fact list still yields one IS page): company, title, period, unit, year header, then one `label value` line per fact. Offsets are code points. */
export function buildSeedPages(facts:readonly SeedFact[],meta:{contentSha256:string;periodEnd:string;extractorVersion:string}):SeedLayout{
 const present=(['IS','BS','CF'] as const).filter(s=>facts.some(f=>f.statement===s));
 const statements=present.length>0?present:(['IS'] as const);
 const out:SeedLayout={pages:{extractor_version:meta.extractorVersion,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:CODE,content_sha256:meta.contentSha256,has_text_layer:true,pages:[]},
  title:new Map(),header:new Map(),unit:new Map(),value:new Map(),label:new Map()};
 const year=meta.periodEnd.slice(0,4);const prior=String(Number(year)-1);
 statements.forEach((s,i)=>{
  const page_no=i+1;
  const rows=facts.filter(f=>f.statement===s);
  const texts=['金蝶國際𠀋軟件集團有限公司',TITLES[s],s==='BS'?`於${year}年12月31日`:`截至${year}年12月31日止年度`,'單位：元 幣種：人民幣',`${year} ${prior}`,...rows.map(f=>`${labelOf(f)} ${presentedOf(f)}`)];
  const lines:LayoutLine[]=[];let pos=0;
  texts.forEach((text,index)=>{const n=cpLength(text);const y=800-index*20;lines.push({index,y,x0:50,x1:500,text,char_start:pos,char_end:pos+n,items:[{text,x0:50,x1:500,y,h:10,char_start:pos,char_end:pos+n}]});pos+=n+1;});
  const span=(li:number,from=0,to?:number):Span=>({page_no,start:lines[li].char_start+from,end:to===undefined?lines[li].char_end:lines[li].char_start+to});
  out.title.set(s,span(1));out.unit.set(s,span(3));out.header.set(s,span(4,0,cpLength(year)));
  rows.forEach((f,k)=>{const li=5+k;const n=cpLength(labelOf(f));out.label.set(naturalKeyOf(f),span(li,0,n));out.value.set(naturalKeyOf(f),span(li,n+1));});
  out.pages.pages.push({page_no,width:595,height:842,text:texts.join('\n'),lines,tables:[]});
 });
 return out;
}

export type CiteAt=(at:{page_no:number;char_start:number;char_end:number;bbox?:{x0:number;y0:number;x1:number;y1:number}|null})=>Promise<string>;
/** value, label, unit and two period spans (statement title + column header) of one fact. */
export async function citeSeedFact(citeAt:CiteAt,layout:SeedLayout,f:SeedFact):Promise<FactCitations>{
 const at=(s:Span|undefined)=>{if(!s)throw new Error(`seed: no span for ${naturalKeyOf(f)}`);return citeAt({page_no:s.page_no,char_start:s.start,char_end:s.end});};
 const k=naturalKeyOf(f);
 return {value:await at(layout.value.get(k)),label:await at(layout.label.get(k)),unit:await at(layout.unit.get(f.statement)),
  period:[{role:'statement_title',citation_id:await at(layout.title.get(f.statement))},{role:'column_header',citation_id:await at(layout.header.get(f.statement))}]};
}
export function snapshotOf(ex:Pick<SeededExtraction,'document'>,row:Pick<ExtractionRow,'pages_json_sha256'|'extractor_version'|'table_algo_version'|'code_version'>):InputSnapshot{
 return {content_sha256:ex.document.content_sha256,pages_json_sha256:row.pages_json_sha256,page_nos:[1,2,3],extractor_version:row.extractor_version,table_algo_version:row.table_algo_version,code_version:row.code_version,hk_label_gen:HK_LABEL_GEN,hk_rules_version:HK_RULES_VERSION};
}
export function seedCandidateInsert(f:SeedFact,citations:FactCitations,snapshot:InputSnapshot,titleDate:string,extractor:{kind:'rule'|'llm';ref:string}={kind:'rule',ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF}):CandidateInsert{
 const unit=f.unit??'CNY';
 const rule:FinancialFactPayload['period_derivation']['rule']=f.column==='comparative'?(f.duration==='INSTANT'?'column_date':'title_year_substitution'):(f.duration==='INSTANT'?'title_instant':'title_duration');
 const payload:FinancialFactPayload={concept:f.concept,statement:f.statement,period_start:f.period_start,period_end:f.period_end,duration:f.duration,value:f.value,presented:presentedOf(f),unit,scale:'1',sign_flip:false,
  period_derivation:{rule,title_date:titleDate,column_text:f.period_end.slice(0,4)},consolidation:'consolidated'};
 const natural_key=naturalKeyOf(f);
 return {kind:'financial_fact',extractor_kind:extractor.kind,extractor_ref:extractor.ref,natural_key,citations,payload,
  fingerprint:createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify({natural_key,payload,ref:extractor.ref})).digest('hex'),input_snapshot:snapshot};
}

export interface SeedDocOptions{issuerId?:string;sourceRef:string;availableAt?:string;docClass?:'annual_report'|'interim_report';periodEnd?:string;language?:'zh'|'en';facts:readonly SeedFact[];extractorVersion?:string;bytesTag?:string}
export interface SeededExtraction{document:DocumentRow;extractionId:string;layout:SeedLayout;facts:readonly SeedFact[]}

/** Stores the document (a new source_ref → v1; same source_ref + bytesTag → next version) and its first extraction (candidates pending). */
export async function seedHkExtraction(h:HkHarness,o:SeedDocOptions):Promise<SeededExtraction>{
 const issuer=o.issuerId??ISSUER;const periodEnd=o.periodEnd??'2025-12-31';const availableAt=o.availableAt??'2026-03-25T08:30:00.000Z';
 const batch=await h.batch();
 const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(`%PDF-1.4\n% F3 seed ${o.sourceRef} ${o.bytesTag??''}\n%%EOF\n`);
 const sha=sha256Hex(bytes);
 await h.store.put(blobPath(sha,'application/pdf'),bytes,'application/pdf');
 await h.docs.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:'00268'}]);
 if(!await h.docs.claimSyncLease(issuer,'hkexnews',batch,600))throw new Error('seed: sync lease busy');
 const interim=o.docClass==='interim_report';
 const doc:DocumentInsert={issuer_id:issuer,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_ref:o.sourceRef,form_type:interim?'財務報表 - [中期/半年度報告]':'財務報表 - [年報]',doc_class:o.docClass??'annual_report',classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,
  title:interim?`截至${periodEnd.slice(0,4)}年6月30日止六個月之中期報告`:`截至${periodEnd.slice(0,4)}年12月31日止年度之年報`,language:o.language??'zh',
  source_url:`https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/${availableAt.slice(0,4)}/${availableAt.slice(5,7)}${availableAt.slice(8,10)}/${o.sourceRef}.pdf`,
  content_sha256:sha,bytes:bytes.length,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:blobPath(sha,'application/pdf'),
  acquisition:{fetched_at:availableAt,http_status:200,content_type:'application/pdf',user_agent:'test'},published_at:availableAt,published_at_precision:'instant',
  available_at:availableAt,available_date:availableAt.slice(0,10),fiscal_year:Number(periodEnd.slice(0,4)),fiscal_period:interim?'H1':'FY',period_end:periodEnd,filing_source_ref:null,
  permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,batch_id:batch,code_version:CODE};
 const ins=await h.docs.insertDocumentVersion(issuer,'hkexnews',batch,doc,[]);
 await h.docs.releaseSyncLease(issuer,'hkexnews',batch,'success',h.now().toISOString());
 return seedExtraction(h,ins.document_id,o.facts,o.extractorVersion??EXTRACTOR_VERSION);
}
/** A new extraction of a stored document (status must be 'stored': a fresh document, or after requestExtract). */
export async function seedExtraction(h:HkHarness,documentId:string,facts:readonly SeedFact[],extractorVersion:string=EXTRACTOR_VERSION):Promise<SeededExtraction>{
 const batch=await h.batch();
 const before=await h.docs.documentById(documentId);if(!before)throw new Error('seed: no document');
 const layout=buildSeedPages(facts,{contentSha256:before.content_sha256,periodEnd:before.period_end??'2025-12-31',extractorVersion});
 const bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(layout.pages));const pagesSha=sha256Hex(bytes);
 const path=pagesJsonPath(before.content_sha256,pagesSha);
 await h.store.put(path,bytes,'application/json');
 if(!await h.docs.claimExtractLease(documentId,batch,600))throw new Error('seed: extract lease refused');
 const extractionId=await h.docs.finishExtract(documentId,batch,{extractor_version:extractorVersion,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:CODE,has_text_layer:true,page_count:layout.pages.pages.length,pages_json_path:path,pages_json_sha256:pagesSha},pageInsertsOf(layout.pages));
 return {document:(await h.docs.documentById(documentId))!,extractionId,layout,facts};
}
export async function allCandidatesOf(h:HkHarness,extractionId:string):Promise<CandidateRow[]>{
 const out:CandidateRow[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
 do{const p=await h.docs.candidatesOf({extractionId},{cursor,limit:1000});out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null);
 return out;
}
/** claim → cite + insert → checks (all passing unless `passed` says otherwise) → finish(done). Returns natural_key → candidate_id. */
export async function seedHkCandidates(h:HkHarness,ex:SeededExtraction,o:{passed?:(f:SeedFact)=>boolean;extractor?:{kind:'rule'|'llm';ref:string}}={}):Promise<Map<string,string>>{
 const batch=await h.batch();
 if(!await h.docs.claimCandidatesLease(ex.extractionId,batch,600))throw new Error('seed: candidates lease refused');
 const row=(await h.docs.extractionById(ex.extractionId))!;
 const citeAt:CiteAt=at=>cite(h.docs,{document_id:ex.document.document_id,extraction_id:ex.extractionId,page_no:at.page_no,char_start:at.char_start,char_end:at.char_end,bbox:at.bbox??null,created_by:'extractor',created_ref:o.extractor?.ref??HK_EXTRACTOR_REF});
 const rows:CandidateInsert[]=[];
 for(const f of ex.facts)rows.push(seedCandidateInsert(f,await citeSeedFact(citeAt,ex.layout,f),snapshotOf(ex,row),ex.document.period_end??f.period_end,o.extractor));
 await h.docs.insertCandidates(ex.extractionId,batch,rows);
 const all=await allCandidatesOf(h,ex.extractionId);
 const byKey=new Map(ex.facts.map(f=>[naturalKeyOf(f),f]));
 await h.docs.writeCandidateChecks(ex.extractionId,batch,all.filter(c=>c.status==='candidate').map(c=>{
  const f=byKey.get(c.natural_key);const passed=f!==undefined&&o.passed!==undefined?o.passed(f):true;
  return {candidate_id:c.candidate_id,checks:[{check:'seed',blocking:true,passed}],checks_passed:passed};
 }));
 await h.docs.finishCandidates(ex.extractionId,batch,'done');
 return new Map(all.map(c=>[c.natural_key,c.candidate_id]));
}
export async function confirm(h:HkHarness,ids:Iterable<string>,by:string=ADMIN):Promise<void>{
 for(const id of ids)await h.docs.decideCandidate(id,{kind:'human',decided_by:by,status:'confirmed'});
}
```
