然后写检查单测：

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/checks.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {FACT_CONCEPTS} from '../../facts/concepts';
import type {FactRow} from '../../facts/types';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF} from '../types';
import type {CandidateRow,CheckResult,FinancialFactPayload} from '../types';
import {HK_CONCEPT_IDS,hkCheckFindings,runHkChecks} from './checks';
import type {CheckContext,CitationCheck} from './checks';

const EX={extraction_id:'e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',document_id:'d0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'};
type Base={statement:'IS'|'BS'|'CF';period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:'6M'|'12M'|'INSTANT'};
const IS25:Base={statement:'IS',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'12M'};
const IS24:Base={statement:'IS',period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'12M'};
const BS25:Base={statement:'BS',period_start:null,period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'INSTANT'};
const CF25:Base={...IS25,statement:'CF'};
interface Over{concept:string;value:string;presented?:string;unit?:string;scale?:string|null;rule?:FinancialFactPayload['period_derivation']['rule'];title?:string;roles?:('statement_title'|'column_header')[];snippet?:string;dropUnit?:boolean;label?:string;unitSnippet?:string;signFlip?:boolean}
let seq=0;
/** Unit evidence consistent with (unit, scale): what scale.ts reads back as that unit and multiplier. */
const UNIT_TEXT:Record<string,string>={'CNY|1':'單位：元 幣種：人民幣','CNY|1000':'人民幣千元','CNY|1000000':'人民幣百萬元','HKD|1000':'千港元','CNY/share|0.01':'RMB cents','CNY/share|1':'人民幣元','HKD/share|0.01':'港仙'};
function cand(base:Base,o:Over,verify:Map<string,CitationCheck|null>):CandidateRow{
 const n=++seq;const id=(r:string)=>`cit-${n}-${r}`;
 const presented=o.presented??o.value;const unit=o.unit??'CNY';const scale=o.scale===undefined?'1':o.scale;
 verify.set(id('value'),{integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,snippet:o.snippet??presented});
 verify.set(id('label'),{integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,snippet:o.label??o.concept});
 verify.set(id('unit'),{integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,snippet:o.unitSnippet??UNIT_TEXT[`${unit}|${scale}`]??'人民幣千元'});
 verify.set(id('title'),{integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,snippet:o.title??'綜合損益表'});
 verify.set(id('header'),{integrity:'ok',currentExtraction:true,snippet:base.period_end.slice(0,4)});
 const payload={concept:o.concept,statement:base.statement,period_start:base.period_start,period_end:base.period_end,duration:base.duration,value:o.value,presented,unit,
  scale,sign_flip:o.signFlip??false,period_derivation:{rule:o.rule??(base.duration==='INSTANT'?'title_instant':'title_duration'),title_date:'2025-12-31',column_text:base.period_end.slice(0,4)},consolidation:'consolidated'} as unknown as FinancialFactPayload;
 const citations={value:id('value'),label:id('label'),...(o.dropUnit?{}:{unit:id('unit')}),period:(o.roles??['statement_title','column_header']).map(r=>({role:r,citation_id:r==='statement_title'?id('title'):id('header')}))};
 return {candidate_id:`cand-${n}`,document_id:EX.document_id,extraction_id:EX.extraction_id,kind:'financial_fact',extractor_kind:'rule',extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,
  natural_key:`${o.concept}:${base.period_start??''}:${base.period_end}:${base.duration}:${unit}`,citations,payload,fingerprint:'f'.repeat(64),checks:[],checks_passed:false,status:'candidate',
  decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,approval_id:null,decided_at:null,inherited_from:null,
  input_snapshot:{content_sha256:'a'.repeat(64),pages_json_sha256:'b'.repeat(64),page_nos:[1],extractor_version:'docs-extract/1.0',table_algo_version:'tables/1.0',code_version:'test'},batch_id:'batch',created_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z'};
}
const ctx=(verify:Map<string,CitationCheck|null>,extra:Partial<CheckContext>={}):CheckContext=>({verify,priorFacts:[],enCandidates:[],...extra});
const check=(r:{checks:CheckResult[]},name:string)=>r.checks.find(c=>c.check===name)!;
const bs=(ta:string,tl:string,eq:string)=>{const v=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>();const rows=[cand(BS25,{concept:'total_assets',value:ta,title:'綜合財務狀況表'},v),cand(BS25,{concept:'total_liabilities',value:tl,title:'綜合財務狀況表'},v),cand(BS25,{concept:'equity_total',value:eq,title:'綜合財務狀況表'},v)];return {rows,out:runHkChecks(rows,ctx(v))};};
const fact=(o:Partial<FactRow>):FactRow=>({fact_id:'f-1',issuer_id:'i',market:'HK' as unknown as FactRow['market'],filing_id:'g',run_id:'r',concept:'revenue',source_concept:'收益',statement:'IS',period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'12M',value:'1000',value_text:'1000',unit:'CNY',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:'2025-03-20',mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:'x',status:'ok',raw_hash:'h',created_at:'2025-03-20T00:00:00.000Z',is_current:true,...o});

describe('HK_CONCEPT_IDS',()=>{
 it('is the 18 spec §7.5 concepts, all in the landed spec-2 catalogue',()=>{
  expect(HK_CONCEPT_IDS).toHaveLength(18);
  for(const c of HK_CONCEPT_IDS)expect(FACT_CONCEPTS.some(d=>d.id===c),c).toBe(true);
 });
});

describe('runHkChecks',()=>{
 it('records all eight checks in order; a consistent column passes every blocking check',()=>{
  const {out}=bs('20000','8000','12000');
  expect(out.map(r=>r.checks.map(c=>c.check))).toEqual(Array(3).fill(['citation_verified','unit_known','value_replays','period_known','consolidated','identity_bs','comparative_consistent','en_cross_check']));
  expect(out.every(r=>r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);
  expect(check(out[0],'identity_bs')).toMatchObject({blocking:true,passed:true});
  expect(check(out[0],'comparative_consistent')).toMatchObject({blocking:false,passed:null,detail:{reason:'primary_column'}});
  expect(check(out[0],'en_cross_check')).toMatchObject({blocking:false,passed:null,detail:{reason:'unavailable'}});
 });
 it('identity_bs is exact at the 5/1000 boundary, also beyond double precision',()=>{
  expect(bs('1000','500','505').out.every(r=>r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);        // |1000−1005|·1000 = 5000 ≤ 1005·5
  const off=bs('1000','500','506').out;                                              // 6000 > 1006·5 = 5030
  expect(off.every(r=>!r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);
  expect(check(off[1],'identity_bs')).toMatchObject({blocking:true,passed:false});
  // (K+d)·1000 ≤ (201K+d)·5 ⇔ d ≤ 10^18 for K = 199·10^18: a double cannot tell 4·10^22 from 4·10^22 + 1
  expect(bs('39800000000000000000000','40000000000000000000000','0').out.every(r=>r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);
  expect(bs('39800000000000000000000','40000000000000000000001','0').out.every(r=>!r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('identity_gp uses the absolute cost and blocks every IS candidate of that column only (per-share rows included)',()=>{
  const v=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>();
  const rows=[cand(IS25,{concept:'revenue',value:'1000'},v),cand(IS25,{concept:'cost_of_revenue',value:'-600'},v),cand(IS25,{concept:'gross_profit',value:'450'},v),
   cand(IS25,{concept:'eps_basic',value:'0.07',unit:'CNY/share',scale:'1'},v),cand(IS24,{concept:'revenue',value:'900',rule:'title_year_substitution'},v)];
  const out=runHkChecks(rows,ctx(v));
  expect(out.slice(0,4).every(r=>!r.checks_passed&&check(r,'identity_gp').passed===false)).toBe(true);
  expect(check(out[4],'identity_gp')).toMatchObject({passed:true,detail:{skipped:true}});
  expect(out[4].checks_passed).toBe(true);
  const ok=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>();
  expect(runHkChecks([cand(IS25,{concept:'revenue',value:'1000'},ok),cand(IS25,{concept:'cost_of_revenue',value:'600'},ok),cand(IS25,{concept:'gross_profit',value:'400'},ok)],ctx(ok)).every(r=>r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('identity_cf has a 2/100 tolerance',()=>{
  const cf=(fin:string)=>{const v=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>();const t='綜合現金流量表';
   return runHkChecks([cand(CF25,{concept:'net_change_in_cash',value:'100',title:t},v),cand(CF25,{concept:'operating_cash_flow',value:'150',title:t},v),cand(CF25,{concept:'investing_cash_flow',value:'-50',title:t},v),cand(CF25,{concept:'financing_cash_flow',value:fin,title:t},v)],ctx(v));};
  expect(cf('2').every(r=>r.checks_passed)).toBe(true);          // |100−102|·100 = 200 ≤ 102·2 = 204
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/checks.ts
// Deterministic checks of HK financial-fact candidates (spec §7.6, R5-8). runHkChecks is pure: the
// candidates of ONE extraction version plus a precomputed CheckContext (citation verification of
// every cited id, the issuer's current published facts, the English comparison candidates) in;
// every check of every candidate out, checks_passed = every blocking check passed. All arithmetic
// is exact (exact.ts on decimal strings, scaled BigInt; decimal.ts for the signed subtraction),
// never Number. Identities group the candidates of one statement column (statement, period_start,
// period_end) over money concepts; a failure blocks every candidate of that column, a missing
// input is recorded as passed with detail {skipped:true} ("缺任一不检"; passed=null is reserved
// for non-blocking checks). value_replays (blocking; codex plan round 1 P1-2) recomputes the
// canonical value from the cited value snippet — values.ts cellValue with the recorded scale, then
// applySign with the cited label — and requires it to equal payload.value exactly; the recorded
// unit and scale must be what the unit citation says (scale.ts detectAmountUnit / detectEpsUnit on
// the unit snippet) and sign_flip what the label evidence gives. hkCheckFindings turns failures into plan-1 quarantine items
// (hk_identity_* per column, hk_restated_comparative / hk_en_zh_mismatch per candidate) plus one
// info code per extraction; buildCheckContext performs the reads.
import type {BatchError} from '../../dq/batches';
import {classifyDuration,isDate} from '../../facts/classify';
import {conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import type {FactRow} from '../../facts/types';
import {allowedUnits} from '../../facts/units';
import {verify} from '../citations';
import {subDecimal} from '../decimal';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF} from '../types';
import type {CandidateRow,CheckResult,CitationRow,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,ExtractionRow,FactCitations,FinancialFactPayload} from '../types';
import {exactIdentity,sumDecimals} from './exact';
import type {HkFactsPort} from './facts-port';
import {detectAmountUnit,detectEpsUnit} from './scale';
import type {Currency,Scale} from './scale';
import {applySign,cellValue} from './values';

/** The 18 HK concepts of spec §7.5 第 4 条 (all ids of the landed spec-2 FACT_CONCEPTS). */
export const HK_CONCEPT_IDS:readonly string[]=['revenue','cost_of_revenue','gross_profit','operating_income','income_tax','net_income','net_income_parent','eps_basic','eps_diluted',
 'total_assets','total_liabilities','equity_parent','equity_total','cash','operating_cash_flow','investing_cash_flow','financing_cash_flow','net_change_in_cash'];
export const TOL_HALF_PERCENT={num:5n,den:1000n} as const;
export const TOL_CF={num:2n,den:100n} as const;
export const CHECK_ORDER=['citation_verified','unit_known','value_replays','period_known','consolidated','identity','comparative_consistent','en_cross_check'] as const;
export interface CitationCheck{integrity:'ok'|'corrupt';currentExtraction:boolean;snippet:string}
export interface CheckContext{verify:Map<string,CitationCheck|null>;priorFacts:FactRow[];enCandidates:CandidateRow[]}
export interface CheckRowResult{candidate_id:string;checks:CheckResult[];checks_passed:boolean}
export interface CheckFinding{reasonCode:'hk_identity_bs'|'hk_identity_gp'|'hk_identity_cf'|'hk_restated_comparative'|'hk_en_zh_mismatch';naturalKey:string;candidateIds:string[];payload:Record<string,unknown>}

const payloadOf=(c:CandidateRow)=>c.payload as FinancialFactPayload;
const citesOf=(c:CandidateRow)=>c.citations as FactCitations;
/** Every citation id a financial-fact candidate references (value, label, unit, period evidence), deduped. */
export function citationIdsOf(c:FactCitations):string[]{
 const period=Array.isArray(c.period)?c.period.map(p=>p.citation_id):[];
 return [...new Set([c.value,c.label,c.unit,...period].filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'&&x.length>0))];
}
const digitsOf=(s:string)=>s.replace(/[\s,()\-–—]/g,'');
const abs=(d:string)=>d.startsWith('-')?d.slice(1):d;
const CONSOLIDATED=/綜合|综合|consolidated/i;
const PRIMARY_RULES=new Set(['title_duration','title_instant']);
const pass=(check:string,blocking:boolean,detail?:Record<string,unknown>):CheckResult=>detail===undefined?{check,blocking,passed:true}:{check,blocking,passed:true,detail};
const fail=(check:string,blocking:boolean,detail:Record<string,unknown>):CheckResult=>({check,blocking,passed:false,detail});
const unavailable=(check:string,detail:Record<string,unknown>):CheckResult=>({check,blocking:false,passed:null,detail});

function citationVerified(c:CandidateRow,ctx:CheckContext):CheckResult{
 const cs=citesOf(c);const p=payloadOf(c);
 const roles=(['value','label','unit'] as const).filter(r=>typeof cs[r]!=='string'||cs[r].length===0);
 if(roles.length>0||!Array.isArray(cs.period)||cs.period.length===0)return fail('citation_verified',true,{reason:'missing_role',roles:roles.length>0?roles:['period']});
 const bad=citationIdsOf(cs).filter(id=>{const v=ctx.verify.get(id);return !v||v.integrity!=='ok'||!v.currentExtraction;});
 if(bad.length>0)return fail('citation_verified',true,{reason:'not_verified',citation_ids:bad});
 const snippet=ctx.verify.get(cs.value)!.snippet;
 if(digitsOf(snippet)!==digitsOf(p.presented))return fail('citation_verified',true,{reason:'value_snippet_mismatch',snippet,presented:p.presented});
 return pass('citation_verified',true);
}
function unitKnown(p:FinancialFactPayload):CheckResult{
 if(!p.unit||!p.scale)return fail('unit_known',true,{reason:'missing',unit:p.unit??null,scale:p.scale??null});
 const def=conceptById(p.concept);
 if(!def)return fail('unit_known',true,{reason:'unknown_concept',concept:p.concept});
 if(!allowedUnits(def.unitKind).includes(p.unit))return fail('unit_known',true,{reason:'unit_not_allowed',unit:p.unit,unit_kind:def.unitKind});
 return pass('unit_known',true);
}
const SCALES:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set(['1','0.01','1000','1000000']);
const CURRENCIES:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set(['HKD','CNY','USD']);
const canonOrNull=(v:unknown):string|null=>{if(typeof v!=='string')return null;try{return canonicalDecimal(v);}catch{return null;}};
/** What the unit citation says: the amount unit line (currency + multiplier) or the per-share sub-unit token. */
function unitEvidence(unit:unknown,text:string):{ok:true;unit:string;scale:Scale}|{ok:false;reason:string}{
 if(typeof unit!=='string')return {ok:false,reason:'no_unit'};
 if(/\/share$/.test(unit)){
  const ccy=unit.replace(/\/share$/,'');
  const r=detectEpsUnit([{page_no:0,text,char_start:0}],CURRENCIES.has(ccy)?ccy as Currency:null);
  return r.ok?{ok:true,unit:r.unit,scale:r.scale}:{ok:false,reason:r.reason};
 }
 const r=detectAmountUnit([{page_no:0,line:{index:0,y:0,x0:0,x1:0,text,char_start:0,char_end:Array.from(text).length,items:[]}}]);
 return r.ok?{ok:true,unit:r.currency,scale:r.scale}:{ok:false,reason:r.reason};
}
/** Replays the cited number through the recorded transformation (P1-2): exact decimal strings only. */
function valueReplays(c:CandidateRow,p:FinancialFactPayload,ctx:CheckContext):CheckResult{
 const cs=citesOf(c);
 const snip=(id:unknown)=>typeof id==='string'?ctx.verify.get(id)?.snippet??null:null;
 const value=snip(cs.value),label=snip(cs.label),unitText=snip(cs.unit);
 if(value===null||label===null||unitText===null)return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'evidence_unavailable'});
 if(typeof p.scale!=='string'||!SCALES.has(p.scale))return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'scale_invalid',scale:p.scale??null});
 const ev=unitEvidence(p.unit,unitText);
 if(!ev.ok)return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'unit_evidence',evidence:ev.reason,unit_snippet:unitText});
 if(ev.unit!==p.unit||ev.scale!==p.scale)return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'scale_mismatch',recorded:{unit:p.unit,scale:p.scale},evidence:{unit:ev.unit,scale:ev.scale},unit_snippet:unitText});
 const cell=cellValue(value,p.scale as Scale);
 if(cell.kind!=='value')return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'value_unparsed',snippet:value});
 const signed=applySign(p.concept,cell.value,label);
 if(signed.sign_flip!==p.sign_flip)return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'sign_flip_mismatch',recorded:p.sign_flip??null,evidence:signed.sign_flip,label_snippet:label});
 const recorded=canonOrNull(p.value);
 if(recorded===null||canonicalDecimal(signed.value)!==recorded)return fail('value_replays',true,{reason:'value_mismatch',snippet:value,scale:p.scale,replayed:signed.value,recorded:p.value??null});
 return pass('value_replays',true);
}
function periodKnown(c:CandidateRow,p:FinancialFactPayload):CheckResult{
 const roles=new Set((Array.isArray(citesOf(c).period)?citesOf(c).period:[]).map(x=>x.role));
 if(!roles.has('statement_title')||!roles.has('column_header'))return fail('period_known',true,{reason:'period_evidence',roles:[...roles].sort()});
 if(!isDate(p.period_end))return fail('period_known',true,{reason:'period_end',period_end:p.period_end??null});
 if(p.duration==='INSTANT')return p.period_start===null?pass('period_known',true):fail('period_known',true,{reason:'instant_with_start',period_start:p.period_start});
 if(p.duration!=='6M'&&p.duration!=='12M')return fail('period_known',true,{reason:'duration',duration:p.duration});
 if(p.period_start===null||!isDate(p.period_start))return fail('period_known',true,{reason:'period_start',period_start:p.period_start??null});
 const computed=classifyDuration(p.period_start,p.period_end);
 if(computed!==p.duration)return fail('period_known',true,{reason:'duration_band',computed,declared:p.duration});
 return pass('period_known',true);
}
function consolidated(c:CandidateRow,p:FinancialFactPayload,ctx:CheckContext):CheckResult{
 const titles=(Array.isArray(citesOf(c).period)?citesOf(c).period:[]).filter(x=>x.role==='statement_title').map(x=>ctx.verify.get(x.citation_id)?.snippet??'');
 if(p.consolidation==='consolidated'&&titles.some(t=>CONSOLIDATED.test(t)))return pass('consolidated',true);
 return fail('consolidated',true,{consolidation:p.consolidation??null,titles});
}

const IDENTITY_OF={BS:'identity_bs',IS:'identity_gp',CF:'identity_cf'} as const;
const INPUTS={BS:['total_assets','total_liabilities','equity_total'],IS:['gross_profit','revenue','cost_of_revenue'],CF:['net_change_in_cash','operating_cash_flow','investing_cash_flow','financing_cash_flow']} as const;
const columnKey=(p:FinancialFactPayload)=>`${p.statement}|${p.period_start??''}|${p.period_end}`;
/** One identity CheckResult per candidate, computed per statement column. */
function identityChecks(cands:CandidateRow[]):Map<string,CheckResult>{
 const cols=new Map<string,CandidateRow[]>();
 for(const c of cands){const k=columnKey(payloadOf(c));const g=cols.get(k);if(g)g.push(c);else cols.set(k,[c]);}
 const out=new Map<string,CheckResult>();
 for(const group of cols.values()){
  const statement=payloadOf(group[0]).statement;const name=IDENTITY_OF[statement];const inputs=INPUTS[statement];
  const money=new Map<string,FinancialFactPayload>();
  for(const c of group){const p=payloadOf(c);if(conceptById(p.concept)?.unitKind==='money'&&!money.has(p.concept))money.set(p.concept,p);}
  const missing=inputs.filter(k=>!money.has(k));
  let result:CheckResult;
  if(missing.length>0)result=pass(name,true,{skipped:true,missing:[...missing]});
  else{
   const ps=inputs.map(k=>money.get(k)!);
   if(new Set(ps.map(p=>p.unit)).size>1)result=fail(name,true,{reason:'unit_mismatch',units:ps.map(p=>p.unit)});
   else{
    const [head,...rest]=ps.map(p=>p.value);
    const right=statement==='IS'?subDecimal(rest[0],abs(rest[1])):sumDecimals(rest);
    const tol=statement==='CF'?TOL_CF:TOL_HALF_PERCENT;
    const r=exactIdentity(head,right,{num:tol.num,den:tol.den});
    const detail={left:head,right,diff:r.diff,tolerance:`${tol.num}/${tol.den}`,concepts:[...inputs]};
    result=r.passed?pass(name,true,detail):fail(name,true,detail);
   }
  }
  for(const c of group)out.set(c.candidate_id,result);
 }
 return out;
}
function comparative(p:FinancialFactPayload,ctx:CheckContext):CheckResult{
 if(PRIMARY_RULES.has(p.period_derivation?.rule))return unavailable('comparative_consistent',{reason:'primary_column'});
 const f=ctx.priorFacts.find(r=>r.status==='ok'&&r.is_current!==false&&r.concept===p.concept&&(r.period_start??null)===(p.period_start??null)&&r.period_end===p.period_end&&r.unit===p.unit);
 if(!f)return unavailable('comparative_consistent',{reason:'unavailable'});
 const r=exactIdentity(p.value,f.value,{num:TOL_HALF_PERCENT.num,den:TOL_HALF_PERCENT.den});
 const detail={fact_id:f.fact_id,prior:f.value,current:p.value,diff:r.diff};
 return r.passed?pass('comparative_consistent',false,detail):fail('comparative_consistent',false,detail);
}
function enCross(c:CandidateRow,p:FinancialFactPayload,ctx:CheckContext):CheckResult{
 if(ctx.enCandidates.length===0)return unavailable('en_cross_check',{reason:'unavailable'});
 const e=ctx.enCandidates.find(x=>x.kind==='financial_fact'&&x.natural_key===c.natural_key);
 if(!e)return unavailable('en_cross_check',{reason:'no_counterpart'});
 const en=(e.payload as FinancialFactPayload).value;
 const same=canonicalDecimal(en)===canonicalDecimal(p.value);
 const detail={en_candidate_id:e.candidate_id,zh:p.value,en};
 return same?pass('en_cross_check',false,detail):fail('en_cross_check',false,detail);
}

export function runHkChecks(candidates:CandidateRow[],ctx:CheckContext):CheckRowResult[]{
 const facts=candidates.filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact');
 const identity=identityChecks(facts);
 return facts.map(c=>{
  const p=payloadOf(c);
  const checks=[citationVerified(c,ctx),unitKnown(p),valueReplays(c,p,ctx),periodKnown(c,p),consolidated(c,p,ctx),identity.get(c.candidate_id)!,comparative(p,ctx),enCross(c,p,ctx)];
  return {candidate_id:c.candidate_id,checks,checks_passed:checks.every(x=>!x.blocking||x.passed===true)};
 });
}

export function hkCheckFindings(ex:{extraction_id:string;document_id:string},candidates:CandidateRow[],results:CheckRowResult[]):{findings:CheckFinding[];info:BatchError[]}{
 const byId=new Map(candidates.map(c=>[c.candidate_id,c]));
 const identity=new Map<string,CheckFinding>();const single:CheckFinding[]=[];let restated=0,mismatch=0;
 for(const r of results){
  const c=byId.get(r.candidate_id);if(!c)continue;const p=payloadOf(c);
  for(const ch of r.checks){
   if(ch.passed!==false)continue;
   if(ch.check==='identity_bs'||ch.check==='identity_gp'||ch.check==='identity_cf'){
    const naturalKey=`${ex.document_id}:${ex.extraction_id}:${ch.check}:${p.period_start??''}:${p.period_end}`;
    const f=identity.get(naturalKey)??{reasonCode:`hk_${ch.check}` as CheckFinding['reasonCode'],naturalKey,candidateIds:[],
     payload:{check:ch.check,document_id:ex.document_id,extraction_id:ex.extraction_id,statement:p.statement,period_start:p.period_start,period_end:p.period_end,detail:ch.detail??{}}};
    f.candidateIds.push(c.candidate_id);identity.set(naturalKey,f);
   }else if(ch.check==='comparative_consistent'){
    restated++;
    single.push({reasonCode:'hk_restated_comparative',naturalKey:`${ex.document_id}:${ex.extraction_id}:${c.natural_key}`,candidateIds:[c.candidate_id],payload:{check:ch.check,document_id:ex.document_id,extraction_id:ex.extraction_id,natural_key:c.natural_key,detail:ch.detail??{}}});
   }else if(ch.check==='en_cross_check'){
    mismatch++;
    single.push({reasonCode:'hk_en_zh_mismatch',naturalKey:`${ex.document_id}:${ex.extraction_id}:${c.natural_key}`,candidateIds:[c.candidate_id],payload:{check:ch.check,document_id:ex.document_id,extraction_id:ex.extraction_id,natural_key:c.natural_key,detail:ch.detail??{}}});
   }
  }
 }
 const findings=[...identity.values(),...single].sort((a,b)=>a.naturalKey<b.naturalKey?-1:a.naturalKey>b.naturalKey?1:a.reasonCode<b.reasonCode?-1:1);
 const info:BatchError[]=[];
 if(restated>0)info.push({code:'restated_comparative',key:ex.extraction_id,message:JSON.stringify({count:restated})});
 if(mismatch>0)info.push({code:'en_zh_mismatch',key:ex.extraction_id,message:JSON.stringify({count:mismatch})});
 return {findings,info};
}

export interface CheckDeps{db:DocumentsDb;port:Pick<HkFactsPort,'readFacts'>}
async function pagesOf<T>(read:(cursor:string|null)=>Promise<{rows:T[];nextCursor:string|null}>):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
 do{const p=await read(cursor);out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null);
 return out;
}
/** Same issuer, same doc_class and period_end, language 'en', current extraction: its HK rule candidates (spec §7.6 en_cross_check). */
async function englishCandidates(db:DocumentsDb,doc:DocumentRow,today:string):Promise<CandidateRow[]>{
 if(doc.issuer_id===null||doc.period_end===null)return [];
 const issuer=doc.issuer_id;
 const docs=await pagesOf(cursor=>db.readDocuments(issuer,{asOf:today,source:'hkexnews',docClass:doc.doc_class,cursor,limit:1000}));
 const out:CandidateRow[]=[];
 for(const d of docs){
  if(d.language!=='en'||d.period_end!==doc.period_end||d.current_extraction_id===null)continue;
  const exId=d.current_extraction_id;
  out.push(...(await pagesOf(cursor=>db.candidatesOf({extractionId:exId},{cursor,limit:1000}))).filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact'&&c.extractor_ref===HK_EXTRACTOR_REF));
 }
 return out;
}
/** Reads everything runHkChecks needs for these candidates of one extraction version. */
export async function buildCheckContext(deps:CheckDeps,doc:DocumentRow,ex:ExtractionRow,candidates:CandidateRow[],today:string):Promise<CheckContext>{
 const ids=[...new Set(candidates.filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact').flatMap(c=>citationIdsOf(citesOf(c))))];
 const rows=new Map<string,CitationRow>();
 for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=100)for(const r of await deps.db.citationsByIds(ids.slice(i,i+100)))rows.set(r.citation_id,r);
 const checks=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>();
 for(const id of ids){
  const row=rows.get(id);const v=row?await verify(deps.db,id):null;
  checks.set(id,row&&v?{integrity:v.integrity,currentExtraction:v.currentExtraction,snippet:row.snippet}:null);
 }
 let priorFacts:FactRow[]=[];let enCandidates:CandidateRow[]=[];
 if(ex.candidates_role==='primary'&&doc.issuer_id!==null){
  const read=await deps.port.readFacts(doc.issuer_id,{concepts:[...HK_CONCEPT_IDS],asOf:today,history:false});
  priorFacts=read.truncated?[]:read.rows;
  enCandidates=await englishCandidates(deps.db,doc,today);
 }
 return {verify:checks,priorFacts,enCandidates};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/candidates/run.ts
// runDocumentsCandidates (spec §7.3): one ingest_batches row (producer documents-candidates, dataset
// documents.candidates, tool_versions {hk_label_gen, hk_rules_version, hk_pub_gen}) and up to three
// phases, each bounded by the budget (no new extraction / issuer with < 90 s left → deadline_hit):
//  1. candidates — candidatesDue (or the given extraction ids) → claimCandidatesLease (the only
//     attempts counter; false → skip: it may just have turned the row 'exhausted') → pages.json
//     from the store, its sha256 checked against the extraction row → generateHkCandidates
//     (citations first, created_by 'extractor') → insertCandidates (idempotent, plain 'candidate'
//     rows) → §7.6 checks over this version's undecided rule candidates → writeCandidateChecks
//     (the only checks writer; it applies human-decision inheritance) → plan-1 quarantine of the
//     findings (dataset documents.candidates) → finishCandidates(done); any throw →
//     finishCandidates(failed) and candidates_error. The lease is renewed (renewCandidatesLease, no
//     attempt counted) before each mutating phase — generation (citations), insert, checks, findings —
//     and a takeover stops the extraction with lease_lost and no further write; generation and the
//     checks start only with MIN_PHASE_MS of budget left (else deadline_hit, finishCandidates(failed))
//     (codex plan round 1 P2-7).
//  2. auto — every undecided, checks-passed rule candidate (any batch: a crash is repaired by the
//     next run) whose extractor_ref has an unrevoked approval whose extractor_version /
//     table_algo_version / code_version equal the candidate's extraction row and whose concepts
//     contain the candidate's concept → decideCandidate(auto). too_many_approvals stops the phase
//     (and makes the batch partial/failed: the approvals table needs an owner).
//  3. promote — see Task 16.
// Counters: candidates phase fetched = generated candidates, inserted = new rows, duplicates =
// rows that already existed, quarantined = check findings parked, failed = extractions that failed.
// dryRun writes nothing (no batch, lease or row): it reports what is due.
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../dq/freshness';
import {quarantine} from '../../dq/quarantine';
import {cite} from '../citations';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '../db';
import {sha256Hex} from '../extract/pages-json';
import {supabaseObjectStore} from '../object-store';
import {DocumentsDbError,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_LABEL_GEN,HK_PUB_GEN,HK_RULES_VERSION} from '../types';
import type {ApprovalRow,CandidateRow,DocumentsDb,ExtractionRow,FinancialFactPayload,ObjectStore,Page,PagesJson} from '../types';
import {buildCheckContext,hkCheckFindings,runHkChecks} from '../hk-facts/checks';
import {supabaseHkFactsPort} from '../hk-facts/facts-port';
import type {HkFactsPort} from '../hk-facts/facts-port';
import {generateHkCandidates} from '../hk-facts/generate';

export type CandidatesPhase='candidates'|'auto'|'promote';
export const DEFAULT_PHASES:readonly CandidatesPhase[]=['candidates','auto'];
export const CANDIDATES_DATASET='documents.candidates';
export const LEASE_TTL_S=600;
export const MIN_ITEM_MS=90_000;
/** Budget a costly phase (generation, checks) needs to start (P2-7). */
export const MIN_PHASE_MS=20_000;
export const APPROVALS_LIMIT=100;
export interface CandidatesDeps{db:DocumentsDb;tables:TableClient;store:ObjectStore;port:HkFactsPort;now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null}
export interface CandidatesOptions{limit:number;extractionIds?:string[];dryRun:boolean;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;phases?:CandidatesPhase[]}
export interface ExtractionOutcome{extractionId:string;documentId:string|null;outcome:'done'|'failed'|'skipped'|'due';code?:string;inserted:number;written:number;inherited:number;quarantined:number}
export interface AutoSummary{considered:number;decided:number;stopped:string|null}
/** Structural subset of hk-facts/promote.ts::HkIssuerOutcome (Task 16). */
export interface PromoteSummary{issuerId:string;outcome:'published'|'failed'|'skipped';code?:string;counts:BatchCounts}
export interface CandidatesReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];extractions:ExtractionOutcome[];auto:AutoSummary;promote:PromoteSummary[];idle:boolean}
export class CandidatesRunError extends Error{constructor(public code:'code_version_unavailable'){super(code);this.name='CandidatesRunError';}}

export const COUNTERS=['fetched','inserted','duplicates','versioned','quarantined','failed'] as const;
export const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,200);
export const remainingMs=(deps:Pick<CandidatesDeps,'deadline'|'now'>)=>deps.deadline===null?Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY:deps.deadline.getTime()-deps.now().getTime();
/** Reads every page of a cursor-paged DocumentsDb read. */
export async function allPages<T>(read:(cursor:string|null)=>Promise<Page<T>>):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
 do{const p=await read(cursor);out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null);
 return out;
}

/** Production wiring over the service-role client (spec §6.3 cron, admin routes, scripts). */
export function supabaseCandidatesDeps(admin:SupabaseClient,opts:{deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;now?:()=>Date}):CandidatesDeps{
 return {db:supabaseDocumentsDb(admin),tables:supabaseTableClient(admin),store:supabaseObjectStore(admin),port:supabaseHkFactsPort(admin),
  now:opts.now??(()=>new Date()),deadline:opts.deadline,codeVersion:opts.codeVersion};
}

class PhaseDeadline extends Error{constructor(){super('deadline_hit');}}
const blank=(ex:{extraction_id:string;document_id:string|null}):ExtractionOutcome=>({extractionId:ex.extraction_id,documentId:ex.document_id,outcome:'skipped',inserted:0,written:0,inherited:0,quarantined:0});

/** candidatesDue, or the given ids (only those still pending/failed; the rest are reported as not_due). */
async function dueExtractions(deps:CandidatesDeps,opts:CandidatesOptions):Promise<{due:ExtractionRow[];notDue:string[]}>{
 if(opts.extractionIds===undefined)return {due:await deps.db.candidatesDue(opts.limit),notDue:[]};
 const due:ExtractionRow[]=[];const notDue:string[]=[];
 for(const id of [...new Set(opts.extractionIds)]){
  const ex=await deps.db.extractionById(id);
  if(ex&&(ex.candidates_status==='pending'||ex.candidates_status==='failed'))due.push(ex);else notDue.push(id);
 }
 return {due,notDue};
}

async function candidatesFor(deps:CandidatesDeps,batchId:string,ex:ExtractionRow,today:string,out:ExtractionOutcome,counts:BatchCounts,errors:BatchError[]):Promise<void>{
 if(!await deps.db.claimCandidatesLease(ex.extraction_id,batchId,LEASE_TTL_S)){
  out.outcome='skipped';out.code='leased_or_exhausted';
  errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:ex.extraction_id,message:JSON.stringify({leased_or_exhausted:1})});
  return;
 }
 // P2-7: renew before every mutating phase; a takeover → lease_lost (no finishCandidates, nothing more written)
 const keep=async()=>{if(!await deps.db.renewCandidatesLease(ex.extraction_id,batchId,LEASE_TTL_S))throw new DocumentsDbError('lease_lost');};
 const budget=()=>{if(remainingMs(deps)<MIN_PHASE_MS)throw new PhaseDeadline();};
 try{
  const doc=await deps.db.documentById(ex.document_id);
  if(!doc)throw new Error('document_not_found');
  const bytes=await deps.store.get(ex.pages_json_path);
  if(sha256Hex(bytes)!==ex.pages_json_sha256)throw new Error('pages_json_hash_mismatch');
  const pages=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes)) as PagesJson;
  budget();await keep();
  const gen=await generateHkCandidates(pages,{document:doc,extraction:ex,
   cite:at=>cite(deps.db,{document_id:doc.document_id,extraction_id:ex.extraction_id,page_no:at.page_no,char_start:at.char_start,char_end:at.char_end,bbox:at.bbox??null,created_by:'extractor',created_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF})});
  errors.push(...gen.info);
  await keep();
  const {inserted}=await deps.db.insertCandidates(ex.extraction_id,batchId,gen.candidates);
  out.inserted=inserted;
  counts.fetched+=gen.candidates.length;counts.inserted+=inserted;counts.duplicates+=gen.candidates.length-inserted;
  const open=(await allPages(cursor=>deps.db.candidatesOf({extractionId:ex.extraction_id},{cursor,limit:1000})))
   .filter(c=>c.status==='candidate'&&c.kind==='financial_fact'&&c.extractor_kind==='rule'&&c.extractor_ref===HK_EXTRACTOR_REF);
  if(open.length>0){
   budget();
   const ctx=await buildCheckContext(deps,doc,ex,open,today);
   const results=runHkChecks(open,ctx);
   await keep();
   const w=await deps.db.writeCandidateChecks(ex.extraction_id,batchId,results);
   out.written=w.written;out.inherited=w.inherited;
   const {findings,info}=hkCheckFindings(ex,open,results);
   errors.push(...info);
   await keep();
   for(const f of findings)await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:CANDIDATES_DATASET,table:'extraction_candidates',naturalKey:f.naturalKey,reasonCode:f.reasonCode,batchId,payload:{...f.payload,candidate_ids:f.candidateIds}});
   out.quarantined=findings.length;counts.quarantined+=findings.length;
  }
  await deps.db.finishCandidates(ex.extraction_id,batchId,'done');
  out.outcome='done';
 }catch(e){
  out.outcome='failed';counts.failed++;
  if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='lease_lost'){out.code='lease_lost';errors.push({code:'lease_lost',key:ex.extraction_id});return;}
  if(e instanceof PhaseDeadline){out.code='deadline_hit';errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',key:ex.extraction_id,message:'phase'});}
  else{out.code='candidates_error';errors.push({code:'candidates_error',key:ex.extraction_id,message:errMsg(e)});}
  try{await deps.db.finishCandidates(ex.extraction_id,batchId,'failed');}
  catch(e2){errors.push({code:'cleanup_failed',key:ex.extraction_id,message:errMsg(e2)});}
 }
}

async function autoDecide(deps:CandidatesDeps,errors:BatchError[]):Promise<AutoSummary>{
 const summary:AutoSummary={considered:0,decided:0,stopped:null};
 // collected first: deciding changes the status the cursor pages over
 const pending=(await allPages(cursor=>deps.db.candidatesOf({status:'candidate'},{cursor,limit:1000})))
  .filter(c=>c.extractor_kind==='rule'&&c.checks_passed&&c.kind==='financial_fact');
 summary.considered=pending.length;
 const byRef=new Map<string,CandidateRow[]>();
 for(const c of pending){const g=byRef.get(c.extractor_ref);if(g)g.push(c);else byRef.set(c.extractor_ref,[c]);}
 const rows=new Map<string,ExtractionRow|null>();
 for(const [ref,list] of [...byRef].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0)){
  let approvals:ApprovalRow[];
  try{approvals=(await deps.db.approvalsFor(ref,{limit:APPROVALS_LIMIT})).filter(a=>a.revoked_at===null&&a.extractor_ref===ref);}
  catch(e){
   if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='too_many_approvals'){summary.stopped='too_many_approvals';errors.push({code:'too_many_approvals',key:ref});return summary;}
   throw e;
  }
  if(approvals.length===0)continue;
  for(const c of list){
   if(!rows.has(c.extraction_id))rows.set(c.extraction_id,await deps.db.extractionById(c.extraction_id));
   const ex=rows.get(c.extraction_id);if(!ex)continue;
   const concept=(c.payload as FinancialFactPayload).concept;
   const a=approvals.find(x=>x.extractor_version===ex.extractor_version&&x.table_algo_version===ex.table_algo_version&&x.code_version===ex.code_version&&x.concepts.includes(concept));
   if(!a)continue;
   try{const r=await deps.db.decideCandidate(c.candidate_id,{kind:'auto',approval_id:a.approval_id});if(r.status==='confirmed')summary.decided++;}
   catch(e){if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&(e.code==='not_eligible'||e.code==='decided'||e.code==='approval_revoked'))continue;throw e;}
  }
 }
 return summary;
}

async function dryRun(deps:CandidatesDeps,opts:CandidatesOptions,phases:Set<CandidatesPhase>):Promise<CandidatesReceipt>{
 const extractions:ExtractionOutcome[]=[];
 if(phases.has('candidates')){
  const {due,notDue}=await dueExtractions(deps,opts);
  for(const ex of due)extractions.push({...blank(ex),outcome:'due'});
  for(const id of notDue)extractions.push({...blank({extraction_id:id,document_id:null}),code:'not_due'});
 }
 return {batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[],extractions,auto:{considered:0,decided:0,stopped:null},promote:[],idle:!extractions.some(e=>e.outcome==='due')};
}

export async function runDocumentsCandidates(deps:CandidatesDeps,opts:CandidatesOptions):Promise<CandidatesReceipt>{
 const phases=new Set<CandidatesPhase>(opts.phases??DEFAULT_PHASES);
 if(opts.dryRun)return dryRun(deps,opts,phases);
 if(!deps.codeVersion)throw new CandidatesRunError('code_version_unavailable');
 const today=deps.now().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'documents-candidates',dataset:CANDIDATES_DATASET,
  toolVersions:{hk_label_gen:String(HK_LABEL_GEN),hk_rules_version:HK_RULES_VERSION,hk_pub_gen:String(HK_PUB_GEN)},codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy});
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const extractions:ExtractionOutcome[]=[];const promote:PromoteSummary[]=[];
 let auto:AutoSummary={considered:0,decided:0,stopped:null};let idle=true;
 try{
  if(phases.has('candidates')){
   const {due,notDue}=await dueExtractions(deps,opts);
   for(const id of notDue){extractions.push({...blank({extraction_id:id,document_id:null}),code:'not_due'});errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:id,message:JSON.stringify({not_due:1})});}
   if(due.length>0)idle=false;
   for(let i=0;i<due.length;i++){
    if(remainingMs(deps)<MIN_ITEM_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:JSON.stringify({not_started:due.length-i})});break;}
    const out=blank(due[i]);extractions.push(out);
    await candidatesFor(deps,batchId,due[i],today,out,counts,errors);
   }
  }
  if(phases.has('auto')){
   try{auto=await autoDecide(deps,errors);if(auto.decided>0)idle=false;}
   catch(e){errors.push({code:'auto_failed',message:errMsg(e)});}
  }
  if(phases.has('promote')){
   // Task 16 replaces this block with promotionDue → runHkFactsSync.
   errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:'promote',message:JSON.stringify({not_wired:1})});
  }
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,CANDIDATES_DATASET,{ok:status!=='failed',cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),
   detail:{extractions:extractions.length,failed:extractions.filter(e=>e.outcome==='failed').length,auto_decided:auto.decided,promoted:promote.filter(p=>p.outcome==='published').length,idle}});
  return {batchId,status,counts,errors,extractions,auto,promote,idle};
 }catch(e){
  // infrastructure failure outside an extraction: close the receipt so no running batch dangles, then rethrow
  errors.push({code:'unknown',message:errMsg(e)});
  try{await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());}catch{/* left running; runbook SQL marks it failed */}
  try{await recordAttempt(deps.tables,CANDIDATES_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{error:errMsg(e)}});}catch{/* same */}
  throw e;
 }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement `scripts/documents/candidates.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Document candidates from the command line (spec §6.3, §7.3). No deadline; dry run by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/candidates.ts [--limit n] [--extraction <uuid>]...
 *        [--phases candidates,auto,promote] [--apply]
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/candidates.ts --regenerate
 *        [--filter source=hkexnews,issuer=<uuid>,document=<uuid>] --actor <auth user uuid> [--apply]
 *
 * Dry run: lists the due extractions (and, once Task 16 wires it, the issuers due for promotion);
 * writes nothing. --apply records an ingest_batches receipt (dataset documents.candidates,
 * triggered_by script) and needs a code version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git checkout).
 * --regenerate (after an HK_LABEL_GEN / HK_RULES_VERSION bump) calls request_candidates_regen for the
 * current extraction versions matching the filter; the next run (cron or this script) regenerates.
 * --actor is the admin user recorded by the function (DOCUMENTS_ADMIN_USER_ID is the fallback).
 * Exit 0 on success, 1 when the batch failed, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {runDocumentsCandidates,supabaseCandidatesDeps} from '../../src/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import type {CandidatesPhase} from '../../src/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import type {CandidatesFilter,ListedSource} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: candidates.ts [--limit n] [--extraction <uuid>]... [--phases candidates,auto,promote] [--regenerate [--filter k=v,...] --actor <uuid>] [--apply]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const PHASES:readonly CandidatesPhase[]=['candidates','auto','promote'];
const SOURCES:readonly ListedSource[]=['edgar','cninfo','hkexnews'];
interface Args{limit:number;extractions:string[];phases?:CandidatesPhase[];regenerate:boolean;filter:CandidatesFilter;actor?:string;apply:boolean}
const bad=(msg:string):never=>{console.error(msg);console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);};

function parseFilter(s:string):CandidatesFilter{
 const out:CandidatesFilter={};
 for(const part of s.split(',').filter(Boolean)){
  const [k,v]=part.split('=');
  if(k==='source'){if(!SOURCES.includes(v as ListedSource))bad(`bad source: ${v}`);out.source=v as ListedSource;}
  else if(k==='issuer'){if(!UUID.test(v??''))bad(`bad issuer: ${v}`);out.issuer_id=v;}
  else if(k==='document'){if(!UUID.test(v??''))bad(`bad document: ${v}`);out.document_id=v;}
  else bad(`unknown filter key: ${k}`);
 }
 return out;
}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={limit:25,extractions:[],regenerate:false,filter:{},apply:false};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--'))bad(`missing value for ${argv[i]}`);return v as string;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--extraction'){const v=next(i++);if(!UUID.test(v))bad(`bad extraction id: ${v}`);a.extractions.push(v);}
  else if(x==='--phases'){const v=next(i++).split(',');if(v.some(p=>!PHASES.includes(p as CandidatesPhase)))bad(`bad phases: ${v.join(',')}`);a.phases=v as CandidatesPhase[];}
  else if(x==='--regenerate')a.regenerate=true;
  else if(x==='--filter')a.filter=parseFilter(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--actor'){const v=next(i++);if(!UUID.test(v))bad(`bad actor: ${v}`);a.actor=v;}
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else bad(`unknown argument: ${x}`);
 }
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>1000)bad('--limit must be 1..1000');
 if(!a.regenerate&&(Object.keys(a.filter).length>0||a.actor!==undefined))bad('--filter/--actor only with --regenerate');
 if(a.regenerate&&(a.extractions.length>0||a.phases!==undefined))bad('--regenerate excludes --extraction/--phases');
 return a;
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 if(args.regenerate){
  const actor=args.actor??process.env.DOCUMENTS_ADMIN_USER_ID;
  if(!actor||!UUID.test(actor))bad('--regenerate needs --actor <uuid> (or DOCUMENTS_ADMIN_USER_ID)');
  if(!args.apply){console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'dry-run (pass --apply to request regeneration)',filter:args.filter,actor},null,1));process.exit(0);}
  const deps=supabaseCandidatesDeps(admin,{deadline:null,codeVersion:null});
  const requested=await deps.db.requestCandidatesRegen(args.filter,actor as string);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'apply',filter:args.filter,requested},null,1));
  process.exit(0);
 }
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true});
 if(args.apply&&!codeVersion)bad('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');
 const deps=supabaseCandidatesDeps(admin,{deadline:null,codeVersion});
 const receipt=await runDocumentsCandidates(deps,{limit:args.limit,extractionIds:args.extractions.length>0?args.extractions:undefined,dryRun:!args.apply,triggeredBy:'script',phases:args.phases});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:args.apply?'apply':'dry-run (no batch written; pass --apply to write)',codeVersion,...receipt},null,1));
 process.exit(args.apply&&receipt.status==='failed'?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/promote.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import type {Market} from '../../facts/types';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_PUB_GEN,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../types';

import type {PromoteDeps} from './promote';

import type {HkHarness,SeedFact} from './test-support';

const run=async(h:HkHarness,over:Partial<PromoteDeps>={},pubGen?:number)=>
 (await runHkFactsSync({...candidatesDepsOf(h),...over},{issuerIds:[ISSUER],batchId:await h.batch(),triggeredBy:'script',...(pubGen===undefined?{}:{pubGen})}))[0];
const okFacts=(h:HkHarness)=>h.facts.facts().filter(f=>f.status==='ok');
async function confirmedDoc(h:HkHarness,facts:readonly SeedFact[]=FY25,sourceRef='2026032500001_c'){
 const ex=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef,facts});const ids=await seedHkCandidates(h,ex);await confirm(h,ids.values());return {ex,ids};
}
const dead=async():Promise<never>=>{throw new Error('process died');};

describe('runHkFactsSync',()=>{
 it('publishes the active set as HK facts: filing, binding, evidence, raw_hash locator, promoted candidates, released lease',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();const {ex}=await confirmedDoc(h);
  const o=await run(h);
  expect(o).toMatchObject({outcome:'published',staged:6,counts:{fetched:6,inserted:6,duplicates:0,quarantined:0,failed:0}});
  expect(o.finish).toEqual({published:6,still_staged:0,abandoned:0});
  const facts=okFacts(h);
  expect(facts).toHaveLength(6);
  for(const f of facts)expect(f).toMatchObject({market:'HK',mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN,mapping_version:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,available_date:'2026-03-25',consolidation:'consolidated'});
  const rev=facts.find(f=>f.concept==='revenue')!;
  expect(rev).toMatchObject({value:'6256000',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'12M',unit:'CNY',source_concept:'收益'});
  const filings=h.facts.filings();
  expect(filings).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(filings[0]).toMatchObject({source:'hkex',origin:'hkex',market:'HK',source_ref:hkFilingSourceRef(ex.document),form_type:'annual',fiscal_year:2025,fiscal_period:'FY',period_end:'2025-12-31',available_date:'2026-03-25',mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN});
  expect(hkFilingSourceRef(ex.document)).toBe('hkex:2026032500001_c:v1');
  expect(await h.port.hkFilingOfDocument(ex.document.document_id)).toMatchObject({filing_id:filings[0].filing_id,mapping_gen:HK_PUB_GEN});
  const ev=await h.port.citationsOfFact(rev.fact_id);
  const roles=(r:CitationRole)=>ev.filter(e=>e.role===r).length;
  expect([roles('value'),roles('label'),roles('unit'),roles('period')]).toEqual([1,1,1,2]);
  const value=(await h.docs.citationById(ev.find(e=>e.role==='value')!.citation_id))!;
  expect(value.snippet).toBe('6256000');
  expect(rev.raw_hash).toBe(hkRawHash(ex.document.content_sha256,value));
  expect(rev.raw_hash).toMatch(new RegExp(`^hkex:${ex.document.content_sha256.slice(0,16)}:${ex.extractionId}:p1:c\\d+-\\d+$`));
  expect(h.docs.candidates().every(c=>c.status==='promoted')).toBe(true);
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='published'&&p.pub_gen===HK_PUB_GEN&&p.run_id===o.runId)).toBe(true);
  expect(h.facts.scope().find(s=>s.issuer_id===ISSUER)).toMatchObject({lease_batch_id:null,last_status:'success',fetch_key:'00268'});
 });
 it('stages only the active set: rejected, undecided, failing and English (comparison) candidates stay out',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();
  const zh=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2026032500002_c',facts:FY25});
  const ids=await seedHkCandidates(h,zh,{passed:f=>f.concept!=='equity_total'});
  await expect(h.docs.decideCandidate(ids.get(naturalKeyOf(FY25[5]))!,{kind:'human',decided_by:ADMIN,status:'confirmed'})).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'not_eligible'});
  await confirm(h,[ids.get(naturalKeyOf(FY25[0]))!]);
  await h.docs.decideCandidate(ids.get(naturalKeyOf(FY25[1]))!,{kind:'human',decided_by:ADMIN,status:'rejected'});
  const en=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2026032500002_e',language:'en',facts:[FY25[2]]});
  await confirm(h,(await seedHkCandidates(h,en)).values());
  const o=await run(h);

  expect(okFacts(h).map(f=>f.concept)).toEqual(['revenue']);
  expect(h.facts.filings().map(f=>f.source_ref)).toEqual([hkFilingSourceRef(zh.document)]);
 });
 it('a second confirmation in the same generation stages only the new candidate; the filing keeps its generation',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();

  expect(h.facts.filings()).toHaveLength(1);expect(h.facts.filings()[0].mapping_gen).toBe(HK_PUB_GEN);
  const pubs=h.docs.publications();

 });
 it('nothing to publish: abandons its run and releases the lease',async()=>{

 it('a lease held by another batch skips the issuer without any write',async()=>{

 it('an issuer without an HKEX stock code fails as scope_unresolved',async()=>{

 it('publishHkRun refuses incomplete evidence: run and publications abandoned, nothing ok; the next run re-stages the abandoned rows',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const port={...h.port,insertFactCitations:(r:string,rows:{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}[])=>h.port.insertFactCitations(r,rows.filter(x=>x.role!=='unit'))};

 it('stale_plan: never publishes the old plan; abandons, releases, and the next run re-reads and publishes',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const port={...h.port,readFacts:async(i:string,opts:Parameters<typeof h.port.readFacts>[1])=>{const r=await h.port.readFacts(i,opts);return {...r,stateRev:r.stateRev+1};}};

 it('plan_inconsistent when stageFacts inserts fewer rows than planned; read_truncated when the snapshot is truncated',async()=>{

  expect(cut).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'read_truncated'});

 it('mixed outcome (spec §12 example 10): a same-day replacement parks one row, finish reports 3/1/0, accepting the item publishes it on the next run',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();
  await confirmedDoc(h,[FY25[0]],'2026032500005_c');
  expect((await run(h)).outcome).toBe('published');
  const v2=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2026032500005_c',bytesTag:'v2',facts:[{...FY25[0],value:'6256999'},FY25[3],FY25[4],FY25[5]]});
  expect(v2.document.source_version).toBe(2);
  await confirm(h,(await seedHkCandidates(h,v2)).values());
  const o=await run(h);
  expect(o.outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(o.finish).toEqual({published:3,still_staged:1,abandoned:0});
  expect(o.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:4,inserted:3,quarantined:1});
  const revs=h.facts.facts().filter(f=>f.concept==='revenue');
  expect(revs.map(f=>[f.value,f.status]).sort()).toEqual([['6256000','quarantined'],['6256999','quarantined']]);
  const v2Rev=h.docs.candidates().find(c=>c.document_id===v2.document.document_id&&c.natural_key===naturalKeyOf(FY25[0]))!;
  expect(v2Rev.status).toBe('confirmed');
  expect(h.docs.publications().find(p=>p.candidate_id===v2Rev.candidate_id)!.state).toBe('staged');
  const item=h.tables.rows('dq_quarantine').find(r=>r.dataset==='facts.hk'&&r.reason_code==='same_day_conflict')!;
  expect(item).toMatchObject({table_name:'financial_facts',status:'open'});
  const chosen=revs.find(f=>f.value==='6256999')!.fact_id;
  await h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(String(item.id),[chosen],ADMIN);
  expect(h.facts.facts().find(f=>f.fact_id===chosen)!.status).toBe('ok');
  const next=await run(h);
  expect(next).toMatchObject({outcome:'skipped',code:'nothing_to_publish'});
  expect(h.docs.publications().filter(p=>p.state==='staged')).toEqual([]);
  expect((await h.docs.candidateById(v2Rev.candidate_id))!.status).toBe('promoted');
 });
 it('step 0a: a published run whose publications were never finished is finished by the next run',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const o=await run(h,{port:{...h.port,finishCandidatePublications:dead}});
  expect(o.outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(o.errors.map(e=>e.code)).toContain('finish_failed');
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='staged')).toBe(true);
  const next=await run(h);
  expect(next).toMatchObject({outcome:'skipped',code:'nothing_to_publish'});
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='published')).toBe(true);
  expect(h.docs.candidates().every(c=>c.status==='promoted')).toBe(true);
 });
 it('steps 0a–0c: a crashed staged run of an earlier batch is abandoned by beginRun (never abandonRun) and its publications re-staged',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const crashed=await run(h,{port:{...h.port,insertFactCitations:dead,abandonRun:dead,abandonCandidatePublications:dead,releaseLease:dead}});
  expect(crashed.outcome).toBe('failed');
  const oldRun=crashed.runId!;
  expect(h.facts.runs().find(r=>r.run_id===oldRun)!.status).toBe('staged');
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='staged'&&p.run_id===oldRun)).toBe(true);
  h.facts.expireLease(ISSUER,'HK' as unknown as Market);
  let abandonedOld=0;
  const watched={...h.port,abandonRun:async(r:string)=>{if(r===oldRun)abandonedOld++;return h.port.abandonRun(r);}};
  const o=await run(h,{port:watched});
  expect(abandonedOld).toBe(0);
  expect(o.outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(h.facts.runs().find(r=>r.run_id===oldRun)!.status).toBe('abandoned');
  const pubs=h.docs.publications();
  expect(pubs).toHaveLength(6);
  for(const p of pubs)expect(p).toMatchObject({state:'published',run_id:o.runId});
 });
 it('step 0a: staged publications of a run another batch already abandoned are abandoned, then re-staged',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const crashed=await run(h,{port:{...h.port,insertFactCitations:dead,abandonRun:dead,abandonCandidatePublications:dead,releaseLease:dead}});
  h.facts.expireLease(ISSUER,'HK' as unknown as Market);
  const other=await h.batch();
  expect(await h.port.claimLease(ISSUER,other,600)).toBe(true);
  await h.port.beginRun(ISSUER,other,HK_PUB_GEN);                     // a foreign batch took over: the crashed run is abandoned, its publications still staged
  await h.port.releaseLease(ISSUER,other,'failed',NOW);
  expect(await h.port.runStatus(crashed.runId!)).toBe('abandoned');
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='staged')).toBe(true);
  const o=await run(h);
  expect(o.outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(h.docs.publications().every(p=>p.state==='published'&&p.run_id===o.runId)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('a publication-generation bump re-publishes under the new generation and hides a zero-output filing (spec §12 example 9, R5-13)',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();
  await confirmedDoc(h,[FY25[0]],'2026032500007_c');
  const half:SeedFact={concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-06-30',duration:'6M',value:'3000000'};
  const b=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2025082500008_c',docClass:'interim_report',periodEnd:'2025-06-30',availableAt:'2025-08-25T08:30:00.000Z',facts:[half],extractorVersion:'docs-extract/0.9'});
  await confirm(h,(await seedHkCandidates(h,b)).values());
  expect((await run(h)).outcome).toBe('published');
  const gen1=okFacts(h);expect(gen1).toHaveLength(2);
  // B re-extracted under the current extractor; its new version produced no candidates at all (zero output)
  await h.docs.requestExtract(b.document.document_id,ADMIN);
  await seedHkCandidates(h,await seedExtraction(h,b.document.document_id,[]));
  const next=HK_PUB_GEN+1;
  expect(await h.port.zeroOutputDocuments(ISSUER,next)).toContain(b.document.document_id);   // literal condition (d) may also list A; promotion takes the union with the active documents
  expect((await h.port.promotionDue(next,10)).map(x=>x.issuerId)).toEqual([ISSUER]);
  const o=await run(h,{},next);
  expect(o.outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(h.facts.filings().map(f=>f.mapping_gen)).toEqual([next,next]);
  const visible=await h.port.readFacts(ISSUER,{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2026-11-06',history:true});
  expect(visible.rows.map(r=>[r.period_end,r.mapping_gen])).toEqual([['2025-12-31',next]]);
  expect((await h.port.factsByIds(gen1.map(f=>f.fact_id))).every(f=>f.status==='ok'&&f.mapping_gen===HK_PUB_GEN)).toBe(true);
  expect(await h.port.promotionDue(next,10)).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('a revoked approval of an auto-decided candidate fails the stage step and abandons the run',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();
  const ex=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2026032500009_c',facts:[FY25[0]]});const [id]=(await seedHkCandidates(h,ex)).values();
  const approval=await h.docs.insertApproval({extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:CODE,concepts:['revenue'],
   gold_sha256:'a'.repeat(64),precision:'0.97',recall:'0.96',report_path:'docs/audits/eval.json',approved_by:ADMIN});

 });
 it('P1-4: a zero-output document that switches to a new extraction between selection and publish → stale_plan, no generation advance; the next run replans',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();
  await confirmedDoc(h,[FY25[0]],'2026032500010_c');
  const half:SeedFact={concept:'revenue',statement:'IS',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-06-30',duration:'6M',value:'3000000'};
  const b=await seedHkExtraction(h,{sourceRef:'2025082500011_c',docClass:'interim_report',periodEnd:'2025-06-30',availableAt:'2025-08-25T08:30:00.000Z',facts:[half],extractorVersion:'docs-extract/0.9'});
  await confirm(h,(await seedHkCandidates(h,b)).values());
  expect((await run(h)).outcome).toBe('published');
  await h.docs.requestExtract(b.document.document_id,ADMIN);
  await seedHkCandidates(h,await seedExtraction(h,b.document.document_id,[],'docs-extract/0.95'));   // zero output (an intermediate extractor, so a later re-extraction is allowed)
  const next=HK_PUB_GEN+1;const before=h.facts.filings().map(f=>[f.filing_id,f.mapping_gen]);const gen1=okFacts(h).map(f=>f.fact_id).sort();
  let switched='';
  const racing={...h.port,publishHkRun:async(...a:Parameters<typeof h.port.publishHkRun>)=>{
   expect(a[5].map(z=>z.document_id)).toContain(b.document.document_id);
   await h.docs.requestExtract(b.document.document_id,ADMIN);                                    // another worker re-extracts B: new extraction, candidates pending
   switched=(await seedExtraction(h,b.document.document_id,[half])).extractionId;
   return h.port.publishHkRun(...a);
  }};
  const o=await run(h,{port:racing},next);
  expect(o).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'stale_plan'});
  expect((await h.docs.extractionById(switched))!.candidates_status).toBe('pending');
  expect(h.facts.filings().map(f=>[f.filing_id,f.mapping_gen])).toEqual(before);               // no generation advance
  expect(okFacts(h).map(f=>f.fact_id).sort()).toEqual(gen1);                                    // nothing hidden, nothing new
  expect(h.facts.runs().filter(r=>r.status==='staged')).toEqual([]);
  expect(h.facts.scope().find(s=>s.issuer_id===ISSUER)).toMatchObject({lease_batch_id:null,last_status:'failed'});
 });
 it('P2-7: a lease taken over between phases is lease_lost with nothing staged; a phase without budget is deadline_hit',async()=>{
  const h=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(h);
  const OTHER=await h.batch();
  const port={...h.port,readFacts:async(i:string,opts:Parameters<typeof h.port.readFacts>[1])=>{
   const r=await h.port.readFacts(i,opts);
   h.facts.expireLease(ISSUER,'HK' as unknown as Market);                     // planning outlived the lease …

   return r;
  }};
  const o=await run(h,{port});
  expect(o).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'lease_lost'});
  expect(h.facts.filings()).toEqual([]);expect(h.facts.facts()).toEqual([]);expect(h.docs.publications()).toEqual([]);
  expect(h.facts.scope().find(s=>s.issuer_id===ISSUER)).toMatchObject({lease_batch_id:OTHER});
  const g=hkHarness();await confirmedDoc(g);
  let clock=Date.parse(NOW);
  const slow={...g.port,readFacts:async(i:string,opts:Parameters<typeof g.port.readFacts>[1])=>{clock+=50_000;return g.port.readFacts(i,opts);}};   // 15 s left after planning
  const late=await run(g,{port:slow,now:()=>new Date(clock),deadline:new Date(clock+65_000)});
  expect(late).toMatchObject({outcome:'failed',code:'deadline_hit'});

 });
 it('P2-6: issuers whose only staged work waits on an owner quarantine decision are not due, so a later issuer is not starved by a limit-1 batch',async()=>{
  const B='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2';
  const h=hkHarness({issuers:[{issuer_id:ISSUER,code:'00268'},{issuer_id:B,code:'00700'}]});
  const runFor=async(issuer:string)=>(await runHkFactsSync(candidatesDepsOf(h),{issuerIds:[issuer],batchId:await h.batch(),triggeredBy:'script'}))[0];

  // B: an ordinary confirmed candidate, created after ISSUER's wait began

  await confirm(h,(await seedHkCandidates(h,bx)).values());
  expect((await h.port.promotionDue(HK_PUB_GEN,1)).map(x=>x.issuerId)).toEqual([B]);         // batch 1 (limit 1): ISSUER's quarantine wait does not take the slot
  expect((await runFor(B)).outcome).toBe('published');
  expect(await h.port.promotionDue(HK_PUB_GEN,1)).toEqual([]);                                  // batch 2: nothing actionable while the decision is unchanged
  const item=h.tables.rows('dq_quarantine').find(r=>r.dataset==='facts.hk'&&r.reason_code==='same_day_conflict')!;
  const chosen=h.facts.facts().find(f=>f.concept==='revenue'&&f.issuer_id===ISSUER&&f.value==='6256999')!.fact_id;
  await h.port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(String(item.id),[chosen],ADMIN);
  expect((await h.port.promotionDue(HK_PUB_GEN,1)).map(x=>x.issuerId)).toEqual([ISSUER]);   // batch 3: the decision changed, the link is actionable again
  expect(await runFor(ISSUER)).toMatchObject({outcome:'skipped',code:'nothing_to_publish'});
  expect(await h.port.promotionDue(HK_PUB_GEN,10)).toEqual([]);
 });
```
