```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/promote.ts
// HK fact promotion (spec §7.7, 6th draft; R5-1 R5-5 R5-7 R5-11 R5-13): one spec-2 sync run per
// issuer under its HK lease, fed by the ACTIVE candidate set. Each step is idempotent; a crash
// restarts from step 0.
//  0. ensureHkScope (creates the HK scope row only if missing) + claimLease (false → skipped
//     'leased', no write). a: staged publications of this pub_gen grouped by run — run published →
//     finishCandidatePublications (row by row: fact ok → published, quarantined → stays staged,
//     gone → abandoned); run abandoned → abandonCandidatePublications; run still staged (a crashed
//     earlier batch) → left for b, NEVER abandonRun on it (spec-2 run functions check the run's own
//     batch lease → lease_lost). b: beginRun (spec-2 abandons every staged run of the issuer under
//     OUR lease; evidence cascades; empty gen-0 filings and their bindings are pruned). c: the runs
//     left in a, now abandoned → abandonCandidatePublications.
//  1. planning snapshot: readFacts(history, includeNonOk, all HK concepts, no limit); truncated →
//     read_truncated; its state_rev is expectedRev.
//  2. to stage = active candidates without a staged|published publication in this pub_gen.
//     Filings for every document with an active candidate plus the zero-output documents
//     (promotionDue (d)); nothing to stage and no zero-output document → abandon, release,
//     skipped nothing_to_publish. stageFilings → bindFilingDocuments → planHkFactWrites (spec-2
//     planFactWrites) → fact_id per candidate from plan.inserts, else the snapshot, by candidate
//     key K + filing + pub_gen (a miss, any plan.ambiguous, or stageFacts ≠ inserts →
//     plan_inconsistent) → stageFacts → stageCandidatePublication (approval_revoked → failed).
//  3. fact_citations for every NEW fact while all are still staged: value, label, unit, each period
//     evidence (evidence_failed); then same-day conflicts and contested joins are parked exactly like
//     facts/sync.ts (dataset facts.hk).
//  4. spec-2 identity rules on new rows ∪ ok rows → quarantineFacts; publishHkRun(expectedRev, the
//     zero-output selection {document_id, extraction_id} — revalidated under the document locks:
//     a document that switched extraction or whose candidates are no longer done → stale_plan).
//     evidence_incomplete / stale_plan / anything else (publish_failed) → abandon run + its
//     publications, release(failed). stale_plan is never retried with a new revision: promotionDue
//     (ab) brings the issuer back and step 1 re-reads. Success → finishCandidatePublications →
//     release(success). No materialization (R5-3).
// Every exit releases the lease (a lost lease stops all writes); after publish nothing can undo
// the run: a later failure is reported next to outcome 'published' and step 0a repairs it. The HK
// lease is renewed (same-batch claimLease) before steps 2, 3 and 4 and a takeover is lease_lost with
// no further write; steps 2 and 4 start only with MIN_PHASE_MS of budget left, else deadline_hit
// (run abandoned, lease released) (codex plan round 1 P2-7).
// raw_hash = value-citation locator hkex:<sha256[0:16]>:<extraction_id>:p<page>:c<start>-<end>.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,TriggeredBy} from '../../dq/batches';
import {quarantine} from '../../dq/quarantine';
import {candidateKey} from '../../facts/keys';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {summarizeWarnings} from '../../facts/rules';
import type {FactCandidate} from '../../facts/types';
import {cpSlice} from '../extract/pages-json';
import {DocumentsDbError,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_PUB_GEN} from '../types';
import type {CandidateRow,CitationRole,CitationRow,DocumentRow,DocumentsDb,FactCitations,FinancialFactPayload,Page,PublicationRow} from '../types';
import {HK_CONCEPT_IDS} from './checks';
import {evaluateHkFactRules,planHkFactWrites,toFilingInsert} from './facts-port';
import type {HkFactsPort,HkFilingInsert} from './facts-port';

export const PROMOTE_LEASE_TTL_S=600;
export const MIN_ISSUER_MS=60_000;
/** Budget step 2 (staging) and step 4 (publish) need to start (P2-7). */
export const MIN_PHASE_MS=20_000;
export const HK_FACTS_DATASET='facts.hk';
const COUNTERS=['fetched','inserted','duplicates','versioned','quarantined','failed'] as const;
export interface PromoteDeps{db:DocumentsDb;port:HkFactsPort;tables:TableClient;now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null}
export interface PromoteOptions{issuerIds:string[];batchId:string;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;/** tests and promote-hk.ts --pub-gen only; default HK_PUB_GEN */pubGen?:number}
export interface HkIssuerOutcome{issuerId:string;runId:string|null;outcome:'published'|'failed'|'skipped';code?:string;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];staged:number;finish?:{published:number;still_staged:number;abandoned:number}}

export const hkFilingSourceRef=(d:Pick<DocumentRow,'source_ref'|'source_version'>)=>`hkex:${d.source_ref}:v${d.source_version}`;
export function hkRawHash(contentSha256:string,c:Pick<CitationRow,'extraction_id'|'page_no'|'char_start'|'char_end'>):string{
 return `hkex:${contentSha256.slice(0,16)}:${c.extraction_id}:p${c.page_no}:c${c.char_start}-${c.char_end}`;
}
const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,200);
const codeOf=(e:unknown):string|null=>{const c=(e as {code?:unknown}|null)?.code;return typeof c==='string'?c:null;};
const isLeaseLoss=(e:unknown)=>{const c=codeOf(e);return c==='lease_lost'||c==='run_abandoned';};
const remaining=(deps:Pick<PromoteDeps,'deadline'|'now'>)=>deps.deadline===null?Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY:deps.deadline.getTime()-deps.now().getTime();
async function allPages<T>(read:(cursor:string|null)=>Promise<Page<T>>):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;
 do{const p=await read(cursor);out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null);
 return out;
}
/** Eligible source of HK facts (spec §7.7 活动候选集): public Chinese HKEX periodic report of this issuer with a current extraction. */
const eligibleDocument=(d:DocumentRow,issuer:string)=>d.permission==='public'&&d.source==='hkexnews'&&d.language==='zh'&&d.issuer_id===issuer&&d.current_extraction_id!==null&&(d.doc_class==='annual_report'||d.doc_class==='interim_report');
const sourceConceptOf=(snippet:string,concept:string)=>{const s=cpSlice(snippet.trim(),0,256);return s.length>0?s:concept;};
const keyOfPayload=(p:FinancialFactPayload)=>({concept:p.concept,period_start:p.period_start,period_end:p.period_end,consolidation:'consolidated',unit:p.unit});
const byId=(a:CandidateRow,b:CandidateRow)=>a.candidate_id<b.candidate_id?-1:a.candidate_id>b.candidate_id?1:0;

export async function runHkFactsSync(deps:PromoteDeps,opts:PromoteOptions):Promise<HkIssuerOutcome[]>{
 const out:HkIssuerOutcome[]=[];const ids=[...new Set(opts.issuerIds)];const pubGen=opts.pubGen??HK_PUB_GEN;
 for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++){
  if(remaining(deps)<MIN_ISSUER_MS){
   for(const id of ids.slice(i))out.push({issuerId:id,runId:null,outcome:'skipped',code:'deadline_hit',counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[{code:'deadline_hit',key:id}],staged:0});
   break;
  }
  out.push(await promoteIssuer(deps,opts.batchId,ids[i],pubGen));
 }
 return out;
}

async function promoteIssuer(deps:PromoteDeps,batchId:string,issuer:string,pubGen:number):Promise<HkIssuerOutcome>{
 const {db,port,tables}=deps;
 const o:HkIssuerOutcome={issuerId:issuer,runId:null,outcome:'skipped',counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[],staged:0};
 const skip=(reason:string)=>{o.outcome='skipped';o.code=reason;o.errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:issuer,message:JSON.stringify({[reason]:1})});return o;};
 const [row]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer},{limit:1});
 const stockCode=typeof row?.hkex_stock_code_primary==='string'?row.hkex_stock_code_primary:null;
 if(!row||stockCode===null){o.outcome='failed';o.code='scope_unresolved';o.counts.failed=1;o.errors.push({code:'scope_unresolved',key:issuer});return o;}
 if(row.status==='merged')return skip('issuer_merged');
 await port.ensureHkScope(issuer,stockCode);
 if(!await port.claimLease(issuer,batchId,PROMOTE_LEASE_TTL_S))return skip('leased');
 let leaseHeld=true,released=false,published=false,abandoned=false;let runId:string|null=null;
 const nowIso=()=>deps.now().toISOString();
 const fail=(code:string,message?:string)=>{o.outcome='failed';o.code=code;o.errors.push(message===undefined?{code,key:issuer}:{code,key:issuer,message});o.counts.failed+=Math.max(1,o.counts.fetched-o.counts.quarantined);return o;};
 const cleanupFailed=(step:string,e:unknown)=>{o.errors.push({code:'cleanup_failed',key:issuer,message:`${step}: ${errMsg(e)}`});};
 // Only a still-staged run of OUR batch is abandoned here; after publish the run is immutable.
 const abandonOnce=async()=>{
  if(runId===null||!leaseHeld||published||abandoned)return;abandoned=true;
  try{await port.abandonRun(runId);}catch(e){if(isLeaseLoss(e)){leaseHeld=false;return;}cleanupFailed('abandon',e);return;}
  try{await port.abandonCandidatePublications(runId);}catch(e){cleanupFailed('abandon_publications',e);}
 };
 const release=async(outcome:'success'|'failed')=>{
  if(!leaseHeld||released)return;released=true;
  try{await port.releaseLease(issuer,batchId,outcome,nowIso());}catch(e){if(isLeaseLoss(e))leaseHeld=false;else cleanupFailed('release',e);}
 };
 const stop=async(code:string,message?:string)=>{await abandonOnce();await release('failed');return fail(code,message);};
 /** P2-7: same-batch claimLease extends our lease; false = another batch took over → lease_lost, nothing more is written. */
 const renew=async()=>{if(!await port.claimLease(issuer,batchId,PROMOTE_LEASE_TTL_S)){leaseHeld=false;throw new DocumentsDbError('lease_lost');}};
 const outOfBudget=()=>remaining(deps)<MIN_PHASE_MS;
 try{
  // ---- 0a: settle staged publications of this generation (no abandonRun on foreign runs)
  const leftover:string[]=[];
  const staged=await allPages(cursor=>db.publicationsOf({issuerId:issuer,pubGen,state:'staged'},{cursor,limit:1000}));
  for(const run of [...new Set(staged.map(p=>p.run_id))].sort()){
   const status=await port.runStatus(run);
   if(status==='published')await port.finishCandidatePublications(run);
   else if(status==='staged')leftover.push(run);
   else await port.abandonCandidatePublications(run);       // abandoned (or unknown) run: its rows can never publish
  }
  // ---- 0b: our run; spec-2 abandons the leftover staged runs under our lease
  runId=await port.beginRun(issuer,batchId,pubGen);o.runId=runId;
  // ---- 0c
  for(const run of leftover)if(await port.runStatus(run)==='abandoned')await port.abandonCandidatePublications(run);
  // ---- 1: planning snapshot
  const read=await port.readFacts(issuer,{concepts:[...HK_CONCEPT_IDS],asOf:nowIso().slice(0,10),history:true,includeNonOk:true});
  if(read.truncated)return await stop('read_truncated');
  const expectedRev=read.stateRev;
  // ---- 2: active set, what to stage, filings
  const docCache=new Map<string,DocumentRow|null>();
  const docOf=async(id:string)=>{if(!docCache.has(id))docCache.set(id,await db.documentById(id));return docCache.get(id)??null;};
  const pool=[...await allPages(cursor=>db.candidatesOf({issuerId:issuer,status:'confirmed'},{cursor,limit:1000})),...await allPages(cursor=>db.candidatesOf({issuerId:issuer,status:'promoted'},{cursor,limit:1000}))];
  const active:CandidateRow[]=[];
  for(const c of pool){
   if(c.kind!=='financial_fact'||c.extractor_kind!=='rule'||!c.checks_passed||c.extractor_ref!==HK_EXTRACTOR_REF)continue;
   const d=await docOf(c.document_id);
   if(d&&eligibleDocument(d,issuer)&&d.current_extraction_id===c.extraction_id)active.push(c);
  }
  const pubs=new Map<string,PublicationRow>();
  const activeIds=active.map(c=>c.candidate_id);
  for(let i=0;i<activeIds.length;i+=100){
   const part=activeIds.slice(i,i+100);
   for(const p of await allPages(cursor=>db.publicationsOf({candidateIds:part},{cursor,limit:1000})))if(p.pub_gen===pubGen)pubs.set(p.candidate_id,p);
  }
  const toStage=active.filter(c=>{const p=pubs.get(c.candidate_id);return p===undefined||p.state==='abandoned';}).sort(byId);
  const zeroDocs:DocumentRow[]=[];
  for(const id of [...new Set(await port.zeroOutputDocuments(issuer,pubGen))].sort()){
   const d=await docOf(id);
   if(d&&eligibleDocument(d,issuer))zeroDocs.push(d);
   else o.errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:`${issuer}:zero_output`,message:JSON.stringify({ineligible_document:id})});
  }
  o.counts.fetched=toStage.length;o.staged=toStage.length;
  if(toStage.length===0&&zeroDocs.length===0){await abandonOnce();await release('success');return skip('nothing_to_publish');}
  if(outOfBudget())return await stop('deadline_hit');
  await renew();
  const docs=[...new Map([...active.map(c=>docCache.get(c.document_id)!),...zeroDocs].map(d=>[d.document_id,d])).values()].sort((a,b)=>a.document_id<b.document_id?-1:1);
  const inserts:HkFilingInsert[]=[];
  for(const d of docs){
   const bound=await port.hkFilingOfDocument(d.document_id);
   inserts.push({filing_id:bound?.filing_id??randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,source:'hkex',origin:'hkex',formType:d.doc_class==='annual_report'?'annual':'semiannual',fiscalYear:d.fiscal_year,
    fiscalPeriod:d.fiscal_period==='FY'||d.fiscal_period==='H1'?d.fiscal_period:null,periodEnd:d.period_end,availableDate:d.available_date,sourceRef:hkFilingSourceRef(d),url:d.source_url});
  }
  const filingIds=await port.stageFilings(runId,inserts);
  const refOfDoc=new Map(docs.map(d=>[d.document_id,hkFilingSourceRef(d)]));
  const filingOfDoc=(documentId:string)=>{const f=filingIds.get(refOfDoc.get(documentId)??'');if(f===undefined)throw new Error(`filing_not_staged:${documentId}`);return f;};
  await port.bindFilingDocuments(runId,docs.map(d=>({filing_id:filingOfDoc(d.document_id),document_id:d.document_id})));
  // candidates → spec-2 FactCandidate (value, label snippet, locator)
  const citeIds=[...new Set(toStage.flatMap(c=>{const x=c.citations as FactCitations;return [x.value,x.label];}))];
  const cites=new Map<string,CitationRow>();
  for(let i=0;i<citeIds.length;i+=100)for(const r of await db.citationsByIds(citeIds.slice(i,i+100)))cites.set(r.citation_id,r);
  const factCands:FactCandidate[]=[];
  for(const c of toStage){
   const p=c.payload as FinancialFactPayload;const x=c.citations as FactCitations;
   const value=cites.get(x.value),label=cites.get(x.label);
   if(!value||!label)return await stop('evidence_failed',`citation_missing:${c.candidate_id}`);
   factCands.push({concept:p.concept,sourceConcept:sourceConceptOf(label.snippet,p.concept),statement:p.statement,periodStart:p.period_start,periodEnd:p.period_end,duration:p.duration,
    value:canonicalDecimal(p.value),unit:p.unit,consolidation:'consolidated',filingRef:refOfDoc.get(c.document_id)!,rawHash:hkRawHash(docCache.get(c.document_id)!.content_sha256,value)});
  }
  const plan=planHkFactWrites({existing:read.rows,openConflicts:await port.openConflicts(issuer),candidates:factCands,filingCandidates:inserts.map(toFilingInsert),filings:filingIds,issuerId:issuer,mappingGen:pubGen,mappingVersion:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF});
  if(plan.ambiguous.length>0)return await stop('plan_inconsistent',`ambiguous:${plan.ambiguous.length}`);
  // fact_id per candidate (R5-1): new rows first, then the snapshot, by candidate key
  const newByKey=new Map(plan.inserts.map(r=>[candidateKey({concept:r.concept,period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,consolidation:r.consolidation,unit:r.unit},r.filing_id,pubGen),r.fact_id]));
  const oldByKey=new Map(read.rows.map(r=>[candidateKey({concept:r.concept,period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,consolidation:r.consolidation,unit:r.unit},r.filing_id,r.mapping_gen),r.fact_id]));
  const factOf=new Map<string,string>();
  for(const c of toStage){
   const ck=candidateKey(keyOfPayload(c.payload as FinancialFactPayload),filingOfDoc(c.document_id),pubGen);
   const id=newByKey.get(ck)??oldByKey.get(ck);
   if(id===undefined)return await stop('plan_inconsistent',`unresolved:${c.candidate_id}`);
   factOf.set(c.candidate_id,id);
  }
  if(plan.inserts.length>0){
   const n=await port.stageFacts(runId,plan.inserts);
   if(n!==plan.inserts.length)return await stop('plan_inconsistent',`staged ${n} of ${plan.inserts.length}`);
  }
  for(const c of toStage){
   try{await db.stageCandidatePublication(c.candidate_id,pubGen,runId,factOf.get(c.candidate_id)!);}
   catch(e){if(codeOf(e)==='approval_revoked')return await stop('approval_revoked',c.candidate_id);throw e;}
  }
  const run=runId;
  // ---- 3: evidence for every NEW fact of this run, written while every new fact is still 'staged'
  //      (insert_fact_citations accepts staged facts only), i.e. BEFORE the same-day conflicts and
  //      contested joins are parked below; parked facts therefore carry their evidence too
  const newIds=new Set(plan.inserts.map(r=>r.fact_id));
  const evidence=new Map<string,{fact_id:string;citation_id:string;role:CitationRole}>();
  const add=(fact_id:string,citation_id:string,role:CitationRole)=>evidence.set(`${fact_id}|${role}|${citation_id}`,{fact_id,citation_id,role});
  for(const c of toStage){
   const f=factOf.get(c.candidate_id)!;if(!newIds.has(f))continue;
   const x=c.citations as FactCitations;
   add(f,x.value,'value');add(f,x.label,'label');add(f,x.unit,'unit');
   for(const p of x.period)add(f,p.citation_id,'period');
  }
  await renew();
  try{if(evidence.size>0)await port.insertFactCitations(run,[...evidence.values()]);}
  catch(e){if(isLeaseLoss(e))throw e;return await stop('evidence_failed',errMsg(e));}
  const park=(reasonCode:string,naturalKey:string,payload:Record<string,unknown>)=>quarantine(tables,{dataset:HK_FACTS_DATASET,table:'financial_facts',naturalKey,reasonCode,batchId,payload:{...payload,run_id:run}});
  for(const c of plan.conflicts){
   const item=await park('same_day_conflict',c.naturalKey,{key:c.key,fact_ids:[...c.newFactIds,...c.existingOkFactIds],values:c.values});
   await port.quarantineFacts(run,c.newFactIds,item);
  }
  for(const j of plan.contestedJoins)await port.quarantineFacts(run,j.factIds,j.itemId);
  // ---- 4: spec-2 statement rules, then the one HK publish entry point
  const parked=new Set(plan.quarantinedFactIds);
  const sourceRefOf=new Map(inserts.map(f=>[filingIds.get(f.sourceRef)!,f.sourceRef]));
  const rules=evaluateHkFactRules({newRows:plan.inserts.filter(r=>!parked.has(r.fact_id)),okRows:read.rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok'),sourceRefOf,issuerId:issuer,mappingGen:pubGen});
  for(const rq of rules.quarantine){
   const item=await park(rq.reason,rq.naturalKey,{key:rq.key,fact_ids:rq.factIds,rule:rq.rule,detail:rq.detail});
   await port.quarantineFacts(run,rq.factIds,item);
   for(const id of rq.factIds)plan.outcomes.set(id,'quarantined');
  }
  o.errors.push(...summarizeWarnings(rules.warnings));
  const manifest=[...new Set(docs.map(d=>filingOfDoc(d.document_id)))];
  // P1-4: the zero-output selection as planned (document + the current extraction planning saw);
  // publish_hk_run rechecks it under the document locks and raises stale_plan if it changed
  const zeroOutput=zeroDocs.map(d=>({document_id:d.document_id,extraction_id:d.current_extraction_id!}));
  if(outOfBudget())return await stop('deadline_hit');
  await renew();
  try{await port.publishHkRun(issuer,batchId,run,manifest,expectedRev,zeroOutput);}
  catch(e){
   if(isLeaseLoss(e))throw e;
   const c=codeOf(e);
   if(c==='evidence_incomplete'||c==='stale_plan')return await stop(c);
   return await stop('publish_failed',errMsg(e));
  }
  published=true;o.outcome='published';
  for(const v of plan.outcomes.values())o.counts[v]++;
  o.counts.duplicates+=plan.counts.duplicates;
  try{o.finish=await port.finishCandidatePublications(run);}
  catch(e){o.errors.push({code:'finish_failed',key:issuer,message:errMsg(e)});await release('failed');return o;}   // step 0a finishes it next time
  await release('success');
  return o;
 }catch(e){
  if(isLeaseLoss(e)){leaseHeld=false;if(published){o.errors.push({code:'lease_lost',key:issuer});return o;}return fail('lease_lost');}
  if(published){o.errors.push({code:'unknown',key:issuer,message:errMsg(e)});await release('failed');return o;}
  return await stop('unknown',errMsg(e));
 }
}

/**
 * One promotion of one issuer in its own documents-candidates batch (the admin confirm route, spec
 * §9: "confirmed 后立即跑一次"; the cron is the fallback). Without a code version nothing runs.
 */
export async function promoteIssuerNow(deps:PromoteDeps&{codeVersion:string|null},issuerId:string,triggeredBy:TriggeredBy):Promise<{state:'published'|'failed'|'skipped';message?:string;batchId?:string}>{
 if(!deps.codeVersion)return {state:'skipped',message:'code_version_unavailable'};
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'documents-candidates',dataset:'documents.candidates',toolVersions:{hk_pub_gen:String(HK_PUB_GEN),trigger:'decide'},codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy});
 let outcomes:HkIssuerOutcome[]=[];
 try{outcomes=await runHkFactsSync(deps,{issuerIds:[issuerId],batchId,triggeredBy});}
 finally{
  const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];
  for(const x of outcomes){for(const k of COUNTERS)counts[k]+=x.counts[k];errors.push(...x.errors);}
  if(outcomes.length===0)errors.push({code:'unknown',key:issuerId,message:'promotion_threw'});
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
 }
 const r=outcomes[0];
 return r.code===undefined?{state:r.outcome,batchId}:{state:r.outcome,message:r.code,batchId};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the cron route**

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/documents-candidates/route.ts
// Candidates / auto-decide / HK promotion trigger (spec §6.3, §7.3): CRON_SECRET bearer (same
// check as facts-sync), limit 1..200 (default 25), maxDuration 300 with a 240 s deadline handed to
// runDocumentsCandidates, which stops starting extractions / issuers when < 90 s / 60 s remain.
// Gated like documents-extract: DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED='1' or 403 (spec §12 degraded path —
// until the Vercel pdfjs smoke passes, extraction and candidates run only from local scripts).
// A missing VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA refuses the run. The HTTP receipt carries codes, keys and counts;
// never messages.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {CandidatesRunError,runDocumentsCandidates,supabaseCandidatesDeps} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import type {CandidatesReceipt} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000,DEFAULT_LIMIT=25,MAX_LIMIT=200;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function publicReceipt(r:CandidatesReceipt){
 const errs=(list:{code:string;key?:string}[])=>list.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key});
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,errors:errs(r.errors),idle:r.idle,auto:r.auto,
  extractions:r.extractions.map(e=>({extractionId:e.extractionId,outcome:e.outcome,code:e.code,inserted:e.inserted,written:e.written,inherited:e.inherited,quarantined:e.quarantined})),
  promote:r.promote.map(p=>({issuerId:p.issuerId,outcome:p.outcome,code:p.code,counts:p.counts,errors:errs((p as {errors?:{code:string;key?:string}[]}).errors??[])}))};
}
function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 if(url.searchParams.getAll('limit').length>1)return err('invalid_parameter:limit','limit may be given once',400);
 const limitRaw=url.searchParams.get('limit');
 let limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT;
 if(limitRaw!==null){if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(limitRaw)||Number(limitRaw)<1||Number(limitRaw)>MAX_LIMIT)return err('invalid_parameter:limit',`limit must be 1..${MAX_LIMIT}`,400);limit=Number(limitRaw);}
 if(process.env.DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED!=='1')return err('documents_disabled','Document extraction and candidates are not enabled (DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED)',403);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const deps=supabaseCandidatesDeps(getAdminSupabase(),{deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion});
  const receipt=await runDocumentsCandidates(deps,{limit,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',limit,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof CandidatesRunError?e.code:'candidates_failed','Documents candidates run failed',500);
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Implement `scripts/documents/promote-hk.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * HK fact promotion from the command line (spec §6.3, §7.7). No deadline; dry run by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/promote-hk.ts (--issuer <ticker|issuer_id>... | --due [--limit n]) [--pub-gen n] [--apply]
 *
 * --issuer accepts an issuer_id (uuid) or a ticker resolved by today's ownership (e.g. 0268.HK).
 * --due takes the issuers promotionDue selects (the cron's choice).
 * Dry run: per issuer the active candidate count (confirmed/promoted rule candidates) and the staged
 * publications of the generation; writes nothing. --apply opens one ingest_batches row
 * (documents-candidates / documents.candidates, triggered_by script; needs a code version) and runs
 * runHkFactsSync. --pub-gen overrides HK_PUB_GEN (owner-run generation bumps only).
 * Exit 0 on success, 1 when any issuer failed, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import type {BatchError} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import {allPages,supabaseCandidatesDeps} from '../../src/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import {runHkFactsSync} from '../../src/lib/documents/hk-facts/promote';
import {HK_PUB_GEN} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../src/lib/entities/resolve';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: promote-hk.ts (--issuer <ticker|uuid>... | --due [--limit n]) [--pub-gen n] [--apply]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const bad=(m:string):never=>{console.error(m);console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);};
interface Args{issuers:string[];due:boolean;limit:number;pubGen:number;apply:boolean}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={issuers:[],due:false,limit:25,pubGen:HK_PUB_GEN,apply:false};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--'))bad(`missing value for ${argv[i]}`);return v as string;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--issuer')a.issuers.push(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--due')a.due=true;
  else if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--pub-gen')a.pubGen=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else bad(`unknown argument: ${x}`);
 }
 if(a.due===(a.issuers.length>0))bad('give either --issuer or --due');
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>1000)bad('--limit must be 1..1000');
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.pubGen)||a.pubGen<HK_PUB_GEN)bad(`--pub-gen must be an integer >= ${HK_PUB_GEN}`);
 return a;
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true});
 if(args.apply&&!codeVersion)bad('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');
 const deps=supabaseCandidatesDeps(admin,{deadline:null,codeVersion});
 let issuerIds:string[];
 if(args.due)issuerIds=(await deps.port.promotionDue(args.pubGen,args.limit)).map(d=>d.issuerId);
 else{
  issuerIds=[];const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  for(const x of args.issuers){
   if(UUID.test(x)){issuerIds.push(x);continue;}
   const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:x},{today});
   if(!r)bad(`unknown ticker: ${x}`);
   issuerIds.push((r as {issuer_id:string}).issuer_id);
  }
 }
 if(!args.apply){
  const report=[];
  for(const id of issuerIds){
   const active=[...await allPages(c=>deps.db.candidatesOf({issuerId:id,status:'confirmed'},{cursor:c,limit:1000})),...await allPages(c=>deps.db.candidatesOf({issuerId:id,status:'promoted'},{cursor:c,limit:1000}))].filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact'&&c.extractor_kind==='rule');
   const staged=await allPages(c=>deps.db.publicationsOf({issuerId:id,pubGen:args.pubGen,state:'staged'},{cursor:c,limit:1000}));
   report.push({issuerId:id,active:active.length,confirmed:active.filter(c=>c.status==='confirmed').length,stagedPublications:staged.length});
  }
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'dry-run (no batch written; pass --apply to promote)',pubGen:args.pubGen,issuers:report},null,1));
  process.exit(0);
 }
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'documents-candidates',dataset:'documents.candidates',toolVersions:{hk_pub_gen:String(args.pubGen),trigger:'promote-hk'},codeVersion:codeVersion as string,triggeredBy:'script'});
 const outcomes=await runHkFactsSync(deps,{issuerIds,batchId,triggeredBy:'script',pubGen:args.pubGen});
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];
 for(const o of outcomes){for(const k of ['fetched','inserted','duplicates','versioned','quarantined','failed'] as const)counts[k]+=o.counts[k];errors.push(...o.errors);}
 const status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'apply',batchId,status,pubGen:args.pubGen,counts,issuers:outcomes},null,1));
 process.exit(outcomes.some(o=>o.outcome==='failed')?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

**Spec:** §9（候选列表/决定/再生/审批/港股隔离裁决/`citations?factId`）、§4.8 `resolve_hk_facts_quarantine`（R5-12）、§7.7 第 5 步、§12 样例 3、8
**Depends on:** Task 16、Task 13（`resolveHkFactsQuarantine`）、Task 11（`/api/citations/[id]` 同目录）

约定：所有管理路由先 `requireAdminUser()`，写路由再做 JSON 内容类型（415）与 Origin（403）校验——顺序与 `src/app/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]/route.ts` 相同；错误体 `{error:<code>}`；全部响应 `Cache-Control: private, no-store`；写成功后经 `research_audit_log` 审计，审计失败只记日志不改响应（同 dq 路由）。公共 `citations?factId=` 走 anon 客户端（RLS：只有 `status='ok'` 的事实、`fact_citations` 随事实可见、引用按 §4.12），错误体 `{error:{code,message}}` + `no-store`，成功 `successCacheControl(now)`。

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement `resolve.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/resolve.ts
// Admin verdicts on HK fact quarantine items (spec §4.8 resolve_hk_facts_quarantine, §7.7 第 5 步,
// §9 POST /api/admin/documents/hk-quarantine/[id], R5-12). Accept validates the verdict like
// dq/facts-resolver.ts (same_day_conflict: chosen ⊆ payload.fact_ids, one numeric value; identity
// items: every member) and calls the SQL function, which promotes and closes the hook
// ({stage:'done', state:'done', message:'hk_no_metrics'}) in the same transaction — HK has no
// metrics to materialize (R5-3). Reject is the generic plan-1 flip (fact rows stay quarantined).
// finalizeHkHooks repairs items accepted through the GENERIC route (/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]:
// spec-2 resolveFactsItem promotes but records hook 'no_target' failed for a market it does not
// know): every resolved_accept facts.hk item whose hook is not done gets the done hook. The
// candidates cron calls it at the start of its promote phase.
import {selectAll} from '../../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {resolveQuarantine} from '../../dq/quarantine';
import {decimalEquals} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import type {HkFactsPort} from './facts-port';

export const HK_FACTS_ITEM_DATASET='facts.hk';
const FACT_ROW_REASONS:readonly string[]=['same_day_conflict','identity_bs','identity_gp'];
export type HkResolveOutcome='resolved'|'not_found'|'already_resolved'|'not_hk_item'|'invalid_choice'|'run_pending';
export interface HkResolveInput{status:'resolved_accept'|'resolved_reject';chosenFactIds?:string[];resolvedBy:string}
export interface HkResolveResult{outcome:HkResolveOutcome;promoted?:number;skipped?:number;chosenFactIds?:string[]}
const codeOf=(e:unknown):string|null=>{const c=(e as {code?:unknown}|null)?.code;return typeof c==='string'?c:null;};
const membersOf=(item:Row):string[]=>{const p=(item.payload??{}) as {fact_ids?:unknown};return Array.isArray(p.fact_ids)?p.fact_ids.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'):[];};

export async function resolveHkFactsItem(port:Pick<HkFactsPort,'resolveHkFactsQuarantine'|'factsByIds'>,tables:TableClient,item:Row,input:HkResolveInput):Promise<HkResolveResult>{
 if(item.dataset!==HK_FACTS_ITEM_DATASET||item.table_name!=='financial_facts')return {outcome:'not_hk_item'};
 if(item.status!=='open')return {outcome:'already_resolved'};
 const id=String(item.id);
 if(input.status==='resolved_reject')return {outcome:await resolveQuarantine(tables,id,{status:'resolved_reject',resolvedBy:input.resolvedBy})};
 const reason=String(item.reason_code);const members=membersOf(item);
 let chosen:string[]=[];
 if(reason==='same_day_conflict'){
  chosen=[...new Set(input.chosenFactIds??[])];
  if(chosen.some(f=>!members.includes(f)))return {outcome:'invalid_choice'};
  if(chosen.length>1){
   const rows=await port.factsByIds(chosen);
   if(rows.some(r=>!decimalEquals(r.value,rows[0].value)))return {outcome:'invalid_choice'};
  }
 }else if(FACT_ROW_REASONS.includes(reason))chosen=[...members];
 try{
  const r=await port.resolveHkFactsQuarantine(id,chosen,input.resolvedBy);
  return {outcome:'resolved',promoted:r.promoted,skipped:r.skipped,chosenFactIds:r.chosenFactIds};
 }catch(e){
  const c=codeOf(e);
  if(c==='run_pending')return {outcome:'run_pending'};
  if(c==='invalid_chosen')return {outcome:'invalid_choice'};
  if(c==='not_hk_item')return {outcome:'not_hk_item'};
  if(c==='item_not_open')return {outcome:'already_resolved'};
  throw e;
 }
}

/** Closes the hook of every accepted facts.hk item that is not done yet; returns how many were fixed. */
export async function finalizeHkHooks(tables:TableClient,now:Date):Promise<number>{
 const rows=await selectAll(tables,'dq_quarantine',{dataset:HK_FACTS_ITEM_DATASET,status:'resolved_accept'},'id');
 let n=0;
 for(const r of rows){
  const detail=(r.detail&&typeof r.detail==='object'?r.detail:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
  const hook=detail.hook as {state?:unknown}|undefined;
  if(hook?.state==='done')continue;
  n+=await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:r.id as string,status:'resolved_accept'},{detail:{...detail,hook:{stage:'done',state:'done',at:now.toISOString(),message:'hk_no_metrics'}}});
 }
 return n;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the shared admin HTTP helper**

```ts
// src/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http.ts
// Shared conventions of the F3 admin routes (spec §9), copied from /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]:
// a write must be JSON (415) and a browser-sent Origin must be ours (403); bodies are
// {error:<code>}; every response is private, no-store (it answers a signed-in admin); the admin
// guard's AdminUnauthenticated / AdminForbidden map to 401 / 403, anything else to a logged 500.
// auditBestEffort writes research_audit_log like the dq route: the decision is committed already,
// so an audit failure is logged rather than turned into a 500 that would invite a retry.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated} from '../../admin/auth';
import {audit} from '../../research/store';
import type {ResearchSupabase} from '../../research/store';

export const PRIVATE_NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'private, no-store'} as const;
export const UUID_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
export const json=(body:unknown,status=200)=>NextResponse.json(body,{status,headers:PRIVATE_NO_STORE});
export const jsonError=(error:string,status:number)=>json({error},status);
/** null = the request may proceed. */
export function writeGuard(request:Request):NextResponse|null{
 if(!(request.headers.get('content-type')??'').toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json'))return jsonError('unsupported_media_type',415);
 const origin=request.headers.get('origin');
 if(origin!==null&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)return jsonError('forbidden_origin',403);
 return null;
}
export function adminFailure(e:unknown,tag:string):NextResponse{
 if(e instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return jsonError('authentication required',401);
 if(e instanceof AdminForbidden)return jsonError('admin role required',403);
 console.error(`[${tag}]`,e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
 return jsonError('unavailable',500);
}
export async function auditBestEffort(admin:unknown,userId:string,action:string,objectId:string|null,detail:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<void>{
 try{await audit({supabase:admin as ResearchSupabase,userId},action,objectId,detail);}
 catch(e){console.error('[admin/documents] audit failed',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);}
}
```

```ts
import {GET} from './route';

const FACT='f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',FILING='90000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',DOC='d0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',EXT='e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
type Rows=Record<string,Record<string,unknown>[]>;
/** Minimal PostgREST-shaped anon client: from(t).select().eq().order() is thenable; maybeSingle resolves the first row. */
function fakeAnon(data:Rows,failOn?:string){
 return {from:(t:string)=>{
  let rows=[...(data[t]??[])];
  const result=()=>failOn===t?{data:null,error:{message:'boom'}}:{data:rows,error:null};
  const q:Record<string,unknown>={};
  Object.assign(q,{select:()=>q,eq:(k:string,v:unknown)=>{rows=rows.filter(r=>r[k]===v);return q;},order:()=>q,
   maybeSingle:async()=>failOn===t?{data:null,error:{message:'boom'}}:{data:rows[0]??null,error:null},
   then:(ok:(v:unknown)=>unknown,ko:(e:unknown)=>unknown)=>Promise.resolve(result()).then(ok,ko)});
  return q;
 }};
}
const BASE:Rows={
 financial_facts:[{fact_id:FACT,concept:'revenue',period_start:'2025-01-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',unit:'CNY',value_text:'6256000000',filing_id:FILING,status:'ok'}],

 fact_citations:[{fact_id:FACT,role:'value',citation_id:'c-v'},{fact_id:FACT,role:'label',citation_id:'c-l'},{fact_id:FACT,role:'unit',citation_id:'c-u'},{fact_id:FACT,role:'period',citation_id:'c-t'},{fact_id:FACT,role:'period',citation_id:'c-h'}],
};
const cite=(id:string,page:number)=>({citation_id:id,document_id:DOC,extraction_id:EXT,page_no:page});
const get=(qs:string)=>GET(new Request(`https://alpha.example/api/citations?${qs}`));

 beforeEach(()=>{vi.clearAllMocks();mocks.anon=fakeAnon(BASE);mocks.citationsByIds.mockImplementation(async(ids:string[])=>ids.map(id=>cite(id,id==='c-v'?7:6)));});
 it('returns the fact and its evidence, one entry per fact_citations row (spec §12 example 3)',async()=>{
  const res=await get(`factId=${FACT}`);
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(/^public, s-maxage=\d+, stale-while-revalidate=600$/);
  const body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toMatchObject({factId:FACT,concept:'revenue',periodStart:'2025-01-01',periodEnd:'2025-12-31',unit:'CNY',valueText:'6256000000'});
  expect(body.citations).toEqual([
   {role:'value',citationId:'c-v',documentId:DOC,extractionId:EXT,pageNo:7},{role:'label',citationId:'c-l',documentId:DOC,extractionId:EXT,pageNo:6},
   {role:'unit',citationId:'c-u',documentId:DOC,extractionId:EXT,pageNo:6},{role:'period',citationId:'c-t',documentId:DOC,extractionId:EXT,pageNo:6},{role:'period',citationId:'c-h',documentId:DOC,extractionId:EXT,pageNo:6}]);
  expect(mocks.citationsByIds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['c-v','c-l','c-u','c-t','c-h']);
 });
 it('drops citations RLS does not show (§4.12)',async()=>{

 });
 it('400 unless exactly one uuid factId is given',async()=>{

   const res=await get(qs);expect(res.status,qs).toBe(400);expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:factId');
  }
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/candidates/route.ts
// GET admin candidate list (spec §9): one of status / extraction / issuer is required (extraction
// wins over issuer; a status next to an extraction filters that page). Each candidate carries its
// checks, every cited span (role, page, code-point range, snippet — a citation that cannot be read
// is listed with nulls), the document title and its publications. Cursor paging per §4.11.
import {requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {adminFailure,json,jsonError,UUID_RE} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http';
import {allPages} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/db';
import {DocumentsDbError} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import type {CandidateRow,CandidateStatus,CitationRow,DocumentRow,FactCitations,PublicationRow} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const STATUSES:readonly CandidateStatus[]=['candidate','confirmed','rejected','promoted'];
const PARAMS=['status','extraction','issuer','cursor','limit'] as const;

function citedIds(c:CandidateRow):[string,string][]{
 const x=c.citations as Partial<FactCitations>;const out:[string,string][]=[];
 for(const r of ['value','label','unit'] as const){const id=x[r];if(typeof id==='string')out.push([r,id]);}
 for(const p of Array.isArray(x.period)?x.period:[])out.push([`period:${p.role}`,p.citation_id]);
 return out;
}
function view(c:CandidateRow,cites:Map<string,CitationRow>,docs:Map<string,DocumentRow|null>,pubs:Map<string,PublicationRow[]>){
 return {candidateId:c.candidate_id,documentId:c.document_id,documentTitle:docs.get(c.document_id)?.title??null,extractionId:c.extraction_id,kind:c.kind,extractorKind:c.extractor_kind,
  extractorRef:c.extractor_ref,naturalKey:c.natural_key,status:c.status,decisionKind:c.decision_kind,decidedBy:c.decided_by,decidedAt:c.decided_at,approvalId:c.approval_id,inheritedFrom:c.inherited_from,
  checksPassed:c.checks_passed,checks:c.checks,payload:c.payload,
  citations:citedIds(c).map(([role,id])=>{const r=cites.get(id);return {role,citationId:id,pageNo:r?.page_no??null,charStart:r?.char_start??null,charEnd:r?.char_end??null,snippet:r?.snippet??null};}),
  publications:(pubs.get(c.candidate_id)??[]).map(p=>({pubGen:p.pub_gen,runId:p.run_id,factId:p.fact_id,state:p.state,updatedAt:p.updated_at}))};
}

export async function GET(request:Request){
 try{
  await requireAdminUser();
  const url=new URL(request.url);
  for(const k of PARAMS)if(url.searchParams.getAll(k).length>1)return jsonError(`invalid_parameter:${k}`,400);
  const status=url.searchParams.get('status'),extraction=url.searchParams.get('extraction'),issuer=url.searchParams.get('issuer'),cursor=url.searchParams.get('cursor'),limitRaw=url.searchParams.get('limit');
  if(status!==null&&!STATUSES.includes(status as CandidateStatus))return jsonError('invalid_parameter:status',400);
  if(extraction!==null&&!UUID_RE.test(extraction))return jsonError('invalid_parameter:extraction',400);
  if(issuer!==null&&!UUID_RE.test(issuer))return jsonError('invalid_parameter:issuer',400);
  let limit=100;
  if(limitRaw!==null){if(!/^\d{1,4}$/.test(limitRaw)||Number(limitRaw)<1||Number(limitRaw)>1000)return jsonError('invalid_parameter:limit',400);limit=Number(limitRaw);}
  const st=status as CandidateStatus|null;
  const where=extraction!==null?{extractionId:extraction}:issuer!==null?(st!==null?{issuerId:issuer,status:st}:{issuerId:issuer}):st!==null?{status:st}:null;
  if(where===null)return jsonError('invalid_parameter:status',400);
  const db=supabaseDocumentsDb(getAdminSupabase());
  let page;
  try{page=await db.candidatesOf(where,{cursor,limit});}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='invalid_input')return jsonError('invalid_parameter:cursor',400);throw e;}
  const rows=extraction!==null&&st!==null?page.rows.filter(c=>c.status===st):page.rows;
  const ids=[...new Set(rows.flatMap(c=>citedIds(c).map(([,id])=>id)))];
  const cites=new Map<string,CitationRow>();
  for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=100)for(const r of await db.citationsByIds(ids.slice(i,i+100)))cites.set(r.citation_id,r);
  const docs=new Map<string,DocumentRow|null>();
  for(const id of new Set(rows.map(c=>c.document_id)))docs.set(id,await db.documentById(id));
  const pubs=new Map<string,PublicationRow[]>();
  const cids=rows.map(c=>c.candidate_id);
  for(let i=0;i<cids.length;i+=100){
   const part=cids.slice(i,i+100);
   for(const p of await allPages(c=>db.publicationsOf({candidateIds:part},{cursor:c,limit:1000}))){const g=pubs.get(p.candidate_id)??[];g.push(p);pubs.set(p.candidate_id,g);}
  }
  return json({candidates:rows.map(c=>view(c,cites,docs,pubs)),nextCursor:page.nextCursor});
 }catch(e){return adminFailure(e,'admin/documents/candidates');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/candidates/[id]/route.ts
// POST human decision on one candidate (spec §9): {status:'confirmed'|'rejected'|'candidate'} →
// decideCandidate(human) (not_eligible / decided → 409; the SQL function is the authority on the
// allowed transitions and on checks_passed). Idempotent: a candidate already in the requested state
// (confirmed also matches promoted) is not decided again. After a confirm the issuer is promoted
// once right away (promoteIssuerNow, own batch); a failure there is reported in `run` and left to
// the candidates cron. Audited as document.candidate_decide.
import {requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {adminFailure,auditBestEffort,json,jsonError,UUID_RE,writeGuard} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http';
import {supabaseCandidatesDeps} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import {promoteIssuerNow} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/promote';
import {DocumentsDbError} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import type {CandidateStatus} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{id:string}>}
const DECISIONS=['confirmed','rejected','candidate'] as const;
type Decision=typeof DECISIONS[number];
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000;

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  const guard=writeGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
  const {id}=await params;
  if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return jsonError('invalid_id',400);
  const body:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const status=(body as {status?:unknown}|null)?.status;
  if(typeof status!=='string'||!DECISIONS.includes(status as Decision))return jsonError('invalid_status',400);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const deps=supabaseCandidatesDeps(admin,{deadline:new Date(Date.now()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion:resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false})});
  const current=await deps.db.candidateById(id);
  if(!current)return jsonError('not_found',404);
  const unchanged=current.status===status||(status==='confirmed'&&current.status==='promoted');
  let result:{status:CandidateStatus};
  if(unchanged)result={status:current.status};
  else{
   try{result=await deps.db.decideCandidate(id,{kind:'human',decided_by:user.id,status:status as Decision});}
   catch(e){
    if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&(e.code==='not_eligible'||e.code==='decided'))return jsonError(e.code,409);
    if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&e.code==='not_found')return jsonError('not_found',404);
    throw e;
   }
   await auditBestEffort(admin,user.id,'document.candidate_decide',id,{status,previous:current.status});
  }
  let run:{state:'published'|'failed'|'skipped';message?:string}={state:'skipped',message:unchanged?'unchanged':'not_confirmed'};
  if(status==='confirmed'){
   const doc=await deps.db.documentById(current.document_id);
   if(!doc?.issuer_id)run={state:'skipped',message:'no_issuer'};
   else{
    try{const r=await promoteIssuerNow(deps,doc.issuer_id,'manual');run=r.message===undefined?{state:r.state}:{state:r.state,message:r.message};}
    catch(e){console.error('[admin/documents] promote',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);run={state:'failed',message:'promote_error'};}
   }
  }
  return json({id,status:result.status,run});
 }catch(e){return adminFailure(e,'admin/documents/candidates');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/candidates/regenerate/route.ts
// POST regeneration request (spec §7.3, §9): {filter:{source?, issuer_id?, document_id?}} →
// requestCandidatesRegen (current extraction versions with candidates_role <> 'none' and a
// finished candidates status go back to pending); the next candidates run regenerates. Audited.
import {requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {adminFailure,auditBestEffort,json,jsonError,UUID_RE,writeGuard} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/db';
import type {CandidatesFilter,ListedSource} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const SOURCES:readonly ListedSource[]=['edgar','cninfo','hkexnews'];

function parseFilter(v:unknown):CandidatesFilter|null{
 if(v===null||typeof v!=='object'||Array.isArray(v))return null;
 const out:CandidatesFilter={};
 for(const [k,x] of Object.entries(v as Record<string,unknown>)){
  if(k==='source'){if(typeof x!=='string'||!SOURCES.includes(x as ListedSource))return null;out.source=x as ListedSource;}
  else if(k==='issuer_id'){if(typeof x!=='string'||!UUID_RE.test(x))return null;out.issuer_id=x;}
  else if(k==='document_id'){if(typeof x!=='string'||!UUID_RE.test(x))return null;out.document_id=x;}
  else return null;
 }
 return out;
}

export async function POST(request:Request){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  const guard=writeGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
  const body:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const filter=parseFilter((body as {filter?:unknown}|null)?.filter);
  if(filter===null)return jsonError('invalid_filter',400);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const requested=await supabaseDocumentsDb(admin).requestCandidatesRegen(filter,user.id);
  await auditBestEffort(admin,user.id,'document.candidates_regenerate',null,{filter,requested});
  return json({requested});
 }catch(e){return adminFailure(e,'admin/documents/candidates/regenerate');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/approvals/route.ts
// POST an extraction approval (spec §4.7, §9, owner decision C): the record that authorises
// auto-decisions for one extractor_ref at exactly these extractor/table/code versions and concepts.
// precision and recall are decimal strings in [0,1] compared exactly (scaled BigInt): either below
// 0.95 → 422 threshold before the database; the table's ea_threshold check is the final authority
// (its violation also answers 422). approved_by is the signed-in admin. Audited.
import {requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {adminFailure,auditBestEffort,json,jsonError,writeGuard} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/db';
import {HK_CONCEPT_IDS} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/checks';
import {toScaled} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/exact';
import {DocumentsDbError} from '@/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const RATIO=/^(0(\.\d{1,12})?|1(\.0{1,12})?)$/;
const text=(v:unknown,max=128)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>=1&&v.length<=max;
const atLeast=(v:string,min:string)=>{const {a,b}=toScaled(v,min);return a>=b;};

export async function POST(request:Request){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  const guard=writeGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
  const b=(await request.json().catch(()=>null)) as Record<string,unknown>|null;
  if(b===null||typeof b!=='object')return jsonError('invalid_body',400);
  const {extractorRef,extractorVersion,tableAlgoVersion,codeVersion,concepts,goldSha256,precision,recall,reportPath}=b;
  if(!text(extractorRef)||!text(extractorVersion)||!text(tableAlgoVersion)||!text(codeVersion))return jsonError('invalid_versions',400);
  if(!Array.isArray(concepts)||concepts.length===0||concepts.some(c=>typeof c!=='string'||!HK_CONCEPT_IDS.includes(c))||new Set(concepts).size!==concepts.length)return jsonError('invalid_concepts',400);
  if(typeof goldSha256!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(goldSha256))return jsonError('invalid_gold_sha256',400);
  if(typeof precision!=='string'||!RATIO.test(precision)||typeof recall!=='string'||!RATIO.test(recall))return jsonError('invalid_ratio',400);
  if(!text(reportPath,512)||!(reportPath as string).startsWith('docs/audits/'))return jsonError('invalid_report_path',400);
  if(!atLeast(precision,'0.95')||!atLeast(recall,'0.95'))return jsonError('threshold',422);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  let approvalId:string;
  try{
   approvalId=await supabaseDocumentsDb(admin).insertApproval({extractor_ref:extractorRef as string,extractor_version:extractorVersion as string,table_algo_version:tableAlgoVersion as string,code_version:codeVersion as string,
    concepts:concepts as string[],gold_sha256:goldSha256,precision,recall,report_path:reportPath as string,approved_by:user.id});
  }catch(e){if(e instanceof DocumentsDbError&&/ea_threshold/.test(e.message))return jsonError('threshold',422);throw e;}
  await auditBestEffort(admin,user.id,'document.approval_insert',approvalId,{extractor_ref:extractorRef,extractor_version:extractorVersion,table_algo_version:tableAlgoVersion,code_version:codeVersion,concepts,gold_sha256:goldSha256,precision,recall,report_path:reportPath});
  return json({approvalId},201);
 }catch(e){return adminFailure(e,'admin/documents/approvals');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/documents/hk-quarantine/[id]/route.ts
// POST verdict on an HK fact quarantine item (spec §9, R5-12): {status:'resolved_accept'|
// 'resolved_reject', chosenFactIds?} (chosenFactIds only with accept, ≤ 100 uuids). Accept →
// resolve_hk_facts_quarantine through resolveHkFactsItem (promotion + done hook in one
// transaction); run_pending 409, invalid_choice 422, not_hk_item 404, already_resolved 409. Reject →
// the plan-1 flip. The generic /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id] must not be used to accept facts.hk
// items (its hook records no_target); the candidates cron repairs such hooks (finalizeHkHooks).
import {requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {adminFailure,auditBestEffort,json,jsonError,UUID_RE,writeGuard} from '@/lib/documents/candidates/admin-http';
import {supabaseHkFactsPort} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/facts-port';
import {resolveHkFactsItem} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/resolve';
import type {HkResolveOutcome} from '@/lib/documents/hk-facts/resolve';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{id:string}>}
const RESOLUTIONS=['resolved_accept','resolved_reject'] as const;
const MAX_CHOSEN=100;
const HTTP:Record<HkResolveOutcome,number>={resolved:200,not_found:404,already_resolved:409,not_hk_item:404,invalid_choice:422,run_pending:409};

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  const guard=writeGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
  const {id}=await params;
  if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return jsonError('invalid_id',400);
  const body:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
  const status=(body as {status?:unknown}|null)?.status;
  if(typeof status!=='string'||!RESOLUTIONS.includes(status as typeof RESOLUTIONS[number]))return jsonError('invalid_status',400);
  const chosen=(body as {chosenFactIds?:unknown}|null)?.chosenFactIds;
  if(chosen!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(chosen)||chosen.length>MAX_CHOSEN||chosen.some(v=>typeof v!=='string'||!UUID_RE.test(v))))return jsonError('invalid_chosen_fact_ids',400);
  if(chosen!==undefined&&status!=='resolved_accept')return jsonError('chosen_fact_ids_not_applicable',400);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
  const [item]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id},{limit:1});
  if(!item)return json({id,outcome:'not_found'},404);
  const r=await resolveHkFactsItem(supabaseHkFactsPort(admin),tables,item,{status:status as typeof RESOLUTIONS[number],...(chosen===undefined?{}:{chosenFactIds:chosen as string[]}),resolvedBy:user.id});
  if(r.outcome==='resolved')await auditBestEffort(admin,user.id,'dq.quarantine_resolve',id,{id,route:'hk-quarantine',status,outcome:r.outcome,promoted:r.promoted??null,skipped:r.skipped??null,chosen_fact_ids:r.chosenFactIds??null});
  return json({id,...r},HTTP[r.outcome]);
 }catch(e){return adminFailure(e,'admin/documents/hk-quarantine');}
}
```

hk-quarantine 测试里 accept 调用的期望是 `{status:'resolved_accept',chosenFactIds:[F1],resolvedBy:ADMIN}`，与上面展开后的对象字段相同（无 `chosenFactIds` 时不出现该键）。

```ts
// src/app/api/citations/route.ts
// GET /api/citations?factId=<uuid> (spec §9, R5-4): the evidence of one published fact. Anon
// client, so RLS decides visibility: financial_facts shows only status 'ok'; the fact's filing
// must be on a published generation (mapping_gen > 0; an older generation's ok row is still
// served by id, spec §12 example 9); fact_citations are visible with their ok fact; the citation
// rows themselves pass through the §4.12 policy (public document + ok fact link), so anything RLS
// hides is dropped. Exactly one factId; errors {error:{code,message}} with no-store; success is
// public with successCacheControl. Part C owns /api/citations/[id].
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '@/lib/documents/db';
import {successCacheControl} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const UUID_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
interface Res<T>{data:T;error:{message:string}|null}
// Loosely typed on purpose (as src/lib/facts/db.ts): the hand-maintained Database type does not describe the F3 tables' relationships.
interface AnonClient{from:(table:string)=>any}
async function read<T>(p:PromiseLike<Res<T>>):Promise<T>{const {data,error}=await p;if(error)throw new Error(error.message);return data;}

export async function GET(request:Request){
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 const ids=url.searchParams.getAll('factId');
 if(ids.length!==1||!UUID_RE.test(ids[0]))return err('invalid_parameter:factId','factId must be given once as a uuid',400);
 const factId=ids[0];
 try{
  const anon=getAnonSupabase() as unknown as AnonClient;
  const fact=await read<Record<string,unknown>|null>(anon.from('financial_facts').select('fact_id,concept,period_start,period_end,unit,value_text,filing_id,status').eq('fact_id',factId).eq('status','ok').maybeSingle());
  if(!fact)return err('not_found','No published fact with this id',404);
  const filing=await read<{mapping_gen:number|string}|null>(anon.from('filings').select('mapping_gen').eq('filing_id',String(fact.filing_id)).maybeSingle());
  if(!filing||Number(filing.mapping_gen)<1)return err('not_found','No published fact with this id',404);
  const links=(await read<{role:string;citation_id:string}[]|null>(anon.from('fact_citations').select('role,citation_id').eq('fact_id',factId).order('role').order('citation_id')))??[];
  const wanted=[...new Set(links.map(l=>l.citation_id))];
  const db=supabaseDocumentsDb(getAnonSupabase());
  const rows=new Map<string,{citation_id:string;document_id:string;extraction_id:string;page_no:number}>();
  for(let i=0;i<wanted.length;i+=100)for(const r of await db.citationsByIds(wanted.slice(i,i+100)))rows.set(r.citation_id,r);
  const citations=links.filter(l=>rows.has(l.citation_id)).map(l=>{const r=rows.get(l.citation_id)!;return {role:l.role,citationId:r.citation_id,documentId:r.document_id,extractionId:r.extraction_id,pageNo:r.page_no};});
  return NextResponse.json({factId,concept:fact.concept,periodStart:fact.period_start,periodEnd:fact.period_end,unit:fact.unit,valueText:String(fact.value_text),citations},
   {status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':successCacheControl(new Date())}});
 }catch(e){
  console.error('[citations] factId',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return err('citations_unavailable','Citations unavailable',500);
 }
}
```

测试里 `fact_citations` 的五行按插入顺序返回（假客户端忽略 `order`）；真实库按 `(role, citation_id)` 排序，测试只断言假客户端下的顺序，不依赖排序语义。

设计要点：

- 编排层（必跑）：合成字节（`content_sha256` 是合成字节的真实哈希）→ `runDocumentsSync`（假适配器 + 假 `fetchBytes`，不联网）→ `runDocumentsExtract`（`extractPdf` 替身按字节哈希返回 `synthetic-annual.ts` 的版面）→ `runDocumentsCandidates(candidates,auto)` → 人工 `decideCandidate` → `runDocumentsCandidates(promote)`，全部写真实 PostgreSQL（`pgDocumentsDb`、`pgHkFactsPort`、`pgTableClient`；对象存储用内存实现，本地库无 Storage）。断言：锚点值与 `checks_passed`、候选对 anon 不可见、发布前值引用对 anon 不可见、发布后可见、`fact_citations` 角色齐全、`filing_documents` 绑定、`raw_hash` 定位串。
- 录制抽取层（条件）：`fixtures/hkex/2026090300863_c.pages.json` 存在时（执行期由指挥用 `record-fixture.ts --hkex <url>` 录制并提交），同一管道再跑这份真实版面，并对黄金文件中 `source.document_sha256` 等于该夹具头哈希的已录条目逐项断言。
- 黄金门（镜像规格二 `src/lib/facts/sync-us.integration.test.ts`）：`ready:false` 只告警不失败；已录条目照常断言；`ready:true` 强制 3 家 × 2 期 × 18 概念、无 `<pending>`、出处齐全、每个黄金文档哈希都有录制夹具。
- 合成版面的约定以 Task 14 的生成器为准（标签列 0、数值列 1–2、表头块含标题/期间/单位/年份行）；若 Task 14 文档化了不同约定（例如年份行作为表格单元格），**改 `synthetic-annual.ts`，不改锚点断言**。

```ts
// src/lib/documents/hk-facts/eval.ts
// HK gold-set scoring and offline candidate pipeline (spec §11.4, §11.3 真实字节验证).
// scoreHkFacts: precision = checks-passed candidates equal to their gold entry / checks-passed
// candidates that have a gold entry for the same (document_sha256, natural_key) — a gold 'missing'
// entry with a candidate counts in the denominator as a mismatch; recall = valued gold entries
// covered by an equal checks-passed candidate / valued gold entries. Pending gold entries and
// candidates without a gold entry (unscored) do not count. Ratios are integer arithmetic, floored
// to four decimals, canonical decimal strings (the approvals route compares them exactly).
// offlineHkCandidates runs generateHkCandidates + runHkChecks on a PagesJson without any database:
// citations are code-point slices of the page text kept in memory (integrity ok, current), prior
// facts and English candidates are empty — eval-hk-facts.ts --source fixtures and
// validate-extraction.ts use it. loadRecordedFixture reads record-fixture.ts output.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {BatchError} from '../../dq/batches';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {cpSlice} from '../extract/pages-json';
import {CLASSIFIER_GEN} from '../types';
import type {CandidateRow,DocumentRow,ExtractionRow,FinancialFactPayload,PagesJson} from '../types';
import {HK_CONCEPT_IDS,runHkChecks} from './checks';
import type {CheckRowResult,CitationCheck} from './checks';
import {generateHkCandidates} from './generate';

export const PENDING='<pending>';
export interface HkGoldEntry{issuer:{ticker:string};concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:'6M'|'12M'|'INSTANT';unit:string;value:string;
 source:{document_sha256:string;page:number|string;line_text:string};recorded_by:string;recorded_at:string|null}
export interface HkGoldFile{version:number;note?:string;ready:boolean;required:{HK:boolean};issuers:{ticker:string;documents?:{source_ref:string;document_sha256:string;period_end:string}[]}[];entries:HkGoldEntry[]}
export const isPendingGold=(e:HkGoldEntry)=>e.recorded_by===PENDING||e.value===PENDING||e.source.document_sha256===PENDING;
export const goldNaturalKey=(e:Pick<HkGoldEntry,'concept'|'period_start'|'period_end'|'duration'|'unit'>)=>`${e.concept}:${e.period_start??''}:${e.period_end}:${e.duration}:${e.unit}`;
/** Provenance a human must have written down; returns the missing fields. */
export const goldProvenanceGaps=(e:HkGoldEntry):string[]=>[
 ...(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(e.source.document_sha256)?[]:['source.document_sha256']),
 ...(e.source.page===PENDING||e.source.page===''?['source.page']:[]),
 ...(typeof e.source.line_text!=='string'||e.source.line_text===PENDING||e.source.line_text.trim()===''?['source.line_text']:[]),
 ...(e.recorded_at===null||e.recorded_at===PENDING||e.recorded_at.trim()===''?['recorded_at']:[]),
];

export interface ScoredCandidate{document_sha256:string;natural_key:string;value:string;checks_passed:boolean}
export interface HkEvalVersions{extractor_ref:string;extractor_version:string;table_algo_version:string;code_version:string}
export interface HkEvalMismatch{document_sha256:string;natural_key:string;gold:string;candidate:string|null;kind:'value_mismatch'|'missing_but_extracted'|'not_extracted'}
export interface HkEvalReport extends HkEvalVersions{gold_sha256:string;concepts:string[];precision:string;recall:string;
 counts:{considered:number;matched:number;gold_values:number;covered:number;unscored:number};mismatches:HkEvalMismatch[]}

/** n/d floored to 4 decimals as a canonical decimal string; 0 when d = 0. n, d are counts. */
export function ratio(n:number,d:number):string{
 if(d===0)return '0';
 const s=(BigInt(n)*10000n/BigInt(d)).toString().padStart(5,'0');
 return canonicalDecimal(`${s.slice(0,s.length-4)}.${s.slice(s.length-4)}`);
}
const same=(a:string,b:string)=>{try{return canonicalDecimal(a)===canonicalDecimal(b);}catch{return false;}};

export function scoreHkFacts(gold:HkGoldFile,goldSha256:string,candidates:ScoredCandidate[],versions:HkEvalVersions):HkEvalReport{
 const entries=gold.entries.filter(e=>!isPendingGold(e));
 const key=(sha:string,nk:string)=>`${sha}|${nk}`;
 const goldByKey=new Map(entries.map(e=>[key(e.source.document_sha256,goldNaturalKey(e)),e]));
 const passed=candidates.filter(c=>c.checks_passed);
 const candByKey=new Map(passed.map(c=>[key(c.document_sha256,c.natural_key),c]));
 const mismatches:HkEvalMismatch[]=[];let considered=0,matched=0,unscored=0;
 for(const c of passed){
  const g=goldByKey.get(key(c.document_sha256,c.natural_key));
  if(!g){unscored++;continue;}
  considered++;
  if(g.value==='missing'){mismatches.push({document_sha256:c.document_sha256,natural_key:c.natural_key,gold:'missing',candidate:c.value,kind:'missing_but_extracted'});continue;}
  if(same(g.value,c.value))matched++;
  else mismatches.push({document_sha256:c.document_sha256,natural_key:c.natural_key,gold:g.value,candidate:c.value,kind:'value_mismatch'});
 }
 const valued=entries.filter(e=>e.value!=='missing');
 let covered=0;
 for(const e of valued){
  const c=candByKey.get(key(e.source.document_sha256,goldNaturalKey(e)));
  if(c&&same(c.value,e.value))covered++;
  else if(!c)mismatches.push({document_sha256:e.source.document_sha256,natural_key:goldNaturalKey(e),gold:e.value,candidate:null,kind:'not_extracted'});
 }
 mismatches.sort((a,b)=>a.document_sha256<b.document_sha256?-1:a.document_sha256>b.document_sha256?1:a.natural_key<b.natural_key?-1:a.natural_key>b.natural_key?1:a.kind<b.kind?-1:1);
 const concepts=[...new Set(entries.map(e=>e.concept).filter(c=>HK_CONCEPT_IDS.includes(c)))].sort();
 return {...versions,gold_sha256:goldSha256,concepts,precision:ratio(matched,considered),recall:ratio(covered,valued.length),
  counts:{considered,matched,gold_values:valued.length,covered,unscored},mismatches};
}

export interface RecordedHeader{recorded_at:string;source_url:string;content_sha256:string;bytes:number;page_count:number;extractor_version:string;table_algo_version:string;pages_subset?:boolean}
/** record-fixture.ts output: {header, pages_json} or the header fields flat next to the PagesJson fields (the shape
 * record-fixture.ts writes). A --pages subset (pages_subset: true) is expanded to page_count pages, the pages not
 * recorded being empty (text ''), so it can stand in for a whole extraction (finish_document_extract wants pages
 * 1..page_count); recordedPageNos lists the pages that carry recorded text. */
export function loadRecordedFixture(raw:unknown):{header:RecordedHeader;pages:PagesJson;recordedPageNos:number[]}{
 const r=(raw??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
 const header=(r.header&&typeof r.header==='object'?r.header:r) as RecordedHeader;
 const pages=(r.pages_json&&typeof r.pages_json==='object'?r.pages_json:r) as PagesJson;
 if(!Array.isArray(pages.pages)||typeof header.content_sha256!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(header.content_sha256))throw new Error('recorded_fixture_shape');
 const recordedPageNos=pages.pages.map(p=>p.page_no);
 if(header.pages_subset!==true)return {header,pages,recordedPageNos};
 if(!Number.isInteger(header.page_count)||recordedPageNos.some((n,i)=>!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>header.page_count||(i>0&&n<=recordedPageNos[i-1])))throw new Error('recorded_fixture_shape');
 const by=new Map(pages.pages.map(p=>[p.page_no,p]));
 const full=Array.from({length:header.page_count},(_,i)=>by.get(i+1)??{page_no:i+1,width:null,height:null,text:'',lines:[],tables:[]});
 return {header,pages:{...pages,pages:full},recordedPageNos};
}

export interface OfflineDoc{content_sha256:string;source_ref:string;doc_class?:'annual_report'|'interim_report';language?:'zh'|'en';period_end?:string|null}
/** generate + check without a database (citations live in memory; prior facts and English candidates are empty). */
export async function offlineHkCandidates(pages:PagesJson,doc:OfflineDoc):Promise<{candidates:CandidateRow[];results:CheckRowResult[];info:BatchError[]}>{
 const now=new Date().toISOString();const documentId=randomUUID();const extractionId=randomUUID();const language=doc.language??'zh';
 const document:DocumentRow={document_id:documentId,issuer_id:null,source:'hkexnews',market:'HK',source_ref:doc.source_ref,source_version:1,supersedes_document_id:null,observed_replacement:false,form_type:null,
  doc_class:doc.doc_class??'annual_report',classifier_gen:CLASSIFIER_GEN,title:doc.source_ref,language,source_url:null,content_sha256:doc.content_sha256,bytes:1,mime:'application/pdf',storage_path:'',acquisition:{},
  published_at:now,published_at_precision:'instant',available_at:now,available_date:now.slice(0,10),fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:doc.period_end??null,filing_source_ref:null,
  permission:'public',owner_user_id:null,license_ref:null,status:'extracted',current_extraction_id:extractionId,extract_lease_until:null,extract_lease_batch_id:null,extract_attempts:1,batch_id:'offline',code_version:pages.code_version,created_at:now};
 const extraction:ExtractionRow={extraction_id:extractionId,document_id:documentId,extractor_version:pages.extractor_version,table_algo_version:pages.table_algo_version,code_version:pages.code_version,
  has_text_layer:pages.has_text_layer,page_count:pages.pages.length,pages_json_path:'',pages_json_sha256:'',candidates_role:language==='zh'?'primary':'comparison',candidates_status:'pending',
  candidates_attempts:1,candidates_lease_until:null,candidates_lease_batch_id:null,batch_id:'offline',created_at:now};
 const snippets=new Map<string,string>();
 const gen=await generateHkCandidates(pages,{document,extraction,cite:async at=>{
  const page=pages.pages.find(p=>p.page_no===at.page_no);
  const snippet=page?cpSlice(page.text,at.char_start,at.char_end):'';
  if(snippet.length===0)throw new Error('invalid_citation');
  const id=randomUUID();snippets.set(id,snippet);return id;
 }});
 const candidates:CandidateRow[]=gen.candidates.map(c=>({...c,candidate_id:randomUUID(),document_id:documentId,extraction_id:extractionId,checks:[],checks_passed:false,status:'candidate',
  decision_kind:null,decided_by:null,approval_id:null,decided_at:null,inherited_from:null,batch_id:'offline',created_at:now}));
 const verify=new Map<string,CitationCheck|null>([...snippets].map(([id,snippet])=>[id,{integrity:'ok' as const,currentExtraction:true,snippet}]));
 return {candidates,results:runHkChecks(candidates,{verify,priorFacts:[],enCandidates:[]}),info:gen.info};
}
/** Candidates + their check results → scoring rows of one document. */
export function scoredRows(sha:string,candidates:CandidateRow[],results:{candidate_id:string;checks_passed:boolean}[]):ScoredCandidate[]{
 const ok=new Map(results.map(r=>[r.candidate_id,r.checks_passed]));
 return candidates.filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact').map(c=>({document_sha256:sha,natural_key:c.natural_key,value:(c.payload as FinancialFactPayload).value,checks_passed:ok.get(c.candidate_id)??c.checks_passed}));
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/synthetic-annual.ts
// SYNTHETIC extraction layout for the orchestration layer of sync-hk.integration.test.ts (plan F3
// Task 18, spec §11.3): the three consolidated primary statements of a fictitious FY2025 annual
// report in the pages.json shape of spec §7.2 — normalised (NFKC) text, lines with code-point
// offsets, one table per page (label cell col 0, value cells cols 1–2) whose header block
// (company line carrying the supplementary-plane 𠀋, statement title, period line, unit line, year
// row) is kept as header_lines. It stands in for extractPdf's output on synthetic bytes; it is NOT
// a recording of a real filing (the real 0268.HK layout is recorded by record-fixture.ts).
// Offsets come from Array.from, never UTF-16 indexes. Conventions follow Task 14's generator
// (spec §7.5): every line carries its items; the year row's tokens sit over the value columns (period.ts maps header years by x); amounts are RMB thousands;
// brackets are negatives. SYNTHETIC_ANCHORS are what the generator must produce (× 1000; cost of
// sales and income tax as absolute values, cash flows as presented).
import type {LayoutCell,LayoutItem,LayoutLine,LayoutTable,PageLayout} from '../../types';

export const SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF='2026032599001_c';
const COL_X0=[50,300,420] as const;
const cp=(s:string)=>Array.from(s).length;
type Row=readonly [label:string,y2025:string,y2024:string];
interface Statement{title:string;period:string;rows:readonly Row[]}
const STATEMENTS:readonly Statement[]=[
 {title:'綜合損益表',period:'截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度',rows:[['收益','6,256,000','5,679,000'],['銷售成本','(2,100,000)','(1,950,000)'],['毛利','4,156,000','3,729,000'],
  ['經營溢利','300,000','250,000'],['所得稅開支','(50,000)','(40,000)'],['年內溢利','250,000','210,000']]},
 {title:'綜合財務狀況表',period:'於二零二五年十二月三十一日',rows:[['現金及現金等價物','1,500,000','1,200,000'],['資產總值','20,000,000','18,000,000'],['負債總額','8,000,000','7,500,000'],['權益總額','12,000,000','10,500,000']]},
 {title:'綜合現金流量表',period:'截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度',rows:[['經營活動所得現金淨額','900,000','800,000'],['投資活動所用現金淨額','(500,000)','(400,000)'],
  ['融資活動所用現金淨額','(100,000)','(150,000)'],['現金及現金等價物增加淨額','300,000','250,000']]},
];
function page(page_no:number,s:Statement):PageLayout{
 const head=['金蝶國際𠀋軟件集團有限公司(合成夾具)',s.title,s.period,'人民幣千元','2025 2024'];
 const lines:LayoutLine[]=[];const cells:LayoutCell[]=[];let pos=0;
 const span=(col:number)=>({x0:COL_X0[col],x1:COL_X0[col]+(col===0?220:90)});
 // one line from its items (C-1): items carry x and code-point offsets; the line text joins them with spaces
 const push=(index:number,parts:{text:string;x0:number;x1:number}[]):LayoutItem[]=>{
  const y=780-index*18;const items:LayoutItem[]=[];let off=pos;
  for(const p of parts){const n=cp(p.text);items.push({text:p.text,x0:p.x0,x1:p.x1,y,h:10,char_start:off,char_end:off+n});off+=n+1;}
  const text=parts.map(p=>p.text).join(' ');const n=cp(text);
  lines.push({index,y,x0:Math.min(...parts.map(p=>p.x0)),x1:Math.max(...parts.map(p=>p.x1)),text,char_start:pos,char_end:pos+n,items});
  pos+=n+1;return items;
 };
 head.forEach((text,index)=>{
  if(index===head.length-1)push(index,['2025','2024'].map((t,i)=>({text:t,...span(i+1)})));   // the year row sits over the two value columns
  else push(index,[{text,x0:COL_X0[0],x1:400}]);
 });
 s.rows.forEach((r,k)=>{
  const index=head.length+k;
  push(index,r.map((t,col)=>({text:t,...span(col)}))).forEach((it,col)=>cells.push({row:k,col,text:it.text,bbox:{x0:it.x0,y0:it.y,x1:it.x1,y1:it.y+10},line_index:index,char_start:it.char_start,char_end:it.char_end,numeric:col>0}));
 });
 const table:LayoutTable={header_lines:lines.slice(0,head.length),cells,row_count:s.rows.length,col_count:3,col_x0:[...COL_X0]};
 return {page_no,width:595,height:842,text:lines.map(l=>l.text).join('\n'),lines,tables:[table]};
}
/** Fresh objects on every call. */
export function syntheticAnnualPages():PageLayout[]{return STATEMENTS.map((s,i)=>page(i+1,s));}
export const SYNTHETIC_ANCHORS:readonly {natural_key:string;value:string}[]=[
 {natural_key:'revenue:2025-01-01:2025-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'6256000000'},
 {natural_key:'cost_of_revenue:2025-01-01:2025-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'2100000000'},
 {natural_key:'gross_profit:2025-01-01:2025-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'4156000000'},
 {natural_key:'total_assets::2025-12-31:INSTANT:CNY',value:'20000000000'},
 {natural_key:'operating_cash_flow:2025-01-01:2025-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'900000000'},
 {natural_key:'investing_cash_flow:2025-01-01:2025-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'-500000000'},
 {natural_key:'revenue:2024-01-01:2024-12-31:12M:CNY',value:'5679000000'},
];
```
