```ts
// src/lib/documents/sync-hk.integration.test.ts
// Plan F3 Task 18 / spec §11.3, on real PostgreSQL (pgDocumentsDb, pgHkFactsPort, pgTableClient;
// memory object store — the local harness has no Storage service). Orchestration layer: synthetic
// bytes (their content_sha256 is their real hash) → runDocumentsSync with a listing adapter and a
// byte fetcher that never touch the network → runDocumentsExtract whose extractPdf returns the
// committed synthetic layout for those bytes → candidates + checks → human decisions → promote
// into the spec-2 tables; evidence is invisible to anon until the run publishes. Recorded layer:
// when fixtures/hkex/2026090300863_c.pages.json exists (recorded by record-fixture.ts at execution
// time) the same pipeline runs on it and every recorded gold entry of that document is asserted.
// HK gold gate mirrors src/lib/facts/sync-us.integration.test.ts: ready:false warns, ready:true
// enforces the §11.4 matrix. The cases run in order and SHARE STATE; do not reorder them.
import {existsSync,readFileSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import type {PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {runDocumentsCandidates} from './candidates/run';
import type {CandidatesDeps} from './candidates/run';
import {runDocumentsExtract} from './extract/run';
import type {ExtractDeps} from './extract/run';
import {SYNTHETIC_ANCHORS,SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF,syntheticAnnualPages} from './fixtures/hkex/synthetic-annual';
import {HK_CONCEPT_IDS} from './hk-facts/checks';
import {goldNaturalKey,goldProvenanceGaps,isPendingGold,loadRecordedFixture} from './hk-facts/eval';
import type {HkGoldFile} from './hk-facts/eval';
import {pgHkFactsPort} from './hk-facts/pg-facts-port';
import type {HkFactsPort} from './hk-facts/facts-port';
import {memoryObjectStore} from './object-store';
import {pgDocumentsDb} from './pg-documents-db';
import type {SourceAdapter} from './sources/shared';
import {runDocumentsSync} from './sync';
import type {SyncDeps} from './sync';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,HK_PUB_GEN} from './types';
import type {CandidateRow,DocumentsDb,FinancialFactPayload,PageLayout} from './types';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const RECORDED_REF='2026090300863_c';
const HKEX_DIR=new URL('./fixtures/hkex/',import.meta.url);
const RECORDED=new URL(`${RECORDED_REF}.pages.json`,HKEX_DIR);
const recordedPresent=existsSync(RECORDED);
const GOLD=new URL('./fixtures/gold/hk-facts.json',import.meta.url);
const CODE='f3-integration';
const bytesOf=(tag:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(`%PDF-1.4\n% F3 sync-hk integration ${tag}\n%%EOF\n`);
const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const pdfUrl=(ref:string)=>`https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0325/${ref}.pdf`;
interface Doc{ref:string;title:string;headline:string;published:string;bytes:Uint8Array;pages:PageLayout[]}
/** sha256 → fixture file for every recorded fixtures/hkex/*.pages.json. */
function recordedFixtures():Map<string,string>{
 const out=new Map<string,string>();
 if(!existsSync(HKEX_DIR))return out;
 for(const f of readdirSync(HKEX_DIR).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.pages.json'))){
  try{out.set(loadRecordedFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(f,HKEX_DIR),'utf8'))).header.content_sha256,f);}catch{/* not a recorded fixture */}
 }
 return out;
}

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('F3 HK offline integration on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let db:DocumentsDb;let port:HkFactsPort;let issuer='';const adminUser=randomUUID();
 const store=memoryObjectStore();
 const listing:Doc[]=[];const layouts=new Map<string,PageLayout[]>();
 let syncDeps:SyncDeps;let extractDeps:ExtractDeps;let candDeps:CandidatesDeps;
 const adapter:SourceAdapter={source:'hkexnews',coverageGap:null,
  segments:()=>[{id:'2026',from:'2026-01-01',to:'2026-12-31'}],
  list:async()=>listing.map(d=>({source_ref:d.ref,source_url:pdfUrl(d.ref),title:d.title,form_type:`財務報表/環境、社會及管治資料 - [${d.headline}]`,headline:d.headline,published_at:d.published,precision:'instant' as const}))};
 const sync=()=>runDocumentsSync(syncDeps,{source:'hkexnews',limit:5,issuerIds:[issuer],sinceYear:2025,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script'});
 const docRow=async(ref:string)=>(await admin.query(`select document_id,issuer_id,market,language,doc_class,status,source_version,permission,mime,content_sha256,available_date::text available_date,current_extraction_id
  from public.disclosure_documents where source='hkexnews' and source_ref=$1 order by source_version desc limit 1`,[ref])).rows[0];
 const allCandidates=async(extractionId:string)=>{const out:CandidateRow[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;do{const p=await db.candidatesOf({extractionId},{cursor,limit:1000});out.push(...p.rows);cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null);return out;};
 const asAnon=async<T,>(fn:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{const c=await admin.connect();try{await c.query('set role anon');return await fn(c);}finally{await c.query('reset role').catch(()=>{});c.release();}};
 const valueCitation=(c:CandidateRow)=>(c.citations as {value:string}).value;

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
  issuer=randomUUID();
  await admin.query(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_zh,country_code,hkex_stock_code_primary) values($1,'金蝶國際(F3 整合測試)','KY','00268')`,[issuer]);
  await admin.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email) values($1,'f3-hk-admin@example.test') on conflict do nothing`,[adminUser]);
  db=pgDocumentsDb(admin);port=pgHkFactsPort(admin);
  await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:'00268'}]);
  const tables=pgTableClient(admin);
  syncDeps={db,tables,store,adapter,
   fetchBytes:async(u:string)=>{const d=listing.find(x=>pdfUrl(x.ref)===u);if(!d)return 'not_found';return {bytes:d.bytes,mime:'application/pdf',status:200,headers:{'content-type':'application/pdf','content-length':String(d.bytes.length)},fetchedAt:new Date().toISOString()};},
   now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE,userAgent:'F3 integration test'};
  extractDeps={db,tables,store,
   extractPdf:async(bytes:Uint8Array)=>{const pages=layouts.get(sha(bytes));if(!pages)throw new Error('no layout for these bytes');return {pages,hasTextLayer:true};},
   extractHtml:()=>{throw new Error('not in this suite');},
   now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE};
  candDeps={db,tables,store,port,now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE};
  const synth:Doc={ref:SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF,title:'截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度之年報',headline:'年報',published:'2026-03-25T08:30:00.000Z',bytes:bytesOf('synthetic'),pages:syntheticAnnualPages()};
  listing.push(synth);layouts.set(sha(synth.bytes),synth.pages);
 });
 // Documents, facts and filings are append-only and test:db builds a fresh database per run; only the scope row is retired.
 afterAll(async()=>{
  if(db&&issuer)await db.reconcileScope('hkexnews',[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:'00268'}]).catch(()=>{});
  await admin?.end();
 });

 it('sync stores the synthetic annual report once (zh, HK, annual_report); a second sync adds nothing',async()=>{
  const r1=await sync();
  expect(r1.status).toBe('success');
  const d=await docRow(SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF);
  expect(d).toMatchObject({issuer_id:issuer,market:'HK',language:'zh',doc_class:'annual_report',status:'stored',source_version:1,permission:'public',mime:'application/pdf',content_sha256:sha(listing[0].bytes),available_date:'2026-03-25'});
  expect([...store.objects().keys()].some(k=>k.includes(sha(listing[0].bytes)))).toBe(true);
  const r2=await sync();
  expect(r2.status).toBe('success');
  expect(Number((await admin.query(`select count(*) n from public.disclosure_documents where source='hkexnews' and source_ref=$1`,[SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF])).rows[0].n)).toBe(1);
 },120_000);

 it('extract stores the layout as the current extraction (primary, candidates pending); page lengths are code points',async()=>{
  const d=await docRow(SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF);

  const after=await docRow(SYNTHETIC_SOURCE_REF);
  expect(after.status).toBe('extracted');

  expect(ex).toMatchObject({candidates_role:'primary',candidates_status:'pending',has_text_layer:true,page_count:3});

  const rev=facts.find(f=>f.concept==='revenue')!;

  expect(rev.raw_hash).toMatch(new RegExp(`^hkex:${String(d.content_sha256).slice(0,16)}:${d.current_extraction_id}:p\\d+:c\\d+-\\d+$`));
  const roles=(await admin.query(`select role,count(*)::int n from public.fact_citations where fact_id=$1 group by role`,[rev.fact_id])).rows as {role:string;n:number}[];
  const n=(role:string)=>roles.find(x=>x.role===role)?.n??0;
  expect([n('value'),n('label'),n('unit')]).toEqual([1,1,1]);expect(n('period')).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  expect((await admin.query(`select fd.document_id from public.filing_documents fd join public.financial_facts f on f.filing_id=fd.filing_id where f.fact_id=$1`,[rev.fact_id])).rows[0].document_id).toBe(d.document_id);
  await asAnon(async c=>{
   expect((await c.query('select citation_id from public.document_citations where citation_id=$1',[valueCitation(revenue)])).rows).toHaveLength(1);
   expect(Number((await c.query('select count(*) n from public.fact_citations where fact_id=$1',[rev.fact_id])).rows[0].n)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
  });
  expect((await allCandidates(d.current_extraction_id)).filter(c=>c.status==='promoted')).toHaveLength(main.length);
 },120_000);

  const fixtures=recordedFixtures();
  if(!gold.ready){
   console.warn(`HK GOLD INCOMPLETE (ready:false, not failing): ${pending.length}/${gold.entries.length} entries still <pending>; recorded fixtures: ${fixtures.size}; incomplete provenance: ${gaps.join(' | ')||'-'}. Owner step (spec §14 黄金集抄录) blocks F3-4.`);
   return;
  }
  expect(pending.map(e=>`${e.issuer.ticker}/${e.concept}/${e.period_end}`),'pending entries in a ready gold file').toEqual([]);
  expect(gaps,'gold entries with incomplete provenance in a ready gold file').toEqual([]);
  const byIssuer=new Map<string,Map<string,Set<string>>>();

   (periods.get(e.period_end)??periods.set(e.period_end,new Set()).get(e.period_end)!).add(e.concept);
  }
  if(gold.required.HK)expect(byIssuer.size,'§11.4: at least 3 HK issuers').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
  for(const [t,periods] of byIssuer){
   const full=[...periods].filter(([,c])=>c.size>=HK_CONCEPT_IDS.length).map(([p])=>p);
   expect(full.length,`${t}: 2 periods carrying all 18 concepts (have ${[...periods].map(([p,c])=>`${p}:${c.size}`).join(', ')})`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
  }
  for(const s of new Set(gold.entries.map(e=>e.source.document_sha256)))expect(fixtures.has(s),`no recorded fixture for document ${s} (record-fixture.ts --hkex <url>)`).toBe(true);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/documents/sync-us.integration.test.ts

// gives the 8-K row (accession 0001321655-26-000039); runDocumentsSync stores the 8-K HTML as the
// main document and the synthetic index.json as its required filing_index asset in one call (no

// the real extractHtml splits the HTML into pages (no 200,000-character truncation, code-point
// lengths); a module citation of "Item 2.02" verifies ok and becomes visible to anon only after
// publish_citations. The cases share state and run in order.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const fixture=(rel:string)=>new Uint8Array(readFileSync(new URL(rel,import.meta.url)));
const SUBMISSIONS=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fixture('../research/ingest/__fixtures__/collectors/edgar-submissions-1321655.json'))) as {filings:{recent:Record<string,(string|number)[]>}};
const EIGHT_K=fixture('../research/ingest/__fixtures__/collectors/edgar-8k-pltr-20260803.htm');
const INDEX=fixture('./fixtures/edgar/index-000132165526000039.json');
const ACCN='0001321655-26-000039';
const CIK='1321655';
const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
/** Code-point index of the first occurrence of needle (never UTF-16 offsets). */
function cpIndexOf(text:string,needle:string):number{
 const cps=Array.from(text),n=Array.from(needle);
 for(let i=0;i+n.length<=cps.length;i++)if(n.every((c,k)=>cps[i+k]===c))return i;
 return -1;
}

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('F3 US document offline integration on real PostgreSQL',()=>{

 const asAnon=async<T,>(fn:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{const c=await admin.connect();try{await c.query('set role anon');return await fn(c);}finally{await c.query('reset role').catch(()=>{});c.release();}};

 });
 afterAll(async()=>{
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Evaluation and real-bytes validation scripts**

```ts
/**
 * HK gold-set evaluation (spec §11.4). Writes the report an extraction approval references.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/eval-hk-facts.ts [--gold <path>] [--source db|fixtures] [--fixtures <dir>] [--out <path>]
 *
 * --source db (default; service role): for every gold document (source.document_sha256) the current
 * extraction of the HKEX document with that content hash and its HK rule candidates as the pipeline
 * stored them (checks_passed as written). Versions come from the extraction rows and must be uniform.
 * --source fixtures (no database, no network): runs generate + checks offline on the recorded
 * fixtures/hkex/*.pages.json whose header hash matches (citations trivially ok; no prior/English
 * cross-checks) — a development aid, NOT approval evidence (its code_version is the fixture's).
 * Output: {extractor_ref, extractor_version, table_algo_version, code_version, gold_sha256, concepts,
 * precision, recall, counts, mismatches[]} to --out (default
 * docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/eval-hk-facts-<date>.json) and stdout.
 * Exit 0 when written, 1 when nothing is scorable or versions are mixed, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {existsSync,mkdirSync,readdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname,join} from 'node:path';
import {allPages} from '../../src/lib/documents/candidates/run';
import {supabaseDocumentsDb} from '../../src/lib/documents/db';
import {isPendingGold,loadRecordedFixture,offlineHkCandidates,scoredRows,scoreHkFacts} from '../../src/lib/documents/hk-facts/eval';
import type {HkEvalVersions,HkGoldFile,ScoredCandidate} from '../../src/lib/documents/hk-facts/eval';
import {HK_EXTRACTOR_REF} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: eval-hk-facts.ts [--gold <path>] [--source db|fixtures] [--fixtures <dir>] [--out <path>]';
const bad=(m:string):never=>{console.error(m);console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);};
interface Args{gold:string;source:'db'|'fixtures';fixtures:string;out:string}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={gold:'src/lib/documents/fixtures/gold/hk-facts.json',source:'db',fixtures:'src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex',out:`docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/eval-hk-facts-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--'))bad(`missing value for ${argv[i]}`);return v as string;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--gold')a.gold=next(i++);
  else if(x==='--source'){const v=next(i++);if(v!=='db'&&v!=='fixtures')bad('--source must be db or fixtures');a.source=v as Args['source'];}
  else if(x==='--fixtures')a.fixtures=next(i++);
  else if(x==='--out')a.out=next(i++);
  else bad(`unknown argument: ${x}`);
 }
 return a;
}
const uniform=(vs:HkEvalVersions[]):HkEvalVersions=>{
 const keys=new Set(vs.map(v=>JSON.stringify(v)));
 if(keys.size!==1){console.error(`mixed or missing versions across gold documents: ${[...keys].join(' | ')||'-'}`);process.exit(1);}
 return vs[0];
};

async function fromFixtures(dir:string,shas:string[]){
 const byHash=new Map<string,{file:string;raw:unknown}>();
 if(existsSync(dir))for(const f of readdirSync(dir).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.pages.json'))){const raw=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir,f),'utf8'));try{byHash.set(loadRecordedFixture(raw).header.content_sha256,{file:f,raw});}catch{/* skip */}}
 const rows:ScoredCandidate[]=[];const versions:HkEvalVersions[]=[];const missing:string[]=[];
 for(const s of shas){
  const hit=byHash.get(s);if(!hit){missing.push(s);continue;}
  const {pages}=loadRecordedFixture(hit.raw);
  const {candidates,results}=await offlineHkCandidates(pages,{content_sha256:s,source_ref:hit.file.replace(/\.pages\.json$/,'')});
  rows.push(...scoredRows(s,candidates,results));
  versions.push({extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,extractor_version:pages.extractor_version,table_algo_version:pages.table_algo_version,code_version:pages.code_version});
 }
 return {rows,versions,missing};
}
async function fromDb(shas:string[]){
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();const db=supabaseDocumentsDb(admin);
 const from=(admin as unknown as {from:(t:string)=>any}).from;
 const rows:ScoredCandidate[]=[];const versions:HkEvalVersions[]=[];const missing:string[]=[];
 for(const s of shas){
  const {data,error}=await from('disclosure_documents').select('document_id,current_extraction_id').eq('source','hkexnews').eq('content_sha256',s).order('source_version',{ascending:false}).limit(1);
  if(error)throw new Error(error.message);
  const doc=(data??[])[0] as {current_extraction_id:string|null}|undefined;
  if(!doc?.current_extraction_id){missing.push(s);continue;}
  const ex=await db.extractionById(doc.current_extraction_id);
  if(!ex){missing.push(s);continue;}
  const cands=(await allPages(c=>db.candidatesOf({extractionId:ex.extraction_id},{cursor:c,limit:1000}))).filter(c=>c.kind==='financial_fact'&&c.extractor_ref===HK_EXTRACTOR_REF);
  rows.push(...scoredRows(s,cands,cands.map(c=>({candidate_id:c.candidate_id,checks_passed:c.checks_passed}))));
  versions.push({extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,extractor_version:ex.extractor_version,table_algo_version:ex.table_algo_version,code_version:ex.code_version});
 }
 return {rows,versions,missing};
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const goldBytes=readFileSync(args.gold);
 const gold=JSON.parse(goldBytes.toString('utf8')) as HkGoldFile;
 const shas=[...new Set(gold.entries.filter(e=>!isPendingGold(e)).map(e=>e.source.document_sha256))].sort();
 if(shas.length===0){console.error('no recorded gold entries: nothing to score');process.exit(1);}
 const got=args.source==='db'?await fromDb(shas):await fromFixtures(args.fixtures,shas);
 if(got.versions.length===0){console.error(`no document found for any gold hash (missing: ${got.missing.join(', ')})`);process.exit(1);}
 const report={...scoreHkFacts(gold,createHash('sha256').update(goldBytes).digest('hex'),got.rows,uniform(got.versions)),source:args.source,missing_documents:got.missing,generated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
 mkdirSync(dirname(args.out),{recursive:true});
 writeFileSync(args.out,`${JSON.stringify(report,null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({out:args.out,precision:report.precision,recall:report.recall,counts:report.counts,missing_documents:got.missing},null,1));
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
/**
 * Real-bytes validation (spec §11.3, F3-4 exit condition; local only, never CI).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/validate-extraction.ts [--gold <path>] [--fixtures <dir>] [--out <path>]
 *
 * For every gold document hash with a recorded fixtures/hkex/*.pages.json: downloads header.source_url
 * (User-Agent EDGAR_USER_AGENT or the collectors' DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, 120 s timeout), requires
 * sha256(bytes) = header.content_sha256, runs the real extractPdf, compares every page's
 * text_hash (sha256 of the UTF-8 text) with the recorded layout, then runs generate + checks
 * offline and scores the result against the gold file. Report:
 * docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/real-bytes-validation-<date>.json (default --out).
 * Exit 0 when every document matched bytes and page texts, 1 otherwise, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {existsSync,mkdirSync,readdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname,join} from 'node:path';
import {extractPdf} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/pdf';
import {sha256Hex} from '../../src/lib/documents/extract/pages-json';
import {isPendingGold,loadRecordedFixture,offlineHkCandidates,scoredRows,scoreHkFacts} from '../../src/lib/documents/hk-facts/eval';
import type {HkGoldFile,ScoredCandidate} from '../../src/lib/documents/hk-facts/eval';
import type {Budget} from '../../src/lib/documents/sources/shared';
import {EXTRACTOR_VERSION,HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,TABLE_ALGO_VERSION} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import type {PagesJson} from '../../src/lib/documents/types';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/shared';

const USAGE='usage: validate-extraction.ts [--gold <path>] [--fixtures <dir>] [--out <path>]';
const bad=(m:string):never=>{console.error(m);console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);};
interface Args{gold:string;fixtures:string;out:string}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={gold:'src/lib/documents/fixtures/gold/hk-facts.json',fixtures:'src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex',out:`docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/real-bytes-validation-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.json`};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--'))bad(`missing value for ${argv[i]}`);return v as string;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--gold')a.gold=next(i++);else if(x==='--fixtures')a.fixtures=next(i++);else if(x==='--out')a.out=next(i++);else bad(`unknown argument: ${x}`);
 }
 return a;
}
const textHash=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const goldBytes=readFileSync(args.gold);const gold=JSON.parse(goldBytes.toString('utf8')) as HkGoldFile;
 const shas=[...new Set(gold.entries.filter(e=>!isPendingGold(e)).map(e=>e.source.document_sha256))].sort();
 const fixtures=new Map<string,string>();
 if(existsSync(args.fixtures))for(const f of readdirSync(args.fixtures).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.pages.json'))){try{fixtures.set(loadRecordedFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(args.fixtures,f),'utf8'))).header.content_sha256,f);}catch{/* skip */}}
 const ua=process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??'unknown';
 const budget:Budget={deadline:null,remainingMs:()=>Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY};
 const documents:Record<string,unknown>[]=[];const rows:ScoredCandidate[]=[];let ok=shas.length>0;
 for(const s of shas){
  const file=fixtures.get(s);
  if(!file){documents.push({content_sha256:s,error:'missing_fixture'});ok=false;continue;}
  const {header,pages:recorded,recordedPageNos}=loadRecordedFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(args.fixtures,file),'utf8')));
  const res=await fetch(header.source_url,{headers:{'User-Agent':ua},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(120_000)});
  if(!res.ok){documents.push({file,source_url:header.source_url,error:`http_${res.status}`});ok=false;continue;}
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const got=sha256Hex(bytes);
  if(got!==s){documents.push({file,source_url:header.source_url,error:'content_sha256_mismatch',expected:s,got});ok=false;continue;}
  const fresh=await extractPdf(bytes,budget);
  const recordedHash=new Map(recorded.pages.filter(p=>recordedPageNos.includes(p.page_no)).map(p=>[p.page_no,textHash(p.text)]));   // a --pages subset compares only its pages
  const mismatches=fresh.pages.filter(p=>recordedHash.has(p.page_no)&&recordedHash.get(p.page_no)!==textHash(p.text)).map(p=>p.page_no);
  if(fresh.pages.length!==header.page_count||mismatches.length>0)ok=false;
  const json:PagesJson={extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:codeVersion,content_sha256:s,has_text_layer:fresh.hasTextLayer,pages:fresh.pages};
  const {candidates,results}=await offlineHkCandidates(json,{content_sha256:s,source_ref:file.replace(/\.pages\.json$/,'')});
  rows.push(...scoredRows(s,candidates,results));
  documents.push({file,source_url:header.source_url,content_sha256:s,bytes:bytes.length,page_count:fresh.pages.length,recorded_page_count:header.page_count,compared_pages:recordedPageNos.length,text_hash_mismatches:mismatches,candidates:candidates.length,checks_passed:results.filter(r=>r.checks_passed).length});
 }
 const evaluation=scoreHkFacts(gold,createHash('sha256').update(goldBytes).digest('hex'),rows,{extractor_ref:HK_EXTRACTOR_REF,extractor_version:EXTRACTOR_VERSION,table_algo_version:TABLE_ALGO_VERSION,code_version:codeVersion});
 const report={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),code_version:codeVersion,ok,documents,evaluation};
 mkdirSync(dirname(args.out),{recursive:true});
 writeFileSync(args.out,`${JSON.stringify(report,null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({out:args.out,ok,documents:documents.length,precision:evaluation.precision,recall:evaluation.recall},null,1));
 process.exit(ok?0:1);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`extractPdf` 的预算类型以 Task 6 `sources/shared.ts::Budget` 为准（`{deadline:Date|null;remainingMs():number}`）；若 Task 9 给 `extractPdf` 定义了别的预算形状，按其类型构造（不限时）。

````markdown
pdf.js：`pdfjs-dist@4.10.38` legacy build，进程内运行；`getDocument` 总是带 `cMapUrl`/`cMapPacked`/`standardFontDataUrl`，目录是 `<cwd>/node_modules/pdfjs-dist/{cmaps,standard_fonts}/`（`src/lib/documents/extract/pdf.ts::pdfjsAssets`）。HKEX/巨潮报告的中文用 CID 字体，**没有 CMaps 抽不出一个汉字**（整合时对 0268.HK 2026 中期报告实测：带 CMaps 86 页、23,786 个 CJK 字符）。Vercel 上这两个目录由 `next.config.mjs` 的 `outputFileTracingIncludes`（`// F3` 块）随 extract/candidates/reprocess 三个路由打包。

## 2. 手动触发

脚本默认 dry-run（读库、可联网、**不写任何行/对象/批次/游标/租约**）；`--apply` 才写。cron 与同来源脚本不要同时跑（租约会让后到者 `skipped/leased`，但会浪费一次抓取）。

```bash
# 采集（无截止；--issuer 可重复，接受 issuer_id 或 ticker）
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/sync.ts --source hkexnews --issuer 0268.HK --since-year 2016
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/sync.ts --source hkexnews --issuer 0268.HK --since-year 2016 --apply
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/sync.ts --source edgar --limit 5 --forms 10-K,10-Q --apply
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/sync.ts --source cninfo --issuer 600519.SH --refetch --apply

# 抽取（--document 可重复）
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/extract.ts --limit 5 --apply
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/extract.ts --document <uuid> --apply

# 候选三阶段（默认 candidates,auto,promote）；只跑某些阶段用 --phases
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/candidates.ts --limit 10 --apply
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/candidates.ts --phases candidates --extraction <uuid> --apply

# 港股晋升（规格二运行模型）；--due 取 promotionDue 选出的发行人
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/promote-hk.ts --issuer 0268.HK
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/promote-hk.ts --due --limit 20 --apply

# cron 路由（部署后）
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "https://<host>/api/cron/documents-sync?source=hkexnews&limit=5"
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "https://<host>/api/cron/documents-extract?limit=1"
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "https://<host>/api/cron/documents-candidates?limit=5"
```

回执只含码、键与计数（不含消息正文）；完整错误在 `ingest_batches.errors`。

## 3. 重处理与再生

- **重抽取**（抽取器升级、页面损坏）：`POST /api/admin/documents/<id>/reprocess`，JSON `{"stage":"extract"}`。当前 `(EXTRACTOR_VERSION, TABLE_ALGO_VERSION)` 已有抽取 → 409 `revision_exists`（同版本不重抽；`document_pages` 只增不减）；否则文档回 `stored`、`extract_attempts=0`，`DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED=1` 时就地跑一次抽取，否则等 cron 或 `extract.ts --document <id> --apply`。旧抽取的引用保持 `integrity='ok'`、`currentExtraction=false`。
- **重分类**（分类规则升级）：`{"stage":"classify"}`；上传文档 409 `not_classifiable`。
- **候选再生**（`HK_LABEL_GEN` / `HK_RULES_VERSION` 升级、修复生成器后）：`POST /api/admin/documents/candidates/regenerate`，`{"filter":{"source":"hkexnews"}}`（或 `issuer_id` / `document_id`），或 `candidates.ts --regenerate --filter source=hkexnews --actor <admin uuid> --apply`。当前抽取版本中已完成（done/failed/exhausted）的回 `pending`；下次候选运行重新生成。人工决定按 `fingerprint` 继承到新候选；自动决定不继承（审批绑定 extractor_ref 与版本，规格 §7.3）。
- **发布代升级**（`HK_PUB_GEN`）：改常量后部署；`promotionDue` 条件 (ab)/(c)/(d) 让受影响发行人下次 cron 以新代重新发布；零输出文档的 filing 进 manifest 以隐藏旧代行（R5-13）。

## 4. 悬空批次、租约与卡住的行

工作者在 `finishBatch` 前被杀（Vercel 超时、OOM）会留下 `status='running'` 的批次。确认 `started_at` 早于 10 分钟（cron `maxDuration=300`）后标 failed：

```sql
update public.ingest_batches
   set status='failed', finished_at=now(),
       errors=errors || '[{"code":"orphaned_running","message":"marked failed by document-pipeline runbook §4"}]'::jsonb
 where producer in ('documents-sync','documents-extract','documents-candidates')
   and triggered_by='cron' and status='running' and started_at < now() - interval '10 minutes';
```

脚本批次（`triggered_by='script'`）无截止，可以合法地跑很久：先确认进程已不在，再去掉 `triggered_by` 条件单独处理。抽取、候选与晋升在每个写入阶段前续租（`renew_document_extract_lease` / `renew_candidates_lease` / 同批次 `claim_fact_sync_lease`，不计尝试次数）；租约过期且已被别的批次认领时，原批次在下一个写入阶段前得到 `lease_lost` 并停止写入（计划审计 P2-7）。

**租约不要手工清**：三类租约（`document_sync_scope.lease_*`、`disclosure_documents.extract_lease_*`、`document_extractions.candidates_lease_*`）TTL 600 s，到期后下一次 claim 自动接管；`extract_attempts` / `candidates_attempts` 在 claim 时计数，第三次失败后终态 `extract_failed` / `exhausted`。HK 晋升的规格二运行：本批次崩溃留下的 `staged` 运行由下一次 `beginRun` 在新租约下废弃（promote 第 0b 步），不要 `abandon_sync_run` 别人的运行。

查看：

```sql
-- 持有中的采集租约
select issuer_id, source, lease_batch_id, lease_until, last_status, last_attempt_at
  from public.document_sync_scope where lease_until > now() order by lease_until;
-- 抽取：等待中 / 已重试 / 终态失败
select status, count(*), max(extract_attempts) from public.disclosure_documents group by status;
select document_id, source, source_ref, extract_attempts, extract_lease_until
  from public.disclosure_documents where status='stored' and extract_attempts > 0 order by extract_attempts desc limit 50;
-- 候选：当前抽取的状态分布（只看 current_extraction_id）
select e.candidates_role, e.candidates_status, count(*)
  from public.document_extractions e join public.disclosure_documents d on d.current_extraction_id = e.extraction_id
 group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2;
-- HK 规格二运行与本规格发布行
select run_id, issuer_id, status, mapping_gen, batch_id, started_at from public.fact_sync_runs where market='HK' and status='staged';
select state, pub_gen, count(*) from public.candidate_publications group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2;
```

`candidate_publications` 长期 `staged` 且其事实 `quarantined`：等隔离项裁决（§8）；其运行已 `abandoned`：下一次 promote 第 0a 步会把它们转 `abandoned` 并重新暂存。

## 5. 孤儿对象

对象按内容寻址（`blobs/<sha256>.<ext>`、`extractions/<content_sha>/<pages_sha>.pages.json`），写行之前先上传；行写失败会留下无行引用的对象（无害：同字节下次复用）。只在需要回收空间时清理，先导出清单，**托管库**执行（本地 harness 没有 `storage.objects`）：

```sql
select o.name, o.created_at, (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint as bytes
  from storage.objects o
 where o.bucket_id = 'disclosure-docs'
   and o.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'
   and not exists (select 1 from public.disclosure_documents d where d.storage_path = o.name)
   and not exists (select 1 from public.document_assets a where a.storage_path = o.name)
   and not exists (select 1 from public.document_extractions e where e.pages_json_path = o.name)
 order by o.created_at;
```

删除经 Storage API（`supabase.storage.from('disclosure-docs').remove([...names])` 或控制台），不要直接 `delete from storage.objects`。不要删除任何被上面三列引用的对象（文档行与抽取行不可删，删对象会让 `file`/`layout=1` 永久 500）。

## 6. 回填与轮询游标

```sql
-- 每来源进度：回填完成数、到期数、失败数
select source, count(*) filter (where backfill_done) as backfilled, count(*) filter (where not backfill_done) as backfilling,
       count(*) filter (where next_due_at <= now() and priority > 0) as due, count(*) filter (where last_status='failed') as failed
  from public.document_sync_scope group by source order by source;
-- 某发行人的游标（{segment, last_ref, settled, attempts, seq}；{} = 从头/无进行中的窗口；按 source_ref 续跑，计划审计 P2-5）
select source, priority, reasons, fetch_key, backfill_done, backfill_cursor, poll_cursor, next_due_at, last_status
  from public.document_sync_scope where issuer_id = '<uuid>';
-- 回填卡在同一项（attempts[source_ref] 递增；第三次失败的项以 document_fetch_exhausted 隔离后前进）
select s.issuer_id, s.source, a.key as source_ref, a.value::int as attempts from public.document_sync_scope s
 cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(coalesce(s.backfill_cursor->'attempts','{}'::jsonb)) a
 where a.value::int >= 2 order by s.source;
```

EDGAR：`files[]` 未核对（`EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED=false`）时 `recent` 走完不置 `backfill_done`、回执 `coverage_summary`，`next_due=now+1d`——这是有意的，见 §10(a)。要让某发行人从头回填：只能经 `advance_document_cursor(…, p_cursor => null, p_done => false, p_reset => true)`（持租约；不带 `p_reset` 时游标只进不退——已完成的回填不能改回未完成、`seq` 必须递增，否则 `cursor_regression`，计划审计 P2-4）或等待 `reconcile` 新行；不要直接 `update document_sync_scope`。

## 7. 候选、检查、审批与自动决定

- 列表：`GET /api/admin/documents/candidates?status=candidate&issuer=<uuid>&limit=50`（`status` / `extraction` / `issuer` 至少一个；`extraction` 优先于 `issuer`；翻页带回 `cursor`）；决定：`POST /api/admin/documents/candidates/<id>`，`{"status":"confirmed"|"rejected"|"candidate"}`。`checks_passed=false` 的候选确认 → 409；`promoted` 不可回退。
- 审批（决策 C，默认无审批行、全部人工）：先跑评测（§10(f)），`precision` 与 `recall` 都 ≥ 0.95 才可能写入：`POST /api/admin/documents/approvals`，JSON `{extractorRef:'hk-facts/1/hk-facts/1.0', extractorVersion, tableAlgoVersion, codeVersion, concepts:[…], goldSha256, precision:'0.97', recall:'0.96', reportPath:'docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/eval-hk-facts-<date>.json'}`（版本串取评测报告里的值；`reportPath` 必须以 `docs/audits/` 开头；`precision`/`recall` 是十进制字符串）。低于阈值 → 422 `threshold`。撤销（没有管理路由；规格 §4.12 只给 `service_role` 直接 `update(revoked_at)`）：
  ```sql
  update public.extraction_approvals set revoked_at = now() where approval_id = '<uuid>' and revoked_at is null;
  ```
  撤销后，已自动确认但未发布的候选在下一次暂存时回到 `candidate`（`stage_candidate_publication` 提交回退并报 `approval_revoked`，该发行人的本次晋升整体废弃、下次重来）。
- 信息码（不降级批次，`src/lib/dq/batches.ts::F3_INFO_CODES`）：`locate_ambiguous`、`period_unparsed`、`unit_ambiguous`、`label_ambiguous`、`not_consolidated`、`restated_comparative`、`en_zh_mismatch`、`extractor_disagreement`、`llm_uncited`。持续出现的码按抽取查 `ingest_batches.errors`，修生成器后走 §3 再生。

## 8. 港股隔离项裁决

`dataset='facts.hk'` 的隔离项（`same_day_conflict`、`identity_bs`、`identity_gp`、`hk_restated_comparative` 等）**只能**经 `POST /api/admin/documents/hk-quarantine/<item id>` 接受：`{"status":"resolved_accept","chosenFactIds":[...]}`（≤ 100；只能选该项 `fact_ids` 中的值）或 `{"status":"resolved_reject"}`。接受在一个事务里提升所选事实并把钩子置 done（`resolve_hk_facts_quarantine`）；运行仍 `staged` → 409 `run_pending`（等它发布或被废弃后再裁决）；选择非法 → 422；非 HK 项 → 404。通用 `/api/admin/dq/quarantine/<id>` 对 `facts.hk` 项只会记 `no_target` 钩子；候选 cron 的 promote 阶段之前 `finalizeHkHooks` 会把这类钩子收尾为 `done/hk_no_metrics`，但事实**不会**因此被提升——误用后请再经专用路由处理。接受后下一次 promote 第 0a 步把对应发布行转 `published`。

## 9. 冒烟（上线抽取/候选 cron 之前，owner/指挥）

(a) **pdf.js on Vercel preview**（规格 §7.1、§15 问题 3）：
1. 推一个 preview 部署；只在 preview 环境设 `DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED=1`。
2. 预览库里有 `2026090300863_c`（0268.HK 2026 中期报告）的 `stored` 文档（`sync.ts --source hkexnews --issuer 0268.HK --apply` 指向预览库），以及 F3-1 实测页数最多的一份年报。
3. `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "$PREVIEW/api/cron/documents-extract?limit=1"` 两次（每次一份）。通过标准：回执 `status='success'`、`page_count` 与本机 `scripts/documents/smoke-pdf.ts <file.pdf>` 一致（0268：86）、函数未超时、Vercel 日志无 OOM；`GET $PREVIEW/api/documents/doc/<id>/pages/47?layout=1`（需会话）文本含 `簡明綜合中期利潤表`（CMaps 已打包；若中文全无，检查 `outputFileTracingIncludes` 与部署产物里的 `node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps/`）。若打包期报 pdf.js worker/ESM 错误：在 `next.config.mjs` 的 F3 块加 `serverExternalPackages:['pdfjs-dist']` 再试一次，结果记入本节。
4. 失败 → 降级（§12）：不加 cron 条目，抽取与候选只在本机脚本跑；记录失败形态。
(b) **Storage SDK 行为**（§15 问题 6）：对同一文档跑两次 `sync.ts … --apply --refetch`，第二次回执 `duplicates≥1` 且无 `object_put_failed`（`upsert:false` 的重复错误已归一为 `'exists'`）；`GET /api/documents/doc/<id>/file` 拿到签名 URL，立即下载 200，301 秒后再下载应失败（记下状态码与错误体）。
(c) 结论（日期、部署 URL、两份文档的耗时与内存、上面每一项的结果）写进本节末尾的"冒烟记录"。

**通过后（owner）**：在 `vercel.json` 的 `crons` 数组**末尾**追加两条，部署：

```json
{ "path": "/api/cron/documents-extract", "schedule": "45 * * * *" },
{ "path": "/api/cron/documents-candidates", "schedule": "25 * * * *" }
```

并在生产设 `DOCUMENTS_EXTRACT_ENABLED=1`。小时级 cron 需要 Vercel Pro（规格 §14）；未确认套餐前不要部署这两条。

## 10. 真实网络核对（指挥执行期；结果写本节与实施日志）

(a) **EDGAR**（§15 问题 1）：用一家公司（如 AAPL）录 `submissions` 的 `filings.files[]` 分页文件与一份申报目录 `index.json`，与 `src/lib/documents/sources/edgar.ts` 的假设对照；一致后另开提交把 `EDGAR_FILES_VERIFIED` 改 `true` 并补真实夹具用例（`sync-us.integration.test.ts` 当前用的是合成的 `fixtures/edgar/index-000132165526000039.json`）。
(b) **HKEX 英文搜索**（§15 问题 2）：录 `lang=en` 标题搜索页；整合时已确认 0268 的中期报告**只有一份中英双语 PDF**（`…_c.pdf`），`…_e.pdf` 返回 HTTP 200 的 HTML 错误页（同步按 `unexpected_mime` 隔离，不入库）。若英文搜索列出的仍是同一 `_c` 文件或不存在的 `_e` 文件，把 `src/lib/documents/deps.ts` 的 hkexnews 适配器设为 `languages:['zh']`（否则每个轮询窗口都会为 `_e` 产生一条 `unexpected_mime` 隔离项），并记规格 §17 偏差。
(c) **HKEX 条数上限**：核对标题搜索按年范围是否截断条数；截断则把 `yearSegments` 改短区间。
(d) **巨潮 `category`**（§15 问题 4）：以规格二核对结果为准，确认定期报告四类的取值与排除词。
(e) **三来源各 3 家 dry-run**（§13）：`sync.ts --source <s> --issuer <3 家> --since-year 2016`（不加 `--apply`），回执 JSON 存 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/dry-run-<source>-<date>.json`；记录首 20 个港股发行人的实测字节数与最大页数（决策 E）。
(f) **录制 0268 夹具**：
```bash
npx tsx scripts/documents/record-fixture.ts --hkex https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0903/2026090300863_c.pdf --pages 44-48,51-52
```
只存主表页（BS 44–46、IS 47、单独的综合收益表 48——保留它以便回放"综合收益表不作 IS"的真实路径、CF 51–52）；头部保留整份 `page_count=86` 与 `content_sha256`，`pages_subset:true`。输出行的 `cjk_chars` 必须 > 0（否则 CMaps 未生效，脚本 exit 1）。提交 `src/lib/documents/fixtures/hkex/2026090300863_c.pages.json`（约 0.4 MB），重跑 `npm run test:db`：`sync-hk.integration.test.ts` 的录制层随之运行。整合时用同一文件本机实测：带 CMaps 的抽取 + 生成 + 检查得到 32 条候选、全部 `checks_passed`，值与印刷版一致（如收入 3,625,422 千元、总资产 13,903,111 千元）。
(g) **黄金集与评测**：黄金集（3 家 × 2 期 × 18 概念，含页码与"缺失"）由实施者之外的人抄进 `src/lib/documents/fixtures/gold/hk-facts.json`，全部录完把 `ready` 置 true；然后
```bash
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/eval-hk-facts.ts --source fixtures
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/documents/validate-extraction.ts
```
报告落 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/{eval-hk-facts,real-bytes-validation}-<date>.json`（`validate-extraction` 对 `--pages` 子集夹具只比对已录页的 `text_hash`）。
(h) **引用回溯抽样**（§13）：F3-4 上线后随机抽 5% 已发布港股事实人工核对页码与片段，记 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-document-pipeline/citation-sampling-<date>.md`。

## 11. 回滚

先导出 `extraction_candidates`、`extraction_approvals`、`candidate_publications`、`fact_citations`、`filing_documents`（审计证据）。从 `vercel.json` 移除五条 `documents-*` cron 并部署。迁移二先于迁移一回滚：
1. 迁移二的函数：`publish_hk_run`、`assert_run_evidence_complete`、`bind_filing_documents`、`insert_fact_citations`、`finish_candidate_publications`、`abandon_candidate_publications`、`hk_promotion_due`、`hk_zero_output_documents`、`ensure_hk_fact_scope`、`resolve_hk_facts_quarantine`；表 `fact_citations`、`filing_documents`（触发器随表）；触发器函数 `fact_citations_guard`、`filing_documents_guard`。规格二的四处检查约束**只有在库里不再有任何 `market='HK'` / `source='hkex'` 行时**才能还原为 `('US','CN')` 与原取值；有 HK 行时保留扩展后的约束。
2. 迁移一的函数（`select proname from pg_proc … where proname in (…)` 按 `\df public.*document*`、`*candidate*`、`*citation*` 列出全部签名后逐个 `drop function`）；表按外键顺序 `candidate_publications` → `extraction_candidates` → `extraction_approvals` → `document_citations` → `document_pages` → `document_extractions` → `document_assets` → `disclosure_documents_public`（视图）→ `disclosure_documents` → `document_sync_scope`；触发器函数 `disclosure_documents_limited_update`、`document_rows_immutable`、`document_extractions_limited_update`、`document_citations_limited_update`、`extraction_candidates_lifecycle`、`candidate_publications_lifecycle`、`extraction_approvals_limited_update`。
3. 桶 `disclosure-docs`：Storage API 清空并删除（同 `data-foundation.md` §8.10 的桶说明）。
4. 演练：合并前在 `test:db` 的临时库上执行一次并确认清单为空。`ingest_batches` 中 `documents-*` 回执与 `dq_freshness` 的 `documents.*`/`facts.hk` 行保留。
````

把 `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-document-pipeline-design.md` §17 下的占位句 `（计划三-文档 落地后补记，格式同规格一 §14。）` 整体替换为（日期按实际落地日填写 `<YYYY-MM-DD>`）：

````markdown
（<YYYY-MM-DD>，计划 `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-document-pipeline.md` 落地后补记，格式同规格一 §14。）计划在分支 `claude/document-pipeline-3cfbb4` 实现，经 Claude 规格复审、质量复审与 Codex（gpt-6-astra，medium）审计。以下为与本规格文字的差异，均为有意决定：

| 规格条目 | 实施 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| §4.8 `request_document_extract(p_document, p_actor)` | 增加 `p_extractor_version`、`p_table_algo_version`；`DocumentsDb.requestExtract(document, actor)` 签名不变，适配器传入两个 TS 常量；文档已是 `stored` 时为无操作（不重置 attempts） | SQL 不知道 TS 常量；规格未写 `stored` 情形 |
| §4.8 `read_documents` | 增加 `p_all_versions boolean default false` | `versions=1` 与契约 `allVersions` 需要 |

| §4.8 `finish_document_extract` 的 `candidates_role` | 额外要求 `source='hkexnews'`（上传文档即使 `market='HK'` 也是 `none`）；页必须恰为 `1..page_count`、`char_count=length(text)`、`text_hash=sha256(utf8(text))` | §8.3 上传不产候选；完整性 |
| §4.8 `insert_candidates` "至少含 value" | `citations.value` 必须是字符串；`financial_fact` 另需 `label`/`unit` 字符串与非空 `period[]` | 证据完整性在写入时可检 |
| §4.6 候选回到 `candidate` | 同时清空 `inherited_from` | 规格未写 |
| §4.11 `approvalsFor` | 只返回未撤销的审批行；超过 `limit` 才抛 `too_many_approvals` | 规格未写 |
| §4.1 视图列 | `disclosure_documents_public` 另外不含 `extract_attempts`、`acquisition`（含 UA 等运维信息） | 公共读不需要 |
| §4.12 策略 | 九张表都有显式 `"<表> service read"` 策略（`service_role` 本身 `bypassrls`）；`document_citations` 的两条策略名 `"document_citations public read"` / `"document_citations service read"`，迁移二按名替换前者 | 与规格二一致 |
| §4.4 码点语义 / 测试库 | 共享 harness `scripts/s4/local-db.ts` 的 `initdb` 加 `--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C`（`// F3`） | 本机 `LC_ALL=C` 默认 `SQL_ASCII`，`length('𠀋')=4`；生产 Supabase 是 UTF8 |
| §4.9 `delete` 仅当 `pg_trigger_depth() > 0` | 守卫用 `pg_trigger_depth() < 2` → 拒绝 | BEFORE DELETE 触发器内直接删除时深度已是 1 |
| §4.9 `bind_filing_documents` | 校验 filing 后先查已有绑定（不同文档 → `binding_conflict`），再校验文档与 `source_ref`；`finish/abandon_candidate_publications` 对 `staged` 运行 → `run_pending`，对已 `abandoned`/`published` → `invalid_input`，运行不存在 → `not_found` | 否则 `binding_conflict` 不可达；规格未写的分支 |
| §4.11 `promotionDue` | SQL `hk_promotion_due(p_pub_gen, p_extractor_ref, p_limit)` 与 `hk_zero_output_documents(p_issuer, p_pub_gen)`；端口签名不变（传 `HK_EXTRACTOR_REF`） | 条件 (ab) 需要只在 TS 侧的常量 |
| §5.1 HKEX 中英两行 | 0268 的定期报告只有一份**中英双语** PDF（`_c`），`_e` 路径返回 HTTP 200 的 HTML 错误页；`language` 仍按后缀（`_c`→`zh`）记为元数据；下载按内容嗅探（`%PDF-` 魔数），HTML 按来源允许集隔离为 `unexpected_mime`，不入库；英文对照检查 `en_cross_check` 因此对这类文件为 `unavailable` | 真实字节核对（指挥，2026-11-06） |
| §5.2 替换版本 `available_at = fetched_at` | 由同步核心在插入前按 `documentVersions` 判定后写入 `p_doc`；联合公告（两个发行人列同一 `source_ref`）的极端竞争下可能取发布时间 | 函数内才知道是否"替换"，但 `p_doc` 由调用方给 |
| §5.4 分类 | 巨潮排除词（摘要/英文/更正/已取消/补充）也用于季报，接受"一季度报告/三季度报告"；EDGAR `SCHEDULE 13D/13G` 归 `ownership`；HK 期间字段只对定期报告类解析，`fiscal_year` = 期末日年份；HK `filing_source_ref` 恒 null（filing 的 `source_ref` 含版本，由晋升生成 `hkex:<ref>:v<n>`） | 实际表单名与命名 |
| §6.1 先 HEAD 再 GET | 一次 GET：`Content-Length` 超限即取消读取，否则流式读到上限即 `cancel()` | 请求数减半（HKEX 1 req/s），效果相同 |
| §6.1 `document_fetch_exhausted` payload "含三次错误" | 记 `attempts` 与最后一次 `{code,message}`；前两次在各自批次的 `errors` | 游标契约不存历史错误 |
| §6.1 `maxPerIssuer` / dry-run | 已知项（即使重新下载）不计入"新项"；dry-run 会下载待处理项正文以核对大小/MIME/哈希并预判 inserted/versioned/duplicates，但不写任何行、对象、隔离、游标、租约、批次、新鲜度 | 冒烟需要；规格只说"不上传、不建批次" |
| §6.1 轮询窗口未走完 | 段 id `poll:<from>`，游标保存该 id，下次从同一 `from` 继续；走完才清 | 规格未定 |
| §6.1 脚本无截止 | 每次写之前若同步租约 120 s 内到期即同批次续租，续租失败按 `lease_lost` | 长回填 |
````

### 自检（writing-plans）

- 占位：无 TODO/TBD/"similar to"；代码块中的 `…` 只出现在字符串、注释与"在某行之后插入"的定位片段里。
- 文件结构中的每个文件都由某个任务创建或修改（`2026090300863_c.pages.json` 与审计目录产物是指挥执行期产物，已注明）。
- 含 `S4_TEST_STATE` 的测试文件恰为四个，均在其任务里登记进 `criticalSuites`（Task 1、13、18）。
- 每个任务都有提交步骤（Task 1 两次提交：代码与最后的锁条目）。
- 依赖列只含更早的任务；没有任务修改更晚任务创建的文件（Task 10 的 `next.config.mjs` 只登记后续路由的路径字符串）。
